tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 23 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan na bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig snrogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ ——

'a 'dra dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug ste gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa chi kha 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyesabu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun snyonang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo ba grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtsho ni na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri 'i zhu las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par nu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes/ 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sprungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhu po/sa pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/— 3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i riskor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags rma/dzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las ga 'an gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs nga/'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i stor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu dhi~X 'grang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / g.yin yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / pi nyed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams nga/ lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bzhes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gzhin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhas bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rte nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang ma/nga du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang r+ṣa gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i zung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod r+ṣa po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen da /nga lo rno ga cig ༵ snro ༵ dzi ༵༵ pa'i shi/nga yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/༵ rjo gas sna/kau lha sna spya/ ༵nga rdo/ dag 'arngo grwa lta bang ༵ tsha yi ༵ ga sdu ༵ gas ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'bor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshe/gas mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/༵lha/ kū/ lja rjo dī ༵ mang ༵ dang ga/bka ༵ 'a / ༵ po ri ༵ sgro sna ba/༵ snaX par du tshwa~X shig sna smi kau~X ༵rdo rdo rjo rjo dzī sna/ rmi / ra byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khordo ra bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon to mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /g.yin yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ / dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

rdo rje rnal wor ma sgrub cing ma rdzo pa'i cho ga ngag 'don bzhugs/ 1rje btsun rdo rje rnal wor ma'i sreg blugs kyi 95/ba/ zhe skun bsdo / ba/spre5/ 39phag mo'i spyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/ 45rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs chung ba bzhugs/ 47rdo rje rnal wor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag bde wo dngu/‘5/ pa bsdo spya/ba/thas// 62rdo rje rnal 'byordo ra ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs/ 89nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ 92rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las ཿnga ba rdo rje phag mo'i sbri / ba thab tha5 bsdo kyib/rnga5/ 100rje bcun rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid bzhugs/ 120rje btsun rdo rje rnal wor ma bden gnyis zhal can sgrub cing mtshe byed pa'i skrudro ga bsdo/gas/ 128smon lam dang bkra shis bzhugs/ 176

sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa'i sgrub ma ce byed1 ngag 'a cadon bsdo kyigs/ 186rdo rje phag mo dpyal lugs kyi khrid yig dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 194'phrin las thams cad ཿnga ba'i sgrol ma gros pa don dam pa rtse ni spras/ sbyo/ 2ku rnga / sdon ba/bro sdo/ 218'phrin las thams cad ཿnga ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ 239sgrol ma ཿnga ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i rje sgron me zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/ 272sgrol ma rnal wor ma'i dkyil wor gyi sgrub thabs ye tre ni bro sdo sha rdo bzag ba ba ṭa kyib/rnga 5 / 285bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'ja / ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 309rje btsun sgrol ma rnal wor ma'i dkyil snyor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 345sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i khrid yig bde wo myur gter bzhugs/ 370

cho ga ngag 'don bzhugs/oX spru sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje zla bar rab chags kun rtog rab spangs phyogs kyi gos can ma/ /bden gnyi tra zung 'jug ma/chog tu sbyor bas khro zhing 'dod chags nyams brgya'i ros sgeg ma/ /bde chen myos byed bzlos gar bsgyur mkhas he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i nā ḍa ka /bde gshegs kun yum rnal 'byor ma dpal btud nas dpal mo de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di yi bsnyen pa tsam la yang / /man ngag gzhan las rtogs bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i/ /lag len mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /gnas dus bzang por maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung nyis brtsegs rdul tshon gyis bris la/ der mañji la ka pā la chang la bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang / me long la si / ra bkram/ gser gyi thur mas chos 'byung sogs rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'khor ltar 'bri/ steng nas dar dmar pos bkab/ nang gi gtor ma gnyis dang / dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams g.yon bskor tu bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / rol mo dang / rdor dril/ ḍā ma sa nang mchong gos zung sogs sgrub mchod kyi yo byad dang / bum pa/ dung chos/ gzungs thag chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga ste bum sgrub la dgos pa dang / mig dar/ me tog /ting lo/ maṇ+ḍal/ 'bru nas sogs slob ma la dgos pa rnams tshang bar byas la/sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oX sum+bha ni za huX hūX phaṭa/ oX gro hā gro hā huX huX phaṭa/ oX gro sna pā ya/ gro ni pā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūX hūX phaṭa/

oṃ su bha wa shurnyoX sarba dharmāX su bha wa shurnyo3haX/ oṃ āX hūX ha hoXhriX h+pha badz+ra a ra snyi ho/ dzaXhuX baX hoXbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya stuX/ dra khyo ho/ oṃ kha kha sku hi 'a hi/sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa/ ur+sha da/ a pa smra ra/ ḍā ka /ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i daX ba li kṛ sna n+tu sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme/ pra yas skyo/ ya thi baX/ya thi niX/ bhañja tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta yaX/ sa phyi khaX/bi shudha/ sa ha yi ka bha wastu hūṃ hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ḍā ki ni ar+ghaX/ pa byaX/ puspro dh+ra pe/ ā lo ke /ga rje/ ni bi ldu/ shasta āXhūX/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhūX/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sgyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'gyung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / kha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /spyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul —2—

mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod spyin tshogs bsog brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel dang cho se 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor wo po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung —3

po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang po rnams gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /sum bha drag tu bzlas la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor/de nas bsrung ba ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oX baX/ haX yoX/ hriX moX/ hre hriX/hūX hūX/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang / oX sum+bha nas/ badz+ra rā dza huX huX phaṭa/ ces lan gnyis brjod/ se gol phyogs bcur brdab pa/ tshams rngam lag len bzhin byas la bsrung 'khor du gyur pa mos par ni gnas bsrung ba'o/ /nang mchod su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung dang / raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lkoX āXhūX ha hoXhiX 'dir lag pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi rol mchod pa spro na byas kyang legs mod/ cho ga'i rim pa la mi dgos so/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oX āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong zhal zas rol mo rnams rgyu —4—

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ pā byiX/ tseXr+sha badz+ra put+pa āXhūX/ eXṭo badz+ra ga pe āXhūX/ tseX( badz+ra ā 'e1 ke āXhūX/ tseX( badz+ra ga rje ā skyoX/ oX badz+ra ni wi bye āXskyoX/ oṃ badz+ra sha p+ta āXhūX/ oX badz+ra spa ra khaX/ lkoX badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dhā spu ṭa pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta/nā da saX bha wa/ badz+ra dharma hriX da ya/ sa rnyo ṣa ṇi huX huX hūX ho ho ho a khaX swāhā/ de nas spro na zhu 'bul bya/skyabs 'gro ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi myangs la/ oX āXhūX zhes brjod/ tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad 'khordo ra ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya/rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum la 'byud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/—5—

zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bsnyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'phyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bye steng du huX dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka /sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka tī no pa nga ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su two stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ca sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taX shri yaX ku ru hūX/ ha ha ha ha hoXbha ga wā na/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa aXhūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzad cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje r+ṣa po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ / sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/de nas bla ma bsgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas —6—

bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying khar e e yongs su gyur pa las/chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/baX yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/badz+ra wa nā hi ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huX hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi lus thams cad gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg sbyangs/ lus kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam rdo rje la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa thur du sdigs pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas gdong gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ spo khung stso phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭāX ga la dril bu g.yer kha dang 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ khro chags 'dres pa/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgeg cing mdzes la nu 'bur rgyas shing sked skabs phra ba/ klu shing gi me tog sna lngas brgyan pa'i dbu skra nag po —7—

sil bur grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar o ba dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar ha yo sngon mo gzhin rje ma/ khar hri mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hre hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hū hū ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i rang bzhin no/ /de nas dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor la/ h+pha/ rang gi snying kha'i ba las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba o badz+ra sa mā dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ o yo ga shudha sarba dharmā sarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo ྅ ha/ de nas 'gro ba dag pa ni/ snying kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas byung /sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/yang 'od 'phros/ de rnams dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'ebyor ma thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa mnyes pa byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam/ de nas dang por ngag bzlas dang / phyi nas yid bzlas bya ste/snying kha'i sngags 'khor ram gsang ba'am lte bar bsgoms nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /mthar bsam mi khyab ni/ snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phre/sa/ khams gsum 'od kyi rnam par gyur/ tshur 'dus gzugs med khams pa thams cad rang lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams pa thams cad bar gyi cha la —8—

thim/ 'dod khams pa thams cad smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang snying kha'i zla ba la/ de sngags 'che/nga la/ de yang ba la/ de yang thig le la/ de yang nā dar gyur/nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ de la blo bzhag slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod spro na mchod bstod cung zad byas la/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gse1la/ ces gsol ba btab ste bdag bskyed do/ /de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su ka las thod pa dkar bo dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba nang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du gnas pa'i lte ba'i hu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor ba/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ba yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du o oṃ oṃ nas swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lko pa nas/—9—

tsakhri ka'i rang bzhin dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying khar huX/ h+pha nas/ yo ga shurnyo3haX gi bar sngar bzhi byed/ thugs ka'i baX yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/slar 'dus snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge la thim/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba bto/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes mgron spyan drangs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhūX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX/ pā ju/ pulge dh+wa pe/ ā lo keg rnye/ ni wi rkye/ shasta āXhuX/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ ༄de nas ma rdzo pa 'bul ba ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra ca —10—

swāhā/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badz+ra pu byaX pra ca swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badz+ra pukhye pra ca ā ༷hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan dan ga bur dang bcasapa'i/ /dri zhim spos me dge ba yi/ / mthu dang ldan pa bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ nas/ dh+ra paX: oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par ༄byed/ /a yig mig 'byed bkra shis pa'i/ /mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ dī paX: oṃ sna tsho gos lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga bur rnam brgyan pa/ /sna tsho gis yi ge hūṃ las byung / /dri 'di 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /gan sgyi: /oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ ni wi du: oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang / /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/ / 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badz+ra shasta:gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha re re la yang zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ nas/ wasta phya: oṃ lī na badz+ra ṇi hūX āXrdo rje lha mo pi waX ma/ /ston mkha'i —11—

mdog mtshungs pi waX lag /pi waX sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra swe ni badz+re ṇi pu dzi te ā hūX/ oṃ waX se badz+re ṇi huX āX rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma/ /gser gyi mdog can gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas: /waX se: /oṃ mṛ ti gi badz+re ṇi hūX āX rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma/ /ban dha'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab /mṛ ti gi: /oṃ murdzi /rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs rdza'i rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang : /nam mkha' /murdzi: /oṃ ha su rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo/ /ke shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangasajenam mkha' khyab: /ha phye: oṃ lā su:rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo/ /dbang sngon mdog mthongs sgeg pa'i tshul/ /bsnyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan pa/ /nam mkha': /lā su: /oṃ girti: /rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma/ /'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra ldan pa/ /nam mkha': /kirti: /oṃ nirti: /rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs gar mdzad ma/ /lag pa gar byed rkang stabs sgyur/ /nam mkha': /nirti: oṃ pulgo rdo rje lha mo me rtag ma/ /gur kum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha': /pur+sha oṃ dh+wa pe: rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha': /dhu peje.oṃ dī pe: /rdo rje lha mo mar me ma/ /glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab: /dī pe /oṃ gan khyu: sha—12—

rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma/ /pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang —rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha /gan dhi oX rū pa rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog mtshungs me long lag /yid 'ong gzugs dang rgyan ldan pa/ /nam mkha: /rū pa oX ra sa rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma/ /dza ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma/ /ma mkha': /ra sa oṃ spar+sha: rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'byud par ldan/ /nam mkha': /spar+sha: oX dharma dh+wa tu ba dzī ṇi hūX āX rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma/ /kuna'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag /zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra dharma dh+wa tu badz+re ṇi pū dzi te aXskyoX/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī na sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pu dzi te āXhuX/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun chad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ nas ma ṇi rat+na pu dzi te: /btsun mo: /ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ khres rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa sti/ /blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /mahā ta/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing/ /—13—

bla med theg pa rab bzhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti rat+na/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /tu re ga a shwa rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongasadagra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khas rat+na: kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī na sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pu dzi te ya/༷༷rdo// phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin dang / /yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor: /bzhes shig: shasta kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sprul snying dang / /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos dkyil: /bzhes shig bla: /ga rje/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos /bzhes shig: /ra sa: /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos/bzhes shig: /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra spar+sha kā ma gu na pu dzi te āXhuX/oṃ āXhūṃ ha ho3sdiX phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshe/gas pa —14—

thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ ā hu/ khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje phag mo bde chen bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong nyams kyis myos pa'i dril bu pa/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul oṃ ā hū/ chang 'tshong mkha' 'gro'i yab gyur ḍi gi pa/ /bar ma'i slob dpon mchog grags rnam rgyal zhabs/ /brtul zhugs rig pa'i rnal 'byor ti lo pa/ /rnam dag: /paṇa grub mkha' spyod gshegs pa'i nā ro pa/ /de sras thu bo pham thing sku mched gnyis/ /skad gnyid smra mkhas lo tsā rnam gnyis la/ /rnam dag /khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma sa skya pa/ /rig 'dzin mkha' spyod dbang po bsod nams rtse/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /rnam dag: /dri med mngon par sangs rgyas sa paṇa chen/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba las grol zhang pa la/ /rnam dag: /rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gdams pa'i gter mjodi dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ /rnam dag: /chos kyi rje bo ye shes rgyal mawo dpal/ /sdom brtson rdo rje 'dzin mchog ngor chen pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug la/ /rnam dag: /rje btsun sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma'i mchog /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa'i rje/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /rnam dag: /oṃ ā hū/—15—

yang na ngor chen pa'i rjes la/ 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen shākya'i mtshan/ /rnam dag: /gzhon nu chos grub byin rlabs yid bzhin gter/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs/ /rnam dag ye shes thugs mnga' rdo rings dbon/ /rnam dag: /yang na chos rje bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su/ nus pa mthar phyin mkhan po sangs rgyas skyabs/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims dang / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag skam dgon pa/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin du chos rje bla ma sa skya bu ston/ theg chen chos rje sbyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ yon tan rgyal mtshan pa/ gzhon nu chos grub man sngar bzhin/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i khyad par sna tshogs yod pas ji ltar 'dod par sbyar ro/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus don dam dga' bzhi'i dngos/ /brtan g.yo'i snying po gcig gyur gsal mdzad pa/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag: /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bla ma/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oX āXhūX/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /yum gyur sgyu 'phrul chen mo bcom ldan ma/ /mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje phag mo la/ /rnam bdag: /bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi: oṃ shrī rā dza shrī rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thamyus cad kyi g.yin yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes —16—

pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / wo dho dang nye ba'i rgo dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams sa kya zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi: gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ spyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi /gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khore dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi: 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta snya da na badz+ra su bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes bdu da rtsi myangs/ tseX( tseXtshe / tseX( sarba sogs lan lnga tsam byed/lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed —17—

yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya ho/ na maXs man+ta bzhi nāX/ asti sma ra spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX/ dharma dh+wa tu a ka sha sa man+ta maX/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shodha le maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ni dhi pū rkye dz+nya na ba le naX/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na sa sta sko s+tha na ba len tsa ye swāhā/de nas bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo skyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ kha gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hi waX huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te tri lo kya ma te mahā bi bye shwa ri ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na maXsarba bhu ta bha ya wa he mahā badz+re hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba juX ka ri ni tra bh+ra ma ni hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na maXmeg ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka ra li zhe huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na ma sta sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye nga ni nga ni mo ha ni huX huX phaṭa/oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hi mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūX hūX phaṭa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma/ /chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos/ /zag med bde stong lhan cig skyes ma'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mo sna tshogs bde ma dang / /bdag med ye shes dbang —18—

phyug sna dzogs yum/ /rdo rje sgrol ma ro langs ma— la sogs/ /sna tshogs mtshan 'chang khyod la phyag: /e yig dpal ldan pad+ma bha ga dang / /gsang ba chos 'byung chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams/ /seng ge'i khri sogs brda thabs du mas mtshon/ khres rab lha mo'i gtso la: /chos dbyings rang bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /don dam 'khor 'das srid pa gsum gyi gzugs/ /mtha' yasasprul pa'i snang ba phyogs brgyar 'bar/ /sku yi dbang phyug ma la: /zab mo gsang sngags chos dbyings sgra brgya pa/ /nges tshig ming don rgya mtsho'i 'jug pa can/ /mtha' dag mgon gyi gsung dbyangs rdo rje ma/ /gzhom med lha mo khyod la: /rang bzhin spros bral mi 'gyur chos dbyings ngang / /ma lus shes bya'i gnas tshul kun gsal ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes lhun grub rnam mi rtog /mkha' spyod thugs kyi rdo rjer: /gang gi rnam 'phrul yid bzhin bsgyur mdzad pas/ /dpag yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub mthu dpal can/ /'phrul ldan dbang phyug mnga' bdag rnal 'byor ma/ /sgyu 'phrul bde ba'i gter la /rdo rje lha mo khyod thugs ye shes dang / /sku dang 'phrin las dbyings dang nam mkha' ste/ /'di dag brtan g.yo kun la lhan cig khyab/ /kun khyab kun 'gro'i gtso mor: /kun gzhi rnam dag mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /sna tshogs gnas dang mchod pa'i bkod par bcas/ /zhing khams 'byor pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur mar /ji ltar bzhed pa'i don kun 'bad med par/ /smon lam dbang bsgyur gang la gang 'dul ba'i/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par don mdzad ma/ /'dod pa kun stsol khyod la: /stobs sogs yon tan gzhal du med pa yis/ /rab —19—

gang rtag tu phan bde spro ba dang / /srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad 'bab pa'i gnas/ /chu gter dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med brjod las 'das pa mkha' 'gro li/ gtso/ /bye ba phrag brgyas lhag bcas khrag khrig zung / /rnal 'byor ma dpal khyod kyi pho nyar sprul/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi bdag mor: /sum cu rtsa bdun snyen ra los sgyur ma'i sku/ /myos byed ri bo mda' dang yon tan grangs/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes ngo bor sdom mkhas ma/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /snyes byas thams cad snying nas so sor bshags/ /yi rangs chos kyi 'khor lo bske ra ba bskul/ /rtag tu bzhugs gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /dkyil 'khor gtso mo dpa' bo dpa' mo dang / /sangs rgyas sras bcas dbang gi lha mo la/ /ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bla med theg par bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /dbang bzhi mnos shing dam tshig lam la gnas/ /byin rlabs rgyud sbyangs rim pa gnyis la slob/ /ngo mtshar spyod pa gsum gyi rol ba sogs/ /mtha' daXg lam rnams bdag gis bsten par bgyi/ /ting 'dzin brtan cing 'phrin las thogs med 'grub/ /pho nya gsum 'dus grub pa brgyas sogs thob/ /'gro ba'i don spyod mthu dang ldan pa yi/ /tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal thob par shog /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma rnams kyi 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang —20—

dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ na go ha da ku las sha lnga/ mu bi ma shu ra las bdud rtsi lnga rnams hū bru kha dzi a ye shes lnga'i ngo bos mtshan pa rlung g.yos/me sbar/ zhu zhing khol/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ o ā hu ha ho hi o gsum ma'i mthar/ a kā ro mu kha sarba dharma na/u du nu tra sno tā ta/ o ā skyo phaṭa swāhā/ lan lngas dbul/ badz+ra yo gī ni ar+gha nas/sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ o gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /lko ā hū/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'ag rten 'das pa'i gtor chog go /o ā hū ha ho hi h+pha badz+ra a ra l+li ho/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'do/da pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyi mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog go /bum pa'i mchod pa gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhu las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings dang /dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ o yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shudhi tsho3ha/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin byed/ lko sarba ta thā —21 —

ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra ru swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ shasta'i bar brjod/oṃ badz+ra ga rjer ṇi ta nas/ a kha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal/ lo/ /zhes pas bston/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la bzhon nas song bas/ bum nang gi rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i ba sbu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas/ bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ oṃ nga sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes pa'ang bzlas/ma sgo bstod rnams gong bzhi bya'o/ /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /dung chos kyi chu bum par glug /oṃ ā hūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas/ bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ dung chos kyi chu blangs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes khrus byas la/ slob ma la bya ba ltar bdag 'jug chirdzogs par blangs/ khyed rang gi zhes pa dang / khyed kyi zhes pa dang / khyed rang rnams zhes pa rnamalobadag gi zhes pa dang / bdag nyid ces 'don pa spo/ de nas slob ma rnams la chab btang me tog bskyed bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul/ slob mas kyang tshom bu g.yon bskor du bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi ā hu gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen —22—

gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe ā hu/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyi bskor ba/ hu dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ byang sgra mi snyan/nub ba lang spyod/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la 'jug pa'i chos 'khor bcas zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /nas/'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad dag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas grub par shog /ces rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su —23—

gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo —24—

gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung / oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+ta wa ra a ma na ye hu/ zhes mig dar btang / ā kha ldi ra hu gis me tog gtad/ bum chus slob ma la gtor la su bhas bsangs/ o ā skyo bdud rtsi sbyin/ bu khyod su yin gang la dga' zhes dri/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes rjes bzlos bya/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes rjes bzlos bya/ slob ma'i snying khar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po bsgom du bcug nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ zhes rjes bzlos byar bcug /rdo rje snying khar gtugs pas brtan par byas par bsgoms shig byas la/ slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya stu ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kha/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams/ dza hu ba ho zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug /ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du mos pa 'di —25—

bzhi ma sgo byas la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i ba yig las 'od byung / khyed rang gi lte bar thim/ 'od 'dus pa las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs ba yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang / 'khor ra ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭā ga bsnams pa/ dras pa dang / mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ ba ha ye 3 mo hre hri hū hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rnams gsal bto la rjes bzlos ma sgo/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pas bdag la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas ting lo slob ma'i khar sbyin la/mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i ba yig las ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rnam pa mun sel gyi ting lo 'od gsal ba byung / khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas rgyud/ lte ba'i ba yig dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang bar 'gyur/ des bde ba chen po'i gar mdzad/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor/ smin —26—

mtshams dang gsang sgor yang dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon nas/ khyed rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dam par byin gyis brlabs/ rol r+ṣa bya/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ tsho'o badz+ra ā be sha a ye shes phab pa'i rgyun de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par mos mdzod/ nga badz+ra lan gnyis/ mdun bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la/ me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis byas la/ oṃ pra ca badz+ra ho slar yang me tog de nyid rang gi spyi bor bcing par mos shig byas la/ glu( pra ti grihā twa i ma satwa mahā ba la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dang khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang / /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra le hri tra/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal//de bzhin bdag la deng stso'i/ cig /ces lan gsum rjes bzlos kyi gsol ba btab/rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha sprul te/ dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad par mos shig byas la/ bum pa bzung / me tog 'thor zhing / he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku 27—

mnga' ba/ /ha he'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ hūX huX phaṭa kyis bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /e waX mnyam par sbyar ba bde ba'i sku/ /ā li kā li rol ba'i gsung mnga' zhing / /aXgi ngo bo son pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /shes rab phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir lce'i// /ces shis pa brjod/ dbang lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi nas/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ oX tsakra lī ra stuX a bhi khri lto hūX/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ lkoX sarba bzhi ḍā zhi ni ye/badz+ra wa rna nī ye/ mahā mu ku ṭa ho/ oX badzi bha wa a 'a ṣañca hūX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna bar g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas brtan bzhugs su gsol ba'i cho/sa pa gyis byas la/ rol chen dang bcas slob ma la me tog gtor la/ oX su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas lung ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kha'i baX yig las sngags rnams kyi 'phreng ba byung / khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying kha'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngags nus pa mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par mos la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/ oX gsum ma lan gsum sgo/ dam bca' ba'i lung 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/ bla ma dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor —28—

ma gnyis su ma mchis pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rdo rje rnal 'ebyor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la cispyanus bzla bar dam 'cha' lags go /slob dpon la me tog gtor la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du garbedu la/ /me tog de nyid slar yang khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bor gtor bas sngags 'phreng gi rnam pas snying khar thim ste/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod byes la/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bo dang snying khar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyed kyi rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung rig sngags kyi byin rlabs dang / nus mthu ma lus pa yongs su 'jug nga/ra gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /des bum dbang thob pas bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang bar byas go /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang ba nas thon/ka ngu/ la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ de nyid lce thog tu bzhag par mos shig /ces oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum brjod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas blangs la slob ma/ la sbyin/ des gsang dbang thob pas/ lam rang lus la brten nas rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i thabs sgom pa la dbang ngo / /de nas si rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor las sirnyu ra slob dpon gyi 'theb srin g.yon pas blangs la/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba rnams su byugs/ 'khru gsum brjod/ de ltar gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i ha yig zhu bas/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes skyes —29—

par mos la/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3snya/ zhes pa dang 'gud rgya byar bcug /des shesarab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i zhu bde de nyid dper byas te/ don rang sems bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgom pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /stong pa nyid ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes pa yin pas spros bral bde stong la cung zad mnyam par zhog ma sgo/ de ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ lam de kho na nyid dngos su sgom pa la dbang ngo / /de nas rjes ni slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra bhu mi ā:huX nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /ces yon 'bul lo/ /tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gnyis dang / skabs 'di gsum gang la byas kyang drang ba las/ dang po gnyis ltar gtso che na'ang / deng sang phyi ma ltar mdzad do/ /lhag gtor dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dus gcig la gtong /de nas rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las —30—
