a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du / zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod rnams byed/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang / bsod nams dang / 'byor pa dang / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ gal te tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i skal ba med na/'chi tshe mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lkog 'dod don zhu/de nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes sku/ /'gro la brtse bas rjes chags lha mo'i skur/ /ston mdzad rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khrul bas sngon bsags sdig kun dang / /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba gang bgyis pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i drung du mthol lo bshags/ /'gyod cing slan chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs dang / /rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhis gos pa dang / /sbom po brgyad sogs nyes pa gang lags pa/ /dri bral lha mo'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /thun bzhi'i bstan 'dzin chag gam nor ba dang / /bzlas pa'i bya ba 'khrul dang cho ga nyams/ /gus pa lhod dang rnam g.yengs dbang gyur dang / /nyon mongs drag po'i dbang gyur mthol: khyun dang khyad par gza' ba'i dam tshig la/ /ngan par rtog —31

dang brnyas dang 'gom pa dang / /tshes bcu'i mchod dang 'khor lo'i mchong pa sogs/ /ngan cing dus su ma mthong : /phyag rgya gshone pa mtsho ni cha mtshan ma dang / /lhag ma 'gom dang dam can lha tshogs brnyas/ /sngags dang lha dang rgyud tshig dri med la/ /kyal ka byas sogs nongs pa: khres rab rigs la smad dang brdeg pa dang / /bskor dang phyag 'tshal la sogs ma 'grub dang / ma dad nyon mongs rang dgar chags pa dang / /rang g.yin bde chen rgyu nyams: /rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi dam tshig dang / /thun mong ma yin dam tshig brgyad po dang / /dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnam bzhi dang / /'gal bar gyur pa thams cad: /snod ma yin la gsang ba bsgrags pa dang / /dbang bskur byin rlabs rigs sngags spyin pa dang / /'os min 'phrin las gsol dang gnas min par/ /sngags rgyud spyor ba byas sogs mthol lo bshags/ /bshags dang bshags bya bshags par byed po bral/ /'dzin pa dag phyir dag tshangs phul bas kyang / /sgrib gnyis rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ /gnas lugs rtogs nas sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/ ma 'byo1ra pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang / yo byad ma tshang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag dang / cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskang zhing / bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar —32—

byin gyis/ brlab tu gsol/ ces bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten sku 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs sin dhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ ra nga nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/oṃ ba/ ha yo/hri mo/ hre tri/ hū hu phaṭa phaṭa/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyi/ tshams rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba byed do/ /de nas spyod lam gyi rnal wor ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin oṃ gsum ma ḍā rnyag brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grag pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam par rtog pa thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /de nas smon lam ni/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur ba'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye —33—

ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /rdo rje phag mo dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang / /zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang / /go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bza' zhing / /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bcas bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag bsrung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /lha mo tshad ma nas/rgyur gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ cho se/ kun gdod nas rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi yi gzugs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka khres rab rang bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rim lnga'i lam las mchog brnyes dril bu pa/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs legs spyod ḍi gi pa/ /mu stegs 'dul mdzad bar ma'i slob dpon zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam rnal 'byor ti snyi pa/ /dregs ldan che dgu'i gtsug rgyan nā ro pa/ /grags pa nam mkha'i mthar son a des pa/ / gsol ba: /blo ldan dam pa klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ /slob dpon mchog gis rjes bzung sgra bsgyur mal/ /mthu stobs mgon pos byin rlabs sa skya pa/ / gsol ba /—34—

gsang sngags rgyud sde'i mthar son rje btsun mched/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar thug kun dga'i mtshon/ /dam chos 'khor los sgyur ba 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba: /mtha' yas gdams pa'i mnga' bdag dkon mchog dpal/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin bstan pa'i brag phug pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /gsol ba:/ chos bzhin lhur mdzad dpal ldan tshul khrims dang / /ye shes rgyal mtshan yon tan mang pos brgyan/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i 'phrin las bzang po can/ /gsol ba: /zab don rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag shākya'i mtshan/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug gzhon nu chos grub zhabs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba spangs pa'i grol mchog rje/ /gsol ba: /yang chos rje bla ma'i rjesasu/ chos bzhin spyod mdzad mchod rten dkar po ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims 'dzin/ /blo gros chos skyong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /gsol ba: /zab don rgya mtsho'i sogs gong bzhi/ mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /chos kun bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thub pa'i bstan la rnam dag bslab pa gsum/ /legs mnos rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa dang / /byang chub sems bskyed pha rol phyin drug sogs/ /theg mchog lam la 'ju ga par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par gsang ba'i theg pa bla med du/ /dbang bzhis smin byas rnam dag dam tshig bsrung / /rdo rje slob dpon mchog dang lhag pa'i lhas/ /yang dag ye shes 'pho bar: /dag snang lha yi 'kho / ra lo 'jug pa'i sgo/ /kun rdzob snang zhen sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /zab mo snying po'i —35—

dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las/ /rab 'byams dngos grub 'grub par /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'khrul tsho 'khor bgrang yas rnams/ /don dam lhan cig skyes par nges bsdoms pa/ /bde chen tsaṇ+ḍali dang mnyam sbyor pa'i/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rtogs par /lam 'di sgrub la bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mtha' dag nyer 'tsho phun tshogs kun sgrub nas/ /rdo rje pho nya gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis/ /lam gyi grogs mchog sgrub par byin: /'khor lo rnam bzhi'i bgrod pa rnam dag nas/ /bcu gnyis sa yi rim pas legs bgrod pa'i/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang / /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ khres rab phag mo'i pa khror rdo rje rol par mdzad/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis/ /sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can/ /bden pa: /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ /tshad med yon tan 'phrin las tshogs kyi nyer 'bar ma/ /bden pa des kyang : /bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs zhe—36—

'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu brtan gyur pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /dus rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gong du bstan pa rnams dang / nyal ba dang / ldang ba ste/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gis chog go /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /kun gyi rtsa bar rab grags pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' thob pa'i thabs/ /snying po'i yi ge bla na med/ /rmad byung sdeb legs 'od brgya'i ro mo bkra/ /mchog dang thun mong sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi gnas/ /rim gnyis ge sar snying po bzhad pa'i dpal/ /mchod chog 'dab brgya'i dga' ston ci yang shar/ /de las dge ba'i chu klung brgya/ /mtha' dag 'gro la nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /lhan cig skyes sku rgya mtsho yi/ /klong du bde bar son gyur cig /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //ma ṅga la// //oṃ rdza sti/ dpal ldan kun khyab zung 'jug ye shes ni/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi srog tu rtag bzhugs kyang / /ma rtogs 'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib bsal phyir/ / rdo rje 'dzin pas chos tshul mtha' yas gsungs/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal dngos grub rlabs 'phreng 'khrigs/ /zab don nor bu'i phung pos gang ba las/ /rmad byung cho ga'i sbyor ba 'dir 'ongs pa chu gter bsrubs la zla ba gsar pa bzhin/ /gang las dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams/ /bskyed mdzad shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni/ /rdo rje btsun mo 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i/ /sgrub thabs mchod chog rnam par dag pa 'di/ /skal ldan 'gro la dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bgrang yas glegs bam sneng brnyan 'bad med du/ /spel bar bya phyir lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /par gyi 'phrul 'khor mi zad sna me sbyin bsgrubs/ / par yig mkhas pa u rgyan rdo rje dang / /'du byed phul phyin bkra shis 'brug rgyal dang / /bstan —37—

'dzin jo bo bsam 'grub rnams yin te/ /gang 'di'i mthun rkyen ma lus sbyor ba po/ /dad pa'i nor dang blo gros rtsal ldan pa'i/ /lhas bsrung thog rgod rdo rje zhes bya bas/ /gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /'di las rgya chen dge ba gang 'grub pa/ /srid zhi'i legs byas kun dang lhan cig tu/ /yongs su zhugs las mtha' dag 'gro ba kun/ /bla med rgyal pa'i sal 'khod par shog /las 'dir 'bad rtsol 'brel pa can kun dang / /dge ba sgrub po rang nyid sngon 'gro ba'i/ /skye bo srid gsum lam la gnas pa kun/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du yang / /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /bdud kyi las dang mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /bsam don dge ba thams cad 'grub pa dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog/ //dge'o// // 38—

lag len bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byar ma'i bsreg blugs 'bring po'i lag len ni 'di yin te/dang por yo byad tshogs par bya ba la/ dung chos sam thod par bsangs chu ku sha dang bcas pa/gtor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa gnyis/ pad 'dab med pa gnyis/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par til nag logs su bya/ gzhan nas gro sran 'bras sogs 'bru sna tshogs bsregs pa/ dur ba/ zas mchog /ku sha /ba glang gi sha skam po la chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu bsres pas byugs pa dang / de bzhin du thig skud rdul tshon/rdor dril/ ḍa ma sa nang mchod/ nyungs kar/ thal ba/ ba byung / dri bzang/thod pa'am/ dung chos su mchod yon/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas/ mar khu dang / yam shing dang / dpal 'bar sogs kyang bzhag go /gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bsangs chu la dmigs nas sum+bha brgya dang / mchod yon la dmigs nas/ glu( āXhuX brgya rtsa bzlas la bzhag /thab gang du bya ba'i sa gzhir/ gtor ma lcog zlum de bzhag la/ bsangs sbyang nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang 'dra/ tshon las bcol ba ni/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin pos gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /sreg blug don du khyod kyis stso me// /zhes lan gsum/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la/ zhes sogs kyis bgegs bskrad la ga sto ma phyir dor/ oṃ bhuX khaX nam mkha' rang bzhin du gyur/ huX laX huX rdo rje'i rang —39—

bzhin du gyur/ de nas 'a bzla bzhin du nyungs kar dang thal ba gtor ro/ /ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs/ tsho( badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bsrung / de nas sa gzhi der thig btang la/ thab kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bris/ de yang thab sor nyi shu las mi chung ba/ mu ran kha khyer sor bzhi/ de rnams dbyibs gru gsum/ rtse mo rang la bstan pa/ dbus su pad 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gri gug /mu ran la rdo rje dang / kha khyer rla pad+ma 'am/ gri gug gi 'phreng ba can/ de rnams kyi gzhi kha dog dmar po yin/ stegs bu gru bzhi ser po/ zur bzhir mgo nang du bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje'o/ /thab nang du bud shing snyoms par brtsigs la me tshang bca'/ stegs bu'i phyi rol ci bde bar/ thab kyi g.yas su mchod yon dang zhabs bsil/ de'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i chu gnyis bshams/ rang gi g.yon du snga ma'i 'phro las mthud de sreg rdzas rnams bshams/thab kyi g.yon kyi phyogs su nyer spyod lnga dang / de'i nang du yang 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/rgyab kyi phyogs ci bde bar gtor ma gsum po rnams bsgrig /rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol brtsigs/ rdor dril nang mchod rnams rang gi mdun du bshams/ dgang blugs kyang mdun du bzhug go /mdun du mi bde na g.yas su 'jog cing / bud shing mar khu ni ci bde bar 'jog pa las gnas nges pa med/ sgrub pa'i mchod yon dang bsangs chu yang g.yon gyi phyogs su 'jog pa lag lan yin/ sum+bha bzlas shing bsangs chu gtor la/ gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya sreg rdzas rnams la bstan te/ 'bru gsum gang mang bzlas/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i las thams cad pa'i thab khung dmar po/ chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/ kha khyer dang mu ran dang / stegs bu dang so so'i mtshan ma sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med —40—

par gyur/ oX aXhuX lan bdun bzlas te dpal 'bar spar/ su lhas bsangs chu gtor la/thab la g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor nas me tshang du bcug /oX dz+wa la dz+wa la hūX/ de nas huX bdun bzlas te rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ yang su lhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i me nyid/ raX las me lha dkar po bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin zhing / pad zla dang ra skyes la gnas pa/ pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i bzhin can/ me lce stong gi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i thugs kar me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la gnas pa'i raX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX e hai hi/ mahā bhū ta/ de wa ṛ ṣi/ dī dzā/ satwa ma/ gri hi stu/ yuXbasti/ a smin pa ni/ hi twa bha ba/ badz+ra dha ra udz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes pa'i mthe bong nang du bstan pa'i thal mo rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / su lhas bsangs chu gtor te/ phyi 'brang rnams bskrad/ oX a gyu ye sa pā ri wā ra khyuX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ bsgrubs pa'i mchod yon te/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i snod du blug /dzaXhūX baX hoX oX sa sni de ba ta sa ma ya stuX/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag go/tseX( asni ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyi dgang blugs phul la/ tseX( asna ye a dī bya a dī bya a bī sha bī sha mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swāhā/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyi mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍa khris dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces bstod cing spro na/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten sogs kyang bya/ yang gong bzhin dgang blugs gcig phul te/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha kho na mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /yang su lhas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang —41 —

las 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i thugs kar huX las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i huX las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba dra ba/ spyo pa nas/ yo ga shurnyo tsho3'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin gsal btab/ mchod pa la phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na sgrub mchod kyi mchod 'phreng bzhin nam/ bsdu na tshigs bcad rnams bor ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ tsho( gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gsum ma dang /na maXs man+ta brnya nāX/ oṃ asna ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan re dang / oṃ asna ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyi mthar/ bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ btags pas dgang blugs phul/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swāhā/ yaX shing dang / oṃ sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saX pa de swāhā/zas mchog /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ mahā be ga ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ga sma ri swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pu spyi ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ba la ye swāhā/zhes pa rnams kyis 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa 'bul/ tsho( mahā shrī pha la dha na swāhā/ 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ ku sha dang / oṃ asna ye he ru ka mahā badz+ra asna ye swāhā/ bcu pa zhes ba glang gi sha la bdud rtsi bran pa 'bul/ de ltar sreg rdzas tshan pa re re la/ rdzas sngags kyi 'gor lha sngags/ tso( gsum ma dang me lha'i sngags/ 'jug tu bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i/ phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/zhes pa re sbyar te tshar gcig phul la/ slar grangs 'dzin pa ni/ spro na rgyas pa la oṃ gsum ma dang / 'bring du na sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags/ shin tu bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ste cung —42—

zad rgyas pa na/ lha sngags de la gong bzhin las sngags btags pa kho nas bsreg par bya ste/ sdig pa zhi ba la rdzas kyang til nyid la gtso bor bya zhing / ma 'byor na yungs kar ro/ /lha sngags gtso bor bzla ba 'di lta bu la/ spyir ni sreg rdzas gang gis kyang kha skong gi grangs 'dzin du rung ngo / /thun gyi mthar/ gtor ma dang po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul zhing / gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor de/ de dag gtor chog gi skabs bzhin bya la/ gsum pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha la 'bul ni/ 8khe asna ye a di bya sogs kyi mthar/ a kā zo( btanas pa lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha / /'dod pa thams cad rab ster ba/ /rang gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs/slar yang mchod pa kha gsos te/ byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sogs kyi 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang / rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ 'dod don zhu ba yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams dkyil 'khor cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra/me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyis/ /mgu zhing tshim par gyur nas kyang / /rang gnas bde bar gshe/gas su gsol/ /ca ru grwa sba na/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /thun mang po dang nyin zhug mang po sbrel nas byed na/ thun re bzhin nam ma 'grub na nyin re bzhin/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas/ sreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa man chad gong bzhin bya'o/ /bsangs chu dang / mchod yon sgrubs pa yang kha gso bar spro na bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i mthar de dag la dmigs nas che ni dang 'bru gsum ci rigs bzla'o/ /sbyin sreg gi me khas mi 'bud pa dang / me ma shi bar mi dkrug pa —43—

sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lag pa pus mo'i khong las mi 'da' ba dang / rdor dril dang ma bral ba byed pa sogs 'di la mi dgos so/ /'di'i sreg rdzas rdzas sngags so so'i 'bul ba'i skabs de 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la thun mong du 'bul ba yin la/ grangs 'dzin pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa kho na la'o/ /de lta na 'di sbyin sreg 'bring po yin la/ bsdus pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i cho ga rnams dor zhing / 'jig rten 'das pa'i skabs kyi rdzas sngags so so ba yang spangs te/ 'bar ba'i phung po nyid drang srong me lha'i ngo bor lhag par mos pas ched pa'o/ /rgyas pa ni/bde mchog pū nag gi cho ga 'don pa spos pa kho na'o/ /de ltar na rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rim pa rnams ma 'dres par bya'o/ /zhes pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //ma ṅga la// //

༄༅/ /phag mo'i spyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/phag mo'i spyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chos 'byung gi dbus su pad+ma'i 'dab brgyad yod pa lte ba la gri gug bris te/ dmar po la dkar pos bcad rgyab che chung khru gang ba bya/ lci ba gong de dang mthun par brtsigs pa'am zlum por brtsigs pa gang bde bya/ gtor ma che chung gnyis sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa nang mchod/ dpal 'bar yam shing til mar khu 'bru sna tshogs ba glang gi sha skam po la nang mchod bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar ba byugs pa'i mthe chung gi mgo tsam mang po bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/sreg rdzas rnams sdo/lhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ tseX( āXhuX/ lan brgya tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thab bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i thab khung gru gsum dmar po kha khyer dang mu ran dang stegs bu bcas pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la hūX/ dpal 'bar me tshang du bcug /thab nang 'bar ba'i me'i dbus su/ e e las zhes pa nas/ oX yo ga sdokhresa3haX gi bar bdun bskyed bzhin/sku'i g.yon du me lha dmar po bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs 'dzin pa ra skyes la bzhon pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa bzhugs par gyur/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ de nas dang po mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul te/ tseX( gsum ma'i mthar/ tseX( asna ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ skye( asna ye a dī khyuX a bhi sha a bhi sha mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dwangs shing dri med nas bstod pa'i bar bya/ bsdu na tshigs bcad bor/ sngags kyi skabs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sa —45—

pa ri wā re khyo mahā asne de ba ta sa pa ri wā re khyu ar+ghaṃ pra titsā swāhā/ zhes sogasathams cad la sbyar ro/ /gtso mo'i bstod pa'i mthar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭaklis dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de nas tshe gsum ma la/ oṃ asna ye swāhā zhesabatags/ a dī bya sogs sbyar la/ mar khu lan bdun tsam phul ba dang / oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya swāhā sbyar bas yam shing / oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swāhā sbyar bas 'bru sna tshogs phul/ ma rna sarba pā pa da ha na badz+ra swāhā/ sbyar bas til lan bdun phul/ dngos gzhi oṃ gsum ma kho na bzla zhing /til phul te grangs 'dzin thun gyi mjug tu ba glang gi sha brgya tsam phul la/ glu( gsum ma brgya tham pa dang sbyar/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i gtor bsngo dang / a kā ro lan bdun gyis me lha la phul/de nas cho ga'i mjug gi rjes chog de ka bya ba las/ khyad par ni/ ye shes pa gshegs pa'i rjes la thal ba cung zad cig dpral bar skud/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mi dmigs par gyur/ zhes brjod pa'o/ /me ma shi bar mi dkyug go/zhes pa 'di nye gnas zer ba'i rtogs ldan gyi don du/ tā ra nā thas bris/ dar rgyas 'phel/ /ma ṅga lo/ dge'o//—46—

ṭa/nga ba bzhu/gas/'jam pa'i dbyangs bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyi pa spror gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /thun mtshams 'od dmar 'dzin pa'i myos ldan ma/ /glog phran ltar g.yo mi 'gyur bde byin ma/ /lha mo mchog gi 'gro 'di rjes bzung mdzod/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs/ /dza ladha ra ba dang po'i mgon po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gzhan dag kyang snang mod/ de ni ma thos so/ /'dir ni slob dpon chen po'i bzhed pa 'phags yul grub chen mang po'i gshegs shul/ sgrub thabs chung ba snyan rgyud ma'am las bdun can du 'byung ba'i don/bla ma'i lung gis iṇ+ḍa snu ti dang / stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje dang / rngon pa'i gzhung sogs las bag tsam kha bskang / man ngag zhal nas brgyud pas cung zad gsal bar byas te snying po mdo tsam bri bar bya'o/ /de yang dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di'i byin rlabs kyang nges par thob pas dang por rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsam la khrus bya/ de nas/ huX las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX huX hūX/rang gi snying ga nas ma mo bcu spros/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra mut+na ra sogs brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bla ma yi dam h+pha/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs dang / de nas skyabs yul rnams rang gi spyi bo nas thim/thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi la ye shes kyi ngo bo'i dam rdzas kyi rgya mtshor gyur/oṃ āXhuX ha ho khyiX skye( āXhūX baX zhes pa bkod/ tso( badz+ra pukhre/ āXhuX/ zhes nang mchod la me —47—

tog dmar pos mchod/ nang mchod des sor mo rnams dang rtsa ba dang / sen mo la thig le byas la/oX baX haX yoX hriX moX hre hriX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āXhuX lan drug gis bdud rtsir phul/ mnyes shing zhu bar lta'o/ /lag pa la sogs pa rnams gnas drug tu byugs pas de dang der lha rnams thim/srin lag gis bdud rtsi gtor zhing gnas dang mchod pa dang / maṇ+ḍal gsang gtor bya/ de nas me long dag pa rgyu ra/ rdul gyis gos pa'i seng ras kyis rtsags la/ g.yon gyi mthe srin lag gis gser gyi smyug gu bzung nas chos 'byung zur gsum pa phyogs bzhi ru dga' 'khyil re/ nang du oṃ gsum ma tshan gsum du bcad pa'i 'og tu baX/ steng du ha dang bcas pa bri/ de nyid skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ h+pha/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ ye shes sems dpa' rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa sngags kyi yig 'bru dang ro mnyam du gyur/ oX āXhiXpra wa ra sad ka raX ar+ghaX pra titsā ye swāhā/ añca ma naX:pu byaX: prok+ṣa naX: oX āXhri hūX hūX haXrnyaX zhes sha wo gyi spos phul/ oX badz+ra yo gī nī puṣ+ṭhaX dhu paX dī paX gan+dhaX bā li gro hā gro hā ma mi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ oX badz+ra punyu āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ so rtsi dang nang mchod dang / cang te'u brdung shing rkang brgyad dam/ rtsa sngags kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas/ dzā zhes rang la bsdu ba'am/ gshegs su gsol te phyi rol mchod pa'o/ /oX hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa/ phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po bzhis brgyan pa/ de'i nang du keng rus kyi phung po la gnas pa'i kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'greng ba'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar nyi ma la/ mi ro gser mdog mig gsum nam mkhar blta ba/ de'i steng du baX dmar po thog ma dang tha mu med pa'i —48—

sems kyi ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rdo rje phag mo sku mdog se snyu'i me tog dang dza ba ltar dmar shing 'od zer me ltar 'bar ba/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus shing / mche ba'i myu gu can/ spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/g.yas phag gdong nag po gyen du phyogs pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing lang tsho la bab pa/ 'dod chags chen po kha ṭāX ga dang 'dus pas bde ba rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar thabs dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya dang / thod skam gyi cod pan dang / mgo bo'i phreng ba can/ skra mtshams su dar dpyangs bcing ba/ g.yon brkyang gis gar stabs ca na mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /mdun nas g.yas skor gyis 'dab ma rnams la/phag mo/ /gshin rje ma/ rmongs byed ma/ bskyod byed ma/ bkrag byed ma/ 'a ka rnams rim pas/ dmar sngo dkar ser ljang khu dud kha'i mdog can/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /tshangs pa gser mdog bram ze'i gzugs kyis rnga yab g.yob pa/ drag po dkar po mig gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ thal mal ba'i cha lugs kyis stong pa/ 'phrog byed dmar po lha'i lus la seng ge'i gdong can/ ral gri mchan khung du bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba/ brgya byin ljang khu mig stong can e na ya'i lpags pas dkrid pas gdugs dkar 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang ro langs gar byed pa dang / lce spyang glu len pa dang / sgrub pa po gtor ma dang / zas mchog 'bul ba dang / mkha' lding gnod sbyin rig 'dzin 'byung po ma mo rnams kyi brjed par byed pa dang / 'bar ba'i phyag rgya 4sa la/ h+pha/ zhes 'og —49—

min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shud+nghaXsarba dharmaXyo ga shurnyo3haX/ lte bar oṃ baX phag mo/ snying gar haX oX gshin rje ma/ khar hri moX rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hre hri skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huX huX skrag byed ma/ yan lag kun la phaṭa phaṭa sto ka /'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar dzaXhūX baX hoXkhaX raX zhes pa'i yi ge rnams phyir phyung / lha mor gyur pas mchod par bsam ste/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas yig chung ltar rdzogs rim sgom la/ skyo na bzlas pa bya ste rang gi lte bar rdo ra'i dkyil 'khor lta bu sgom nas/ oṃ gsum gyi bdag nyid yi ge so gnyis pa kho na bzla'o/ /phyi nas bgrang phreng dang ngag tu brjod pa med par sngags yid kyi bsam nas bzla ba ni yid bzlas so/ /de nas thams cad gsal stong du bsdus nas ldang ba'i tshe/ oṃ gsum gyi sngags brjod cing / oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ gzugs dang sgra dang dran rtog thams cad sku gsung thugs so/ /zhes mos nas/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /de ltar zla ba drug tu snying po 'bum phrag bzhi bzla zhing sgom pas sems brtan par 'gyur la/ de ltar na bde ba dam pa thob bo zhes so/ /mdo tsam du ni 'dir gzhung kho na las kha bskang ba rnams med kyang rung gsung ba ltar ro/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga ste dang po'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa ni/ dus rgyun du'am khyad par gyi dus tshes bcu la sogs pa la/ mdun du stegs bu bshams/ yo byad thams cad tshogs pa dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs dang / skyabs sems sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag bskyed rdzogs pa dang / oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra krodha huX phaṭa/ zhes lag pa sa la reg bgegs bskrad de stong par mos/ hūX glurablangs nas skor ba byas te/ huX las rdo rje nas/ mud ga ra'i bar sgrub thabs ltar sgom pa ni srung ba'o/ /de nas 'og gzhi maṇ+ḍal sa la bri/ der mni la sogs pa la/ thod pa myos byed kyi bkang —50—

ba de'i steng du me long gi dkyil 'khor bldag go /de rnams kyi ji ltar bya tshul gong gi phyi rol mchod pa ltar bya/ de nas/ oṃ bi 'o ba bi ḍā ya swāhā sogs dang / de'i rjes su su lhas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung zhes pa nas/ baX dmar po zhes pa'i bar gang ltar/ de las rdo rje phag mo nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i bar yang gong bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na/ oṃ āXhūṃ zhes brjod pas byin gyisabarlabs so/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul tshul ni rngon pa'i gdams ngag gis yig snar bkod pa ltar ste khyad par ni gtor ma'i skabs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags/ glu( gsum gyi bdag nyid snying po'i mthar a kā ro btanas nas 'bul/ mchod pa re re'i mthar mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dang khyad par 'di lta bu zhig stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ me tog la sogs pa re re zhing rdzas dang sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin ma chad cing ma nor bar/ drug brgya bdun cu don lnga re 'bul ba ni/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshe nges par dgos la/bsnyen pa dang / gzhan gyi skabs ci rigs la ma byung yang rung ngo / khyad par bsgrub pa la ni/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma kha sbyor las 'byung ba'am/ kun spyod lam 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nyid/ mtshan mo gzhi mdo dang / dur khrod la sogs par lan 'bum la sogs pa'i bar du phul bas 'bras bu shin tu che gsung / gzhan yang bka' sdod nag po chen po'i ro langs 'jigs byed la gtor ma 'bul te/ de'i tshul ni 'og nas ston no/ /gtor mi dang bcas phyi rol mchod pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /sbyin sreg rgyas pa ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gzhan du bri bar 'dod la/ gzhung gzhan las shin tu bsdus pa me mar gyi bsregs blugs kyang rung par bshad pas de yang bya mod/ gas du shes la/ de bzhin du za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro yang ngo / /'dir nang —51 —

dang phyi las nang ni bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ltar sgoms la/ kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la bza' ba yin/ phyi 'bring po ni/ dngos grub kyi don du thab ni zur gsum dmar po kho na yin/ de yang sa gzhi bgegs sbyangs ba rdzogs pa yan chad phyi rol mchod pa ltar bya/ de nas bum pa bsgrubs nas thab khung gru gsum khru gang rgya phyed dpangs/ kha khyer dang mu ran la sna tshogs rdo rje dang gri gug gis mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa bya/bum bskyed ltar bum pa bsgrubs pa las/ nga lan stong sogs bzlas pa'i bum pa de thab kyi g.yas su bzhag /bud shing rnams bkod la/ thab bsangs sbyangs bskyed/ der me spar la/ra las me lha dmar po spyi blugs mchog spyin/ dbyug pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i phyag bzhi pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ ā hu/ lte bar oṃ ba sogs/ shar lto nas med lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ asni de ba ta ā kar+ṣa ya dzā dza : ba ho o asni ye swāhā/ byon zan dbul/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mos bum pa'i dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ oṃ shrī he ru ka asna ye swāhā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun phul/phyi rol mchod pa ltar byin wos byas nas/ nyer spyod dang nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshang dbang sogs kyis bstod/gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ asna ye oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ sreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor ba/ 'bru gsum dang / oṃ ku ru ku ru sruhwas byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ asne de wa ta swāhā zhes pa kho nas thams cad 'bul zhing las bcol/ dgang blugs gsum gyis mi lta 'bar ba'am/ shar lhor bzhugs par sgom pa dang lto ba rab tu yangs pa rnams gang rung sgom/ de nas su lhas bsangs ba nas/ gtor ma grub pa'i bar phyi rol mchod pa ltar las/ 'bar ba'i dbus su zhes sam/ lto ba yangs par e las sogs —52—

brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /sreg rdzas 'bul ba'ang sngar dang 'dra ba las sngags ni/ glu( gsum gyi mthar/ oX shrī he ru ka bid+ma he bi du rā dza ya/ dhī ma he pra tso dā ya swāhā/ de nas mchod bstod bzod par gsol la gshegs so/ /slar 'jig rten pa mchod pa ni/ cung zad tsam gyi khyad par ltar shes nas gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dngos grub kyi don du grangs tshad med pa dang / las kyi don du phyogs bzhi re rer 'bum bdun khri 'bum bdun khri dbul bas nges par 'grub ste/ de ltar na sbyin sreg ste gsu ma pa'o/ /gal te slob ma rjes su 'dzin na ni bdag bskyed dang / phyi rol mchod pa rdzogs par byas la/bum pa bsgrub/ de nas 'grub na gzhon nu ma'i ston mo dang sbyin sreg bya/ mi 'grub na mtshams de nas/ bdag 'jug blang ngo / /de la bum pa sgrub tshul ni bsangs sbyangs/ bum par mdun skyed ltar lha bskyed nas/ mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig bya/ dung chos su oṃ tu skye tu ste mahā ta skye swāhā ga ba'i rgyun 'bab par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa byas la/ gtor ma phul/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas bzod par gsol/ me tog dkar po gsum dang cas pas sngar/ dung chos kyis mchod yon phul bas rjes su chags pas zhu ste/ chos 'byung gsang ba'i bha ga bum pa dang lha mo 'khor bcas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu bor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX lko brjod/ de nas byin rlabs dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa rdzogs pa yan chad rngon pa'i gdams ngag dang 'dra/khyad par ni/ mna' chu blud pa'i rjes la/ nga brjod cing bsangs chus 'thor/ de yang phreng ba ji lta ba'am/ yang na/ oṃ sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ye badz+ra si rtsi phya sarba pā paX bhasmin ku ru hūX phaṭa/ ces pas til/ bhasmin ku nas gnas su/ a pa nā ya swāhā/ zhes pas yungs kar chu dang bcas pa'i seng ras dang / kham phor dang / dur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i lci changs rnamasarim pas bya/ oṃ dza sna ka ri badz+ra shi ṣa phya/ pu nu dz+nyā na saX bha ra rnyo pa kā ya swāhā rnams —53—

bzed zhal du bzhag /chu bzhin dbul/ dril bu sil zhing bzed zhal g.yon du skor la/ oṃ bha ra bha ra paṃ bha ra paṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes phyi dor/ purnyu sogs me tog spyi bor bzhan /hūṃ bdun dang / las thams cad pa'i sa rdza rā ja'i bdug pa dang mar me skor ro/ /de ltar drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba byas rjes/ rtogs pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir ldog ltar/ /dad pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems/ /phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya/ /dad pa med pa'i sems can la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /ji ltar sa bon tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po skye mi srid/ /de bas na dad pa bskyed par bya'o/ /spa brjod pa khyad par ro/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ mngon rtogs ji lta ba 'bogs pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes pa bor/ de nas slob mas/ byang chub rdo rje'i sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /zhes sogs bya/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal bas/ bum pas/ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ snying po la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ tsakra bī ra sta/ zhes pas dbang bskur bas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nas bzlas lung spyi dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na dngos bstan yin gsung ste/ nye bar sems dpa' gsum rtsig tu byas la sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi zhal du zhugs/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de las byung nang dang phyi'i bha ga nas byung / lte bar chos 'byung gi nyi ma la 'khod par bsam nas/rjes zlos lan gsum bya ba yin no/ /de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'od zer sna lngas mtshan pa'i bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ gtso mo'i dpral mgrin snying ga nye ba gsang ba'i thig le —54—

dang 'dres/ de rnams byang sems su zhu ba la khar dbab par bsam la/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum brtags pas bdud rtsi sbyin/ ca ra'i dkyil 'khore gyi dga' ba 'khyil ba las slob dpon gyi ming med g.yon pas blangs te/ slob ma'i gnas bzhir snying po brjod cing thig le bya/rdo ra'i maṇ+ḍal spyi bor bzhag ste/ ka sogs yi ges bskor te/ sprul pa'i rtsibs can nyi dbang dkyil 'khor la zhugs shing / 'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra ba/ /rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsregs shing 'khor lo gsum po byed pa gang yin pa/ /kun dga' dang bcas rol pas gyen gshegs phag mo 'di yi sems la gsal gyur cig /zhes brjod slob ma/ rang gi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi 'od ro ma nas brgyud nas phag gdong gi smin mtshams kyi dga' ba 'khyil ba la rgyab pas g.yas su 'khore bar bsam la/ rlung 'dzin du bcug /dga' 'khyil de dbu ma'i lam nas zhugs/ lte 'og tu 'khore ba la yang sems bzhag /der dga' ba bzhi'i myong ba dang sre ba'am mos pa bya/ 'di ni mngon rtogs kyi skabs su'ang sgom ste ga ska dang mthun no/ /de nas/ de'i 'od kyis phyi rol snang ba rang la thim/ lus yas mas thams cad lte bar thim ste stong pa la 'jog /yang sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes mos la lha skur ldang / de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la dge ba bsngo rjes chog ni spyi dang mthun/ /snga ma'i sin+ta ra'i rgyun phyi ma la yod na byin rlabs che gsung / rang gi bdag 'jug gi tshul cho ga de —rdzogs par byas shing / 'og nas 'byung ba ltar tshogs 'khor dang / sbyin sreg sogs sngar bshad pa ltar grangs tshang ba lan bdun gyis bsags rgyab dman pas kyang 'grub par gsungs te sngon du bsnyen pa grub pas so/ /byin rlabs sgom pa ste bzhi pa'o/ /gdags pa'i srung ba ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud phyi rol pad 'dab brgyad/ rdo rwa me ri —55—

dang bcas pa/ lte bar paṃ/ rtsibs rnams la g.yas skor gyis go che'i sa bon/ mu khyud la hu kho na bris/ sa bon rnams la rang rang gi mdun nas brtsams te sngags kyi tha mar che ge mo gnod pa sogs 'di ltar bu las rak+ṣa ku ru zhes pa hu gnyis kyi bar du chud pa bris te/ gro ga la gi khyi ngam gur gum gyis so/ / rab gnas ni/ mchod gtor bshams/ bdag bskyed sgom/ bsang sbyangs zla ba la/ ba dkar po las/ bris pa ji lta bar bskyed/ lha'i ngo bor mos/ ye shes pa yang 'khor lo'i rnam par bstims/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ de nas ming yig bsgrub bya'i ngo bor mos la dbang bskur te gzungs thag brtags la 'bug phug sogs ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /mthar brtan bzhugs su pra tiṣ+ṭha bzlas te/ mchod bstod bkra shis byas la/ btab nas dkris byas te/ ma/go bo'am dpung par gdags pa'am/ kham phor dkar por sgrub tshul spyi mthun du bya'o/ /gdags pa'i srung 'khor te lnga pa'o/ /drag shul spyor ba la sbyor ba gsum gcig tu gril bsrung / 'di la ting 'dzin chas gos sogs/ las kyi khyad par bcu tshang bas sgrub cing / sum bha'i 'khor lo ni/ rigs ldan che ba dang 'dra/ yang na dbyangs gsal 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bri/ 'khor lo de nyid dang / gshin rje 'khor lo le'u tshe bcu bdun pa/ dbus su phag mo gtso 'khor bdun gyi sa bon spel tshig ra phaṭa ghu gnyis kyi nang du chud pa dang / mu khyud phyi ma la snying po spel tshig can gyis bskor/ me re'i nang du ghu phaṭa kho na bri'o/ /'dir rang rje btsun ma nag mo gshed po thod dbyug 'dzin pa brgyad dang lha mo rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ re re'i mdun du ma mo brgyad dang / gshin rje brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam pa sgrub thabs ji lta bar bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs zhe sdang gshed po dang go ldog gi 'byud pa gcig sgom/bsgrub pa grub nas drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thab kyi 'og gam/ g.yos khang chen po'i thab 'og tu gnon — 56—

no/ /de'i spogs chog /phur bu gcig gam/ lnga'am/ bdun nam/ bcu gcig gi sgrub pa bya/ dgra bo'i dri ma sogs las/ gzugs brnyan bya dgug gzhug sogs kyi mthar/ gnas lnga phur bus gdab/ kha sbyor dbye ba byas la bsgrub/ de nas chu mig gi khyad par zhig tu sbas la bka' bsgo'o/ /sngar gyi 'khrul 'khor dang 'dra ba rgya skyegs kyi ril bur bcug pa bdun yang sgrub nas zla ba re re zhing chu mig tu dor bas/ tha mas nges par 'grub bo/ /yang spogs pa ni/ bsnyen pa song nas nag po chen po sgrub ste/ mngon rtogs kyi skabs gtso mo'i mdun du/ hūX las nag po chen po ro langs 'jigs byed bka' non pa'i tshul skem zhing khros pa/ phyag gsum pa g.yas dang pos rtse gsum gnyis pas gri skyog po/ g.yon pas ka pā la sha chen gyis gang ba/ bya rog gi tshogs spro ba/ khyi nag gis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na rol pas gar mdzad cing / phyogs bzhir skyes bu gsal zhing la btsugs pa/ wa rnams sgra 'byin pa dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis bskor ba'o/ /hriXkaX kaX baX bo rnams las bha gī nis 'byud pa/ kā li dang /ka ra lī dang bha ra ḍi dang / be+e ta li rnams gri thod bsnams pas bskor ba'o/ /rang gi bdag bskyed rdzogs pa dang / ye shes pa spyan 'dren dam gzhag dbang bskur/ mchod gtor phul la/ las bcol/ mchod gtor gyi sngags ni/ oX shrī spu i dam bā ling gro hā gro hā huX phaṭa/ mahā maX sa pur+sha dh+wa pe dī pe/ rak+ṣa tā la pa tā le/ aṣ+ṭa nā ga /de ba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ gro hā pā ya gro hā dz+wa ya i dam bā liX ha ha hūX hūX kha kha 'a hi 'a hi hū ཾ ༷ dza h+pha mahā aṭaṭa hā sa/ ga rdza ya ga rdza ya/ ta dzi ya ta dzi ya/ oX kriṣ+ṭha bhaṇ+ḍa h+pha h+pha phaṭa/ rtsa sngags ni/ shā sa na'o/ /drag sngags ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyi ste/ dag las shes/ /'dis 'jig rten pa'i gtor sngags kyang rung ngo / /der rtsa sngags/ snying po/ drag sngags rnams 'bum du bzlas la/—57—

slad nas/ yang rang nyid sgom nas mtshan ma dmigs kyi bar bzla'o/ /de nas nag po'i tshes la/stan nag po la 'dug /ba byung lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang / dri bzang dang gri khrag gis chag chag btab pa'i stegs bu la gzhon nu ma'i rdul dang ro sol gyis dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas la/ me tog nag po'i gdan lnga tshom bu bkod/ sha chen gyis spos dang / gtor ma sogs bshams/ bdag mdun gnyis ka rdzogs nas/ mchod gtor phul la bzlas pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams su tshogs 'khor bya ste/ 'di bsnyen bsgrub sbrags ma ste/ zla drug sogs bya/ de nas thun dang po la/ bdag bskyed dran tsam bya/ de nas nga rgyal de tsam la gnas pas/ mdun bskyed kho na sgrub ste/ mthar drag tu bskul ba mang du bya/ rang nyid tshogs 'khor sogs kyi tshe sgrub grogs yod na de bzlas pa dang bskul ba byed du gzhug go /'di rgyun mi 'chad du byas pas nges par zhag bdun sogs la rtags 'byung ste/ de nas las sbyor bya'o/ /dgra bo'i dri ma bdun po gang rnyed dang / rdo dang lcags dang zangs dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gro phye las/ ling ga byas pa'i snying gar dug dang ske tshe dang / gri khrag dang bya rog gi khrag dang rgya skyegs kyis mi pags la 'khor lo man ngag ltar bri/ 'khor lo skyed chog rab gnas dkris sogs drag las spyi dang 'dra/ de ling ga'i snying gar bcug la bu ga bkag /de'i bshang lam nas spyi bor gsal shing las byung ba'am/ lcags kyi gtsangs (rtsang ka kyis 'khor lo la ma gnod par phug /mi rus kyi phur bu yang sgrub pa byas nas bzhag /dug dang khrag chen gyis byugs pa'i tsher ma sngags kyis bsgrubs pas lus bkang nas/ lhor sor bcu gnyis pa'i dong zur gsum pa/ ro sol gyis byugs par bcug la sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan/ de nas bsam gtan gyi las tshogs bzlas pa dang bcas gtso 'khor gyi sngags kun dang dgug bzhugs gzhug dang / khrag sna thal chen/ yungs kar rnams kyis thun gyi brab pa dang / mi rus kyis phur bus brdab pa rnams byas la/ de ltar zhag gsum dang lnga dang bdun bar ma chad du bya/ slar rab chad kyi thod pa kha sbyor du —58—

bcug la/ dgug bzhugs dang / kha spyor phye nas sku las spros pa'i khā dang khyi dang / gtum po/mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gri gug gis btub pa dang za ba'i bar byed par bsams shing / rnam par shes pa dbyings su spar la/ sngags ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi gong du che ge mo mā ra ya zhes pa gzhug ste/ thun bsdu khar sprul pa rnams 'khor lo la bcug nas mchod gtor phul la bzod gsol byas te/ ling ga sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan no/ /de yang thun bzhin bsgrubs pas/ 'gul ba sogs mthong na/ mahā kwa la mchod nas/ yang ling ga lcags kyis phug /lcags lag pa g.yon pas bzung /lag pa g.yas pas tsher ma dang thun gyis bsnun nas gsang sngags bzla'o/ /mtshan phyed kyi dus su/thab kyi thugs ka nas me byung bas brdungs par bsams shing / dur khrod kyi me'i rgyun gyi 'bras phub kyi me la gdung ba zhag bdun bya me ma shi ba byed gsung / de nas ling ga dang 'khor lo de gzhin rje la gtad pa'am/ sbyin sreg bya'am gtor mar dbul ba gang yang rung ba byas pas nges par 'grub ste/ gal te zhig rgya la ma 'grub na/ khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi zhal du nag po chen po'i gzugs 'bul ba'i sbyin sreg byed de des ni mi 'grub pa mi srid gsung / sgrubs pa'i skabs nag po chen po/ rtse gsum kha thur ltas la gnas pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs khyi la bzhon pa/ g.yas g.yon du rang dang 'dra ba la/ phyag gsum gar na gsal shing re re bzung ba sgom pa yin no/ /drag shul gyi skabs 'dir mi gsal ba stong zad zhal las shes pa dang / ma mo dang gshin rje'i 'khor lo'i skabs/ kha bskong dgos pa tshes mang ba yod do/ /'dir mahā kwa la'i drag shul sbyor ba 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan la med kyang / man ngag /gzhal gdams yin cing / skabs 'dir 'byung pos 'dzin pa dang spyo bar byed pa gnyis gsung ste/ 'dir ma bris so/ /de ltar drag shul gyi sbyor ba ste drug pa'o/ /sgom pa'i phyir zlog ni/ mngon rtogs rdzogs pa dang / snying ga'i paṃ las/ de spros/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gnyis/ nang ma rtsibs bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ phyi ma bcu

la sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang / mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma rnams/ 'di rnams gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi bskyed nas/ 'khor lo skor zhing sngags bzlas te/ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye sarba dwa : na sta bha ya pra tu gi ra sdi hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla la gzhan ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bri ba'i zlog pa ni/ bsgoms pa ltar 'khor lo rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa la sngags sngar gyi lha'i rim pas bris/ che ge mo la gnod pa'i sngags dang / 'khrul 'khor ngan pa byed pa thams cad pra t+ya gi ra hi zhes sam mā ra ya/ stu bha ya ban+ta ya hu phaṭa/ ces bris nas bsgrubs pa ni spyi dang 'dra ste sngags dang lha'i khyad tsam mo/ /de yang rdul gyi ras la gur gum dang tsan dan dmar pos bris/ rdo rwa me ri'i phyi ma/ phyogs re rer sngags thams cad la hūṃ che ge mo la rak+ṣa hū zhes spel lo/ /mthar sgrub pa'am 'dogs pa gang rung bya'o/ /phyir zlog pa ste bdun pa'o/ /tshogs mchod ni dang por gzhon nu ma yi mchod pa bya la/ de yang gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ste mdor bsdus rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi yig snar bkod zin la/ mchod pa'i skabs btung ba dang / mgo la sku ba dang dri'i byugs pa dang /mig sman dang / rdo ra'i thig le dang / gos dmar po dang / me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang / so rtsi sogs dngos su sbyin no zhes pa ni lag len no/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs dpa' bo drug dang rnal 'byor ma drug ces gsungs pa ni/ slob dpon ma gtogs pa ste tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /mang po yod na lha re re la gnyis gnyis sogs byas pas rung zhing / gang ltar mtshan mo'i dus sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / byin dbab zhu 'bul dang / bdag bskyed dang phyi rol mchod pa gtor ma bcas pa dang / tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / lha la 'bul ba dang / tsho gis byin len du byed pa dang / mahā ste ra ba ro langs 'jigs byed mchod pa dang / longs spyod pa dang / brda dang glu gar bya ba dang / rjes chags dang / lhag gtor ma mo dgu dang / 'byung po sogs la sbyin te cho ga ni spyi dang —60—

mthun no/ /tshogs kyi bya ba grub pa na/ slob dpon gyis byin rlabs byas nas bde stong dbang bzhi pa nyams su blangs pas skya rengs shar ba'i tshe phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes/ gang zag lam mthon por song ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa zhig gis nye rgyu sgrub tshul gyi 'phros la tshogs 'khor gsungs pa ste/ tshogs mchod dang spyod pa ste brgyad pa'o/ /bsnyen pa dang las rim bdun te/sgrub thabs las bdun can gyi man ngag gi gnas tsam thams cad stan zin to/ /'di'i man ngag gi zhal gdams ci rigs pa zhig da dung yod snang bas rnyed na bstan par bya'o/ /ngag 'don nam nag 'gros su bris na tshogs che bas 'dir mdo tsam ste lag len mthong ba las shes so/ /smras pa/ khengs ldan rnams ni yi ge tsam lta ste/ /man ngag med na de dag rnam par 'khyams/ /rang bzo kun la man ngag mchog go zhes/ /deng sang rab rmongs phal cher 'di na smra/ /rgyud don yin yang man ngag zhal gdams te/ /gzhan la med kyang gzhan dang mi 'gal ba/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ci phyir 'di mi brten/ /phyogs 'dzin can rnams ci dgar byed la reg /ces pa'ang smras so/ /'gro la rtag tu phan pa'i don/ /man ngag gsal bar bris pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro kun mchog thob shog /'khrul na 'phags mas bzod pa'i rigs/ /zhes pa'ang dpal stag lung thang pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyis zhal snga nas bka' stsal spyi bos nod de/ tā ra nā thas gu ru lho phyogs pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa ni rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o/ /zhus dag/ka phywa ṇa wadhe/ ma ṅga la bsnyur// //—61 —

dang bcas pa mdo tsam gyi yi ge bde chen rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ su sti su sti bha snye/ na mo badz+ra yo gi nī ā+oṃ/ 'bum phrag 'char ka'i 'od 'chang 'khril ldem sku/ /rab chags bde bas myos pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /mi phyed sngags kyi de nyid rtag 'char ba/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /zhabs sen snar ma'i mdza' bo'i 'od ris dag /srid gsum bde byed sa 'dzin rtser bkod las/ /yon tan ge sar rdul gyis yongs brdal bas/ /phyogs kun ku mud nags tshal skal bzang gyur/ /gang gi bka' drin kun dga'i dga' ston la/ /brtse dgar rol las bde chen mdza' mo yis/ /rnam kun rtse 'jos yid dga' thob 'di mtshar/ /de phyir 'di ni bla ma dam pa'i lung / /gang dag phyogs su lhung ba'i blo/ /legs pa'i tshul la dpyod med de/ /rta gdong bdag po'i 'od gsal ba/ /sbyin skyes rnams la mun pa nyid/ /smra mang yi ge gdams pas dman/ /rnyed pa'i lcags kyu ya mtshan rmad/ /gzhan du mi dbang tshig gcig gis/ /grong khyer yul 'khor bcas mnga' bdag /de lta bas na bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams kyi zhal lung ste/ de yang rgyud thams cad kyi mthar thug pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po'i nges gsang mchog las brtsams te/ tshe gcig kho nas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du byed pa ste/ rje —62—

btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kho na la brten nas rim pa gnyis bsgom par bya ba las/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa ni 'dir bshad par bya la/ phyi ma rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni re zhig gzhan du shes so/ /de yang dpal rdo rje 'chang he ru ka yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams las grub chen nā ro pas dngos su brnyed pa ste/ de la 'dir sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'i nyams len gnyis las/ dang po la/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun pa nyid do/ /de la yang thog mar re re la rtags thon thon sbyong zhing / de dag tu cung zad spros pa la dga' ba'i rigs yin na/ phyag dang bskor pa sā tsa gdab pa sogs bsags sbyang spros pa mang du bya la/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i rigs ni bla ma'i mos gus kyis bskul ba'i dmigs pa so so nyid 'bad de bya ba kho nas don tshang ba yin no/ /phyis ni thun gyi thog mar ci rigs bsgoms pas 'grub bo/ /de dag kyang re re kho na dang / gnyis ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / bzhi ldan sogs rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par ci rigs rigs su bsgom pa ste/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i nyams len la rnal 'byor bcu gcig yod pa/ bsdu na thun gyi sngon 'gro rnal 'byor dngos gzhi/ rjes thun mtshams te gsum las/ dang po la/spros pa la mos na/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sngon 'gro gtor ma/ rten byin rlabs/rang lhar bsgoms pas bdag bsrung/ go cha dgod pas rnal 'byor bsrung ba/tshams rngam gyis gnas bsrung ba/ zhing sbyong zhing lha mnyes pa'i phyir gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs rnams kyang / gzhung bzhin thun thams cad dam thog ma lta bu ——63—

gcig la bya/ mi spro na de dag bsnyen pa sogs rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i skabs mi dgos shing / bsgrub mchod sogs la ni nges par bya ba yin no/ /'dir nges par sbyar ba ni ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khore ba'i sdug bsngal las 'bras mi bslu ba/ cis kyang dgos med rnams blo 'gyur ba thon nges re bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ de rjes dam rdzas byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdud rtsi myang bas snying ga'i ba yig la mchod par mos shing / rang gi lus 'od ltar dwangs pa dang bde bas tshims par bsam/ 'bru gsum dag tu brjod/ 'di ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa kun rdzob byang sems kun+da bde chen gyi sems bskyed pa'o/ /de rjes su tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ tshad med bzhi yang byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa yin pas/ mdo sngags thun mong gi sems bskyed pa gsal 'debs pa nyid yin la/ de'i yan lag tu tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /spro na yig brgya'i rnal 'byor spyi dang mthun pa zhig bar 'dir byed pa'i srol yod pa ltar byar rung la/ nges par dgos pa'i cho ga ni ma yin no/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ rdo rje chos ni gsung rdo rje yin la/ bla ma'i sku drin yang gtso bor gsung gi sgo nas thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bla ma rdo rje chos su sgom pa man ngag yin cing / sku mdog dmar pos sems can la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags pa mcho ni/ ḍa ma rle'i sgras grag stong bde stong nyid spros pa thams cad shrī~X /de 'i do /༵ ༵rdo bye rngo gyur ni byer mai ༵ sa shes rdo/ bog cig ༷༵ dhi stsu —64—

tu mtshon pa/ thugs bde stong gi snang cha rdo rje chos kyi rnam par shar ba ni/ sku dang ye shes zung 'jug ste de mtshon byed do/ /de'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung chos/thugs sangs rgyas te/ de yang mthar thug gi skyabs gsum ngo bo gcig pa'i gnad kyis yin no/ /de ltar yang / thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de'i mthar thug phyir/ /zhes so/ /nge/ la gsol ba btab pas rang la thim pa yan chad bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ de ltar na/ skyabs 'gro/ tshad med/ rdor sems kyi rnal 'byor rnams spyi dang thun mong yin la/ bdud rtsi myang ba dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni thun mong ma yin pa ste/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang bzlas pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ mngon rtogs dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa dang / 'di kho nar bskyed rim gyi yan lag rnams dang lam thams cad tshang bar rtsi ba dang /dmigs pa'i gtso bo lha'i snang zhen la bslab pa'o/ /dang po la/ gang 'tshang rgya ba'i rang bzhin/ gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing /ji ltar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bsgom pa ste bzhi las/dang po ni 'chi ba chos sku lam du 'khyer ba yin te/ de yang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi rkyen nges sad pa las/ rnam par mi rtog pa cung zad gcig sgom par bya la/ de ni gong du tshad med kyi snying rje chen po dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi mos gus byin rlabs dang / bdud rtsi myang ba'i bde ba rnams/ skabs 'dir mi rtog pa'i stong nyid dang ro gcig tu bsres pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i don te/ rang bzhin —65—

bde stong zung 'jug snying rje dang byin rlabs kyi thabs las mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhes bsnyad pa yin cing / 'dis 'chi srid spyong zhing / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i sa bon gsos 'debs pa dang / lam gong ma rdzogs rim bsgoms pa na/ don gyi 'od gsal rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi 'dings pa yin no/ /'di kho nar ma zad/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo thams cad la/ dag rdzogs smin gsum myong ba zhig dgos te/ mar 'khor ba dang rnam pa mthun pas srid pa sbyong zhing dag par byed pa dang / yar sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul dang mthun pas 'bras bu rdzogs byed dang / bar du rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba gcig rnams tshang dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying gar chos 'byung gsal gdab pa'i skabs yin te/gzhi dus kyi sems can rnams gang du skye ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i bag chags sbyong / 'bras bu'i dus gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing rnam par dag pa'i thabs te/ chos 'byung 'og ma spyir snod kyi 'jig rten dang / gong mas mngal skyes kyi mngal dang / sgong skyes kyi sgo nga'i khyim dang / skye gnas gzhan gnyis kyi gnas kyi bag chags sbyong bar byed do/ /chos 'byung 'og ma ni stong pa nyid/gong ma ni stong pa de'i rang gdangs snying rje/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba chen po/ bsnol mar gnas pa ni bde ba stong pa snying rje gsum ming dang ldog pa'i chas phye ba ma gtogs/ ngo bo sems dang ye shes su gcig pu gnyis med par mtshon te/ chos 'byung de gnyis ka'ang gdengs ka zur gsum gyen bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra zur gcig pa thur du bstan pa ste/ spyir zur bzhi pa yin la/—66—

phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zur gsum mo/ /de yang gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ longs spyod bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rig ma'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ khri/ gsum du ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes pas/ zur gsum 'og mas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa gsum dang / gong mas sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang /chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum mtshon no/ /zur gsum mtshan pa gnyis kyang sku gsung thugs gsum dang / lus ngag yid gsum mtsho ni te/ de la zur 'og mas ni gsum ka la khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo 'dus ma byas dang / bde chen kyi snying rje dang / gzhi dus kyi 'gyur bde lam dus dang / 'bras dus kyi ye shes rdo rje tshon pa ste/ longs spyod bzhi sogs kyi don no/ /stong pa nyid shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pa dang / gru gsum gyi rnam pas bde chen 'dren byed gsang ba'i bha ga mtshon pas rig ma'i skyes bu zhes chos 'byung la btags pa'o/ /de la rnam par thar pa gsum ni/ ji skad du/ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa kun dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di la bshad lugs mang na'ang /'dir dngos po gang la yang ngo bor rang bzhin mi dmigs pa ni stong nyid dang /rgyu rkyen gyi 'char sgo ma 'gags bzhin du rgyu rkyen rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i skye med ni mtshan ma med pa dang / 'bras bu rang bzhin mi dmigs pas de la rnam rtog med pa ni smon med de/ snying rje gsum la yang ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba bshad —67—

khungs dang ldan pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir na re zhig spyi skad dang mthun par bya ste/sems can rnams sdug bsngal ba las sgrol 'dod pa ni sems can la dmigs pa/ sems can rnams phra ba'i mi rtag pa skad cig gis skye 'jig can las skyob par sems dpa' ni chos la dmigs pa/ sems can ma dmigs bzhin du de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la brtse ba mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin du shar ba ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ste/ phyi ma 'di dngos ni so so skye bo la med mod/phyogs mthun ni phung sogs 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di ye nas/ grub rgyu med pa brjod bral du 'dug pa la/ der ma rtogs pa la snying rjer shar ba'i gdangs ma 'gags shing / de la bden 'dzin mngon gyur gyi bdag pos ma bcos pa zhig 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar na grub pa'i don stong pa'i sems las skye srid len pa'i sems sogs 'byung zhing skye ba len pa sogs 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / ji skad du/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i lha bskyed pa sogs thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi gdangs de kho na las 'byung ba zhig dgos te/ stong pa las lha sku 'byung ba mtshon no/ /gzhan yang chos 'byung ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin dang / bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mtshon pa yin cing / chos 'byung 'og ma bde skyong 'khor lo dang / steng ma sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang / zla ba chos 'khor dang / ba yig longs spyod 'khor lo dang / yi ge so gnyis bde chen 'khor lo mtshon pas/ rdzogs rim skabs rtsa 'khor de rnams grol zhing dag pa —68—

dang / 'od zer spro bsdu dang 'od kyi gong bus 'bar 'dzag dang / dga' 'khyil bzhi ni thig le bzhi dang 'byung bzhi'i rlung / lag bcu drug ni thig le 'pho ba bcu drug ste/ de rnams byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi skabs mi 'gyur ba'i thig le thob pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ chos 'byung der zla ba sgom pa nas go cha ma bkod par te/de la zla ba ni pha'i khu ba/ ba yig ni bar do'i sems nyid/ sngags 'phreng ma'i rdul/ de gsum 'dzom pa yin ni/ ji skad du/ de rjes khu khrag zhu thig le/ /'dres pa ru ni gyur pa na/ /kun gzhi las ni rnam shes skye/ /ji ltar chang ros myos pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de la zla ba la ba yig bkod pa'i rjes su yi ge so gnyis gsal btab na/ pha'i khams dkar po bar do zhugs zin pa de mngal du 'jug pa mtsho ni cing / zla ba sngags 'phreng sngon la bskyed nas/ ba yig phyis bsgoms na/ mngal du dkar dmar tshogs zin pa la bar srid 'jug pa spyod pa dang / dus mnyam du bskyed pa ltar na/ gsum tshogs pa tsam la bar do'i lus ma 'gag pa'i skabs dang sbyor ro/ /de nas de gsum 'dres pa dang / 'od 'phros pa na rlung bcu sogs rim pas grub pa/ sdig sgrib sbyangs pa ni yan lag rdzogs par 'grub pa'i 'gal rkyen spangs pa yin la/ 'di nyid kyi lugs srol 'ga' zhig las/ 'od zer phyi rol tu yang spro bsdu byed pa'i man ngag yod pa'ang mi legs pa ma yin no/ /tshur 'dus thim pa ni/ phung khams skye mched rim pas grub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni dbang po rnams rdzogs nas btsas pa/ de yang zla ba sngags 'phreng ba yig dus gcig la bskyed nas rim pas gsal —69—

gdab pa 'di bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku lam 'byer te/ de yang gzhi dus 'chi ba 'od gsal las ldang ba dang bar do 'grub pa dus mnyam/ bar do 'gag pa dang skye srid 'grub pa dus mnyam pa yin pa de spyong zhing / rdzogs rim skabs 'od gsal dag pa'i lhar ldang ba'i smin byed du 'gro la/ 'bras dus chos sku las longs skur bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /zla ba sa bon sngags 'phreng bcas gcig tu 'dres pa phan chad skye ba sprul sku lam 'khyer yin no/ /bskyed zin nas kyang chos 'byung zla ba ba yig sngags rnams sngar ltar bsgom dgos shing / sngags rnams ni mgo gyen bstan ba yig la kha mngon du phyogs pa'o/ /de yang thig le zla ba khu ba sku/ /rnam par bcad pa rdul nyi gsung / /a yig mun can thugs rab brjod/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dir yang ma'i rak+ta gsung gi chos yin pas sngags su bkod pa dang / ba gyi srog la yang a yig gi don tshang ngo / /skye gnas g.yin gyi tshul la'ang / zla ba sngags 'phreng dang 'od kyi gong bu sgong skyes kyi khu bcud dang sems 'dres pa sbyong zhes bla ma dag gsung la/ don ni gzhan rnams mnga' skyes dang 'dra ba las/ 'od kyi gong bus sgong las skyes pa'i bag chags sbyong ba yin la/ zla ba dang sngags 'phreng ni drod gsher skyes la gsher dang drod gnyis dang / rdzus skyes la/ gnas lus la sred pa dang len pa'i mthu gsos btab pa mtshon cing sbyong ba yin no/ /rdzogs rim skabs kyang khams dkar dmar 'du 'phrod las bde chen gyi lha bskyed pa dang /'bras bu longs skus sprul pa rags pa'i sku 'dzin pa'i tshul ston pa dang 'dra'o/ /skabs 'dir sku'i rnam pa'i mtshon don rnams kyang shes dgos te/—70—

'og tu 'chad pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ go cha 'ching ba/ ye shes pa dgug gzhuga'agro ba dag pa rnams te/ de la go cha bcings pas phung khams byin gyis brlab cing / go cha'i ha yo ni/ snying kha'i ba yig gi gong tsam du bsgom pa yin la/ phaṭa ni tshigs chen la bskong ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi phyi thams cad dgang bar bsgom mo/ /'di rnams bsgoms pas bgegs dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing / rdzogs rim gyi skabs 'khor lo lnga dang / tshigs kyi 'khor lo kun gyi rlung dang thig le la dbang thob pas dbu mar thim par byed pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur la/ 'tshang rgya ba'i che tshe rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu'o/ /ye shes pa bstim pa'i gnas skabs su/ dam ye mchog dman tha dad du 'dzin pa spong zhing / ye shes pa der rang sems su shes shing / rdzogs rim skabs dpe'i 'od gsal gyi thabs kyis don gyi ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyu dang /'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i tshe thams cad ye shes gcig tu 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ /'gro ba dag pa ni/ snying ga'i 'od kyis phog pas phyi nang gi 'jig rten thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ste/ zhing sbyong ba dang 'gro ba smin pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de ltar gsum la/ gzhi dus su yang go cha bkod pas skye mched dang sgo gsum gyi nus pa mthar gyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dam ye bsres pas 'gro ba ris mthun snga ma rnams dang sems dang dran pa dang blo gros kyi nus pa mnyam pa dang / lo bcu gnyis sam bcu drug gi mthar bde ba rdzogs pa mtshon te/ yo ga shurnyo'i sngags kyis nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i skabs —71—

'byud rgya byed pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /'gro ba dag pas ni/ rang rang gi las kyi bya ba la gnas pa dang mtshungs so/ kha cig rigs bdag rang chas dang /kha cig rigs bdag gi dod du rdo rje phyed pa byed do/ /'on kyang 'dir dbang bskur rgyas btab sgos su mi byed pa'i lugs la thod skam lnga rigs lnga mtshon byed kyi dbu rgyan rang chas so/ /gnyis pa 'di de kho nar bskyed rim gyi yan lag rnams dang / lam thams cad tshad rtsi ba ni/ lhar bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung sogs ni gsang dbang gi lam/ g.yon bskor du 'khor ba'i bde ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam/ de la mi rtog pa bde stong dbyer med dbang bzhi pa'i lam/chos 'byung rang nyid gsang dbang / dga' ba 'khyil ba shes rab ye shes/ mi rtog pa dbang bzhi pa'o/ /yang chos 'byung 'og mas gsang gnas/ gong mas lte ba sprul 'khor mtshon te/ de gnyis na rtsa mdud gru gsum gnas pas so/ /zla ba ni mi shigs pa'i thig le mtshon pas/ snying kha chos 'khor dang / ba gyis mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud mtshon pa dang / yi ge so gnyis ni spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis dang byang sems so gnyis 'bab pa mtshon pas gsang dbang dang / 'khor lo de dag tu dga' ba bzhi 'char ba ni dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhis mtshon te shes dbang dang /dga' 'khyil re re la lag bzhi bzhi bcu drug ni mas brtan dga' ba bcu drug dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu dril pa'o/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo / /gzhan yang zla ba me long ye shes dang / /nyi ma'i dod sngags 'phreng mnyam nyid dang / ba yig sa bon sor rtog ste spyor ba dang / rnal 'byor —72—

dang po yin la/ 'od 'phro 'du bya grub dang / sku yongs rdzogs chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /de rnams bsnyen pa'i yan lag yin cing / go cha ni nyer bsgrub ste shin tu rnal 'byor dang / ye shes pa bstim pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / zhing sbyong sogs bsgrubs pa chen po dang / go cha sogs gsum po de las rgyal mchog dang / phyi ma gnyis rnal 'byor chen lnga'o/ /bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsum lam phyed kyang tshang ste/ lhar bzhengs pa yan chad sprul sku lam byed dang / go cha nas bzlas pa'i bar longs sku lam byed dang /bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor chos sku lam yin cing / gzhan yang don gyis na mkhyen gsum lam byed kyang tshang bar mngon la/ rgyud sde spyi la grags pa'i sku gsum lam byed ni gong du bshad zin to/ /'di dag lung dang sbyar rgyu mang mod kyi yi ge nyung ba la mngon par dga' ba'i phyir ma spros so/ /gnyis pa lha'i snang zhen la bslab pa la gsum/ gsal snang la bslab pa dang / nga rgyal bslab pa dang / bde stong du 'chang ba la bslab pa'o/ /dang po la yang rnam pa la bslab pa dang / dag pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i steng gi nor bu la sems 'dzin te/ de yang mi rus kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar gdan zlum po la gnas pa'i tog zlum po'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin/ sems 'dzin tshul spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'khor lo las gyes pa'i rus pa'i drwa ba dang / dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran cung zad dang bcas pa'i thod skam lnga po la sems 'dzin/ de nas thod skam lnga'i sbrel thag rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba steng 'og tu rim pa gnyis dang / snyan ltag tu dpa' mo'i —73—

dar dpyangs ljang khu gsum 'byog tu lding ba dang / bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra grol ba sil le bun ne bas sku stong khyab pa nā ga ge sar gyi me tog sil mas brgyan pa dang / spyan dbus ma dang / spyan gnyis te mtha' dmar zhing spyan 'bras nag pa/ rnam par bkra la g.yo zhing hur bag tu gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dang / shangs dkyus zul zul cung zad mtho zhing mdzes pa dang / smin phrag tu khro gnyer 'byog po bsdus pa dang / snyan shal ring la mdzes pa dang /rus pa'i snyan cha dang / mgrin pa sgeg bag chags pa dung 'khyil ba'i ri mo lta ba dang / mgul rgyan dra phyed dang / skra mtshams su rus pa'i za ra tshogs dang / de nas 'jam la ring zhing phra sbom phyed la shugs dang ldan pa'i phyag g.yon steng phyogs su thod pa 'dzin tshul dang / de la zhal ras gyen du phyogs pa ni/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gang ba yid tsam 'dzum zhing / khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu lhag ger gsal ba dang / phyag g.yas thur du drag tu brkyangs shing sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i bsnun thabs dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug g.yas pas 'dzin pa dang / yang na 'dir rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru lhan cig tu bzung bar byas kyang rung la/ sgrub thabs khungs ma gzhan las rdo rje kho na yang bshad cing 'dir ḍā ma ru g.yas su bzung na kha ṭāX ga la ḍā ma ru bcangs pa mi byed cing / 'dir ḍā ma ru med na kha ṭāX ga la cang te'u btags pa dgos so zhes kyang lugs gzhan no/ /de bzhin du rab dkar thod pa dmar la dwangs pa'i rak+ta'i rgyun gyis gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung bas/ khrag gi rgyun zhal tu snye gsol ba dang / de nas dpung gdub gnyis dang / phyag gdub gnyis dang /—74

mtho la zlum zhing mkhregs pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa dang / mnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sked skabs dang / thod dum gyi 'og pag can gyi ske rags las dra ba dra phyed dril bu gsil gsil 'phyang ba dang / lhag par rgyas pa'i sta zur dang /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i lto ba dang / ze'u lhag ger bzhad pa'i bha ga mtho la sdug pa dang / mkhrang bag chags pa'i brla dang bcas pa'i zhabs g.yon bskum pa dang / g.yas brkyang ba dang / zhabs gdub las g.yer kha 'khrol ba dang / de nas 'jigs byed kha bub tu bskyel ba'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas rna ba g.yon pa steng du lta ba mnan pa dang / dus mtshan ma thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba gan kyal du bskyel ba'i nu ma nas/ skye gnas kyi bar mnan pa dang / man+da ra ba gsar du kha bye ba lta bu'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'brum phrag 'phro ba dang sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma mang po can lhag par rgyas pa'i gdan dang / me dpung drag tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ sku lus li khri'i mdangs can dmar la dwangs shing 'od 'phreng 'khrug pa pad+ma ra ga'i lhun po la thun mtshams kyi dmar bas phog pa lta bu'i sku mdog dang / phrag pa g.yon la brten pa'i kha ṭāX ga yab dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo/ de yang rtsa ba na rdo rje rtse gcig /de'i steng du keng rus kyi dbyug pa'i rtse mo la bum pa sna tshogs rdo rjes kha brgyan pa las ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha dang / ba dan lce gsum pa dpyangs pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du mi mgo rlon pa sngo nag/rid pa dmar po/ bag bral gyi thod ril dkar po rnams brtsegs pa/ rtse mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang bcas pa la rim pas sam cig car sems 'dzin pa ste/ de yang kha ṭāX ga phrag par 'phred la bkal ba dang /—75—

mchan khung du brten pa dang / kha ṭā ga'i 'og gi rtse mo thod pa dang lhan cig phyag g.yon pas bzung bar 'dod pa ste lugs gsum mo/ /de ltar cha sum cu so bdun du rim pas slob pa ni man ngag gi rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /mthar cig car gsal gdab ste/ gsal dwangs snyog pa med pa nam mkhar 'ja' tshone shar ba lta bu la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag /gang la dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i yul gyi khyad par ma gtogs/ 'dzin lugs ni thun mong yin no/ /go rim 'di kho na dgos pa rang yang ma yin pas/ gang sems bzung glod nas bzung nas chog ste/bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa 'di lta bu dag la/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams rim pa mi 'dra ba dang / thun grangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs mdzad mod/ 'ga' zhig rim gyis bslab mi dgos pa yang yod pas ci rigs su bslab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dag pa dran pa sangs rgyas chos/ zhes pa ltar/ dag pa 'di rnams mngon rtogs nam bsgom pa'i tshe dran par yang bya dgos la/ 'dir de la/ der mos pa shugs drag pos sbyong ba yin te/ dag pa de la bzhi ste/ phyi dang / nang dang / gsang ba dang / de kho na nyid dag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos thams cad la chos dbyings stong pa gnyis med pas zhal gcig ma/ de'i ngang las gdod ma nas ma g.yos kyang / cha tsam gyis dbye na/ gdod ma'i bden pa gnyis yod pa'i kun rdzob phyag g.yon/ don dam phyag g.yas te/ de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug ni sku gcig pu/ zhabs g.yon thabs snying rjes 'jigs byed myang 'das kyi mtha' dang / g.yas shes rab stong pas dus mtshan 'khor ba'i mtha' gnon pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang /—76—

shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ /zhes pas/ mi gnas tshul 'di mdo dang thun mong ngo / /yang 'jigs dus gnyis chad par lta ba dang / rtag par lta ba mtshon pas thabs shes gnyis kyis de gnyis sel ba'ang yin no/ /zhal steng du phyogs pa yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang /thod skam lnga ni/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga/ mgo 'phreng lnga bcu sems las byung ba lnga bcu dag pa sbyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa/ mgul rgyan sbyin pa/ gdu bu tshul khrims/ rna cha bzod pa/ spyi bo'i nor bu brtson 'grus/ ska rags bsam gtan/ gang la rgyan pa'i sku shes rab/ gcer mo ni kun rtog spangs pa/ gri gug rang gzhan gyi 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa lta ba ngan pa/ the tshom ste rtsa nyon drug gcod pa/ thod pa ni rnam rtog gi mgo thod gcod pa ste/ rtog med kyi ye shes yin la/ nang bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba ni/ ye shes des bdud bzhi bcom pa/ skra grol ba ni sgrib gnyis dag pa/ kha ṭā ga zhes pa ni bod skad du bsgyur na/ mkha' dbyug ste/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las ma g.yos bzhin du gzugs skur ston pa / ye shes kyi me 'bar ba ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis srid pa gsum bsregs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes rtog med las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin du/ de nyid kyi 'char sgo dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams su snang ba sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ni zhal gcig ma/ /mgo 'phreng ni yi ge lnga bcu phyag gnyis ni gā/rnyi~X sno ga// 'a/ rdzu ༵ rdo/ ba'i~X ma sbyi ༵da lda 1 ḍi dhi rdo nga bca ༵ pa/ rdzu ḍi spo77—

bzhin/ 'jigs dus gnyis der bkag cing gnon pa/ zhal gyen du phyogs pa ni gtum mo gyen du 'bar ba/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhal du 'bab pa/ haX las byang sems 'dzag pa/ skra gol ba ni bde ba rgyas pa/ gcer mo ni bde bas rnam rtog gcod pa/ phyag rgya lnga ni phung po lnga bde ba thob pas rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gtso mo'i sku ni shes rab yum kha ṭāX ga'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / bha ga mnyam par sbyor ba/ rtsa dung can dang mkha' 'gro gdong mtshon cing /zhabs gnyis kyis 'jigs byed yab yum mnan pa ni/ de ltar snyoms 'jug gi rkyen gyis g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba dung can mar 'gags pa/ phyag gnyis ni de'i rkyen gyis steng gi lam gnyis dbu mar thim pa/ bde ba'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs gcod pa dang / dngos grub thams cad stsol pa ni spyan gnyis te/ gzhan rnams nang bshad dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ lam dus kyi skabs rnams sngar bshad pa de rnams su tshang mod/ 'dir 'bras dus la sbyor ba gtso che ba yin no/ /chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rang bzhin bde ba chen po ni bde chen gyi sku ste zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum ni sku gsum/ phyag gnyis ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yon pa ni shes rab rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid rtsal 'ga' med du 'char bas/zhi ba rkyang pa la mi gnas g.yas pa ni thabs bde chen gyi ye shes kyis srid pa'i nyon mongs thams cad rang bzhin med par rang mtshang rig pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pas spangs pa'i srid pa la mi gnas pa ste/ mi gnas tshul 'di ni sngags —78—

kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /bdud rtsi gsol ba ni/ zhu bde'i rkyen gyis sems kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes mngon du gyur pa/ spi gug gi sgrib gnyis drung nas phyung ba/kha ṭāX ga a wa dhū ting las rlung dang / khams dkar dmar gyi 'gros thams cad thim pa/ yang kha ṭāX ga ni lha yi sku/ khres rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ zhes pa ltar/ kha ṭāX ga lha sku dag pa'i sgyu lus/ ka pā la zhu bde mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ cang te'u rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'o/ /de ltar na/ dang po'i grub don gzhi dus bden gnyis dbyer med kyi gnad kas/ lam thabs shes zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas/ lta ngan sel zhing yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang /bdud dang nyon mongs pa bcom zhing sku gnyis zung 'jug mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa dang /gnyis pa'i don ni/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og gi rgyu ba dbu mar 'gags pas/ 'bar 'dzag bde stong gis rnam rtog gcod pa dang / rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ba dang / gsum pa'i don/ spyir rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde ba dang / khyad par thun mong min pa rtsa g.yas sbyor ba'i rkyen gyis thog ma 'og gi lam gnyis 'gag /de nas steng gi lam yang 'gags pas/ zhu bde khyad par can yas brtan mas brtan gyi rim pa rdzogs pa'i bde bas nyon mongs gcod cing dngos grub thams cad 'thob pa dang / bzhi pa'i don/ lus snyu lus/ sems bde stong / lus sems ngo bor dbyer med/ rtsa 'khor rnams su rtsa rlung thig le'i bgrod pa 'gags shing thim pas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sku bzhi mngon du byed pa ste/ lha sku gcig pu 'di nyid —79—

la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos tshang tshul te/ de dag re re la mos pa brtan po re bzhag pa'i mthar/ skyon kun spangs/ yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ de tsam gyis bar chad mang po sel ba dang / dngos grub dang byin rlabs cher 'byung mod/ nga rgyal rnam pa lhang nge ba de la sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsis bzung nas/ ma bcos par lam du 'khyer shes na/ byang chub sgrub pa'i nye ba'i thabs su gsungs te/ ji skad du/sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /ces so/ /de yang tha mal ma dag pa'i snang ba dang / ma dag par zhen pa'i nga rgyal zhig yod pa la/ de dag pa'i gsal snang dang / dag pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur ba yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhal snga nas kyang /tha mal rnam rtog rgyun 'di ma gtogs pa/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal par gyur pa'i yid/ /des ni mngon sum dag tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi rang bzhin can/ / gang yin de ni kun rtog 'char mi byed/ /ces so/ /gsum pa bde stong du 'char ba la bslab pa ni/ skyes pa'i rten gyis ni/ji skad du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /ces pa ltar ram/ bud med kyi rten can ni thabs dang mnyam pa sbyor ba yid kyi bsgom pas zhu bde 'dren pa'am/ yang na rnal 'byor lam dang pho nya'i lam/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs la brten nas bde ba rdzogs par byas nas/—80—

lus sems bde bar shar ba'i ngang nas lha skur gsal le ba/ nga rgyal lam me ba de la rang bzhin med par bslab par bya'o/ /'di gsum la yang rim pa 'di kho na dgos pa ma yin te/ thog mar gang nyams su blang kyang 'dra'o/ /yang man ngag las 'byung ba ltar gsang bar chos 'byung du dga' ba 'khyil ba drag tu 'khor bas bde ba bskyed par bsgom ste/ dbang gi myong ba yod na dran par byas pas bde ba dang / smin mtshams kyi phyi lpags pa'i nang tsam du dga' ba 'khyil ba bsgom pa'am/ smin mtshams kyi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil ba 'khor bas stong pa dang mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar gsungs pa ltar 'di dag kyang bsgom mo/ /'di gnyis ni yas babs dang / mas brtan gyi lhan skyes 'char sa gnyis la gnad du bsnun pa yin te/ gnad che ba zhig 'dug go /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs snying gar byed pa'am/ yang na man ngag las 'byung ba 'di las dang po pa la 'phral du zab ste/ chos 'byung sa bon sngags 'phreng nye 'og gam/ gsang gnas su phab la klog pa'i tshul gyis thog mar ngag bzlas dang / de nas yid bzlas bya/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs gtso bor spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ci nus bya'o/ /yid bzlas la ni dang por bkod pa'i bzlas pa dang / de nas chos 'byung g.yon bskor du bar med du 'khor zhing /yi ge mi 'khore bar 'dug pa la rnga sems gtad de/ lag len ltar bum pa can ci rigs su sgom mo/ /de la ngag bzlas ni/ 'khor bar ming tshig yi ge'i rnam rtog dang ngag gi bag chags sbyong / rdzogs rim rdor bzlas bum can sogs rlung gi rnal 'byor —81 —
