gyi sngon du 'gro bas rlung dag par byed/ 'bras bu gsung gzhom med kyi nā da'i dbyangs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'o/ /yid bzlas ni rdzogs rim gyi yan lag tu bzhed pa ltar don la'ang gnas pas/ gong gi phrugs gcig po de'i sbyang bya de dag dang mi sbyor yang /smin rdzogs kyi nus pa mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni gzhung chung las snying po kho na las ma gsungs kyang / man ngag las rgyas pa yi ge so gnyis pa dang / 'bring po gzhung gi dngos bstan bzhin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags dang / bsdus pa snang mdzad ma'i sngags rnams spyir gdam ngag yin pa las/ dang po gtso bor byed do/ /de yan chad dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gsum pa rjes thun mtshams la/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ da lta snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus pa/ lhar snang stong par nges pa'i phyir dang / khyad par khams gsum gyi dngos po rnams lus kyi cha gsum la bsdu ba ni/ rags pa thim pa/ lus dang sngags 'khor ba yig rmams rim pas bsdu ba/ snang ba gsum / nā da yang bsdus pa 'od gsal te/gzhi dus 'khor ba'i 'chi ba slar yang 'byung ba mtshon nga/ dang / lam/ dus su 'od gsal sgrub pa'i rgyu dang / 'bras dus su gzugs kyi sku mi snang bar bsdu ba mtshon no/ /slar yang thun mtsham/sa kyi lha ldang ba ni je dang de las bar srid/zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba mtshon cing / sku dang sprul pa rgyun mi/ 'chad pa yang mtshon no/ /yang na 'di'i tshab tu thun mtshams kyi lha la gsol ba btang nga 'i rjes la/ chos 'byung sngags 'phreng zla ba ba yig rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ ro — 82 —

ma nas brgyud/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rnal 'byor mar gyur/ thams cad 'dus/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/rkyang ma nas brgyud nas lte bar byon/ zhabs gnyis ro rkyang gi sna la gtad pas de gnyis zhabs la thim/ dh+ra tir zhugs nas gyen du gshegs/ dbu ma lus dang bcas pa je thung je thung le ya snyel/ cung zad mi rtog par bzhag go /sna g.yon nas thon pa'i 'pho ba byed pa'ang yod mod kyi/ 'di bzang bar snang ngo / /'dir yang gong dang mtshungs te/ de las ldang ba ni/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pas 'gro ba rnams kyis mi mthong yang / don la chad pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba mi mnga' zhing / 'phrin las dus rgyun chad pa med par spyod pa mtshan no/ /de ltar de thams cad 'bras bu lam du byed pa dang / srid pa ma spangs par lam du byed pa gzhi bsgyur pa yin pas/ dmigs pa de dang de la 'bras bu de dang de'i nga rgyal dang / gzhi'i chos de dang de rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du mos pa bya dgos so/ /dmigs pa 'di 'pho ba dang 'brel ba yin gsung ngo / /de yang baX yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pas he ru ka dpyid pa dang / phag mo thig le ro gcig tu bsres pa mtshon gsung / de la/ nang sems kyi rang bzhin baX yig shin tu dwangs pa'i rlung sems phra mo ste/ sbyang bya rlung sems phra mo/ /de sbyong byed ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yin/ zla ba sngags 'phreng rlung sems gtso bor gang la rten pa'i dkar dmar 'dres pa'i thig le dpyid ces pa ste/ sbyang bya sems rags pa dang / lus rags pa bskyed byed khams dkar dmar/ sbyong byed ye shes sems dpa'o/ /phyi'i sku ni sbyang bya/ lus sems rten —83—

dang brten pa shin tu rags pa/ sbyong byed dam tshig sems dpa'o/ /gzhi dus kyang 'khore bar 'jug pa skye ba'i tshe de gsum snga ma snga ma la/ phyi ma phyi ma 'byung zhing / 'khore ba ldog /'chi ba sogs la/ phyi ma phyi ma/ snga ma snga ma la thim 'gro bas/ skabs 'dir yang de dang rnam pa mthun par bsgoms pas/ rdzogs rim dang / 'bras dus 'od gsal thams cad stong pa mngon du byed pa'i rgyu dam pa'o/ /'di skabs bla ma 'ga' zhig gi gsung gong du bshad pa'i dpyid dang thig le de/ dag byed dmar cha nyi ma/ dkar cha thod skam du 'gro ba sogs mang du bzhed mod/ dpyad par bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam la 'jug khar bar chad srung ba'i don du go cha dgod cing / mtshams bcing ba dang /sku gsung thugs kyi lam byed dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir dag pa gsum dran pa dang /thun gyi dge ba spel ba'i phyir gzhan don du smon lam gdab pa rnams byas nas/spyod lam la 'jug ste/ sku gsung thugs lam khyer dang ma bral bar byed pa'o/ /de nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim ltar nyal na lha rdzas kyi gdan khri'i steng du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan can phyag mtshan spangs pa'i tshul gyis nyal/ rdzogs rim ltar nyal na/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor gyi rim pas nyal nas bzhed pa ltar yin la/ 'on kyang 'di dang thun mtshams kyi lha sku la/phyag mtshan spangs pa nges par sgom dgos pa ni ma yin cing / las dang po la ni rtsa ba'i dmigs pa la cung zad gnod pas/ thun gyi dmigs pa de nyid dang mtshungs par bsgoms na legs so/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor yang / nam mkhar gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang snying gi sgra —84—

bsgrags pas/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal sad par mod te/ stong pa'i ngang las lha skur langs pa'am/ lha sku'i rnam pa de nyid la thugs mi rtog pa snang med de sad par mos pa byed dgos pa yin la/ de ltar na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang / /tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed/ /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs/ /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang / /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa ltar las/ 'gro ba dag pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes la byed pa/ nā ro pa'i rgya gzhung nyid na gsal bas de ltar byas na legs shing / de bzhin du gzhung chung dang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sdom na mi gsal yang /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang / kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang / rjes chags rnal 'byor rnams/ bla med spyi 'gros kyis go nus shing / tshes bcu mchod pa dang / tshogs 'khor dang / gzhon nu ma mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg che chung dang / lag mchod sogs la bslab pa dang / lam gyi yan lag las tshogs phra mo rnams kyang man ngag bzhin shes par bya'o/ /da ni lung mdor bsdus pa dang sbyar bar bya ste/ 'di nyid grub chen nā ro ta pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba ni yin mod kyi/ rgyud gang la rten te gnas zhe na/'dir 'byor pa ni shin tu mang mod/ re zhig gang la brten nas mdzad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang kun spyod la brten te/—khyad par rdzogs rim sogs gsal bar kun spyod la brten no/ /de yang rtsa rgyud le'u dang po las/ pho nya lhan cig skyes bsgrub —85—

ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa yi ni dngos grub bya/ /'di rim pa gnyis ka'i mdor bstan yin la/ 'dir ni pho nya mo'i mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma kho na bsgoms pas 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'grub ces pa'o/ /ji ltar bsgom na/ le'u gnyis par/ rdo rje phag mo rab 'jigs ma/ /he ru ka la mngon phyogs pa/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can ma/ ka pā la ni an+t+ra sa bkang / kha nas ru ti ra 'dzag shing / /lha dang lha min mir bcas la/ /phyogs kun tu ni sdigs mdzub byed/ /ces dang /so gnyis par/ de yi kha dog mtshon cha 'chang / /zhes phyag mtshan bstan te/ he ru ka'i rang bzhin kha ṭāX ga la phyogs pa ste/ kha ṭāX ga lha pho mo thams cad la yum dang yab tu mngon brjod sogs bshad rgyud rnams las gsungs pas so/ /go cha ni/ brgyad par/ oṃ haX hri hre huX phaṭa/ yi ge baX yoX nyid dang ni/ /yi ge moX dang hri nyid dang / /huX dang phaṭa ces sbyar ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu grags/ /zhes pa'o/ /dam ye bsre ba ni/ nyer brgyad par/ mchog 'bring tha ma lhan cig 'gugs/ /zhes pa dang / smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung dang thig le ni/ bzhi par/a wa dh+wa ti'i gnas de bzhin/ /smin ma'i bar du nges par gzhug /ces so/ /gsang bar bsgom pa ni bzhi par/ khyim du dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin zhes pas bstan cing / nyer gsum par/ 'di yi mtshan ma khyim du ni/ /rdo rje lta bu me long bcas/ /sogs kyang phyogs mthun no/ /bskyed gzhi dang lte bar bsgoms pa'i chos 'byung sogs ni/ lnga par/ de nas chos kun 'byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs lte bar mi shigs dge /sngags pas cho ga bzhin du bri/ /chos kun gcig tu bsdus ri —86—

par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de'i don bshad rgyud sa pu ṭi las/ /gru gsum dag pa e yi dbyibs/ /dbus su dgyes pa'i yi ge ba/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ khro rje ra slo rnam par 'byung / /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang bya/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad/ /ces dang / de'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma las/ 'dis ni lte ba'i pad+ma la sogs pa yang gsungs so/ /zhes bshad cing / nge rnams kyis de dag ston par man ngag las 'byung bar ma zad/lwa ba pa dang / nag po spyod pa'i gzhung gis kyang de ltar bshad do/ /'dis smras pa/ stong nyid mdzes mar rnam kun rol rtsed spyod/ /dga' bzhis lang tshos mang bcings chags ldan su/ /kun rtog pir gyis rnam bkra'i ri mor byas/ /de las dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba mtshar/ /'dir 'bad rnam dkar ci mchis pas/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /bdag kyang he ru ka dpal du/ /rdo rje btsun mos bsgrub nga/ra mdzode/ /bdag ni skye ba thams cad du/ /bla ma'i bran du 'gyu/ra ba dang / /zhing rnams thams sa cad yongs dag pas/ /'gro ba smin par byed gyur cig /'on te dmyal bar skyes na yang / /de nyid las gzhan bde ba can/ /nam yang mi 'dod de bas na/ /sems kyi rdo rje mngon sum gyur/ /rdo rje slob dpon bka' yis gnang ba dang / /skye bo mang pos bskul nas 'di sbyar ro/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug 'khor lo yongs dag pas/ /mi 'gyur bde chen de ring thob par shog /rdo rje rnal ra sgyur ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag bde chen rol nga/ zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang /rtsib ri bsam gling mkhan pos bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyogs —87—

mtshon tsam zhig rang lo nyer bzhi pa la/ brag stod chos kyi pho brang du brtsams pa las/ slar yang don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rang lo bzhi bcu pa la cung zad kha bskongs dang bcas te tshang bar bsgrigs pa yin no/ /ma ṅga la/ rab tu dkar ba'i rten bzhengs 'dis/ /bdag cag gis ni thog med nas/ /sdig ltung gang bsags yongs dag ste/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog/dge'o// //

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa byed lugs mdor bsdus pa ni/phyi mtshams bcad/ de'i nub sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / de'i nub nas sam sang tho rangs nas gzung zhag bdun gyi bar la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la gtso bor bya/ thun 'jog khar/mgon po bdag ni/ zhes pa nas/ byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar dang / rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ sogs brjod/ de nas nang mtshams bcad/ tho brtsigs yang na bug sgo bya/ mar ram mar dang bsres pa'i zan la gtor ma gnyis sam gcig bshams/ chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs/rang kha blta sar gtor ma dang mchod bshams yong ba byas/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku zhig yod na mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ med kyang bla ma yi dam kyi sku gzugs gang rung la mchod pa rgyas pa'am/ ma grub na nyer spyod lnga g.yon skor lag len ltar dang / nyin re bzhin mchod pa gtor ma kha gsos/ mtshams nang du dgos nges kyi mi yod na dmigs 'og tu bcug /de phyin don ji ltar gal che yang mi 'phrad/ chas ka sngar yod phyir mi gtong zhing / gsar pa rang nyid yod sar mi len/ skabs 'di dag tu skyid sdug legs nyes/ gtam snyan mi snyan sogs gang la'ang re dogs med pa dang / rgyun du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang / khyad par sngags 'phreng bskor re song nas rang lhar mos —89—

pa slar gsal 'debs pa re dang / bla ma la mos gus dung pa dang / /sems la snying rje dung pa re nges par dran par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa 'di ma grol bar la rkyen gang gi yang dbang du mi btang / na na yang na go chod/ shi na yang shi go chod/sngar mi lus thob pa phal cher don med du song ba la/ da lta yi dam kyi lha 'di lta bu sgrub tu yod pa skal pa bzang / 'bad rtsol drag po zhig bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad chen po bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zhes pa nas/ sum bha lan gnyis brjod pa'i bar bya/ nang mchod byin rlabs ni/ sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs / stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung nas/ ha hoXhi'i bar bya/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni sum bhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang lha rdzas zhes pa nas/ a khaX grwahwa'i bar bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams yun thung ngu re dang / de rjes bskyed rim la rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du zhes pa nas 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim gyi bar bya/ de nas rang gi lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baX yig dmar po/ de'i mdun nas g.yon skor du oX gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i yi ge mgo bo gyen bstan dang / kha dog dmar ngo/ra bsam/ sngags bzla skabs lce ba'i sngags 'khor la sem/sa brtad da' bu bzla/ thun 'jog khar yid bzlas bya/ nyin gcig la thun gnyis byed na/ snga thun 'jog khar/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/khams gsum zhes pa nas slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/—90—

mchod bstod cung zad byas kyang rung / ma byas kyang rung ngo / /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa nas/ go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i nas/ thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul tu rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ de nas ngag 'grol ba dang zas kyi bya ba sogs bya/dgong thun la skyabs 'gros brtsams te/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i rjes su gtor bsngo bya/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i nas/ cho 'phrul rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ yi ge brgya pa'i rjes su/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sho lo ka gcig /bdag gis dus gsum sogs smon lam dang bkra shis bya/ nyal ba'i tshe lha sku mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdus la/ bsam med kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dang / nye ba'i snying po'i sgras bskul bas/ 'od gsal las ldang ste/ skad cig gi rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams nas thun la 'jug go /thun gyi skabs ngag ma shor bar gal che'o/ /re zhig de tsam mo/ /zhus dag /ma ṅga la//—91—

ma yin pa bzhugs/na mo gu sa 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi cha rkyen pra se na dbab pa/ gnod spyin mo'i sgrub thabs/ sman chen po'i bcud len sogs nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor zab khyad can du bzhugs pa las/ snying po bsdus pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yum bka'i thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs rim gyi khrid ni 'di yin te/ stsed kyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya maṇ+ḍal rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'khrid tshul dngos nyams len la gnyis/de kho na nyid thabs kyis bsgom pa dang / de kho na nyid dngos su bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la thun gyi thog ma'i bya ba/ dngos gzhi/yan lag ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas kyi 'jug tu rdzogs rim 'di rnams bsgom na des khyab/ sgom bzlas mi byed par rdzogs rim kho na la nyams len byed pa'i skabs yin na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra bar rgyas bsdus gang 'os re bya/ rang gi mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po spyan gsum pa/ ḍā ma ru dang / thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa zhig bsgoms te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ ces drag tu gsol ba gdab/ bla ma —92—

'od du zhu rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsams te bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor de/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa gang sgom kyang / thun gyi 'gor ji ltar 'os pa sgom dgos pas/ thun gyi thog ma'i bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rlud sbyang ba rang lhag par gnas pa/ rlud sems 'od gsal du 'jug pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtsa lam sbyong ba ste thog mar rlung rengs 'dul ba dang yan lag lnga sbyong ci nus bya/ de nas rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku can shin tu khong stong du gsal ba'i lte ba dang / gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i bar du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs zur bsnol zhing 'brel bas zur drug tu song ba/ dbus su zla ba la ba yig sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa dang bcas pa bsgom/ de nas rlung ro bsal/ lus gnas spyi dang mthun par bca'/ rlung phyi la 'gro ba'i tshe ba gyi 'od zer sna sgo nas phyir song /blos 'byud tshad kyi nam mkha' khengs/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe 'od zer de rnams sna sgo nas zhugs te nye ba'i ba la thim/ 'di la dbugs 'gro 'ong rang babs kyi steng nas byed par bzhed pa ltar yang rung mod kyi/ 'gro 'ong gnyis ka dal bus byed pa dang sbyar nas bsgom na legs par 'ong ngo / /dmigs skor dang lnga'o/ /de nas gzhan 'dra ba las/ rlud thur sel la las mi 'chol/ gang ba can spyi dang 'dra bar bsgom/ nye 'og gi chos 'byung de g.yas skor g.yon skor gang rigs su 'khor zhing / 'os zer spro bsdu mi byed par dbus kyi ba yig kho na la sems gtod pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /—93—

spyir btang la dmigs skor dang po la myong ba thon pa'i rjes su gnyis pa 'di bsgom pa yin yang lag len du 'di gnyis spel gyin bsgom na bogs che zhing / myong ba sne rnyed pa myur ba'i dgos pa yod ces gsung ngo / /dmigs pa 'di gnyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim sgom bzlas dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ sngags 'khor gyi oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru rnams dang / dga' 'khyil ba yig la bsdus pa'i ngang nas bsgoms pas legs par 'ong ngo /gnyis pa ni rtsa dbu ma'i sgo 'byed cing / rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs te/ 'di la dmigs rim gsum yod pa las thog mar rtsa a wa dhu ti'i dbus kyi cha la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ rlung gnad 'jam rlung kha sbyor la 'bad/ lte ba nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po rkyang pa gcig bsgom lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan du grags pa spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ mar sna chos 'gyung gi rtsa ba'i nang du zug /yar sna tshangs bug la reg pa cig bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad de/chos 'byung gi kha mtshams dang mnyam pa'i thad du/ ba yig gam a yig dmar po gang yid la gsal ba cig bsgom/ rlung ro bsal nas rlung bum can drag po bzung bas/ steng 'og gi rlung gnyis car ba la phog /sol me ngar ma bus pa ltar gyur pa las/ me lce phra mo zhig tsher gyis 'bar/ dang por sor gang tsam nas/ mthar sor bzhi tsam gyi bar du rim pas sbor/ gang ltar yang gtum mo'i me lhag ge 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ spros pa mang po spangs te 'di kho na bsgoms na 'phral du gsal stong ngang bde ba dang rlung dbu mar zhugs pa'i —94—

nyams myong skye 'di drod bskyed pa la yang ches bsngags pa ni 'di'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan phra mo ste/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o /de nas yang rtsa dbu ma'i yas sna'i sgo dbye ba ni/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi nang du thig le dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs can sen mo zlum po tsam zur langs su yod pa/ dga' 'khyil lag bzhi pa'i ri mo can gcig bsgoms la/ 'jam rlung ran par bzung ba'am/ rlung 'gro 'ong dal bu'i ngang nas/ 'bud rngub byas pas smin mtshams kyi dga' 'khyil gyi thig le de/ g.yas skor ram g.yon skor re mos kyis drag tu 'khor bas lus sems bde bas gang ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'di la dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams su 'khyogs pa'i nang du thig le 'khor ba la sems gtod pa'i lus kyang yod mod kyi/ nges par rtsa'i dbyibs de lta bu bsgom dgos nga/'ang min no/ /'di bde bskyed pa la bsngags te dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /yang rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna'i sgo dbye ba la bslab pa ni/ kha sbyor 'jam rlung dang bcas thur sel 'og gi lam gnyis ka dang ngo/ra cung zad cung zad skul/goms nas drag tu bskul/rang lus kyi lte 'og sor bzhi nas gsang ba'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gcig bsgom/ de'i kha mtshams thad kyi nang gi dbus su thig le dmar po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lha bu la/ dga' 'khyil gyi ri rmo yo/nga pa gcig bsgom/ rlung kha sbyor gsang bar drag tu mnan pas chos 'byung mi 'khor zhing dga' 'khyil gyi thig le myur bar 'khor ba la sems rtse —95 —

gcig tu gtad/ 'dis stong nyams gtso bor skye ste/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rlung dbu mar 'ching ba ste/ 'dir bum pa can drag po sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi ngang nas 'di ltar bsgom ste/ nye ba nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma lte ba'i thad du a dang bcas pa gong bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang yas snar ha yig dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba bsgom/ rlud bum can bzung bas/ gong bzhin lte ba'i a las gtum mo'i me sor bzhi tsam 'bar/ de'i rtse nas dar dmar po'i rnal ma bskyang ba tsam gyi me lce shin tu phra ba rim gyis 'bar nas/ spyi bo'i ha la reg pa las ha las thig le'i rgyun phra mo ba thag lta bu'am/ dar dkar gyi rnal ma brkyang pa lta bu rim gyis babs te/ lte ba'i a la thim pas 'bar 'jag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu byung ba la sems gtad do/ /'dis kyang rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa zhes grags kyang / don la ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gags/ dbu ma rgyas/ rlung sems bcings pas 'od gsal gyi rlung gi ngo bor gnas gyur/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag skyed pa yin na/ dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /gsum pa lam gyi yan lag 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus tha mal gyi rnam pa la sha khrag rus gsum spangs pa'i stong sang nge ba/ lus kyi dbus su dbu ma gong bzhin/ g.yas su ro ma dmar pa dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar ba gnyis gro sog tsam/ spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa gsum po gsum gshibs su yod pa/ ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis dbu ma las ring bar yod pa de/ yar ldog ste dbu ma'i nang du chug /yas sna gnyis spyi bo nas tshur 'khyogs te sna bug g.yas —96—

g.yon du zug /nye ba'i ba yig ga a yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/zhabs g.yas g.yon gnyis ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis la reg ge gtad pa/ sku las 'od zer 'phros ro ma'i lam brgyud sna sgo g.yas nas thon/ 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/'od zer phar spros pa rnams tshur ldog pa dang / lhan gcig tu sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i lam brgyud de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de 'dra lan gcig gam gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i lam nas yar gshegs pas/ ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis/ rdo khab len gyis lcags skud drangs pa bzhin du yang drangs pa na/ ro rkyang gi yas sna gnyis po sna sgor zug yod pa'i mtshams nas bral te/ gru gu bsgril ba ltar hril gyis 'gril ba zhabs g.yas g.yon la thim/ phyi rol lus kyi rkang mthil nas brtsams te gsang ba'i bar rim pas yal/ bcom ldan 'das ma dbu ma'i lam nas snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo sogs su yar byon pa'i tshe/ dbu ma yang de'i rjes su thung ri li li song ba dang lhan cig /phyi dbyibs kyi lus kyang de'i rim ḍā/sa yal/tshangs bug nas rgyang gis thon pa dang / rang sems bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal ba de yang 'od gsal stong nyid du thim ste/ de ka'i ngang der dbyings rig dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu la mnyam par bzhag /de ka bskyar gyin yang yang bsgom/ 'dir ni rang lus stong par sbyangs pa'i phyir/ slar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos par bzhed/ yang ro rkyang nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mi byed —97—

par lte ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma nyid 'byon bzhud byed pa dang / 'pho ba'i skabs sna sgo g.yon pa nas 'pho ba byed pa sogs dmigs pa mi 'dra tsam gyi spros pa 'ga' re yod kyang / dkyus su bshad pa nyid ma nor ba yin no/ /'di la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung yang zer/ gser chos dang snyan brgyud dang tshig brgyud du byed pa'i srol yod do/ /dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa de kho na nyid dngos su sgom par byed pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad bcas rlud rang babs su bzhag /sems ma bsgrims/ ma glod/ gang yang yid la mi byed par cham me bzhag cing / de ka'i rang ngo la cher re bltas pa na/ gang du'ang ngos bzung du med cing / blo'i yul las 'das pa'i rang rig rang gsal spros pa dang bral ba gcig 'char bas de la mnyam par bzhag /de ka la gnas na legs/ gal te rnam rtog 'gyu ste/ sngar byas sogs 'das pa dran na/ de'i ngo bo la brtags te/ 'das pa ni cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir na/da lta bde sdug gi yul du yod yod ltar snang ba ni 'khrul ba ste/ skyes zin skye med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /ma 'ongs pa la brten pa'i re dogs sogs rnam rtog skye na/ de dag ni da lta ma byung ba'i phyir ci yang med de/ bde sdug gi yul ltar snang ba ni 'khrul ba'o zhes ma skyes pa skye med nam mkha' lta bur thag bcad/ da lta mngon du snang ba'i dgra gnyen la sogs pa'i rnam rtog shar ba na/ de thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du 'khrul snang tsam yin no zhes skye ba skye med nam mkhar lta bur thag bcad do/ /dmigs bskor brgyad pa'o/ /yang zhal shes kho na'i man ngag gcig ni/ rlud sems 'od gsal du —98—

'jug pa'i skabs/ sngar gyi de zla shas goms na rtsa bzang ngan dang / rtsol ba che chung gi rim pas cung zad myur bul tsam ma gtogs 'byongs yong zhing / de nas 'bud dus lto ba bcer phyir bzung / lus sprug rngubs te bshang sgor sdig /shugs bkyed 'dar thon par bya/ 'bar ba'i dus kha spyor yang 'then cing /'bab pa'i skabs kha spyor mdun du brgyangs nas sprug pa dang 'phar rdeb gcig bya ste/ dmigs skor dgur yang bya'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid ni 'di tsam kho na yin la/ go don ni rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig bla ma rje btsun chen po grags rgyal gyi mdzad pa dang mi 'dra ba med pas der rtogs par bya'o/ /spyir rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag chen mo la yang / yab bka' yum bka'i rdzogs rim gnyis su dbye gsal byed pa cig yod cing / man ngag gces bsdus kyi nang na yang nā ro pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag bya ba/ nag po lam slong gi gtum mo'i nang tshan gcig dang 'dra rung ba zhig dang / brgyud pa gzhan dang gzhan las kyang / nā ro pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag tu 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod nyid kyi chos skor kho na la grags shing dgos nges pa'i rtsa a wa dhu ti'i man ngag ni 'di kho na te/ 'di shin tu 'byer bde/gdams ngag che/ gnad zab rtags 'phral du yong / /bka' gnyan pas dam por bya'o gsung ngo / /sngar yig rnying dum dum 'khrigs su yod pas go rim bsgrig tshul bla ma'i zhal la bltos pa yin na yang / deng 'dis bklags chog tu bkod pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ /ma sge la// zhus dag /—99—

phag mo'i sgrub thabs bde ba spyin pa zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ snya sti/ bde mchog dpa' bo'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba/ khams gsum rgyal ma dmar ba'i 'od chags sku/ /glog phran ltar g.yo gnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma/ /bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal ldan la phyag 'tshal/ khres rab pha rol phyin pa'i zlos gar ni/ /'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg can/ /mtshar sdug 'od kyi phyogs cha rnams 'gengs ma'i/ skur ston rgyal ba'i yum gcig bcom ldan ma/ /'char ka gsar ba'i 'od ris 'chang ldan bde bas myong ba'i bag yangs ma/ /gzhom med dhu ti'i glu dbyangs rna ba'i bcud len rab spyor chu skyes dbang / /rab rgyas mchog tu bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i so 'phreng gsal mdzes ngom pa 'di/ /bdag yid rkang drug gzhon nu lhan skyes sbrang chang gis myos rol bar mdzod/ /'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i chu rlung de yis/ /bde chen yongs 'du 'bras bur smin pa'i dpal yon bzang pos/ /bdag sems gzhon nu ring du dub pa ngal bso'i bsti nas/ /gnyug ma'i lus kyi bskyed tshal brgyan par mdzod cig /ka ye/ rab chags lag pa'i 'khri shing phyag rgyar 'byud/ /rab bde ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi 'jib byed pa/ /rnam kun rtse 'jo'i rol ba'i dpa' bo bzhin/ /bdag kyang bdag po'i gnas la 'god par mdzod/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba bzhin badz+ra wa rā tī sgrub par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la gdong byang ngam nub tu phyogs pas/ dang por phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phul la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal dang / yi ge brgya — 100—

pa'i bsgom bzlas ci srid mtshan ma ma thob kyi bar du bya'o/ /bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal gzhan du shes la/phyogs skyong gi gtor ma ni 'og nas 'byung ngo / /mi shes sam mi spro na ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /de nas phyis bsnyen pa'i skabs su ni skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ añca mā naX gyi kha dag pa sngon du 'gro bas rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la/ spro na 'dir yang bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal byed/ oX āXshwe ma rgyu rlu ru tsa rā ṇa ka ma lwa ya/ saXmya rnyi na bha sa na ka rā ya na ma ste huX/ mos pa drag pos phyag byas la/ oX shā n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ thod pa'i nang gi myos byed sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oX āXhuX rtsa sngags brjod cing chos 'gyung bri 〈tseX(baX āXskyoX〉tseX( ā huX baX zur gsum dang lte bar dgod/ sor mo bcus ma da na blangs la/ sor bcu bsnol ba spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar du reg pas khrus dang / bsrung ba bya ste oX āXhūX zhes bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas/ g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gung srin mthe'u chung rgyab rnams su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rim pas/lkoX baX/ haX yoX / khyu moX/ hre hriX/ hūX hūX/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha mo drug gi ngo bo/ lkoX badz+ra pukhye ā huX gis re re bzhin me tog phul/ tseX( a hūX gis nang mchod phul/ de zhu stu༈nga thim pa gnas drug tu srung zhing thim par bsam mo/ /mdun du sa gzhi dag pa la/ bdud rtsis chos 'byung sor gsum pa bris pa'i dbus su baX de la ka ra bī ra la sogs pa'i me tog dmar po mchod/ de'i steng du ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba/ skye( āXhūX/ bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ /me long dag pa la si rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor byas la 〈ha hriXbaX〉tshad med bzhi bsgoms par bya ste/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dag pa gsum dran par bya'o/ /lte ba'i chos 'byung sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa'i 'od 'phreng dang mdun gyi sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rdo rje rol pa mo sa gsum na bzhugs pa — 101—

thams cad dang / rang bzhin gyi grub pa thams cad h+pha/ dzaXhū ཾ ༷ baX hoX dgug gzhugs bcing mnyes bya'o/ / lha mo sngags kyi gzugs brnyan sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ huX aXrdo rje dang dril bu bzung / nga lan bdun gyis sngags pa'i bsang chus/ oṃ āXkhaṇ+ḍa ro he sarba byu nu sma ra ya huX huX phaṭa/ hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams su gyur/sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badz+ra puspro āXhuX nas ni wi t+ya'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang drang byas la/ sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum bto pas mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod cing / spro na/ rlud gis bskyod pas 'og gi 'khor lo nas bzhengs glog gi zer ltar 'od gsal zhing / /rtsibs can gsum po bsregs nas 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod gyur bdud rtsi'i rgyun rab gsal/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bcud dang 'dres shing skyon bral shin tu kun dga'i tshogs ster ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam dbye bral ba rdo rje phag mos 'gro 'di srungs/ /mu tig gis spras byi rle'i chun po ltar gsal skar bcas dgong kha'i thun mtshams 'dra/ /me stag rab 'phro 'jigs byed me 'bar lta bur phyogs dang nam mkha' gsal byed cing / /me tog dkar po dang ldan kaX shu ka yi me tog 'bar ba'i tshogs 'dra ba/ /gzi brdzid du mas rnam brgyan dmar ba'i sku mnga' rdo rje phag mos khyed la srungs/ /he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ ka sogs yi ges skor te sprul pa'i rtsibs can nyi dbang dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing / /'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra ba/ /rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsreg cing 'khor lo gsum po byed pa —102—

gang yin pa/ /kun dga' dang bcas rol ba gyen gshegs phag mo bdag gi sems la gsal gyur cig/dzaXhuX baX hoX rang gi snying gar sngags kyi dkyil 'khor thim par bsam/ lha mo tshad ma sogs 'don/ tshad med bzhi sgom par bya'o/ /de nas klu'i 'dug stangs sam/ min na skyil krung 'cha'/ brla g.yas dang g.yon/ dpung pa g.yon pa rnams su thal mo brdab pa'i sgra byed cing / oX su bhā wa shudha sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3haX/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu khro3haX/ dag pa gsum dran pa'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid sgom zhing / oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ oX a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nya na badz+ra su bhā wā at+pa ko3haX/ de'i tshe dbugs phyi rol tu bkag go/de nas rngub pa dang mnyam du sgyu ma lta bur dran pas/ rang sems hriXde las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ oṃ hri gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya sarba duXrgi phaṭa/ huX las rdo rje gur dang ra ba dang sa gzhi dang me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ srung 'khor gyis dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa las/ lha mo sku mdog dkar mo de'i bha ga las 'od 'phros pas spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rdo rje sems dpa' he ru kas bcom ldan 'das ma la 'khyud cing rdo rje bde ba chen po'i dam tshig gis snyoms par zhugs/ rang gi rnam shes rlung dang bcas pa baX yig gi rnam pas sbyor mtshams su zhugs nor bu'i thig le dkar po la thim/ de shes rab ma'i rdul la thim pas yab yum bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas thig ler gyur/ de las bha ga chos 'byung gru gsum gdengs ga gyen du bstan pa/ phyi rol dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa phyi rol dur khrod dang —103—

srung ba'i 'khor los bskor bar gyur/ hu zhes pa'i sgras thig le de nyid cha gsum du gyur pa'i 'og ma nyi ma/ bar ma zla ba/ steng ma ba las rdo rje/ de rnams 'dres pa las sku yongs su rdzogs par bzhengs te/ pad nyi'i gdan la/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje phag mo li khri'i mdangs ldan/ thun mtshams kyi sprin ltar dmar ser rnam par 'gyur ba'i bzhin/ rtsa zhal shin tu mdzes shing lhag par chags pas 'dzum zhing bzhad pa/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs shing yid tsam khro ba/dmar shing bkra la rab tu g.yo ba'i sbyan gnyis zur mig tu blta zhing / spyan dbus ma g.yo ba med par gyen du gzigs pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i skra tshogs phyed ltag par bcings/ phyed sil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa la me tog gi phreng ba mdzes pa/ snyan g.yas pa'i rgyab tu phag zhal mthing ga khro zhing 'khrug pa/ mche ba bzang ring can/ gyen du phyogs shing hū sgra sgrog la rna ba 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dang po gri gug thur du sdigs pa/ gnyis pas cang te steng du khrol ba/ g.yon dang pos thod pa zla ba dang me tog gi rgyun gyis gang ba bsnams nas gsol ba/ gnyis pa rtse gsum 'og tu bsnun pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang gis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ gcer mo brgyad gnyis lon pa ltar lang tsho bdo ba/ sku sha rgyas shing 'jam la mnyen lcug gi lus can ma/ rab tu chags pas pad+ma bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru 'od phreng 'khrug pa/ nu ma mtho zlum mdzes shing sked skabs phra bas gsum 'khyog gi gar stabs kyi ldem skyog can/ nyi ma bcu gnyis las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar zhing / rang thabs kha ṭā ga dkar po mchan khung du gnas pa la 'khyud pas yan lag dang 'dus pa/—104—

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bu mo pad+ma can gyis rnam pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal can/ kun+da ltar dkar ba'i thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang / rus 'phreng sil sil gyis skra mtshams rgyas par brgyan pa/ mi ro'i steng na gar mdzad pas/ 'bar zhing g.yo ba'i bskal ba'i me'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sprul pa mtha' yas pa spros shing sdud pa'i sngags 'chang ma/ de'i lte bar oX baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hre hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsiṇ+ḍa ga'i rang bzhin/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha mo drug po gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa'o/ /oX wā rā hi hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ yā sī ni huX hūX phaṭa/ oX mo ha nī huX huX phaṭa/ oX sañca lī nī huX hūX phaṭa/ oX san+t+ra sma nī huX huX phaṭa/ oX tsaṇ+ḍi kā hūṃ raX phaṭa/dpral bar 'khor lo la oX dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āXdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la huX sngon po/ 'bar ba 'a phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i bskor ba spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ar+ghaX sogs dang / nang mchod kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX'abyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu rdzo3haX/dbang gi lha dpal he ru kas rdo rje rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ oX badz+ra bhā wa a bhi tañca huX/ dri ma thams cad dag spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oX aX praX aX pāX puX dhuX tsuX aX baX gaX nywa naX laX bruX shaX āXhūX/ zhes mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams phyir phyung nas mchod par gyur/ oX ar+ghaX āXskyoX/ de bzhin/ prok+ṣa naX/ a sbyo sa —105—

naX/ pu duX/ puspro/ dh+ra pe/ di pe/ ldo ṇi/ nywa staX/ bhan+taX/ tī laX/ ne lī py-iX/ laX ba naX/ kṛ haX/ u du naX/ tsho'i gī tī/ nirti/ shasta āXhūX/ de nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad gri thod ḍa ma sakha ṭāX ga thogs pa ljang khu rnams kyis bstod par bsam shing / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la med cing bsam pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /zhes bstod/ de nas/ lte ba dang spyi bo dang / de nas phag gdong gi dpral ba'i bar du dh+ra tī dmar po mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa lte ba nas ze 'bru'i bar du bya ga sto dkar zhing phra ba/ nye ba'i nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su hruX oṃ āXhuX/ sngags 'phreng tshan pa gsum du bkod pa dang / dga' 'khyil bzhi dang bcas pa/ phag gdong gi smin mtshams su zla ba la baX/ bya gdong gi rtser nyi ma la baX/ yi ge rnams las steng 'og tu 'od sbu gu lta bu 'phros/ sna bug g.yon dang bya gdong las byung / 'jig rten gsum gyi bud med rnams kyi spyi bo dang /kha ga mu kha las khu rdul dang / skyes bu'i spyi bo dang / che kha las khu ba drangs te/nyi zla gnyis dang 'dres/ de thams cad steng 'og nas sngags phreng la thim/—106—

thams cad bya gdong gi khar byon pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs shing bde bas myos pas 'dar g.yo ba la bsam nas sngags bzla/ dmigs pa de yang yang gsal btab yang 'khor lo gru gsum g.yon skor du bar med du 'khor ba/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i bdag nyid du mos la/ thur sel drangs shing rtse gcig tu sgom/ skyon sngags bzla'o/ /oṃ badz+ra wā rā hi a be sha ya ༵ ba~X be+e dzī sbyi snru rī/ snying po huhu rdo/ṭa/ rdo rdo/ rdo dhi/ /sna/mi snye gā rdo ༵༵/ shi/ ༵ rdo/nga/ po'o/ /tsho( badz+ra wā rā hi dz+nyā na a be sha ya ā uhrī swāhā/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags so/ /de nas 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang /rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnam pa gnyis ka'ang spro na bya'o/ /thun mtshamasal 'jug pa'i tshe rab gnas dang / 'khor dang sprul pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsam/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa swa bhā wa sogs gsum brjod de/ rjes gzhig gis bsdus la/ slar yang skad cig gis lha mo langs te/ dag pa rdo rje gsum dran par byas te thun mtshams la 'jug go/mdor bsdu na gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi chog go ces kho bos smra'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod rnyi// / ༵rjo ༵ ༵ tshi rdzu/gni ༵ ༵/༵/༵ unyu dī~X/ ḍi mgo ༵ skyed nga~X/ ta sdu/ bdud rnyi hūṃ pā/ ༵/ /༵/ ༵ rdo/ra 1 s+ho di~X rnyi ༵ nyim ༵ /dho dog dī sna/ /sa dhi /༵ thi spya/ kā spya ༵ ༵hūṃ rī sa/na dho rdo hu pho pyi ༵shi / ba ༵ u/ sgri sbyi gyur/ de'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems bdud rtsir spyan drangs te/ yi ge 'khru gsum dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang gtor ma —107—

rnyi mdu na ba 1 ༵ med ༵ bsa' kau/ skra nas /za~X rdo she ༵ ༵ rlo kyi/ zi gong ༵/ dhi lha ༵ ༷/༵ / snro rdo dro a ༵ /dā rje hu shā dhi sam ༵ stu dri ༵je bsam zhes lan/ bdun kyis dbul/ ar+gha sogs dang / nang mchod dang / bstod pa dang / rnal gal 'byar ma ṭā dhi~X ༵ ༵dhi rna~X/de/ na///hā/ dzī kha kha ༵ rnyi kha dzhai dī rdo yak+ṣa/ sdi/sa sogs dang / ar+gha sogs dang / nang mchod dang / lha yi tshogs rnams sogs spyi dang mthun par bya ste 'jig rten pa la 'bul ba'o/ /de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rje btsun ma dang 'jig rten pa h+pha/ tse( badz+ra ḍā ki ni 6spro ma bā li gro sna gro sna ha ha ha ha kha kha kha kha/ a a a ༵/ rnyi / 'jig /na rdi la 'a rmo ༵/ ldi/ / ༷ dī/ ma ce/ ༵ nga sgrod/ ༵kau grub ༵ ༵ ༵ dzhai ༵ / ༵//sa ༈ sna~X / ṭā ༵ kau ༵/ sogs kyi ༵ rde pa rang lab /sdu go/ /dhi// ༵/ ༵ /༵/sa/ yang phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa ni/ h+pha gyis spyan drangs nas/ yo ga sdo khri sde'i bar bya/ o ā hū zhes mchod pa rnams yid kyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ḍi ya pu li rā ma gi ri ka ma khya shrī hwa pho dharma sa bho ga ni rma ṇa mahā su kha kā ya zhes bstod/ o badz+ra yo gi ni pukhre dhu pa dī pa gan+ta bā li grot+na gro sna ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hu hu hū phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mchod gtor changs gcig tu 'bul/ rjes gtor chog ltar bya'o/ /'di ni yid kyi bsam pa kho na yin gyi rdzas dang yo byad med kyang chog go /bya rog gi gtor ma'i sngags ni/ glu rna kla kla kla dharma tā/ ā kā sha — 108—

tsā ri ṇaXsirnyi dā yi naX kaX bāX yaX shaX pa la sirnyi kā ga sa nā na/ pra snyu t+yā/ kā ka ba li/grot+na tu klaX klaX klaX swāhā/ chu gnas kyi sems can la ni/ oX shāX blaX shāX a pra tiṣ+ṭha tsā la tsa ri ṇaXspu bya ma sha ma la sirnyi shu na ka /saX ta na dzā shu na kā bā li grot+na stu klaX klaX klaX swāhā/ khyi la sogs pa sa la rgyu ba spyi la/ oX sgrim sgrim sgrim shu n+ya tā/ da shā shā tsā ri ṇaXni saX ba lā/ sidha bhā ta go ta hūṃ ni/ bhā ta ni bā li grit+na tu grot+na tu ra ra lha swāhā/ lce spyang gi gtor ma la/༄oX hroX hroX hroX phaṭa kla ra kla rī ṇa ku la pra mū ta si pa/ hi li hi li ba li grot+na tu/ sarba sirnyi mu/ da da skye da da n+tu hroX hroX hroX swāhā/ de yang tshes bcu la sogs pa la thog mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gtor ma dang brgyu sogs me tog dmar pos mchod/ de nas bya rog la sogs de dag yid kyis bsangs sbyangs/ sa bon las lhar bskyed/ h+pha/ gyi ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab yid kyis mdor bsdus su byas la/ lag g.yas nam mkhar rdo rje sdig 'dzub bya/ gtor ma/ til dang / nas dang / sha chen dang mar sres pa/ yid kyis byin gyis brlabasanas sngags brjod cing / lag g.yon pas sbyin/ ltas brtag/yig brgya brjod de bzod par gsol/ gshegs su gsol te bkra shis bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs ci rigs dang / tshes bcu' mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang byed rung / sku gzugs kyi drung du sha chen gyi spos 'bul ba'i sngags ni/lkoX āXhri hūX hūX haXhaXnyer gcig brjod do/ /de ltar na gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa ni/ bu mo gzhon nu ma skye gnas ma nyams pa sum cu rtsa bdun nam/bcu gsum mam/ drug gam/ lnga'am/ gcig kyang rung / yan lag ma nyams pa/ rab sngags kyi spyod pa can/ 'bring dbang bskur ba/ tha ma dbang ma thob pas kyang rung / dam tshig nyams pa'i ni ye nas mi btub pa'i de la brtag dgos/ gal te skye gnas ma nyams pa ma brnyes na/ bu ma btsas pa bzung ngo / /gal te de yi ma btub na/ khye'u 'am/ rigs so drug gi bu mo'i gzugs brnyan gyis kyang chog — 109—

tsam yin gsung / gang ltar nyi ma dang po la phyi rol mchod pa rgyas par bya/ gzhon nu ma rnams la snyan mnan/ nangs par phyi rol mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ gzhon nu ma rnams dbang thob na dkyil 'khor khang par 'jug /ma thob na phyi rol lam yol bas bcad/ de yang rang gi gnyis ka mthong bar byed/ cho ga ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas dang mchod pa byin dbab/ bu mo rnams bsangs sbyangs nas/ bskyed chog mdun bskyed ji lta bar byed/ so bdun yod na lha so bdun du bskyed/ de bzhin du grangs bzhin du bcu gsum ma dang / go cha drug gis bskor ba'i bdun ma dang /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi yis bskor ba'i snga ma dang / gtso mo rkyang ba bskyed/ gtor ma'i bar mdun bskyed dang 'dra/ tshogs mchod bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ bza' bcas sna tshogs sbyin/bar chad srung ba'i sngags bzlas shing / ltas brtag /lhag gtor btang / bkra shis brjod pa'i bar rjes chog kyang 'dra ba las mchod pa'i skabs/ so rtsi dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / btung ba'i khyad par sbyin par bya gsung ngo / /de nas sbyin sreg sngags kyi bcu cha las mi nyung bas lha mnyes par bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni gzhan tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa ni dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'am/ me long gi dkyil 'khor 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ bdag mdun chabs gcig tu byas nas sgrub pa/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gceg gam/zla ba drug tu bya'o/ /de nas yang yang bskul tshig gi sngags dang / spyor ba drag pos bsgrubs pasagrub par 'gyur ste/ de nas ni las dang dngos grub thogs med du 'grub gsung / de nas phyi rol mchod pa ni 'grub na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ ji ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga bzhin te/'dir sta gon ni mi byed/ g.yin sa chog nas bzung rdzogs par bya gsung / de tsam ma grub na/gzhal med khang rdzogs pa mtha' ma nyi ma tsam bri/ dbus su nyi ma la chos 'gyung bya ste/ de yang ma grub na bsdus pa chu tshon gyis bri bar bya ste/ da ltar 'di la phyag bzhes gtso bor mdzad do/ /dkyil —110—

'khor dkar po gru bzhi pa'i dbus su ljang khu/ zlum po de'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po/ phyi rol tu dga' 'khyil bzhi/ dbus su baX phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i maṇ+ḍal/ yang maṇ+ḍal ljang khu gnyis/bum pa sgrub na maṇ+ḍal ljang khu dang / dbus su dkar po/ der me tog sna tshogs bgram ste lag len bzhin bya'o/ /dbus su skyed bu gsum gyi steng du'am/ mañji la ka pā la chang dang bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhag /de nas me long dag pa la/ gzhon nu ma'i mtshal gyi spags pa'i ras dmar po la rdo ra rtsags te dgram/ gser gyi smyug gu mtheb srin gyis bzung nas lag len bzhin 'dri/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma 'bul de/ suX bhas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho hriX oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX pad+ma ka ma la ya staX/ oṃ in+t+ra ya/ ka ye sogs kyi mthar pra ba ra sa sko raX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ pā duX/ añca ma naX/ prok+ṣa rna/puṅge sogs kyis mchod/ a kwa ro lan gsum gyis sam bdun gyis phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje gdan gyi lha tshogs sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'am/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po la sogs la/ /gsang spyod don du gtor ma 'di/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /suX bhas bgegs skrad/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgom/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX raX baX laX suX ro gcig tu 'dres pa la pad+ma dang nyi ma/ chos 'gyung dang bcas pa/ de'i nam mkha' la yaX las rlud / raX las me/ de'i steng du oṃ āXhūX las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum de la gnas pa'i/ a las ka pā la dum bu gcig pa/ nang du hūX bhuX nas ha ho hriX yi bar ga sto rdzo ltar ro/ /de'i steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ lko pa nas/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su zhes pa'i bar mdzo rtogs ltar ro/ /—111—

oṃ pi 'o pa pi khyu ya snya hā/ oṃ spyo two pa spyo t+yā ya snya hā/ oṃ tsha no pa tshanā ya snyu hā/ oṃ me la pa ko pa me la kā ya snya hā/ oṃ shā sha ne pa shā sha nā ya snyu hā/ skye( pi la po pa pi la pā ya snyu hā/ pu dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gro so su na si ma ku/ hwa tra brgyad brjod de gnas byin gyis brlabs/ nyi ma'i steng du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar pa gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ phyi rol dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos 'byung dbus su pad nyi la/ baX las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong lhar ro/ /rtsa sngags brjod pas/ gtso mo dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang / rab sngags ma dang / rdo rje rnam snang ma dpag tu med par gyur/ lkoX maX taX baX laX a ā/i yī/ u mū/ re grwa/ '-i lī/ e i/ o au/ aX hūX phaṭa snyu hā/ /yum bzhi dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spro ba'i bdag nyid du bsam/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang h+pha zhes pas las kyi mkha' 'gro dang / skye gnas gsum gyi bdag nyid 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad spyan drangs/ oX sarba tra byaX bi shodha ni huX phaṭa ces pa'am/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pas kyang bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/ thog mar me tog 'bul te/ sngags re re'i mthar oX badz+ra sdi khye sogs sbyar ba ste/oṃ sarba bzhi ḍa ki nī ye badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra brta nī ye: /badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye /ḍā ki nī/ lā me/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he/ rū pri nī/ a ā nas/ aX: /oX baX wā ra hi/haX yoX ya mi nā/ hri moX ha ni/ hre tri pañca nī/ hūX hūX san+t+ra sa nī: /phaṭa phaṭa tsa'i ki:nan+da budha ya: /de'i rjes su chu bzhi dang / nyer spyod lnga dang / yang dag dga' ba'i me tog —112—

gi /sogs dang / rin chen bdun dang / lha mo bcu drug dang / nang mchod dang / gsang mchod/rkang brgyad dang / o ḍi ya sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sogs dang /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyi brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi skyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /gang dang gang zhig gshin rje ma dang de nas bcom ldan rmongs byed dus kun skyong byed ma/ /gzhan pa skrag byed ma dang gang yang dri med rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug gtum byed ma/ 'khor lo la gnas zhal gcig phyag bzhi sngo dang dkar mo dang ni gser gyi mdog can ma/ /ljang dang du ba dang mtshungs gar byed de rnams zhabs la rang gi mgo bos phyag bgyi'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags chen po yang spro na bstod bskul du bya gsungs de'i rjes su gtor ma phul la/o sarba bhak+ṣa kā mo ni sarba bhak+ṣa shodha shī gu phya badz+ra ṇi kro khru shwa rī sarba dra byi bya bi ni sho dha ya sho dha ya hū/ bzlas brjod yun ring du byas la/ tshogs la longs spyod de de'i cho ga g.yin du rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang / yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod nas/ sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman/ /bya ba dman par gang gyur pa/ /rang dang mchog gi dngos grub gtso/ /lha mo de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /srid dang zhi ba sogs dang / mnyams pa chags pa dang ni chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzugs kyang / /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cing lha mo rnams kyi bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la — 113

'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang / /myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ tshul khrims tsa dan gyi lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /lha mo tshad ma sogs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ khyod kyis sems can sogs dang / oṃ ga tsā ru swa bhā bā naX kṛ ta rnye na ta thā ga tsā sarba bzhi tho bi sa rdza ya ma ma karmaX ku ru rdza hā/ a kā ro brjod pas dkyil 'khor dbye/ nye bar oṃ baX sogs go cha bgo /snang ba lhar dran bzhin pas/rdo rje btsun mo 'grub gyur nas sogs dang / rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam btab bkra shis bya ste mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o /gal te byin rlabs bya bar 'dod na/ bzlas pa yan chad sngar ltar bya/ de nas bum pa sgrub ste/ sgrub tshul ni spyi dang mthun la mdun bskyed dang bum pa gnyis ka la mchod gtor phyogs gcig tu 'bul ba yod de/ de la ni mdun bskyed bzlas pa grub nas bum pa bskyed cing bzlas nas/ bzhu zin pa la/ mchod pa rgyas pa mdzad pa phyag len yin cing tshad ldan dang 'gal ba'ang med do/ khre nas bdag 'jug ni/ mig dar 'ching ba man chad dang / bsdu na ye shes dbab pa man chad mdzad/bod kyi lag len dang bstun/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas brtsams te/ slob ma'i bya ba ji lta ba bzhin yang rung bar mngon/ de yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lha dang bla ma mnyes par byas la yon phul te/ sgyu ma'i 'khor lor rnam par 'khor ba rnams/ /skyob mdzad tshig 'bru spangs pa dngos kun rtogs/ /mgon po khyod nu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ste/ /'gro ba'i skye bo skyob pa khyod kyis skyongs/ /zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ sa khams pa la skyes —114—

bu'i gzugs bya/ slob ma'i lte bar sba/ de'i gdung bas sdig sgrib thams cad sha za'i gzugs kyis gzugs brnyan la thim/ huX las skyes pa'i phur bu/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya sogs kyis/ phur bus gdab/ oṃ badz+ra mut+na ra sogs kyis tho bas brdung / de nyid stong pa'i ngang du thim/ gtor ma gcig la sgron me lnga btsug /slob ma'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams la skor zhing / oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka ṭi kaX ṭuX ka ṭi swāhā/ tsho( sdus ghuṣ+ṭa lha ni ni tsho ni gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya snya hā/ tsho( ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni a the sma dha ni snya hā/ slob ma 'di'i lus ra lo bzhir gnas nas khams bzhi la gnod pa skyed pa lus ngag sems dang ye shes rdo rje bzhir sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad phyir dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de rnams rdo rje kha ṭāX ga 'dis tshal ba rgyar dgas par 'gyur ro/ /nga dang rol mo sgra bya/ sgron me chur bcug la lam gyi bzhi mdor gtor ma dor/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ ra bzlas pas srung ngo / de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ de la slob dpon gyi/ ā khaX bī ra huX/ gis me tog gi phon po lag tu gtad/ sngags de nyid kyi mig dar bcing / oṃ āXhuX gis bdud rtsi mgo la gtor/ kha ṭāX ga'i yu ba slob dpon gyi bzung / de'i 'gram nas slob mas 'jug te/ snying po bzla zhing nad du khrid/ dur khrod kyi gnas sam/ dga' 'khyil gyi gnas la 'dug par mos su 'jug deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ zhes sogs kyi gsang bar gdams/ oṃ pañca a mri to ta ka ṭha khu'aX 'di ni khyod kyis dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes sogs kyis dam bzhag dang mna' chu blud/ de nas slob ma phag mor bsgoms pa la/ lte ba la sogs par/ oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo sogs/ sgom du bcug nas/rdo rjes reg cing / oṃ baX wā rā hi huX phaṭa swā hā/ nas rtsa ni ka'i bar brjod/—115—

de nas slob ma lus thang sha bcad pa'i tshul gyi nya bzhi sgrim/ glu rna su bha ba sogs dag pa gsum dran du bzhug /slob ma'i rkang pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ der chos 'byung gru gsum/ dbus su 'bar ba'i klog dang bcas pa/ slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dang / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pas lhe bar sib sib thim/ de'i rkyen gyis de rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur nas bde ba'i gar mdzad pas me lces lus thams cad khyab par 'bar/ spyi bo nas byang sems babs/ bde bas khyab/ lus kyi nang 'od zer sna lngas khrig mer gang / chos 'byung mi mngon pa tsam du g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtod du bzhug cing / rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing bdug pas bdug /oṃ yaX raX paX laX huX badz+ra bā rā hi a be sha ya āX.āX.āXzhes dang / rtsa sngags dang snying po'i mthar gong gi dbab sngags btags pa lan brgya'am ci rigs su bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā dz+nyā ya tiṣ+ṭha bha bān tu zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ rdo rje rgya khram spyi bor bzhag /de nas me tog tre las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog tu mos nas/ rdo rje thig le dngos kun za ma tog /ma lus 'gro la bde ster mig 'phrul lta/ /kun 'gro dpal ldan phag mo chos kun bskyed/ /sgyu 'phrul snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ /spro na rjo badz+ra ḍa rdo sogs brjod cing ga kho/ bsdu na oṃ pra ru badz+ra hoX de nas me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bcings te/ pra ti gro sna stuX/ i me satwa mahā bā la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /sogs dang / mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oX gyi 'od kyis gsal bar bsgom ste gdong g.yog dgrol/ yang na mig dar bcings dgrol mi mdzad pa'ang yod de dngos bstan no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gsal —116—

bar sgom du gzhug /'jug pa rdzogs so/ /maṇ+ḍal phul la/ lha mo sku'i rdo rje ni/ sgyu 'phrul rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi go 'phang mnyam med pa/ /bdag la de ring gnang bar mdzod/ de bzhi du/ lha mo gsung gi: /mi shigs rgya mtsho khyod kyi:bdag la: /thugs kyi: /bde ba'i : khyod kyi: /bdag: /ye shes: /ye shes rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi go 'phang mnyam med pa/ /bdag la de ring gnang bar gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btang/ de nas/ slob ma rnams pad nyi la baX las rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ bsgoms pa nas/ rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na/ go cha 'god pa dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa bor kyang chog gsung / 'on kyang gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ lhar bskyed dbang bskur go cha sa bon tsam gyi 'god pa yin no/ /tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swabha ba at+pa ko3haX/ bum pa'i dbang ngo / /slob dpon dang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ byang sems dkar dmar lce thog tu myangs par bsam la spyin cing bco / bdud rtsi de nyid lte ba'i baX la thim/ de las me 'bar spyi bo'i haX zhu ba'i bde ba la mnyam par 'jog /oṃ āXjiX/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra su bhā wa lha t+pa ko3haX/ gsang dbang ngo / /slob ma he ru ka'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpar sgyur gsung / bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar gyur/ /lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid/ /'di'i nges pa las lha mo'i mtshan rnams bsgyur gyi phyag mtshan sogs mi bsgyur bar bzhed kyin snang bas gang mos so/ /de nas phyag rgya mtshan nyid rdzogs pa gto la/ spyi bor rdo rje bas ste/ lha mo 'di ni khyod dang mthun/ /'di ni —117—

sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /gnyis su med dang bdag med pa'i/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /lkog brjod de/ de rdo rje phag mor gyur/ snyoms par zhugs/ lha mo dam 'phyud tsum pa na/ /rnal 'byor gsal pa'i rnam shes so/ /'dod bcas spyor ba gnyis pa ni/ /rjes su rnal 'byor yin par 'dod/ /rtsol bral shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ /lhag pa'i bde ba gsum pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po gsum las gzhan/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /sbyor dang 'dzag dang lhung ba las/ /skad cig bzhi bo mthong zhes gsung / /bde ba'i nyams myong dran par byas te mnyam par bzhag /gnas bzhir dkyil 'khor gyis tre ra'i thig le bya/oṃ ā hu ā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bha wā shwat+pa ko3ha/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas lus gnad bcas dbugs phyir dbyung / rang rdo rje sems dpa' kha sbyor sgyu ma lta bu/ rlud nang du rngub/ de nyid mtha' nas dbus su yal ba la dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /de nas bde stong dbyer med de nyid lha skur ldang / sdug ma nam mkha'i nor bu dang / /'dus byas spros pa kun zlog kyang / /de ni rgya chen yid la byed/ / ā ho 'od gsal mdzes ma'o/ khres rab mdzes ma la chags sbyor ba yis /'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa las grol ba/ /bskal ba'am bskal pa stong gi bar du yang / /ye shes 'di sbyor sgrub pas gnas par byos/ /a re a re ā ho/dbang bzhi pa'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas spyi ltar/ deng nas brtsams te sogs bya ste bod snga ma'i phyag len ltar rung ngo / /bla ma rgya gar ba'i phyag bzhes ni/maṇ+ḍal dang yon phul te/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /de ring gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su —118—

bdag deng gyur/ /zhes slob mas rjes zlos byed pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni sngar mchod pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lugs 'di la nyal ba dang / ldang ba dang zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa ni khyad par zur pa med pas ma spros so/ /spyir 'di'i gzhung ni zab don rim gnyis kho na las 'phros pa'i rim pa cher ma bshad pa/ bla ma'i man ngag gis rgyas par bstan pa de dag go /byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni rtsen mas kha bskangs pa'ang mdzad mod kyi gzhung gi dngos bstan 'di kho na legs pa yin no/ /go don ni gzhud gi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /gang zhig mtha' la mi gnas dbu mar gshegs/ /'gro 'ong med las srid pa'i gnas kun tu/ /dmigs med thugs rjes sems can ma dmigs kyang / /'gro kun sgrol mdzad 'di ni ya mtshan rmad/ /de 'dra'i rje btsun bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'di na man ngag ldan par rab sbyar yang / /byis pa'i blo ni don la rnam par 'khor/ /de bas 'khrul na dam pa rnams bzod mdzod/ /kun dga' snying pos 'dir ni rnam phye ba'i/ /dge ba gang yin de yang nga rgyal med/ /gal te yod na'ang 'gro kun thar bar shog /'di dag gis kyang don mchog mi 'gyur ram// //zhes pa rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bde ba spyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal stag lung thang pa rje btsun bla ma don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ mi 'phrog pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyi bka' stsal spyi bos nod te tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /ma ṅga la bī pū la/ /— 119—

dmar khrid bzhugs/oṃ spru sti/ srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po ni/ /bla ma dam pa la btud de/ /man ngag yongs su bri bar bya/ /tshe 'di nyid la mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bde chen 'bras rab stsole byed pa/ /g.yin du bstan bya ma yin pas/ /'di ni skal ldan nyid la 'os / /'dir grub chen sha dzo ri'i zhal gdams/ grub thob slob dpon rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo zhes bya ba'i gzhung lugs rdzogs pa'i rim pa man ngag gsum pa 'di nyams su len pa la gtum mo dang / dga' ba 'khyil ba gang rung re byas la/ tha mar 'od zer bsdu ba dang / thog mar sngags kyi ting 'dzin gnyis sbyar ba dang / gtum mo/dga' ba 'khyil ba/ 'od zer bsdu ba/ re res kyang chog par bzhed pa dang /thams cad rim can du bsgoms pas lam rdzogs par 'dod pa gsum las bdag gi rdo rje slob dpon phyi ma 'di bzhed do/ /sngags kyi ting 'dzin 'di yang thog mar gzhi'i tshul tu sgom pa dang / re re bzhin du thog mar rdzogs rim sgom la sngags kyi ting 'dzin gyis bogs phyung nas/ ngo sprod pa sogs phyag len du mdzad do/ /sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin la rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes kyang zer ro/ /de dag sgom pa'i lag len ni 'di ltar yin te/ dang po bsags sbyangs dang lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs/ de nas rang phag mor lam gyis — 120—

bsgom pa'i dang por phag gdong gi sna dang / de nas mig dang / gdong dang / rna ba 'phyang ba dang / mche ba dang / kha dog sngon po dang / rtsa zhal gyi shangs dang /zhal dang / mche ba'i myu gu dang / spyan gnyis dang / spyan dbus ma dang / snyan dang / skra mtshams dang / dbu skra dang / mkhur tshos dang / 'gram pa dang /mgrin pa dang / zhal ras byings dang / phyag bzhi ka la re re dang / nu ma re re dang / sku stod dang / sked skabs phra ldem dang / lte ba dang / bha ga dang / ro smad dang / zhabs re re dang / sku mdog dmar ser dang / ro dang / nyi ma dang / pad+ma dang / ba sbu gyen la lta ba dang / dbu rgyan dang / phyag rgya drug dang / mgo phreng dang / me tog phreng dang / me dpung dang / phyag mtshan re re dang / sku ril po ste de rnams la zhag re re sbyang ngo / /rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal la zhag bco lnga bslab/ nga rgyal dang gsal snang gnyis ka sbrags nas zhag bdun nam zla ba gcig tsam bslab bo/ /de nas rje btsun ma'i bris sku dang / mchod yul rnal 'byor mar sgom pa dang / gnas khang dang / bla ma sogs dang / pha ma dang gnod byed dang /chags yul dang / snying du mi sdug pa rnams sems can thams cad dang / snod thams cad la zhag gsum gsum mam re re bslab/ de nas re zhig rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin sgom ste/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la che re lta zhing grim gyi bsgrims pa'i 'dun pa tsam ma gtogs ci yang mi sems par bzhag /rnam rtog thol skyes na 'phro bcad nas sems rig ge ba 'di la cher re blta ba re byas nas bzhag go /gal te 'di gal che bas don 'di la mno bsam byed dgos snyam pa byung na bdud yin/ de ma thag gzhom dgos gsung / gang la'ang thug —121 —

phrad du gtad med yang yud du bya/ rnam rtog shas che zhing da dung 'dzin pa dam na rig pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par gtan la phab cing phab pa re re'ang mthar dmigs med snga ma lta bus zin par byas nas sgom/ de la zla ba tsam bya gsung / 1 de nas re zhig rdzogs rim sgoms la phyis rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dug tsha / nga ngo / /rang gi nye bar chos 'byung dmar po sor gsum pa de'i nang la dbu ma zug pa'i nang du/ gtum mo sor gang tsam dbus su baX dang bcas pa sgom nas rlung kha sbyar khyad par bshang lam bsdams pas thur sel drangs/ chos 'byung g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ shin tu drag pa la sems bzung / 2 baX las me rlud shugs drag dbu ma nas byung sna sgo nas thon sor bcu gnyis kyi bar snang la dga' 'khyil yod pa la phog pas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba sgom/ rlung sbyor ba 'jam pos bum can bya gsung / 3 de nas sor brgyad tsam dang / sor bzhi tsam dang / 4 sna rtse la rag tsam dang / sna rtse'i nang du 'khor ba/ 6 rnams la zhug drug drug go /yang sna nang du 'khor ba 'di gegs chung la phan yon che bas zla ba tsam byas na yang legs/ de nas gtum/ mo dngos ni/ dbu ma'i nang gi lte bar chos 'byung sor phyed pa gtum mo skra rtse ltar phra ba sor gang sgom/ /'di man ngag ni lte 'og sor bzhir byed gsung / de ltar na nyin re bzhin nam/ de tsam ma lcogs na thun re re la me sor re re ring du spar ro/ /rtsa thams cad gsal sal mthong ba dang / 'khor lo re re'i bar bkag phug pa na de las rgyud pa'i rtsa thams cad mes gang bsde sgom/ de ltar sor lnga bcus spyi bo'i haX la reg cing phug par sgom/ de dag tu rlung stod du —122—

'tshangs na/ 'og rlung nye ba man chad du bsdams/ de la steng rlung yang yang brdeg pa nang gi gtun shing dang / brla khul nas brgyud lag pa gtan la btsugs nas lus 'degs shing brdabs pa phyi'i gshun shing ste/ smad kyi ba sbu nas du ba lta bu'i rlung mthon pa'am/ bshang sgo dang gsang ba dang gang na sa nas mngon pa sogs ci rigs pa yod do/ /yang brla steng du rkang pa gcig shos bzhag nas dal bus ldang yang bsdad/ yang ldang ba lan gsum byas te/ mthar lus thams cad la phur mnye bya/ de nas g.yas g.yon du phar 'gyel tshur 'gyel bya ba ljon pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes so/ /yang phyag rgya'i mkha'am rang gi lag gis rdo rje dbab pa ni/ 'di'i bogs 'don dang / gtum mo shin tu goms pa'i gegs sel yang yin gyi da lta mi mkho zhing / 'phral du gnod pa yod/ de yang 'od kyi 'khor lo dpag tshad tsam mgo bo la bskor zhing steng du 'gro ba dang /glog gi dbyug pa mthong ba dang / brgyal shing spyi bor phug pa la/ rtsol ba klong nas sbyor ba des gegs sel bar snang gsung / de nas ha las byang sems kyang thun re la sor gang tsam re 'bebs shing ba thag lta bu dbu ma nas 'jug cing /gzhan rtsa thams cad gang bar bsam ste/ 'khor lo bzhi so sor phyin pa na dga' ba bzhi skye zhing / gal te ma skyes na myong ba dran nas mos pa bya/ 'di la dang por mun nag tu 'dug la rtags snang dmigs kyi bar du lte 'og tu sgom/rtags snang lnga pa dmigs nas me spor lugs snga ma ltar byed pa dang / rtags snang dmigs rung ma dmigs rung de yan chad de ltar byas nas/ de nas rlung thengs re la lte rlung lte la 'og rlud la brdabs pas/ yar thabs su dbu mar —123—

zhugs nas me yud kyi spar/ byang sems yud kyi zhu/ nye ba'i gtum mo dang 'dres pa'i bde ba la sems rtse gcig tu byed pa goms pas rtags lnga dang 'gog pa'i rdo rje 'byung / yon to brgyad tshan gnyis 'thob ste/ spyod pas bogs phyung bas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yin gsung / me dmigs kyi gtum mo'i rim pa'o/ /da ni 'di las kyi gtum mo yin gsung ste gtso bor ni yin la/ mtha' gcig tu ma yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo yang yod pas so/ /de la rim pa 'di la gsum/ rang bzhin gyi gtum mo/ rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo/ las kyi gtum mo gsum las/ dang po ni sngar gyi gtum mo dang rim pa 'di'i gtum mo phyi ma gnyis dang / 'od zer bsdu ba rnams la shin tu goms pas g.yas g.yon dang srog thur 'dres nga brtan por song / de nas khams 'od gsal du thim pas rlung sems tsam gyi dkyil 'khor grub nas de'i phyag rgya dang / snyom par zhugs gtum mo sbar bas thob pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba lugs 'byung lugs ldog brtan par byas pas/ tha mal pas lus zad nas rdo rje'i skur 'gyur ro/ /las kyi gtum mo ni las kyi phyag rgya dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i lam yin te/ 'di skabs tha mal gyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par gyi phyag rgya'i brtags thabs/gnod sbyin mo sogs bsgrubs pa/ phyag rgya dgug pa/ sbyor thabs sgom tshul/gnad bzhi dang thor bu ba'i zhal gdams kyang mang du yod par snang / ci rigs ni bka' drin du'ang thob mod/ rnam rtog shas che ba 'ga' zhig gi dbang las/kha cig ma nod pa yang yod pas ma spros so/ /rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo la brten —124—

pa ni 'di yin ste rang he ru ka dang ye shes kyi rig ma'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyom par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje'i gtum mo sbar ba'am/ rang rnal 'byor mar sgom nas rlung gnyis rtse sprad pas gsang ba'i gtum mo sbar bar sgom pa gdams ngag yin cing gang ltar gsang ba nas thig le dmar po las me khyug gis song / khu ba'i rtsa nas zhugs/ lte ba'i gtum mo dang 'dres/ dbu ma'i lam nas song / ba sbu nas me'i zer phyir spros lha dang lha min sogs thams cad bsregs/ me lce spyi rba li/ thig le la reg reg 'dug /rtsa nang gi byang sems thams cad zhu/ spyi bo'i rtsa rgyud kyi byang sems thams cad ha las brgyud nas babs/ de bzhin du 'khor lo bzhi kar song nas gong ma rnams 'og ma dang 'dres/ lte ba yan chad du brtan par byas/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma yungs 'khru tsam dkar po 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba dga' ba 'khyil ba'i rnam pa nor bu'i nang gi rtse'am/ bya gdong gi rtse mor khor khor 'khor bas/ bde ba bzod dka' ba chil chil ba la sems bzung / yang de las lhan skyes 'dren cing / de shin tu brtan na dang por nor bur phub/ de yar drangs te rim gyi sor re re steng de/ mthar spyi bor 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mas brtan gyi lhan skyes 'char ba yin/ de yang brtan na 'od zer bsdu ba sgoms pas 'od gsal dngos la 'jug par 'gyur/ de yan chad du mtshan mo'i nyams len ji ltar bya ba ni dang por gtum mo sgom pa'i skabs thig le lte bar phyin pa yan chad du ched gnyer mi byed/ de nas lte ba'i thig le 'dres pa'i bde ba la sems bzung ba'i ngang nas gnyid logades gnyid mthug po bde bar chud gsung / de man chad du nyin mo gang la —125—

goms pa'i rgyun de nyid la 'phen pa shugs cher bcug ste gnyid dus su 'byer/gal te rmi lam bzung 'dod na me dmigs kyi me dang / dga' ba 'khyil ba'i thig le mgrin par sgom la rmi lam yin snyams du byas pas zin 'ong / de nas gnyid dus su lhar bsgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang dmigs pa sbyong / de nas gnyid kyi skabs su rmi lam zin/ nyin mo'i dmigs pa dran nas thams cad lha skur 'byongs shing / der gtum mo dang / 'od zer bsdu ba dga' ba 'khyil ba gang sgom pas kyang rmi lam gyi lha skur slar yang 'od gsal du 'jug /de ltar na gnyid thun gcig gi nang du yang ldang 'jug yang yang nus gsung / 'od zer bsdu ba thog ma'i skabs su sgom na yang / de dag dang 'dra la/ dang por gzhan la goms nas de nas lam re mthor song ba'i skabs ni 'phen pa btang nas stong par bsdus pa'i ngang la ring du 'jog /der sems mi gnas na skad cig gis lhar bskyed la yang yang sbyang ngo / /gnyid du 'gro khar yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dga' ba 'khyil ba 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /'di ni rjes zhig gi rim pa yin te/ dbu ma'i nang gi nye snying gang rbang du spu ljang khu sgom/ de las sna g.yas nas 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ de dag thams cad sna bu g.yon nas zhugs khyu la thim pas thig le sran ma tsam ba yig dang bcas pa'am/ nā das mtshon par gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus kyang nang gi rlung 'od zer gyi tshul du bsdus/ thig le la thim/ sku yang yal/ ba dang thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas stong pa la ring du bzhag /de nas yang lhar ldang / de'i mtshon pa'i snang ba gang snang yang lhar sgom pa ni 'od zer bsdu ba zhes bya ste ldang 'jug 'di —126

yang yang sgom mo/ /'dir nyams kyi khrid pa ci rigs pa la/ 'od zer bsdu ba'i tshan bdun po re re la zhag drug drug bya/ de rnams song ba'i rjes su slar lam gyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgom dgos so/ /de dag tu nyams ci rigs pa skyes na/dug dang bral ba ste/ de nyid sems dang gcig gam tha dad nyams sna tshogs dang / khyad par bde ba nam shar dus de nyid yang yang btsal/ gzhan yang de'i tshe skyo ba dang dga' ba nyon mongs ci skyes thams cad legs par btsal mthar gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngo bo la 'jog tshul/ bde ba'i rtsal dang / rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags pa de nyid rtag tu bskyangs shing / phyogs med du sbyong / gang snang thams cad de ltar ngo 'phrod par bya'o/ /gtum mo'i me nang dang / dga' ba 'khyil ba'i thig le'i nang dang / khyi gi thig le'i nang du lha sku thig le sogs skyed chog ji lta bar sgom/ yang de'i nang du gtum mo dang / lha sku la sogs pa thug med du sgom ste/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim phan tshun rgyas 'debs pa yin gsung ste/ phyogs 'dra ba yin no/ /go don ni gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid lag len rdzogs so// //bde ba'i 'jug ngogs rmad du byung / khren tu myur ba'i man ngag ni/ /tshe 'dir byang chub 'grub nges pas/ /thob pa 'di la dga' bar byos/ /de skad kyang gsung ngo / /zhes pa 'di yang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa dam pa rje btsun dpal stag lung thang pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ bla ma dam pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi bka' stsal spyi bos nod de tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la bris/ /zhu dag/ ma ṅga la shubha wastu//— 127—

sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bde ba chen po'i dpal 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhu kyi gan//oṃ snya sti/ na mo gu ra we/ ye shes bskal ba'i me yi gzi 'od can/ /sgeg 'a myong du mas rnam brgyan drag mo che/ /mi phyed sngags kyi de nyid rtag 'char ba/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /dpag yas sgrub thabs chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /nam mkha'i nor bu dang mchungs snying po ste/ /gsang ba'i man ngag o rgyan las byung ba/ /bden gnyis zhal can mchod pa'i cho ga brtsam/ /de yang dus bzang po la stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dri ste/ pad+ma dmar po'am/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte ba zlum po la chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtse mo mdun du bstan pa/ gru bcar ljang khu bya/ pad+ma'i phyi rol du rgyas par na dur khrod rdo rwa 'od zer 'phreng bas bskor ba 'bri/ bsdu na dur khrod med kyang chog /shin tu bsdu na rdo rwa me ri'i tshab tu re kha nag po dang dmar pos bskor ba tsam byed pa'ang yod/ de'i steng du mañji la thod pa myos byed kyis bkang ba dang / me long chang gis brlan pa la si rgyu ra snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi smyu gu g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gzung nas 'bri bar bshad kyang / myu gu ji ltar 'os pa gser gyi mtshan par byas te g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gis bzung / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis kyang smyu gu'i rtsa ba nas 'dzin pa tsam mdzad pa'i srol yin/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du/ rtsa sngags yig 'phreng bdun pa 'bri na/oX gsum la 'phreng gcig /sngags 3zha gsum la re re/ hūX gsum la gcig /phaṭa gsum la — 128—

gcig /swāhā la gcig go /gsum du byed na/ yig 'bru dang po bcu bdun la gcig /de nas bcu gcig la gcig /de nas bzhi la gcig go /chos 'byung gi phyi rol phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba lag bzhi pa re re 'bri/ mdun gyi de mdun drang thad la mi byed de/ rtse mo g.yon du bya/ ngag sbyor gyi gnad gcig kyang yod do/ kha cig si rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor snod du bcug dar dmar gyis 'gebs pa'i srol yang yod de phal cher mi byed pa'i dar dmar po'i gur khang ngam/ bla bre'am/ yol khang gis bcang chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyad dang gtor ma lnga mug mas/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ḍā ma sa rol mo dang mig dar sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshogs par bshams/ bum pa yang spyi dang mthun par 'cha'o/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs dang / / zhu 'bul skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom/ /drug po spyi mthun sngon 'gro yin zhes bya/ / de nas cho ga'i rim pa la 'jug ste/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oX nga ni rmi hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā hūX huX phaṭa/ oX gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oX ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza huX huX phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oX swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shu khyordo3haX/ zhes pas sbyangs/oX āXhuX ha hoXhiX zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ h+pha badz+ra a ra smi ho/ dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā gī ni sa ma ya stuX/ khru shuho/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oX kha kha 'a hi 'a hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/rāk+ṣa sa/ bhā ta pre ta bi shā tsa/ ur+sha da/ a pa smra ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i maX ba li gro : stu rmo ma ya rwak+ta stu/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra ya lha skyi/ ya bai baX/ ya thi lgaX bhañja tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sa klu khaX/ bi bri dha/ sa ha yi ka bha nywa stu huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ skye( badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ pā duX/ tseX( badz+ra pulpe āXhūX/ dh+wa pe/ ā 'e1 ke ga rnye/ ni be rkye/ shasta āXskyoX/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha'i 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs — 129—

mkha' 'gro/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXñcaX lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod spyi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / kha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /spyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod spyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya wo kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis —130—

bdag la gsungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel dang cho se 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor wo po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang par 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad srung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par g.yin du song zhig /ra drag tu bzlas la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ de nas gnasadang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhu las byung ba'i rin po che/ sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang bcas shing thogs pa med pa'i dbus su/ ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ ā hu zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub —131—

pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug sbos/ mar me/ dri chab/zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /o badz+ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ pā py-i/ o badz+ra put+pa ā hū/ tse( badz+ra hu pe ā hū/ tse( badz+ra ā 'e1 ke ā hu/ skye( badz+ra ga rnye ā hu/ tse( badz+ra nai we rkye ā hu/ o badz+ra shabha ā hu/ o badz+ra spa ra ṇa kha/ o badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sa pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba ba khyu spyo ṭa pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da sa bha wa ta/ badz+ra dharma hrid ya/ sa rnyo ṣa ni hū hu hu ho ho ho ā kha khyu hā/ de nas spro na zhu 'bul bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ skyabs 'gro ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad 'khore ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug —132—
