nyi shu pa bzhi ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gnas su gyur pa'o /de ltar rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin/ sku gsum rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum po de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa kha dog dmar po zhes pa nas sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/rang sems zhes pa dang / bdag nyid ces pa dor ro/ /gong bzhin ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ /bzlas pa cung zad nga yang ci rigs pa bzlas/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i lha tshogs zhes pa nas/ gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar du gsol ba btab pa/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu blang ba rnams zhal gnyis ma'i skabs dang khyad par med de/ gtor ma rnams su lhas bsangs nas/ gsol bar gyur gyi bar/ tse( badz+ra bā rā hi/ a be sha ya/ sarba du gin khyi spru hā/ zhes pa la/ tse pho hrī ha ha he he ha ha hi hi/ h+pha h+pha zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+gha nas/ shabha 'a bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du nas/ kun 'grub shogagong ma'i bar/ oṃ kha kha nas kun 'gru/ba ye rdzog /'og ma'i bar/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang /bum sgrub kyang 'dra ba las/ yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i ces pa nas rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ bzlas pa ni/tse( badz+ra bā rā hi/ sogs snying po dang / sum+bha ci rigs pa bzla ba ni khyad par ro/ /bdag 'jug gi skabs/ ji ltar bltams pa nas nga bzla ba'i bar/ lte bar o ba nas/ dkon ma cedro ga gsum la sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ smras nas dam tshig nyams par 'gyu/ra ta re/— /83—

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig nas/ oṃ ā hri hri khyu spyo bar/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nas/ mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur/ 'og gzhi chos 'gyung ni/ zhes pa nas/ sku gsum gyi ye shes so/ /rdo rje rgya gram bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /yig 'khru rnams nas ye shes dang yon tan rgyas pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pas ma gos pa nas zung du 'jug pa'o/ /zhal gcig phag gi zhal ni rtog med de bzhin nyid du chos thams cad ro gcig pa'o/ /phyag bzhi ni sku bzhi brnyes pa'o/ /rdo rje ni ye shes te nyon mongs pa 'jom pa'o/ /thod pa ni bde ba skyong ba'o/ /lcags kyu ni 'khor ba pa rnams thar par 'dren pa'o/ /zhags pa ni gdug pa can rnams 'ching ba'o/ /thod skam lnga ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'o/ /zhabs g.yon bskum ji brkyang ba ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /skra gyen du brdzes pa ni yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba'o/ kha ṭāX ga ni nas snang ba 'phro ba'o/ /de thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ /dngos gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje nas/ sprul sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs so/ /zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ oṃ gsum ma'i dod du 'di nyid kyi snying po bzla/ khyod zhabs pad+mo nas/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur/ gyi bar yang 'dra ba las/ oX gsum ma'i dod du 'di nyid kyi 'don pa spo/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baX yig las zhes pa nas 'jug par gyur cig 'di la'ang sngags 'don pa spo pur+sha nas sha lta'i bar ro/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa nas bsod nams 'di yi sogs lhag ma mchod pa kha gso nas/ bkra shis kyi bar la'ang khyad par —184—

med de/ snying po 'don pa spo ba tsam bya'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs cho ga'i yan lag rnams kyang 'dra ba la/ /tshogs phud 'bul ba'i skabs thog mar 'di nyid kyi gtor sngags kyis 'bul dgos so/ /de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje phag mo bden gnyis zhal can gyi cho ga bde chen dpal 'bar la 'don pa bsgyur te/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo don thams cad yongs su grub pa'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga bde blag tu grub pa 'di yang / deng sang gi bla rul rnams las/ dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal chen pos khyad par du gyur pa/ tā ra nā thas blo dman mig phug lung rgyus kyang mi shes pa rnams kyi don du smras pa ca(// //ha ha// zhus dag/

grags pa'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/na mo gu sa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/dpal gyi blo gros ma'i rang bzhin de'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga mug da par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i lag len 'di la 'jug par 'dod pas/ rje btsun zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub mchod kyi tshig don gnyis ka blo la nges por bya'o/ /'og gzhi'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte bar chos 'byung can/ me long la chos 'byung rkyang pa dga' 'khyil bzhi dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi cha la gtso mo'i sngags yig 'bru rnams brtsegs pa dang / de'i g.yas phyogs su be+e ro tsa na'i sngags dang /g.yon du brje'i sngags rnams brtsegs te 'bri/ gzhan mdun bskyed kyi bshams la khyad par med/sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi mdun du tsan+dan dmar po'i lde gus byugs pa'am/ phye ma bkram pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gsum pa/ gtor phran gcig dang mchod par bcas pa bshams/ cho ga'i rim pa la tseX( sum+bha nas bzung / 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim gyi bar dang / nang mchod/ su lhas bsangs nas/ oṃ āXhuX lan gsum gyi bar bdud rtsi'i dbus su chos 'byung gi lte bar hruXzur gsum la g.yon bskor gyi/ oṃ āXhuX/ de'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dang / khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su spyan drangs te thim/ lkoX āXhuX ha ho hri/ bdag dang gnas la bdud rtsi gtor/ oX sdiXgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba ྅spyin huX phaṭa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs rnams thams cad tshar bcad/— 186—

steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du srung ba'i 'khor lo grub par gyur/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baX dmar mo nas/ sgo ka'i ngo bo rnams kyi rgyas btab par gyur/oṃ su bhā wa oṃ badz+ra shu sgo3: oṃ yo ga shurnyo: stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar raX yig dmar po gnas pa las/ ye shes kyi me 'od 'phros/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan cing /gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir/ dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dbus su/ dri bral chu skyes dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo 'og tu zla ba dang / steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kha sbyor gyi dbus su hiXyig dmar ser ro/ /de las gri gug hriXs mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug cung zad thur du sdigs pa'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ g.yon thod khrag steng phyogs su gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ phyi rol g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāX ga dkar po bsgrengs pa sku'i g.yon ngos su rdo rje rab bsngags ma ljang khu zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ phyag g.yas thod khrag 'phyar zhing / g.yon gri gug thur du sdigs pa/g.yas su rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma ser mo zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba/ phyag g.yon thod khrag 'phyar zhing / g.yas gri gug thur du sdigs pa/—187—

gtso 'khor gsum kar yang gcer bu mo dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal cung zad gdangs shing ha har ba6da pa/khro gnyer bskyod pas 'jigs pa yang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ lang tsho la bab cing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang bar/ chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki ni ye hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams dang /rdo rje rab bsngags ma'i gsang bar/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ oṃ badz+ra brte nī ye hu phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams dang /rdo rje rnam snang ma'i gsang bar/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hū phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams te/ chos 'byung rnams dmar po/sngags rnams lha rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /gtso mo'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang nyid kyi mgrin pa nas bcad pas/ rtsa a ba dhu tī dang rkyang ma dang / ro ma gsum chad pa na/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams rgyun chad/ ma rungs pa thams cad shin tu skrag par gyur/ phyag g.yon pas dbu skra'i phyed nas bzung /spyan gsum thur du gzigs pas sa 'og gi 'jig rten bskyod par byas/ rtsa gsum bcad mtshams kyi a ba dhu tī nas me dang mun pa'i rang bzhin khu rdul 'dres pa'i rgyun byung ste/ gtso mo rang nyid kyi zhal du 'jug par gyur/ g.yon rkyang ma nas mi bskyod pa dang 'dres pa'i kun+da'i rgyun byung ste/ g.yon rdo rje rab —188—

bsngags ma'i zhal du babs/ ro ma nas/ rang byung dang 'dres pa'i rak+ta'i rgyun byon pa/ g.yas rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma'i zhal du babs/ lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /'dir sngags gsum po mang nyung ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /thur sel gyen du drangs pa'i sbyor ba las/ gtso mo'i gsang bar gnas pa'i sngags las 'od zer 'phros/rtsa gsum gyi lam nas byung / g.yon gyi rdo rje rab bsngags ma 'od zer gyis drangs te/ bdag nyid la thim/ badz+ra brta'i skabs rkyang ma nas zhugs te/ gtso mo'i gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du/ gtso mo nyid kyi sngags kyi g.yon du/ sngar gyi rnam pas bzhugs par gyur/ g.yas kyi rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma yang 'od zer gyis drangs/ rang nyid la thim/ be+e ro tsa na'i sngags/ ro ma'i lam nas brgyud/ gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du/ gtso mo'i sngags kyi g.yas su sngar gyi rim pas 'khod/ gtso mo nyid kyi dbu yang rang gnas su byon/ rnyag tu 'brel bar gyur/ rang gi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la dmigs te/ su lhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba ces pa nas/ sku mdog dang mtshungs pa 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo lko pa bor/ lte bar oṃ ba dmar mo nas/ tsarnyi ka'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ h+pha dza : ba ho/ o yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3ha/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hu phaṭa snya hā/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha ā hu/ oṃ badz+ra brna nī ye hu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha ā hu/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra purmye ā hu/zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis me tog phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wa ra ar+gha pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin du/ putre nas shaga'i bar gyis 'bul/ nus na de thams—189—

cad la sngags gsum po re re bzhin/ mchod sngags sbyar te 'bul ba yin no/ /de bzhin du sngags gsum po re re'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ oṃ ḍi ya pu snyi ra ma gi ti kā ma k+ṣa shi ha lha/ dharma sa sto ga ni rma ṇa mahā su kha kā ya na ma ces pa lan gsum gyis bstod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /'og ma'i bar bya/ gtor ma 'bru gsum lan bdun sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a ra zhi ho dza / ba ho badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya stu dra khyo ho/ lan bdun gyis phul/ sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod de/ mdun bskyed kyi sngags gsal btab/ rlud phyir bsal/ yang sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod/ rang gi sngags gsum gsal btab/ rlud nang du rngubs/ thur sel steng du bskyod pa'i sbyor bas/ rang gi gsang ba'i sngags gsum las 'do zer 'phros/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yas pa nas thon/ mdun gyi lha mo gsum gyis shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs sku lus kyi nang gang / gsang ba'i sngags las 'od zer nyams bde ba dang ldan pa spyan drangs/rang rang gi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ bdag nyid kyi sna g.yon gyi sgo nas zhugs/ a ba dhū ti'i lam brgyud/ gsang bar gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi sngags gsum la thim/ dmigs pa de nyid yang yang gsal btab cing / spro bsdu'i dmigs pa yang lhag por bsnan te/ oṃ sarba bzhi ḍā gi nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra brte nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hu hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ slar yang gong bzhin ar+gha nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma gsum yang 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha: mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor 'og ma hū las byung ba'i nas/ de rnams kyi dbus su hru yi ge de rnams las nas/ chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dmar ba/ bde ba chen po'i nas —190—

bar snang la dbus su o sarba brnya ḍā ki nī ye hū phaṭa snyu hā/ g.yon du / lko badz+ra brna nī ya hu phaṭa/ g.yas su/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hū phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsigs ma rnams so/ /phyi rol phyogs bzhir nas/ gcig tu 'dres pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba zhes pa nas 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /lte bar o ba dmar mo nas/ tsa'i ka'i ngo go /h+pha dza hū ba ho o yo ga shurnyo3: o sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wa ra ar+gha swāhā nas/ shasta ā hu gi bar gyis mchod/dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs/ glo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ bar 'dir o sarba brnya sogs sngags gsum so sor cung zad bzlas nas/ mthar gcig tu dril ba gong bzhin bzla bar bya'o/ /mthar nga dang / yi ge brgya nga/ yang cung zad bzlas/ bo com ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gsung rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs zhes pa nas/ gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar du zhal gnyis ma'i cho ga bzhin no/ /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ ya las nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bzhi ḍā ki ni ye/ oṃ badz+ra brta nī ye/ o badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye i da purmye sogs kyis 'bul ba nas/ kun 'grub sna|ga /gong ma'i bar dang / kha kha ji hi /nywa hi nas/ yig brgya lan gsum bar gyi gtor chog byas/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs nas/ yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba nas/ yo ga shu zle'i bar gong mdun bskyed bzhin/ de nas ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pa sogs/ cho ga lhag ma rnams zhal gnyis ma'i skabs dang khyad par med de/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i skabs su sngags gsum so so dang ci rigs par sbrel ba ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bdag 'jug gi rim pa yang / phal cher mtshungs te/ ji ltar bltams pa nas dra bzla ba'i bar/ lte bar o ba nas/ dkon — 191 —

mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dang/'a thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes pa nas/ nyams par 'gyur ta re/ dang/'a bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig pa nas/ a a hri hri grwa spyo bar/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nas/ mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pa ma gos pa'o/ /'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan ma ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa spangs pa'o/ /nyi ma ni bde ba chen po'i nas/ thabs dang ma bral ba'o/ /lha gsum ni chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'o/ /dbu bcad pa ni sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa'o/ /rtsa gsum bcad pa ni/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang / khams gsum rnam par dag pa'o/ /gcer bu ni rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /me dpung 'bar ba ni kun tu khyab pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba spro ba'o/ /'og gi gzhi'i chos 'byung ni/ dug gsum gyi chos nyid ces pa nas/ ye shes dang yon tan rgyas pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ /dngos gzhi'i ma rdza 'bul ba nas/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur/zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ rang skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das ma sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi skur gyur/ zhes pa dang / o gsum ma'i gnas su/ gsum dril ba'i snying po 'jug pa ni khyad par ro/ /chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba zhes pa nas/ gcig tu 'brel bar gyur gyi bar/sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i nas/ shasta'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ sngags kyi thad 'don pa sgyur ro/ /gtso bos ji ltar/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ bkra shis kyi mthar thug par/ rjes chog kyang 'dra ba las/ 'don pa sgyur ba phran tshegs — 192—
gnyis zhal can gyi cho ga la 'don pa sgyur ba 'di yang / blo gros shin tu dman pa rnams la dgos par byung nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag/ bkra shi/sa//

'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX snya sti/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sgrub pa'i thabs las/ rdzogs rim sgom thabs kyi man ngag /dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las brtsams te/zab mo'i rim pa la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mtho bar gshegs pa/ slob dpon chen po in+t+ra dh+wa ti'am/ ldong ngar ba dang / lha mo dpal gyi blo gros dang /birnya pa dang / a wa khyo ti pa dang / thun mong brnyes pa stong pa nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i man ngag /bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ba ren dra ru tse ces bya ba/ dpal ha du dkar por grags pa la/dpyal lo tsa ba kun dga' rdo rjes dka' ba dang 'bad pa du mas bla ma mnyes par byas te/ yang dag par thob pa'i gdam pa/ nyams len sgom pa drug gam sgom thabs drug gi 'khrid tshul du grags pa 'di la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ byams snying rje rnams sngon tu btang ste/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ sems bskyed kyi khrid/ maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ yig brgya'i khrid/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid rnams rim gyis 'bogs shing / rtags thon thon du sgom —194—

dgos te/ de dag gi dmigs rim ni bde mchog gi khrid yig rnams su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsol 'debs ni/ stan bde ba la lus gnad bcas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la/rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can zhig bsgom ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i sku'i ba skru nyag re la yang 'dus par mos/ snying thag pa nas mos gus dung dung pas/bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdo rje 'chang chen sku drin can la gsol ba 'debs so/ /he ru ka dpal rje btsun khyed la: mkha' mnyam ngo bo nyid kyi sku la: /bla ma ye shes chos kyi sku la: /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la: /dmigs med thugs rje sprul pa'i sku: /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la nyams dang rtog pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsol ba drag tu btab/ sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug nas/ bla ma la yid ches pa'i mos gus kyi gsol ba drag tu btab pa kho na gnad du che'o/ /mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ 'di 'og tu dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa re re bzhin thams cad kyi thun mgor sbyor yang dgos la/ 'di nyid thog mar yun ring du dmigs khrid du bcad nas kyang bsgom par bya ste dmigs skor dang po'o// //༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dbyibs la bslab pa/ rlud la bslab pa/yig 'bru/ la bslab pa/ 'od lus la bslab pa/ 'od gsal la bslab pa/ zung —195—

'jug la bslab pa ste drug go /dang po dbyibs la bslab pa la gsum ste/bdag dbyibs la bslab pa dang / dbyibs spo ba la bslab pa dang / snang ba dbyibs la bslab pa'o/ /dang po bdag dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'am/ don grub ma'am/ dbu bcad ma la sogs pa gang la brten kyang rung mod kyi gtso bor zhal gnyis ma nyid la brten nas mdzad do/ /de yang mngon rtogs blangs pa'i gzhug tu sgom pa yin na/ de kha'i ngang la yid kyis yang yang gsal btab pas chog /thun mtshams gzhan du bsgom na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i gsol 'debs rnams sngon du btang / rang lus ci yang mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang la/ chu las chu bur brdol ba'i tshul gyis/ baX yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam pa/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs gdan dang bcas par wal gyis gsal btab/ rgyan cha lugs sogs yongs rdzogs dmigs pa gsal po byung na rab yin/ gsal ba de kha'i rgyun la sems bzung / de tsam mi gsal na/ thog mar yongs rdzogs gsal 'debs thengs gcig byas nas/ sku mdog dmar mo/ /rtsa zhal khro mo/ g.yas zhal phag gdong / gri gug /thod pa/ kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ pad nyi ro gdan la g.yon brkyang gi gar gyis bzhugs pa tsam zhig lam gyis gsal btab/ rgyan cha lugs cha shas phra mo rnams yod snyam pa tsam bya/ de kha la yud tsam zhig bsgom ste 'phro bcad/ yang zhib mor gsal 'debs theng gcig byas te sngar bzhin sems bzung / de ltar yang yang bsgom/ bar skabs su ngal gso ba dang / 'jug tu thun 'jog pa'i —196—

skabs/ rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad smig rgyu lta bu'i rtags su mos pa byas la/ shes pa khong lhod kyis glod/ goms nas smig rgyu lta bu'i rtags 'byung yang 'byung ba yin/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbyibs spo ba la bslab pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma la goms na/'di sgom pa yin te/ de yang rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du lugs sku'am/ rdo rje dril bu lta bu gang yang rung ba zhig bzhag /rang lha skur sgom pa bzhin/ de rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ de yang zhib tu gsal btab pa'i rjes su/ rags pa la sems 'dzin tshul sogs gong dang 'dra/ dmigs pa mtshams gcod tshul gong dang 'dra zhing / ngal gso dang thun mtshams skabs kyang de kho na bzhin no/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe mdun gyi lha rang gi lte ba'i ba la thim par bsam/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /gsum pa snang ba dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ skyabs sems gsol 'debs gong bzhin song nas/ ka ba bum pa rtsig pa shing bu rde'u sogs/ rang gi nye skor na yod pa'i dngos po thams cad/ rdo rje phag mo'i skur lam ste bsgoms nas/ de dag las dmigs pa'i yul gang yang rung ba rnam pa gsal ba zhig/rdo rje phag mor nan tan du gsal btab cing shes pa drag tu bstad la bsgom/gzhan rnams lha skur lam me yod pa'i mos pa tsam bya/ ngal gso sogs dmigs pa'i yan lag rnams gong dang mtshungs/ gcig la gsal na gnyis gsum la bslab pa sogs/ rim gyis rim gyis sbyong ba yin/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /des sgom thabs dang po dbyibs la bslab pa zhes bya ba legs par tshar ba yin/— 197—

gnyis pa rlung la bslab pa la/ rlud bsdu ba dang / rlud sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mong gi zhal gdams las 'byung ste/ skyabs sems gsol 'debs te thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar las/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun spyi dang 'dra bar bcas/ rang rdo rje phag mo'i skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus lte ba'i thad du ba dmar po/ rtsa zhal gyi sna rtse nas yar gzhal ba'i sor brgyad kyi thad tsam gyi nam mkha' la dga' ba 'khyil ba/ lag bzhi pa /spa dog dmar po rgya skyegs kyi khu bas bris pa lta bu rang la mdun bstan pa'i dbang du byas pa'i g.yon skor du 'khyil ba gcig bsgom/ 'di sgom sa nges pa can ni/sna rtse nas yar sor brgyad drang thad du gzhal ba ma yin/ gyen sogs cung zad yod pa la rtsi ba yin pas/ don dpral ba'i dbyings dang mtho dman mnyam pa'i tshad las/ dpral ba la sor bzhis ma reg pa'i bar stong yod pa'i nam mkha' la sgom pa yin/ dga' 'khyil gyi tshad la spyir nges pa med kyang / mthe bong gi sen mo'i rgya tsam sgom par bzhed do/ /de rjes rlung ro lan gsum bsal/'jam rlung kha spyor du bzung / 'di la thur sel rang gnas su bcing ba ma gtogs yar 'then mi dgos/ lhe ba'i ba las rlung sbos ring gi du ba lta bu sngo skya zhig gyen du nar gyis byung / rlung gang nas rgyu ba'i sna bug nas 'thon/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dga' ba 'khyil ba la phog pas/ g.yon skor du khyil li li myur du 'khor ba la shes pa bstad/ rlud g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba gsal ba'i tshe na de bzhin yin la/ rgyu ba mi gsal ba'am mnyam rgyu'i skabs yin na/ sna bug gnyis ka nas rgyu bar mos dgos pa yin/ 'di zhag shas sgom dgos pas —198—

dmigs chung dmigs skor gcig tu bya/ thun gyi rjes yan lag rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ smig rgyur mos pa'i tshab tu du ba lta bur mos pa bya/ de la goms nas sna rtse nas sor drug gi thad kyi nam mkha' la dga' 'khyil 'khor bar sgom/gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ 'di yang zhag shas bsgom dgos pas dmigs skor gcig tu rtsi/ de bzhin du sna rtse nas sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sar dga' 'khyil 'khor bar sgom/ gzhan 'dra/ 'di yang zhag shas bsgom dgos pas dmigs skor gcig tu brtsi yang sna rtse'i nang du dga' 'khyil 'khor ba la sems gtod/gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ 'di yang dmigs skor chung ba gcig ste/ mdor na tshan pa bzhi po de la/ spyir dmigs pa gsal mi gsal dang / rtsol ba che chung gis yun ring thung sbyor ba yin gyi/ zhag grangs la nges pa cher med na'ang / dmigs pa gsal mi gsal 'bring ba zhig gis thun bzhi la rlung thengs drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam re sgom pa yin na/ de rnams la zhag bdun re bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su snga dro sogs thun re re bzhin dum bu bzhi bzhir bcad pa thun chung re rer byas te/thun chung dang po la sna rtse nas sor brgyad pa'i mtshams su dga' 'khyil 'khor bar bsgom/ gnyis pa la drug gsum pa la bzhi/ bzhi pa la sna rtser 'khor bar bsgom/ g.yin gong dang 'dra/ 'di la rtags ma byung gi bar du sgom pa gal che/ma mtha' yang zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam thun bzhi so sor rlung thengs brgya rtsa brgyad re bsgom par bya'o/ /phal cher la de tsam sgom pa la'ang rtags cung zad cing 'ong ngo / /dmigs chen dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba ni/ mchog gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba ste/—199—

mig sna rtser lta dgos/ gzhan lus gnad spyi dang 'dra/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dang dmigs pa'i yan lag snga ma dang mtshungs/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni gsang gnas su/ chos 'byung dmar po/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa sor bzhi'i tshad tsam dbu ma zangs dung kha gyen du bstan pa lta bu yar sna spyi bo'i thad du sleb pa/ kha dog dmar po'o/ /g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang /g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis/ yas sna sna bug gnyis la zug cing / de nas mar yong ste mgrin pa man chad la dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon la gzhabs te song bas/ mgrin pa nas rgyu zhabs kyi bar du rtsa gsum gsum gshibs su thal le bsgom/ rtsa gsum gyi mas sna gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi dbus su sleb pa ste/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams nas sor do tsam thur du gzhal ba'i thad du phyin pa'o/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mas sna de/ ba dmar po 'od 'phro ba gcig gi 'od zer rgya mdud ltar spyi dbyibs sgor sgor ba yin pa la zur chung 'bar 'bur mang du yod pa gcig bsgom ste/ de la zug pa/ lte bar ba ser po mgo bo thur bstan me'i rang bzhin can 'od 'phro ba/ 'od kyi dbyibs zlum ril le ba la 'og phyogs su rtsa ba phra zhing / rtsa bde nyid kyi 'og gi kha g.yel ba'i rnam pa can sgom ste/ ba yig bum pa kha bub lta bu zhes grags pa'o/ /bsha/nga lam du k+ṣa dmar nag cig dang / spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu bla ma'i ngo bo rdo rje rgya gram sgom/ zhag shas dmigs pa de la bslab/ dmigs chung dmigs skor gcig byed/ de nas rlud nang du 'jug pa dal bus drangs shing / gnas pa dang phyir 'byung ba rang babs su ba theg /dmigs pa snga ma de ka yin/ yang phyi la dal bus dbyung ba yun ring —200—

du 'byung ba la bslab/ 'jug pa dang gnas pa rang babs/ sems kyi dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ste zhag bdun tsam bsgom/ 'di la yang dmigs chung thun gcig go /de nas dmigs pa'i gzhi snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ dbu ma la sarba budha'i sngags/ ro ma la badz+ra baṇ+ḍa dang / rkyang ma la be+e ro tsa ni'i sngags rnams lte ba nas mas sna'i bar la/ yig 'bru rnams brtsegs mar yod pa/ kha dog dmar po'am/ rtsa'i kha dog dang mthun pa'am/ dbu bcad ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'am/ yang na dbus kyi yi ge nag por bsgom kyang rung ste/ dmigs pa gsal zhing gsal thebs na/ lha dang sngags kyi byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug pa'i gnad yod pas sngags 'bru de dag nges par sgom dgos/ci ste shin tu mi gsal na/ thun gyi mgo la lan gcig gsal btang nas/ de phyin thun de'i nang du ma bsgoms kyang chog /de nas rlung ro zhi ba lan gsum dang / drag po lan gsum 'bud/ rlung phyir 'gro ba na rtsa gsum nas hu sngon po phreng ma chad par 'don/ nang du 'ong ba na/ oṃ dkar po mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu phyi rol nas sna sgor zhugs lce'i rtsa ba'i thad tsam du sleb pa na/ bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su dkar mer re re zhu nas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang na mar na ra ra song / mas sna'i yig 'bru dang 'dres/ a wa dhu ti'i nang nas yar byung / 'og rlung 'then/ rlung kha sbyor drag por bzung ba'i skabs der/ bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa yar byung ba de/ dbu ma'i nang gi ba yig la thim pas/ ba yig kha thur bstan de nyid gyen du log par bsam/ mgrin pa dang sked pa rgyab tu cung zad skyed/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du blta/ steng rlung shin tu —201—

drag tu mnan/ rlud gzhal ba cig kyang bya/ yang mi bde na hūṃ gis phyir bsal ba sogs sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /tshul de thun re'i nang du rlung theng brgya rtsa re tsam sogs ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ thun chen re'i nang du thun chung bzhi sogs bcad nas bsgom na'ang legs/ de'i tshe thun chung re'i 'jug tu yan lag lnga spyong lta bu'i lus sbyong gang 'grub re bya zhing / thun chung mi gcod na thun chen po'i mthar lus sbyong gang mang bya'o/ /de dag ni dmigs chen gcig ste dmigs bskor chen po drug pa'o/ /des sgom thabs drug las rlung la bslab pa'i dmigs pa tshar ba yin/gsum pa yig 'bru/ la bslab pa la lnga ste/ nang gi bzlas pa la bslab/ gtum/ mo'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa dang / 'bring po dang / rgyas pa dang / shin tu rgyas pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong gi zhal gdams kyi ngo sprod rgyab skyor skabs las 'byung ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar po sor bzhi pa/ dbyibs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ chos 'gyung gi kha'i steng du 'dab ma gsum/ dbyi mong gi me tog kha zum pa 'dra ba bsgom/ g.yas zhal phag gdong gi smin phrag nas/ sor brgyad gzhal ba'i bar snang la dga' ba 'khyil ba/ zlum po'am/ g.yung drung gru bzhi'i dbyibs can gang ltar bsgom kyang 'dra ste/ gdugs lta bur g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mas sna chos 'byung gi 'dab ma la reg tsam/ ro ma'i yas sna spyi bo nas g.yas la 'khyogs te phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas par zug pa bsgom/ chos 'gyung gi nang du sngags gsum gyen 'greng du yod pa'am/ oṃ —202—

gsum ma'i sngags 'phreng g.yon skor du dgod pa dmigs pa gang gsal ba zhig pa sgom pas chog /dbu ma'i nang gi lte bar ba dmar po me 'od 'bar ba zhig sgom/ lus gnad gru mo bsrangs/ mnyam bzhag dam po bcas/ rlud kha spyor drag po bsgom pas/ chos 'byung gi 'dab ma kha bye/ sngags 'phreng las me 'od 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang du dmar nar gyis 'bar/ lte ba'i ba la phog pas de'i me lce dang yang 'dres/ lte ba nas g.yas ro ma phug ste ro ma'i lam nas brgyud/ phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dga' khyil la phog pas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor bar bsgom/ yang me lce de nyid rtsa zhal gyi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i lam nas brgyud/ gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung sngags bcas la phog pas/ g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems bzung 'di zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ rje btsun zhal gcig ma bsgom na/ shangs g.yas g.yon dkyus ma las 'gro 'ong bya'o/ /'di la bde ba shas chung na/ lte ba'i ba la shes pa gtod pa dang / gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung 'khor ba la sems gtod/ gsal snang shas chung na steng gi dga' 'khyil 'khor ba la gtod/ mi rtog pa shas chung na steng gi dga' 'khyil yang sna sgo nas zhugs te lte ba'i ba la thim par bsam ste shes pa khong glod la bzhag /rjes dmigs pa'i yan lag gong dang mtshungs pa las/ du ba'i dod du srin bu me khyer gyi snang ba dang 'dra bar bsgom/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo bsdus pa ni/ thun mong gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi dmar sol le ba zhig gi pad+ma'i lte bar ba dmar —203—

po sgom/ hro 'jam rma kha sbyor las/ 'on kyang ring du bzung ba gnad du che ba la sems drag tu bstad pas/ me rlud 'dres pa sngo dmar dar skud tsam zhig nar gyis gyen du 'bar/ sor gnyis kyi tshad tsam la gnas par bsgom/ thun 'jog tsa na 'bar ba de ba la bsdu'o/ /dmigs chung thun gcig go /de bzhin du sor bzhi 'bar/ thun chung gcig /brgyad tsam du 'bar/ thun chung gcig ste/ de rnams la'ang rtsol ba dang dmigs pa 'bring gis zhag bdun re tsam bsgom na legs so/ /dmigs chen dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa gtum mo 'bring po ni/ thun mong gdams pa'i ngo sprod nang nas 'byung ste/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dwangs shing phra la dmar ba khong stong gi nang du/ yar snar ha dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ lte bar ba dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen bstan/gsang gnas su chos 'byung sngags bcas sngar bzhin dang / dbu ma'i mas sna chos 'byung du chud tsam yod pa sgom/ rlung bum can zhi drag gang yang rung ba bsgom pas/ chos 'byung sngags bcas las me 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ba la phog /de las me lce dar dmar po'i skud pa tsam 'bar te/ ha la reg pas/ha zhu ste bdud rtsi dkar nar rar babs/ ba la thim pas thig le dkar dmar 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur/ chu rgyun phra mo ltar babs pa gsang ba'i chos 'byung sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ shes pa yang der drag tu bstad do/ /dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa gtum mo rgyas pa ni/ zhal gdams thor bu pa'i nang nas 'byung zhing / zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs che ba ye shes grub pa'i mchod brjod la —204—

brten pa'i nyams len te/ 'di la rtsa dbu ma rtsa 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa rags pa tsam gsal btang la/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar ba dmar po/ snying gar hu sngon po/ mgrin par oṃ ser po rnams mgo gyen bstan dang / spyi bor ha dkar po mgo bo thur bstan no/ /rlung kha sbyor drag po'i ngang nas 'og rlung shugs bskyed de drangs pas/ ba las me lce glog gi 'od lta bu gyen du 'bar/ hu dang o bsregs pas me'i rang bzhin du dmar sgam gyi rnga song / ha la reg pas zhu ste byang chub kyi sems 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rim pas gang bas/ o dang hū sos te kha dog sngon bzhin las shin tu 'od gsal bar gyur/ lte ba'i 'khor lo gang ba'i mthar/ ba la thim pas zag med kyi bde ba skye bar bsam/ de nyid yang yang bsgom ste dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /lnga pa gtum mo shin tu rgyas pa ni/ 'di yang zhal gdams thor bu pa'i nang nas 'byung ste/ ye shes grub pa'i mchod brjod kyi don nyams su len tshul lo/ /de yang chos 'byung dmar po'i rtsa ba lte 'og sor bzhi'am rgyu zhabs su zug /gdengs ka lte ba'i thad dang mnyam pa/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum spyi dang mthun pa gsal gdab/ 'khor lo bzhi po yang spyi dang mthun pa las/ thams cad kyang pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i rnam pa can lte ba dmar/ snying ga sngo/ mgrin pa ser/ spyi bo dkar ba'o/ /dbu ma'i nang lte bar ba dmar po/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ dmigs pa gsal na ba gyi mthar skor du dbyangs yig bcu drug dmar zhing phra bas g.yon skor du bskor ba bsgom/ snying ga'i dbus su hu sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la mdun du oṃ dkar po/ g.yas su tra —205—

ser po/ rgyab tu hriḥdamar po/ g.yon du ā ljang khu/ mgrin par dbus su mu yig nag po/ shar du la/ dkar po/ lhor rmā ser po/ nub tu pa dmar po/ byang du tā ljang khu/ spyi bor ha sngo skya mgo bo thur du bstan pa bsam/ bshang lam du ya sngon po/ sum mdor re dmar po gsal bto ste rlud ro bsal/ bum can kha spyor drag tu bzung / ya las rlung g.yos/ re mer 'bar ba chos 'gyung gi mas sna nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ lte ba'i 'khor lo bsregs shing / ba las kyang me 'bar ba dang lhan cig yar song / snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnams lcags bsregs pa bzhin dmar lam gyis bsregs/ dbu ma'i yas sna nas 'thon te/ g.yas su 'khyogs/ phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ sku lus gang / zag med kyi bde ba bdud rtsi byang sems kyi rnam par tshur drangs te/de rnams kyi shangs bug g.yas nas byung tshur 'dus/ phag zhal gyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i lha la thim/ ha las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs/ rtsa 'khor re re gang zhing / sngar mes bsregs pa'i tsha dpal zhi ste gsos shing dri ma med par byas nas/ mthar thams cad lte ba'i ba la thim pas/lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ 'di zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ g.yas zhal med pa dbu bcad ma lta bu la/ me lce dbu ma'i mas sna nas mdun du 'khyogs te/ shangs dngos kyi bu ga nas 'gro 'ong byed dgos so/ /dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /de ltar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams bsgom na/ rtags lnga dang yon to brgyad skye ba la shin tu myur —206—

ba yin no/ /de yan chad kyis sgom thabs drug las/ yi ge la bslab pa zhes bya ba gtum mo'i man ngag tshar ro/ /bzhi pa 'od lus la bslab pa la/ gnyid sad dus kyi gdams ngag dang /rmi lam gyi gdam pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/rang gi spyi bor bla ma sku dngos sam rdo rje 'chang / lte bar ba dmar po/ rang gi skyil krung gi 'og phyogs sam/ lha'i rnam pa bzhengs par bsgoms yod na de'i rkang pa'i bar du ya sngon po/ brla'i bar du ra dmar po/ rma 'jam hro bzung la/ ya gyis rlud g.yos/ ra gyis me spar ba rang gi lus la zhugs pas/ ba yig la reg /ba las me lce phyogs bcur 'bar bas/ rang lus tha mal gyi rnam pa bsregs pa'am/ lha'i sku'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa yin yang thogs bcas rnams bsregs par bsam/ lha sku 'ja' tsho ni ltar 'od du yal yal ba la sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes dran par byas nas ci nus su mnyam par 'jog cing yang yang bsgom/ dmigs pa'i yan lag sngar dang 'dra ba las/ me khyer kyi dod du mar me'i rtags sbyar ro/ /'di thun mong gi gdam pa las 'byung ba yin/ dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ni/ mchog gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/ gzhung las/ gang tshe rmi lam du ni bla med byang chub mchog /thob nas ring por mi thogs brtan pas mchog 'grub bo/ /ces rmi nyams tsam zhig bstan pas kyang / don gyis rmi lam gyi gdams ngag bstan par bzhed de/ de yang sngon 'gror/ rlung la bslab pa dang / 'od lus la bslab pa dngos la cung —207—

zad sbyangs/ dmigs pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po re dang / mgrin par oṃ ser po la sems cung zad gtod pa spel te lan mang du sgom/ mtshan mo nyal khar rlung la bslab pa dang / 'od lus la bslab pa'i dmigs pa nan tan du bsgom nas/ thun mtshams mi byed par nge/'i 'phros la/ tsog pu'am seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ gong gi nyams dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad dang / mgrin pa'i oṃ ser po la sems bag re bstad pa'i ngang nas/rlung rang babs su bzhag nas gnyid log /nangs par gnyis sad nas gtor ma la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar sgom pas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur zhing / 'on kyang lan gcig zin pas 'a chogazin pa brtan por ma song gi bar du 'bad de bsgom dgos/ dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o/ /de nas rmi lam lhar sbyang ba ni/ nyin par rlung sbyang ba sngon du 'gro bas 'od lus kyi rnal 'byor la bslab/ de'i skabs thams cad la do nub rmi lam du yang / lha sku snang stong 'di kho na bsgom par bya snyam du 'dun pa dung dung po yang yang sbyar/ nyal khar yang sngar bzhin las/ 'dun pa de nyid yang yang sbyong ba gnad du che/ de ltar goms pas thog mar rmi lam du lha sku gcig tsam rang shar du 'byung zhing / mthar snang ba thams cad lha skur bsgyur ba'i bar du 'byung ste/ gzhan gyi lugs kyi sprul sgyur sogs thams cad zhor la 'byung ba'o/ /dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /des sgom thabs bzhi pa 'od lus la bslab pa tshar/ lnga pa 'od gsal —208—

la bslab pa la/ 'od gsal dngos dang / 'od gsal gyi yan lag gnyis so /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi 'od lus su sbyong ba'i dmigs pa de tshar gcig song ba'i rjes la/ rang lus 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku de yang shin tu dwangs pa/ je dwangs rje dwangs su song / je srab je srab la nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur te spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du rtsen ne bzhag /'dzin pa med par ltod de shig se bzhag /bcas bcos med pa rang sor bzhag /bsal 'grib med par rjen ne bzhag go /yang sngar bzhin lha skur skad cig gis gsal btab ste stong par sbyang ba lan 'ga' yar song ba na/ yang thogs bcas kyi lus bsreg pa'i dmigs pa mgor sbyar ba'i 'od lus stong par sbyang ba rgyas pa de tshar re byas nas/ lha sku stong par sbyang ba bsdus pa de sngar ltar lan mang du sgom/ de ltar spel gyis sgom mo/ dmigs pa'i yan lag sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mar me'i rtags kyi dod du nam mkha' sprin med pa'i rtags sbyar ro/ /'di thun mong gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba yin/dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal gyi man ngag ni/ mchog gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba yin te/ de la bzhi/ gnyid 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ 'chi ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ de dang bar do bsre ba/ 'da' ka 'pho ba'i gdams pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni nyin mo'i 'od gsal la cung zad goms shing nyams ci rigs pa shar na/ nyal khar lte ba'i ba la sems bstad/ sngar gyi nyams myong de —209

ka la mnyam par bzhag ste gnyid log pas/ mi ring bar gnyid 'od gsal du chug par 'gyur ro/ /dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o/ /rmi lam dang 'od gsal sgom pa'i skabs thams cad du dbu bcad ma'i rtsa gsum gyi gdams pa bsgom pa shin tu gnad du che zhing gdams pa gzhan med kyang chog par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ da lta rgyun gyi nyams len la/ 'chi kha dang / 'chi sems dngos kyi tshe yang / sems bde gsal gyi rang ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba 'di ka skyong rgyu yin zhing / da lta rtags lnga'i nyams myong skyong ba bzhin du/ 'chi kha'i rtags thams cad la yang / rtags gang shar de kha'i steng du bzo bcos med par mnyam par 'jog rgyu yin/ da lta yang mnyam bzhug thun mtshams kyi sgom re byed bzhin du/ 'chi ba'i dus su yang 'di kho na ltar byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang gtong ba nyid yin/ phyis 'chi ba'i tshe las la sbyor tshul ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dang por na 'chi ba dran pa ni/ lus can thams cad kyi tha ma 'chi ba la thug pas/ 'chi ba la gdung ba byar med/ skabs 'dir chos kyi sleb par bya dgos snyam pa'o/ /gnyis par na/ 'chi ba la mi 'gyod pa bya ba/nyes ltung rnams bshags/ sha 'khon rnams sbyangs/ zhen chags rnams bcad par bya'o/ /gsum par na/ 'chi ba dngos grub tu len pa zhes bya ba yo byad thams cad sbyin par btang / bla ma yi dam la gsol ba drag tu btang/ bdag 'chi ba chosi kyi skur nyams su blangs pas chog pa re dga' na snyam bu pha khyim du 'jug pa ltar spro sing nge bya/ bzhi par na/ 'chi ba ngo shes par bya ba ni/ 'byung bzhi thim rim snang gsum 'od gsal rnams/ gang shar ba'i tshe de la ngo shes —210—

byas nas che re mnyam par 'jog pa yin no/ /lnga par na/ 'chi ba chos skur 'phyer ba'i gnad ni/ rang lus dang snang ba thams cad rmi lam ltar bden med du thag bcad/ nus na rlung kha sbyor du bzung / mi nus na rang babs su bzhag /sems 'od gsal spros bral de ka'i ngang bskyang bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor kho bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar ltar 'od gsal sgom pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bur khrong gis gsal ba dang / snang ba thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor du mos/ bdag bar do'i gnas skabs su yang 'di kho na bsgom par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa sbyangs shing / thun mtshams spyod lam kun tu 'di thams cad bar do yin par 'dug /da ma 'khrul ba byed dgos snyam pas 'od gsal dang / lha sku dang / sgyu ma lta bu de yang yang dran par bya/ dmigs skor bco brgyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rlud sbyangs pa ci rigs pa sngon du btang nas/ lte ba'i ba las 'od kyi gong bu re'am hū re chad nas/ bshang lam chu so/ lte ba/ kha/ sna bug rna ba/ mig /dpral ba'i sgo rnams bkag /gong ma'i yi ge na mi gsal yang / snying ga /dpung pa/ spyi gtsug gi sgo phyi nang gnyis las/ gtsug sgo phyi ma ste gsum po 'di rnams kyang bkag na legs/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma zangs dung lta bu'i nang nas/ pad+ma dmar po nyi shu rtsa brgyad brtsegs pa/ rang sems ba yig gam thig le dkar po'i rnam pa/ lte 'og sor bzhi/ pad+ma rnams kyi 'og na yod par dmigs/ rma kha sbyor cung zad bzung / rlung phyir 'gro dang —211—

mes po'i shul bldan las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bstun te hal gyi sgra lngas/ rlud sems rnams paṃ la bsdus pa de/ sgra re res pad+ma re re'i steng du/ yar yar spar bar bya'o/ /hig gi sgra lnga la'ang de bzhin du sbyar/yang na/ 'di la hal gyi sgras bkug nas hika gis 'dzin ces zer ba'ang 'dug /de bzhin du hika ces pa'i sgra lnga dang / hūṃ gi sgra lnga dang / ha ka gi sgra lnga dang / hu yig gi sgra lngas kyang / gong bzhin spar te/ sgra tha ma la ba yig spyi gtsug gi steng du 'bur re thon par bsam/ de rjes rlung nang du dal bus shugs bskyed de rngub pa dang / ba de mar la rim gyis babs nas nye 'og sngar shul du 'dug par bsam/ rkang mthil brdung ba'am 'bebs chung gcig gnyis byas na legs/ myur du 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags 'byung / 'chi ba'i tshe las la sbyar ba ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mar 'bebs pa mi dgos/ ba de spyi gtsug nas rgyang 'thon nas/ dga' ldan nam bde ba can la sogs par 'phos na sprul sku'i 'pho ba yin/ bla ma yi dam sogs kyi thugs kar 'phos na longs sku'i 'pho ba yin/ 'di la dmigs pa mi gsal na thang kha la sogs pa la dmigs pa gtod pa yin/ dbyings su 'phos te rig pa nam mkha' dang bsres nas/ spros bral du mnyam par bzhag na chos sku'i 'pho ba'o/ /sna bug nas 'pho bar yang bzhed de mi legs zhes kyang gsung la/ lus kyi sgo dgu bag zan gyis dgag pa dang / mgrin pa'i rtsa sdom pa dang / tshangs sbug gi skra btogs te lha la 'bul ba sogs kyang / man ngag gi rnam grangs tsam du mdzad do/ /dmigs skor bcu dgu pa'o/ /des sgom thabs drug las/ 'od gsal sgom pa'i man ngag tshar/ drug —212—

pa zung 'jug la bslab pa la/ dngos dang bogs 'don gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar/ lha sku snang stong 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa sgom pa'i rjes la/ stong pa'i ngang las/ chu las rlabs rdol ba ltar/ ba dmar po zhig wal gyis byung / de'i steng khyu gang tsam gyi nam mkha'i mthongs su ha dkar po zhig kyang lam gyis byung / ba gyi me 'od kyis gdung ba je che je cher 'bar bas/ ha zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dngul chu'i thigs pa ltar thigs pa'am/ ba thag ltar phra na ra ra babs ba la thim pas ba yig gzi brjid rgyas par gyur/ yig 'bru gnyis la shes pa che re gtad pas/ de gnyis je nye je nyer song ste/ ha dang ba khrug chil gyis 'dres/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ bde stong zung 'jug de nyid rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur khra gsal te song ba la mnyam par bzhag /snang ba thams cad la de kas rgyas btang/ dmigs pa'i yan lag logs pa mi dgos/ rgyas btab de kho na yin no/ /dmigs chen skor nyi shu pa ste/ rang lus thabs ldan gyi dmigs pa rnams rdzogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya'i man ngag ste/ mchog gi gdams pa'i nang nas 'byung ba thig le'i zhal gdams zhes bya ba de yin la/'di la yi ge logs su bkod yod cing / bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs dgos pa'i phyir 'dir ma bshad do/ /de yang sgom pa drug po 'di dag /gzhung las/dang po ri dwags sred byed snang ba ste/ /ces pa la sogs pa rtags lnga dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag gsal bar gsungs pa'i lag len man ngag tu bzhed cing /—213—

gang zag gcig gis drug car rim can du sgom pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sgom pa dang po lnga la/ thun mtshams kyi skabs su rtags lnga rim can du sbyar ba yin gyi/lam blo chod ltar bsgoms na/ drug po de dag las rang gang mos pa re re'am gnyis gnyis sogs nas bsgoms pas cho ga ste/ de'i tshe na re re la yang rim gyis rtags lnga 'char bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ dmigs pa'i yan lag thun mtshams lam 'byer la/ rtags lnga so so'i mos pa mi dgos/ sgyu ma lta bur mos nas rang babs su glod pa kho nas chog go /'on te drug po khrigs chags su sgom pa la yang / re re'i skabs su rtags lnga tshang bar 'char ba min nam snyam na/mthong snang gi rtags lnga 'char mod/ 'dir rtags can gyi ye shes brtan g.yo'i tshad kyi dper sbyar ba'i rtags lngar bzhed pas/ rim pa lnga la rtags lnga re re sbyar/ drug pa la 'bras bu dang sbyar ba mi 'gal lo/ /sgom thabs drug po ār+ya de ba'i spyod bsdus kyi rim pa drug gi man ngag dang 'byor te/ dbyibs lus dbye na/ rlud ngag dbye na/ yig 'khru sems dbye na/ zhes bya zhing / 'od lus bdag byin brlab pa yin la/ 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi don du ma zad ming yang gcig go /rgyun gyi gegs sel bogs 'don gnyis ni/ sgom pa drug po gang la brten yang 'dra ste/ sems cung zad ni gnas/ brtan pa ma thob pa'i skabs der/ byings rgod kyi gegs mang du 'gyung bas/ byings rgod bsal tshul thun mong ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gnad kyi gtso bo byings na byings pa nyid kyi rang ngo la bltas pas/ ngos bzung med pa gsal hring/ ge ba la mnyam par bzhag /—214—

byings pa mnyam bzhag mi rtog pa la ngo sprad cing bogs 'don/ 'phro rgod byung na/'phro rgod re re bzhin kho rang gi rang zhal la che re bltas shing bcos med du bzhag pas/ rig pa gsal sing nge ba/ snang ba bkra lam me ba/ 'dzin med ngos bzung dang bral ba de ka skyong dgos te/ rgod pa mnyam langs gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin du ngo sprod pa'o/ /gegs sel bogs 'don gyi rnam grangs cig la rlung stod du tshangs shing sems mi gnas na/ 'og rlud drag tu 'then/ bshang lam dmar zing nge ba la sems bstad/ bde ba shas chung na lte ba'i ba la sems gtod/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum bya/ yang rlud smad du 'dus pas mi bde na/ dmigs pa spyi bor bstad la/lte ba'i dbus nas rlung sbos ring gi dung pa lta bu byung / tshangs bug nas thon/steng du gdugs phub pa ltar 'dug par bsam/ rlung kha sna re mos nas drag tu 'bud/ stod du me bde na rlung stod du log pa yin pas/ rlung rnams spyi bo nas mar du ba drag tu 'phyur ba bzhin byung / lus kyi dbus brgyud/ bshang lam zangs dung gi phod ka 'dra ba nas mar thon/ 'og phyogs thag ring por 'khyil te/phub kyi dbyibs ltar sgor ro ro 'dug pa la sems gtad/ 'bebs che chung ci rigs pa ran par bya'o/ /gzhan yang me shas che bas skad 'gag /ro stod na/ khrag mkhris rgyas na/ lte ba'i ba las me 'bar/ spyi bo'i ga ha zhu/ lus thams cad khengs par bsam pas sel/ yang na 'bab chu rnyog med dwangs po mthong sar phyin/ sna bug nas 'od zer sog ma'i sbubs lta bu song ste/ chu dkar la bsil ba dwangs pa rnams drangs/ sna bug nas zhugs/ don snying rnams grang —215—

sil gyis byung bar bsam pas nges par sel/ yang chu khams rgyas pas lus 'dar zhing / sgyid lug na/ sum mdor chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du/ rdo rje sngon po me 'bar ba bsgom/ yang na spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa a wa dhu ti'i sgo bla ma'i gsang bas mnan/ sku las me 'bar bas lus kyi rkang mthis yan chad rim gyis khengs par bsam/ sa khams rgyas pas lus lci zhing byings na/ 'og rlung bsdams/ gsang gnas nas me rlung 'dres pa gyen du song / spyi bo'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje la phog pas/ g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsgom/yang na sna bug gi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bsams la/ rlud 'phog pas drag tu 'khor ba la sems bstad pas sel/ rlud khams rgyas pas shes pa 'o phyo/ snying mi dga' ba sogs byung na/ glo g.yon pa 'og tu bcug nas nyal/ sum mdo zhi ra las me sbar/ spyi bo'i ha las bdud rtsi zhun mar ram til mar lta bu babs/lus khengs par bsam pas sel/ thur sel gyi rgyun sdom pa'am/ dus min du 'chor na/ lte 'og tu bla ma me 'bar ba bsgom/ bla ma'i zhabs kyis gang na sa'i 'og sgo mnan par bsam/ steng rlung glod do/ /gzhan yang gang na sar bu ga brtod la/ sgo de nas nad rnams thon 'gro bar bsam/ rlung drag tu 'bud pa'am ha 'don/ gzhan yang snying las sprid pa 'byung / glo ba las glo/ mchin pa las g.yal/ mkhal ma las skyigs bu mcher ba las sgregs pa 'byung bas/ de dang de'i nad la don snod de dag la dmigs nas rlu8 kha sbyor du bzung zhing / skabs skabs su sprug 'khor byas la/ ha 'don pa dang sgregs pa bton pas sel/ gegs sel thams cad la yul sna tshogs kyi —216—

bdud rtsi bsten pas kyang sel lo/ /phag mo dpyal lugs kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di yi ge rnying pa rnams su/ thun mong gi gdams pa/ khyad par gyi gdams pa thun mong dang khyad par gyi ngo sprod rgyab skyor/ mchog gi gdams pa thor bu'i zhal gdams sogs sna tshogs kyi nang na/ dkrugs pa dang / 'thor ba dang /gab pa'i tshul gyi yod pa rnams gab 'khrugs med pa bklags chog gi tshul du bsgrigs pa'i khrid yig dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di yang / chos tshul 'di mi nub par bya ba'i phyir du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //go don rgyas par yig rnying du yang blta bar bya zhing / blo gros dang ldan pas rgyud sde la sbyangs na 'bad med du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ khungs che ba dang /byin rlabs che ba dang / rgyud don dang 'brel ba dang / lam rgyas pa dang / lam cha tshang ba ste khyad par lnga'i sgo nas/ yum bka' rdo rje phag mo'i khrid tshul gzhir bzhag pa la/ khrid tshul gzhan kun las lugs 'di mchog tu gyur par nges so// //zhus dag/ bkra shis//—217—

dan dam pa nas she ba rnal 'byar ma' rgyud kya rgyal pa bzhugs/yo gi ni/ stu rā yi/spya gar skad du(phro zu dza pa ra phri sarba stso da 'i sol / tārā ya she dza/bad skad du/ she la~Xthams rngod ga tshe ba 'a sgral she/mo'adu / sa pa dazha ༷nem rda zhes/ bya bgyi rnal 'byar ma3de / kya rgyul pa/sgral malani 'tshal lo/da/da nas〈4 phan sto ma~X bstan pa/〉dngas grub as go //ra btu sgrub byad spyod par khya//bud da 〈sa kyi dngos grub/༵bye rji rdog ༵/rde yang //mi yi/ sbyi she/ḍi 'a byed//lha dang lha na shing na snyeng //sheg bdabang du da//nya rnyi zlab dang mtshungs/ mi//ngang mirdemin gang gib rnam par 'dud//klu rnams gas par byed pa dang //dngan gang sa cig gi i gyi rgyu bde ba sni〉mi/yi/bu mo khri phrag dang rnyi/byed pa//skyes ༵ gcag sa 'dod chen gyas/'a/ bu mo phrag dang//'i reralha dang lha spya mo/gi/bud med 'bum sngi zaX gnon ༷/khu ba pher / pa byed pa las//krig sa thams cad 'dad spyad pa//rda ge pa skye ༵/kyi pa rteb turnga'i gad//'jags pa kun las thar pa dang//bskal 4sto/ mi sa 2 yangaril/she/kha' ris 'a dzi sbya pa'i dngos grub gzha 'a pa/〉lte gyi she// lu la sags ra ga 'an dang //bcuX kyis len dang gnad ma//rab tu

sgrub byed sngags chen po/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po bye ba mthu chen dang / /grong khyer gsum 'joms tshangs sogs lha/ /mang gagazhug nyid du byed par 'gyur/ 'das 〈rgyud kyi byung tshul/〉 pa'i dus na rdo rje ho/ /sangasargyas dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor sprul/ /bde mchog bde mchog dgos rdorje/ /yid bde thig le la sogs bstan/ /'bum phrag brgya pa sgril ma yi/ /sngags kyi rgyal po sngon bshad pa/ /rdzogs ldan dus su mi rnams spyod/ /de nasa'abum phrag drug pa bshad/ /de yang nub nas khri nyis stong / /phyi ma'i dusasuspund pa yin/ /de yi snying po rtsod dus 'dir/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pas rnam spyod pas/ /nges brjod 'bum gyi rjes 'brang pa/ /slar yang rgyud 'di snang b.ra'agyur/ /nges par 〈gsungs pa'i dgos pa/〉'dod chags chags chen 'dig /'dod ldan 〈longs sprul/〉rnams la byang chub ster/ /sangs rgyas phrin las thamasacad 'byung / /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya'i sngags/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'dus pa/las/ /dam pa'i don yang 'grub pa'o/ /de nas bde chen/ bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol mas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ tā re tu stu reture snya hā/ 'di ni/ 〈i sku/〉de ngos grub thams cad byed pa'o/ /oX ku ru k+ṣi hiXswāhā/ ku ru ku lce'o/ /oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re hūX phaṭa/ snying po'o/ oX tware swāsmagasung bskul bar byed pa'o/ /i.āXtāX huX/ thugs bskul bar byed po go /na morat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ mahwa sa tā ya/mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tsha5 thā/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re sarba dugaX pra duXrnge mam kri te/nga ya/ staX bha ya/ mo hā ya/ ban+ta ya huX hūX huX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba du niX rtaX/bha ni —219—

tā re rma khri/'a~X ni las thams ca~X pyi dho~X//laXpa niXrta phoX/mo lnga'i 'o//rma ar re : pho //sa pa ga /rdo ru pa ༵tsho badz+rardeso//hi a be shwa ya phe phe phe rdo swāhā/zhes pa sngags a ma yi ngo / mi/rdebadz+rabā ra a be shā ya sarba ༵ je hri ༷༷swāhā/rdo rje phab mo go go ༵ //rderderde ṭā rmiXswāsga'od zer ca~X nyu 4 'o/ huXphaṭa/༵sbu zho sru sma ba~Xbyed paX// byed pa sgo byed pa'o// spyi ṭa ho dbang snre ṭā pa ni/phaṭa ge ni de she da pa'/she/sruhwa laXlaXlaXbyeXdzaXṭa ༵ṭa/ pa las/brgyad byad pa'//rdoXlngiXbaX haXdagug par shed droX//oṃ ga krodhika ya lhaXsnoXhū ཾ sna/rje lte ge mu she//rma 'cho phaṭa/spra ba 'a~X/ba snga chubaskyoka/ na da kya'// na ༷ ca da 'i'o tsa ༵ kā na hūṃ spyo rmaXsko dra ta ya tshu/rdegha ghaX lha ta ya ghā yaX huX phaṭa/'amathu~X/༵tsho//pad+ma na ta 3 she she kho badz+ra grordeb hu hu lu shrī dhi lto sna lja/rta zi lha 'a//na maXs ༷snya ༅khyo na ༵lo rtakra~X ya/mahā h+pha rtsi rdo / ṇa pa ra bā ༵/hūṃ/ hwa ha ya de sbi ka snyi ya/lī gro ta //1 hū ཾ ༷ phaṭa/bdud la ba'i 'o// hūX ya de ka ka mahwa/ka'u hwaXspyo/oṃ mahā ka lī de bī ka ra lī bi kran+ta kā la rā khyi tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi khyi hāXphaṭa/lha moge lha)di ke tsho skyes pa ki:sku gi bi ༷'anag ma sa she sa// bi le lti naX sarba ge snan+dhan+dha hu phaṭa/phur busagadab pa' 'a//'chi she/'i/denas〈lam gyi sngon 'cha/rkab/las khi nge skya'i rmi she ni tri sder ldan 'das ma lha chub spre kyi / dngazhes pa'i 'di phyung ngo/na maXs man+ta kā ya wā badz+ra ṇi/ ṭa nyudzaXs pa sngags 'a phyung nga //gdug ༷ thams cad bkug nas kyang//nam

mkha'i dbyings su bskyel nas ni/ /rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros nag /gnas lnga dag tu phur bus btab/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khro bo che/ /rdo rje phur bu bskulabar mdzod/ /stong gsum dag gi khor yug la/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bcings par mdzad/ / oṃ la 'a ya la/ grong 〈dgra la phur gdab〉mkhar salagazugs byas nas/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan byas la/ /mi rus las skyes phur bu yis/ /btab na de yi mod la 'chi/ /sbul 〈gnod byed gzhal ltos〉dang seṅgeglang po dang / rkun po'i yan lag dag la gdab/ /'di yis gdugacing sdangasems ldan/ /log 'dren dag la gdab par bya/ /ye shes pad+ma kha phye nas/ /rdorje phur bu'i rab sbyor bas/ /rang rang rigs kyi khro bor bcas/ /rdorje sem༅sogs sngags la gdab/ /'di yis rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ rdo rje rda dpa' la phur gdab〉phur bus btab pa na/ phung po rab tu 'jig pa dang/rdorje'i gnas kyang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig go /zla 'bras bu tshwa5lde1rachen po ba nyi ma'i rlung gi dbus/ /rang sngags sa bon bsgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid dmigs gyur na/ /bcu drug pa la de 'grub 'gyur/ /sems ni nam mkhar gyur pa la/ /zla ba nyi ma nub pa dang / /mun pa'i ye shes thim pa na/ rdorje'i lha ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /lus kyi dri marasasbyangs nas/ /ye shes chen po rang sngags lha/ /zla ba nya la 'grub para'agyur/ /rang sngags sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje gur sogs brtag parabya/ /'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba dang / /lus med rnams kyis kyangami221

mthong //spu las nad rnams spre'u 'am/khyi dang 'dra bar rab tu stung//yeshes sems dpa'i dam rdzo 'dis//rdo rje mar+sā chas bsnun par bya/tamamakha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni//ye shes me dpung dkar po ba4//sems/can khams ni ma lus pa//gnas las me ni 'bar bar bsgrub//mtsharma na/rdemed lnga dag byed pa yang //gtsang ma'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur//sdig pa rdorje'i ye shes 'dis//skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur//lte ba'i 〈rdzogasi sbyore/ :sku rdes 'byor r+sā po/〉dbus su re kha bsam///a mchog tu phra ba ste//'gyurardenyams dga' bde ba'i gnas//mi shigs tshangs pa 'bru/ba par 'gyur//ramasaX dang yi ge oṃ//rdo rje āXyig bas8sde par bya//rlung go de nyid rab grubardenas// 'gro drag po'i ngag tu lngar//'od zer rnam lnga rtsi ltos ga/pad+mas rdo rje rab dbye ba//go le rdo rje byed pa ste//ye shes ab/rgyawapor tsor/〈rgyas shad ni/〉 de nas rdo rje snying po la sogs pa sa wor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ma 'di tsi zhig/lags/lteb las ni hro khamasaḥng //tsi phyir kyi lus chos su 'gyur//bdud lasarde'adas pa'i nga ci 'ding chas/mu/ji ltar tshar sa pa mi pa la stos lngar/mu/pad+masardorje 'byed byed //'a dag ca phyar 'gal 'khyu/ra//dam tshig/de yi mkhyen/ pas gsungs//'a cig rdo rje ji bzhin to//lus ni gzhan dag go tshayin//sems kyi rang bzhin rnam g.yo ba//spyo pos rtsa bang ba pa~X/ba'i lus po byung //lte ba sku zhes bsha/da pa de//de dag de las byung ba //bram tshe mola'adod spyod pa//rdo rje sku ru khyur ba'o//hro gis smra bar byed pa'i phyir//rdo

rje'i ngag ste de nyid brjod//dbyangs mkhan bu mo'i dam tshig gis/rdorje ༈sku yirigasung du 'gyur ba na//'khrul bas gnyas gsu rtog pa'i semag/thig/le 'di las byung ba'i phyir//mig mdzes g.yung mo'i dam tshig gis//rdo rje thugasasu'agyur ba'o//nga ni 'gro bas mi shes te//tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyugache//'phrul ldan lha zhes 'jig rten rtog/sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje ste//thams cad nga yi rnam par 'phrul//sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur//gsung gordorje dbang phyug che//'jug sel thugs kyi rdo rje'o//'di na yang dag rdzogasasangs rgyas//sems can khams la dbyer med de//de dag rnams/kyi lus banayid//mnyam 'gyur tshangs la sogs par snang //lus ni sprul pa'i 'khor loraganas//mgrin par de bzhin rmi lam mo//gnyid kyi rnal 'byor snying garadagod//bde ba spyi bor mngon par brjod//gzhan yang rtsa lcug smo pa dang //ri bong stag sogs chu bo dang //wo ma.ā+oṃ la sogs dngos ca tu//sangs rgyas gar glus ge ge ye cha//na gri yis gnyid dag spong ba༅pa//tshangs pa'i dam tshig gta mug spong //gzhan —sa gnyad dag spong b.radaka'//bud kho bral la sdom brtson med//'dod ldan tshangs spyod wo po ni//zhi ba'i dam tshig 'dod chags spong //zhe sdang rdo rjer rnam shen//rmongs sel khyab 'ju / ka dam tshig go/gzhan du byams pas spang b.radaka'//rnam pa 'di gsum gsang chen po//lha yi bde ba ser snarabacas//brtson 'grus phrag dog dam tshig ste//g.yo sgyus bsad rnams 'dulabyed pa//dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'//pad+ma'i snying po bde bas//dzi

srid ma rnyed 'bras bu med/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug rtsa 'di yis/ /khro rje gnyis spangs 'byed par byed/ /shes rab rtogs par byed pa thab ga khresarab med la thabs mkhas med/ /rdo rjes pad+ma rgyas byed kyi/ /pad+mas rdo rje 'byed par byed/ /sprul pa bde chen 'khor los kyang / /chos dang longs spyod rnam para'abyed/ /de ltas 'di ni gsang chen te/ /rgyud gzhan du ni 'bad pas sbag /del 'di ni sku gsum rdo rje'i gsang ba'o/ /sems med gnas dang 'khrul bskyed dang / /sngon nas rnam par 'khrul ba yi/ /'jig rten 'di la sku gsus gnas/chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa'o/ /rang byung ngo bo brjod med pa/ /chosakun rang bzhin zhi ba brnyes/ /rkyen ni rnam par bkra ba mkhyen/ /rdorje can gyisachos sku'o/ /me long gzugs brnyan ltar sems 'di/ /phra zhing lus ni rdu5med pa/ /skad kyang sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag pa'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'o/ /sems/can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /sprul pa tha dad sna tshogs 'ju ga /'o khros spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa ste/ /gcig gyur 'dren pa bde ba che/ /rtsa yi dra ba lha moste/ /de bzhin khams dang nyer bcas pa/ /bud med rnal 'byor me'i dkyila'akhor/ /spangs nas ri mo su zhig len/ /de la 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go /dri mas sems ni mngon bsgom pas/ /rnam shes ye shes dgami 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog gis bgrod pa'i gnas/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan para'atshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dngos po bden brdzun rnam dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong / /rang bzhin dag pa'i de khon/ /a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /huX zhes bya ba ni ye shes dang ldan —224—

pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o//phaṭa ces bya ba ni dgas par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o//tra ces bya ba ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o//u zhes bya ba ni smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o//ha zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i gzung༅kyi sgo'o/rde/hi zhes bya ba ni rjes su chags pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o//o zhes bya ba ni lus 'jig par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/kha zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo'o//a zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i gzungs kyi po/kla zhesabya ba ni rab tu miganas pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/rde/a zhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o//ya zhes bya ba ni rdo rje rlung ste gzungs kyi sgo'o//ra zhesabya ba ni rdo rje'i me ste gzungs kyi sgo'o//wa zhes bya ba ni rdo rje chu ste gzung༅kyi sgo'o//la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o//ta zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sems te gzungs kyi sgo'o//i zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i dbang po rnams te gzungasakyi sgo'o/rde/ba zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams su byed pa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o//u zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/rnam shes ye shesarnal 'gyor te//de dag rdo rje rab spyor bas//rnal 'byor la ni sto/worabasgom//rjes kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o//de la 'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go /spre'u dang glog ltar mi gnas pa//rab tu bzung bar dka' ba'i sems//'dod pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa//ye shes dbang mo nyan para'atshal//nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon//gser khams rdo la rnam gnasapa//mngon par zhi ba yod ma yin//sreg dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis ni//nyi mabazhin du rnam par gsal//lcags bzhin me la rnam bzod na//gzhan dgaci

phyir mi bzod byed//de phyir ye shes rnam shes dag/cha gnyis rnam par rtog mi 0ri sbyo/lha sde/ rdo sde/ de tshobya//ri sdug bsngal sdi da she //ga bla med bde ba baXzad para'agyur she/de/sdug bsngal ga pa zhes brjod de/phy-i/ med bsdi ba ༵cwa namasas//ba dang sdug gyis ni sematha gyur pa//bsad ge dang sdi tha da rnam parathar//sdug bsngal gyas sems lhas / ༵ris / //dge da~X ga pa 'darayed//ri bo nyams ni darnga ka'ang ba sa//rnam par be rtog /she sa mi// ba nyams pre ci/༷ ba dang //nags tshaX/ dan pa' sa phyagasadzhai//ga bzang brtan pa bla ldan bzung zhi//dang par 'a/ pa byas nasashe//rdorje cho bkad ma ni mi / /zi mi ge zi dge sgo mu ge snye mu//de ba she pa' btsun i mas/sno pha 'u ge lte ge ge byan gyas brlab / sa/grwa mo'i mtshan rdzi shā/byab bung dang //de i yi shan tu brkyang ngaX ta/nga /khab dang gru ma mtshan she /bungs bur ya gh+ri//nges pas ye she/ bla dang she nga zhe ge rje ge mu//sgeg 'gro cha 9 /ltasprage mu stid nas spya/rje/mag ba skra bzung lkag ma rdorje/she/ ༵she rdzartsacing ༷ra bya//kyi 'byud pas 'khyud she pa dang//rda 'a cing sri tsārdzung //da pho mas bsnun 'tshi ////rnyi rje mu rab las she/ nga //da kya sgra rnams byad pa dung /she/nu ma 'a dang sa pa' ba mi//sbyar ba thadang spyiXs ha te bya bar bya/she/bya rnab mja'akhung snyedang rtags/༵/na mos btab brtog rardeyang //'a bya rna ba sna'i~X/ khung dang rtags//thi mas btab bya nyed/ma6nardekring dang //pa'i 'gram dang she she ༵la dag tu//ma paXbya zhang 'khyud pa stabs brgyad bya//༷ra ma nga ga lce dang lces bas

nas/ /pad+ma bskul zhing rtsa mchog sad par bya/ /zab tshes pa dang shin tu chung ba dang / lhod pa dang / rtsub pa dang / rtag tu 'dzag pa dang /drod dang gsherabadapral ba'i bha ga ni spang ngo / /dpangs mtho ba dang / 'jam pa dang / stong mnyam pa dang / kha rgyas shing dam pa dang / khrag dang khu bar ldan pa dang/ sbunyungabadang / dus ma yin par mi 'dzag pa dang / ring zhing snying po zlum pa ni skal pa bzang mo'o/ /de yongs su bskul bas ji srid du khong nas gi ta kyi sgra 'byubasadesrid du'o/ /rnyaXzhes bya bas mchog tu dga' ba'i tshe bcings par byed /yang na hūX zhes bya ba snying ga la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /yang na hri ha zhes bya ba mgrin pa la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /huX dang phaṭa kyi bya ba dang / mda' bo tshe'i sbyor ba byas la khu ba bcing bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang cha bzhi pa'i phyed kyi mtshams su lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya ste gal te bha ga'i ze 'bru la gnas pa'i thig le yang rdo rje'i khas btung bar bya'o/ /bskor ba la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / /rlungagosbyor bas mnyam par bya'o/ /'di la dgang ba dang / gzhil bdang/ rengs pa dang / /bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ mi mo rnams kyi sbyor ba la'ajug ste/ lus 'di nyid kyis dngos grub thob pa zhes bya'o/ /de las dga' babazhi'i dbye bas sgrub pa po la rengs pa dang / rngus ba dang / ba sbu ldang ba dang/dbugs 'gyur ba dang / 'dar ba dang / kha dog log pa dang / mo 〉 ma 'byung ba dang / thim pa zhes bya ba snying stobs brgyad 'byung tho/ /bu mos ye shes thos pa ni/ snying ni 'gul zhing bskyod pa dang / /'dar dang dran pa nyams pa dang/ /skugrol gcer bu gsher bas khyab/ /mdog dmar rab tu phra ba'i mig /ye shes lnga —227—

yi rnam par 'phrul/ /bud med shes rab ye shes te/ /de las ye shes lnga thob khyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes spyor ldan pa/ /sku yi rdo rje bsnyen par brdzo/ /rtsanimanyam par gyur pa dang / /sri ta kyi sgra dang skad 'gyur ba/ /gsung ni nye b.rabasgrub pa'o/ /bskyod pa las ni rab zhu ba/ /nor bu bcu drug mab bsate/ /yid kyi bde bas gnyis 'gags pa/ /thugs kyi de nyid bsgrub parabarjod/ /gzhu yi gzugs can rab sbyor bas/ /dung dang kun+da ltar thigale/ /sdom brtson bde bas bzung bar bya/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shesamachog /bsgrub pa chen po'i de nyid de/ /rnam shes ye shes dag par byed/ /ledoyis rdo rje bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'agrub par 'gyur/ /ye shes wo por rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byoramakhas pas bstod/ /bud med sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /sgrib pa dag tu yongasami'agyur/ /de skad ces gsungs so/ / de la 'di ni rnal 'byor dang po'i dam tshig go /ut+pal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /phyag gnyis rnal 'byor bsgoms byas la/ /nam mkha' dbyingasakyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /dbus su kun nasazlum po ste/ /las kyi snam bu lnga dang ldan/ /ut+pal dmar po sil marabakram/ /zla ba nyi ma'i sbyor ba las/ /dam tshig sgrol ma bas5par bya/ /ljangasngon 'od zer dmar po 'khyil/ /mche ba gtsigs pa me stag 'bar/ /mjogasbyin gri gug ḍā ma sa /mda' dang ut+pal sdong bu dang / /thod pa khrag can rtse—228—

gsum dang / /bzhi pa tshe tog gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod rgyan dang ut+pawargyan/ /g.yas brkyang rol pa'i skyil krung can/ /rang rang sngags las lha mo'i tshogs/ /snying ga'i dbus nas spro bar bya/ /oṃ tā re swāhā/ mig le'o oṃ tu stu reswāhā/ rna ba la'o/ /oṃ tu swāhā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ re swahā snying ga'akho /o tā re ṇi swāhā/ spyi bo la'o/ /sngags kyi bdag pos byin rlabs dang / ye shes dam tshigamanyam par bya/ /dbang gyi don ni bsgoms byas la/ /rang lhar sems ni brtan bya'o/ /rnal 'byor wo po'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /de nas sgrol mas bka' stsal/ pa/ oṃ laX maX paX taX huX badz+ra a bhi khiñca rdo snaX oX bruX aX dzi khaX hūX/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ski nyu hūX/ oX huX khaX huX badz+ra a bhi khri nyu huX/ oṃ huX taX huX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi khi ྅ ni huX/ oṃ dzaXhūX baX hoXbadz+ra satwa/ stuX badz+ra na ma a bhikhris huX/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje dkyil ga bor bri bar bya/ rkababargyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /phyi rol rab merir bcas/ /dur khrod dag kyang bri bar bya/ /dbus su ut+pal mthingakhadagod/ /shar du zhi ba'i ut+pal dang / /byang du bum pa bri bar bya/ nub tulcags kyu 'bar ba ste/ /ral gri lho ru dgod par bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbangadang ni/ /gsod byed rnams kyi mtshan ma'o/ /grwa bzhir rigs kyi lha moste/ /ut+pal mdzes pa re re bri/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo ru dgod/ /skyobs chen pha rol gnon pa yi/ khro bo rnams kyang grwar dgod do/ /las rnams byed pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /phyi rol dag tu bri bar bya/ /dbus su bdag nyid gnas byasanas/ /rdo rje mtshan ma'i tshogs spros pas/ /sems can khams rnams sbyangs—229—

par bya//mchod pa'i sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams//mchog tu gang ba spro b.rabya//rim yi ga bur ma nyams pa//bha ga mchog las yang dag blangs/rnalarde'abyor ma khor los ༵rdzo//yang gsungs pa/ā+oṃ dgu mor rang gigabyas nas//rgyas pa lnga mchod rten las//srog shang rtse mor rang sasems//mda' gzhu'i sbyor bas 'pho bar bya/mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang //'di yis grol 'gyur the tshom med//rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad bya ste//mi lpags ras rnying bgo ba'am//gcer bu'i brtul zhugs byas nasani//dogs pa'i sems ni kun spangs nas//ji lta bur na snang ba leg/'dod saspyod bde ba la bsdus nas//kau /sa ngan spyod thams cad kyag/blar byangachub bsgrub par bya//de la 'a rdo rje dam tshig go/gang las slob dpon dbang bskur ba//slob dpon gcig tu gyur pa yi//sring mo sgrol ma dang mnyasabartag/rdorje slob dpon de bzhi du//rig ma'am bdag gi rig mayang //slob dpon mchog tu yonga~Xsu brjod//bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnya5pas//de yi grib ma'ang 'gom bya//'on kyang dga' ma dges dbangamo'i//ga rtse ge mu sgo dgu las byung ba//cig ma snod gcig za bdang//gtsangasbra sems kyis tsum pa dbul//lhan ga mal stan longs spyad nag/'kha/gis rdo rje bzung gsor te//yo nir sor bya dam ཿda nas//tshin dang yi gosadages bskul bas//so dang sen ris 'drud pa dang //'jib dang sgo di la nyesa'adra / la ba//gus dang phyag bcas bag brkyang bas//'gongs pa 'a la nyesardemed de//slob dpon dges las dngoXgrub kun//bzang mo de yis rtagatu

thob//yu dza gus pas gzhib pa yo ni //phyag bya gal sprodang dza rgo༈spyar//'dab ge sher ru snro/ bar bya/de/ya de nyir+sha tsa sdo zhes mi dod dod dod dge ge gu dang // thasa'akhru/la ༷//ra nyas da tsho/ga/sa pa rnamyo nyang/ mnyas/ ye pa'/nga/ zhi' nas las sna re re pa rnams brtse 4 1 1 / sdig dodage pa phyags bzha'u sto dang grwa bzhar utrul 'a gzu 1 gas bya// yang tāX gsum gyas mtshan pa/ ba kun nas zlusardepo la/oṃ pra phro tā re a mṛ ta mu khri a mṛ ta lo tsa ni/sa༅a the ga dha ni/sarbardesbyonge/sne/ ke rna ra 7 re ni / sa/pa de ste she bā shaX ka she/tsho sa ru ṣa bā rā dzā na bā ba h+maX lha ru tāX snyu3sgyig khyi~X/jebakad ༵/zhabar la rtsabs bcu par pad+ma dil yag rna sa pa zha/༷ yinang brgyad pa ste dbus zla dbang ༷du sa ye//bying kyi rdzo/ ba yo pa/sa goyang brgya/ sna dbus su zla ba la tag lkag ga/'a la kha sbyar sdo ge ( na nya mashe na 'a dbang du 'a ra//she spya rtsabs drug pa ya ༷drugargya skye//dbus su hraXsgi spyaX ku ru hraXye pa bri/ga ra rdo na srid tsa༅ dmar pa dang/rgya dge ge she dang /khrag ye pa ṭaX5she snrur gā/ da pa 'angadu byad da/she/sto ma la sags rir la //mon ni rta re ma~XbasaXrtsan+d+rabacas/ka lha hisarba dun ༷dbang du byadaX/༷/saXrba ma hā na tā tu stu gos kri /duṣ+ṭha ma dzhai ya bha ga wā sarba tri na ban+ta ༵ hu hu lngi phaṭa snya she swāhā/gas ra rdzo mdud byas na//oṃ rgyun 'de bar byad pa' mchag/ut+pal lamaXn bsngags pas//gang rdzo she pa sa dbang (da//ming las ma zurnga na 1 0 0 4 1 re rta go salardelo'i tsho/she/chud bus sna spun rengs 9 //thod les nga mtha~X la/kham par dbus su bzhag na ngas//'dab brgyad pad+ma ra ga ga nang/khrid rde

sngig lte bar ga brgyad bris//rnong bas rdo leb dag la t+yā/kha phub bzhan/ shan tu rengs//snyen ra lo de dug ༵nga 'di/yi tshe wo btasti/pa chus//thod par hūX phaṭa mu rnyir ///sau sa nges gur gsod sherabyed//gro gar gur pa chud par bri la// bsang bzang paraXsa'//yanga~Xzwa yi chud par //rgyasa~Xshe ba byed paXkha/dri/rtsabs gis a ga nang sdod pa/zhi/ge mu chus kha sla phror bcas/li/na hwa khri shā/rdegis sa zur ba bye skun/khan tu ba 'alas la ma///rde/bha ga rgoXgs//bskor ba nga dang bsdil bzhir bcas//'a ba smor glu' dhī /'a kug༅rdel bris na//res 'dab ma nya shu she/she/re kha ge sde ge sde zhes mi dod dod da bskor /she/rgyal/la zhi sgo bzhi ga byas dzhai//shes da ma ltar las she//ge shesaXsnabagrub sga ba ༵//sna sa rda rje she bus brgyan//tha ba shed dang //ral sgo dang ut+pa la//thad bcas lcags kyu mtshams su'//de dbus 'dab ma ཿ pa bri//oṃ pra san tā re a rdzita mu khi a mṛ ta lo tsanesam:| sno rig ra tsho skye khrirngasarba mo ha ni tu ren/dbang du byed pa sngags sa/bye/ nas bka' stsal/pa//saXrba mo ha tā / tu stu re sarba du giXn yi spra ha ya bha ga ba rge' dun naX ban+ta ban+ta huX hu phaṭa swāhā/ni hi gnyi zla ba twa yag ba~Xs/mi/dbus rtsabs drug la kurukul+le//sngags na ༷༷gnyas dbus chudage rdzo dro//mtsho bang nabs lo las/zhir sded//bo mo'i sro bzlas pas sa 3ya zhang //ci rta ma bdun 3kho dugashema'i//gya ma sbyaraXsna 'byung ba kun//pa mthe zhi/sa sa mib mkha' 'gram//sbyor ba 'phrog nga char 'bebs dang //ma mas gnod lusasu

'gyur/ /dpyid zla ra bar bu mo mdzes/ /rdul ldan gyi ni ras btags la/ /zla mtshan gyis bsgos de la ni/ /ri mor dam tshig ldan pas bri/ /sgrol ma'od zer can ma dang / /phag mo'i gzugs la mngon mchod na/ /gang gang 'dod pa'i las thams cad/ /thogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'igazungs kyi mthu gsungs pa/ gos mtha' 'am skra la mngon bsngags bcings/ /'brog dgon dag tu 'jigs med 'gyur/ /ut+pal sbyin sreg brgya rtsayis/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ /oX tā re tu stu re tu re a mu kaX tsheb sha ma na ye swāhā/ bya rog gshog par bsngags nas ni/ /dgra bo'i khyam du spos na skrod/ /oXtā re tut+ta re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shī gh+raX ga mi ni de ba da t+taX uta tsa ṭa ya huXphaṭa/ so so 'cha' dang yungs kar dang / /thang phrom a shwa ka'i tshe tog /'dab bcas spyin sreg byed pa'am/ /yang na mngar gsum bsregs byas na/ /nyin bdun bu mo mchog thob 'gyur/ /oX tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu ka nyi dha nī/ /kumā rī/ ma phya mud+ma te na ta phywaXsi ta pra stso ya n+tu swāhā/ zla mtshan ras la sgrol ma ni/ /ut+pal zhags pa bsnams pa bri/ /mchod cing lnga stong bzlas nas ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bas spyad/ /oX tā ri tu stu re tu ye a mu gī ma ma ba si taX/ ga sna ka rje ka thā ya hūX phaṭa/ reg phrug tsher ma zla mtshan bcas/ /sreg blugs stong phragagacig gis ni/ /mi bdag bu mo mchog kyang 'gugs/ /lkoX tā re tu stu re tu re a mu ka bi dha naX swas+thā nā dā kar+ṣa ya ma murnyi ke dzaX zla ba gzas bzung 'jig rten dbang / /dung dang btags te 'dod mar spyin/ /yang na sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i sha /arka'i bal la dril byas la/ /ba dmar mar khus mig sman bya/ rdorje chos—233—

dang nyi ma dang / /rta rgyal mchog gi spos bdug nas/ /bltas pas pad+ma garadabang 'bab/ /ha la ha la'i mjug ma dang / /'jam 'bras rtsangs pa'i mjug ma dang / /'gron bu ror bcas khu ba 'dzin/ /sdig pa'am sbal pa'i zhag gisasam/ /'o ma rnam gsum sbyar ba dang / /a phu mtshal dang sbyar ba ni/ /gu gul bcas pa'i ril bus kyang / /rtag tu khu ba rengs par 'gyur/ /oṃ tware tu stu reture san+ta ra ṇi hiX de ba dat+ta bā shaX ku ru ho/ pad+ma lcags kyu bcas pa gi /sbu ta lid+mas 'gugs par bya/ /zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams pa yi/ /lha co se/'gugs par byed pa yin/ /oṃ tsa tu dha dza khedhū kha bi kri tā na na ka rna bi shā tsi hūXphaṭa/ gshin rje gshed kyi bris sku'i mdun du zhag bdun bzlas na/ rna bar sgrog pa grub bo/ /oX budha tsu ru mā tsu ru te grwa hā/ mchod rten gyi drung du gtsang sbra dang bcas pas bzlas na/ bdag nyid gang du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe zad pa dang / ring du 'tsho ba yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyis sbal pa'i bzung ba na/ /de dag dud med thal bar bya/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ma rma ni khung du/ /thigalebyas na 'gugs par 'gyur/ /mi tshil mi yi thod par bzhag /na ku)bal rgyasasdong bur bya/ /gzugs 'tshong thod pa dag las ni/ /snag tsha blangs te bu mol/ /thig le byas na 'gu/gas par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ya hūX snyam 'o tshalalan bdun mthon par bsngags nas bkrus na mig gi rab rib sel bar 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rting pa'i sha dang / byi la nag mo'i mchin pa'i rag pasaganas dang rdzas kyi ཿnga po skrod par 'gyur ro/ /na rgu ṭa dang mu rnyedang bhadharanag po dang / /bhadha dang ni sba tig ta rnams grib ma la bskams pa dang/bol—234—

wa dang / sgo ha ri ta gi rnams bu ram la sbyar nas dang po lnga dang phyi nas chu tshod gcig nas lhag ma yang sor mo gsum gyi tshad du zos na zla ba drug nas rgan po yang gzhon nur byed pa la the tshom med do/ /na mo bi ga ta rā ga me tri yo sidha lotsa ne swāhā/ zhes pas kyang rab rib sel bar byed do/ /zlum po mtshams snyerdorjes brgyan/ /hū bzhis rdo rje legs par mtshan/ /oṃ pa da kra ma snyi/ pa bkra masri/ sdo/ da ya ma sī/ ni rma ma sī/ arka ma sī/ ma rga ma sī/ 5rmi zhi mā sī/ ba na ma sī/gu lpa ma swe/ tsi ba ra ma sī/ mahā tsi ba ra ma sī/ arnya dha na ma sī swāhā/ lte ba la bri ste oṃ ni thams cad du'o/ /dbus su rdo rje'i g.yas dang g.yon du/ tshe brta lī.oṃb rā li/ oṃ ba rā ha mu khri zhes bri'o/ /mtshams su yang / o mya ri : zhesardobri'o/ /dbus su oṃ bā rā lī/ oṃ ba tā lī/ oṃ pa rā ha mu khyisarba dun pra du ni kā ye bā kyi ste mu kha za ya/ sta bha ya zhes so/ /dbus su ma yig go /de'i nang du de ba dat+ta rak+ṣa rak+ta 'o/ /'di ni gro ga la gur gum gyis bris na thams cad du bsrungab ste/ 'od zer can ma'i 'bor lo'o/ /yang gsungs pa/ dbus su lha mogaser mtshungs pa/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba can/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rnal 'byor mni bstodang bcas/ /grwa bzhir 'byung ba bzhi yang dgod/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'a skuyi ni/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bla med pa'o/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'borani/ /bha ga'i dbus su zla ba bsgom/ /dmar mo bcu gnyis lo yi tshul/ /phyag rgya lnga dang thod pas brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyangs rol par mdzad/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa'o/ /spyi bor ut+pal phreng ba bcings/ /g.yas pa nag—235—

sdo ser ༷ 'a //sna la si bar she rnam par 'phro//dkaXbeba'i bajo sngon po na//'a gya zhal ldu pyas zi//steng zhal dud kha zangs gri ༵/stutsu///ral gra sho tsho/zi dpa sdigs//rda rje shi ba dbyug pa dang //zangs 'gasardephyag rgya'/tsho/du she gsams da nas mtshe//tsigasaXri pa'iXzhags pa dang //he tar ngu 'a ḍi bum she ༷bcas//ma gags (dad pa ༷stags ga sbyin rdecan ma// ru ka ya' sgral mni//tā las ljang khu 'a da//mi khu yi sdogs gi khyu spyi sgyu zu/la 'a pa 'a//྅ga bka pa thams cad sbyan par byad/'i/ gsarden pa' phyag rgya yas//ye ri pa she las skyobs pa ste//ya ge bgyod bzlas nges 'grub 'gyur/ye/ ji gaXgashe snrag gnyas dmar//herukazol yum gyur pa'am//lhor dzo bad mchag ma rda she//da na rukasbyar gri//gang la dkyi' ba da 'grub ༷yā/ra//thad 'a rdu 'a khrag stingadang // lab 'byen/dmasaXbasnams pa 'a/rlo/sdi)bzhapa ye da par mnan//thal ba 'a byad kha ṭā ge tshor ge ge/'a/ gi thi zlaX par bya/da rjas bsnun nas khrag mu ge gyur ge ge 'a//skad ༷ga gcag sa gsad par byad//zhags pa lcags kyu' 'a gu yas//she ma thams cad nga bkuXsna 'i gas/khuXb grogadang chang gdang na//gang bu la sags dgug par bya// thu sum+bha na 'a na hū/ hā gro hā huX/gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX/ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi du rwadza : ༷phaṭa/skyoXgoji sku she ke rje/ ra tshod shas las sngi ba//rda 'i ra rab tu ye/ / 'bar zi sto tamagriratreng //gtun sdong 'a gya sas pa bsnams/khra ba she~Xrjo ma/ na//bskal pa' me bzhan gza brjad ༷bar//mda' gzhu dbyug tha na pa
