mchog /rdo rje zhags pa sdigs 'dzub can/ /spyan gsum g.yon brkyang stabasabasgom bya/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa yi/ /lha yi rgyal po 'di dgago /lha mo nag mo rnal 'byor bsgom/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa'i lag /lha yī 'joms pa dgra bo yi/ /mgo gcod tri shā la 'chang ma/ /bya rgod lce spyang rti laspro/ /rgyu ma mi mgo'i me tog can/ /ma mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /rolazhon pa rnam par bsgom/ /yang na stag mo la gnas pa/ /drag shul spyod pasabasgom par bya/ khu ba rdo rjer byas pa las/ /rang gi sems ni rdo rjera'agyur/ /rnam rtog med cing spros dang bral/ /mkha' ltar rang bzhin gos pa med/ /rang rig bde ba chen po ste/ /dbang bskur mchog ni 'di dag go /tshelong gzugs brnyan 'dra sems kyis/ /thig le rdo rjer byed par 'gyur/ /sronadang thur sel sgo dbye bas/ /btsan thabs sbyor bas dbugs bkag na/ khu bami 'gyur 'thob pa ste/ /thig le nor bur bkag ste bsgom/ /lha lpo'i gzugasabarnyan bsgyur bar bya/ /sgrol ma sgrol ma can grub 'gyur/ /yang na thogs med gzugs kyis te/ /skyes pa bud med nges 'grub 'gyur/ /las rab 'byams kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /dam tshig mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'byams dang / /bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos mngon par bstod byasanas/ /lag na rdo rje 'chang la rgyud 'di gtad/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byungaba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las ji snyed pa rtsa ba'i rtog pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa —237—

grub chen brnya nā tha'i zhabs las mnos nas/ slar rgya gar gyi mkhan po sdig ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyis byung gi paṇ+ḍita mi'i nyi ma'i dka' 'grel dang bstun te g.yar khral du bsgyur ba'o/ /yang slad kyisabhang ga lar zhabrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍita ga bye badz+ra'i drung du/ /slob dpon r+ṣa po maramemadzad dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel chen po dang bstun nas cung zad bces shing / thams cad du grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi zhal lung gi regazig so so rnams dang / khyad par gu ru lho phyogs pa wo po'i man ngag dngabastun nas legs par bcos te dag par bgyis pa'o// //zhus dag/ bkra shis//

las phyi ma'i rgyud kye rgyal po bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza pa ra mu rba sarba ka rmo da ya ut+ta ra tan+t+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ma/ sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ma/ ye shes dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ 'byung ba bzhi rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen mo/ shin tu phra ba/mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed/ dag byed chen mo/ las —239—

thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu spyin pa/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/ sgra sgrog dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ma/ rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba/ ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o/ /de la 〈'di rni thabs kyi dum bu〉'di ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi gnas so/ /de skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /de nas he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sgrub/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog gyur gsungs/ /ma mo 'dus pa nyams dga'i gnas/ /ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ hu gi ye shes rdo rje sems/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rnams spro ba/ /sngags 'dir mgon po bskul bar bya/ /o badz+ra satwa dza : ba ho su ra ta stu dro lja ho/ rdo rje 'e sdang bdag nyid ni/ /nag po hū sgrog brgyu' mig /rdo rje thod pas lag sbrel ba/ /rtse gsum srin po'i mgrin pa btsir/ khro mo'i dbang phyug sku la 'phyud/ /mi lpags rlon pa'i na bzar bcas/ /skra ser gyen du 'khyil ba'o/ /go 〈zhi ba 〉ri tso ri 〈drag mo snying 'dren pa 〉 rab rmongs 〈pa'i rmongs 〉 dang / /〈rnam par 'gyur ba 〉ro langs sbos 〈gar gyi tshul/〉 mo za 〈ra bo 'dogs pa'i 〉nus ma/ /dur 〈shi ba slong ba'i tshul 〉khrod ma dang 〈ro ldan pa'i tshul 〉gtum mo rnams/ /sngo dang ser mo btsod kyis mdog /gnag dang dmar ser ljang khu dang / /sngo bsangs de bzhin ser skya'o/ go ri keng rus 〈mig zim bu 'dod pas myos pa lta bu'i zhi ba'i lta stangs/ 〉dbyug pa dang / /thod pa g.yas dang g.yon par bsnams/ /tso 〈drag mo'i 'bru tshugs su lta ba lta stangs 〉ri mda' gzhu 'gengs byed ma/ /rab rmongs 〈kyi lta stang chang gis bzi ba lta bur mi gsal 〉bar lta ba/ rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje dang ni byis pa'i —240—

ro/ /ro langs ma 〈shi ba slong ba'i lta stangs cung zad gyen du lta ba/〉yi g.yas g.yon na'o/ /sbos mo 〈kar gyi lta ba g.yas g.yon du res kyi lta ba/〉 rgyu ma 'dren par byed/za nus 〈phus 'debs grangs rnam g.yeng (rnams phyogs ka kyi sna ba phyogs bcur lta ba'o/〉rdo rje thod pa'o/ /snying dang snying gis bkang ba yis/ /grod 〈ro za ba'i lta ba mdun steng 'og tu res kyis lta ba/〉pas brel ba dur khrod ma/ /mgo 〈dbugs 'byin phyogs bcur lta ba'o 〉/dang lus 'dzin gtum mo'o/ /o dz+wa la dz+wa la/ smohu hu hū snying po'o/ /lko e hre hi ru lu ru lu dza hū ba ho/ o badz+ra ḍā ki nī bya e a ra l+li ja ja e( ḍā ki nī ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+ta ya ban+ta ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī nā hri da ya hu phaṭa dza dza hu ba ho ṭak+ki hu dza dgug pa'i sngags so/ /o shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba ྅yan sa ma ye mu tra pra bhañja ka hu phaṭa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags so/ /o ba ṭa ba mu kha ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+ta ya ban+ta ya/ to ṣa ya to 'a ya/sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī nā hri da ya/ ha ha hi hi lko/ ā hū/ dbang du sdud pa'o/ kha chen myos byed ba glang sha /khrag bcas he ru ka mchod na/ /he ru ka dgyes dngos grub mchog /dur khrod chen por stsol bar mdzad/ /yang gsung pa/ khru ni nyi shu'i tshad ldan pa/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor bri skyukur bya/ /dbus su gzugs brnyan dgod par bya/ /zhal bzhi gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /rdo rje zhags pa dung dang mda'/ /lcags kyu ut+pa la dang gzhu/ /de bzhin gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /yi ge bcu pa'i gdan las skyes/ /me tog ma dkar de bzhin du/ /spos ma gnag cing mar me ma/ /ser mo dri ma kha dog dmar/ /—241 —

gnod mdzes ma dang rnam rgyal ma/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu la sogs dgod/ /yang gsungs pa/ hu gi yi ges hū 'don ma/ /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rab khros phag gi gdong ldan ma/ /rdo rje thod pa lag na thogs/ /gar gyi ro ldan bsgom byas 'a / /yi ge hu gis sbyor bzlas pas/ /'od gsal bar ni byed pa dang / /bgegs dang nad rnams 'joms pa'o/ /de la 〈nges don rgyas spyod ni mgon 'dir yod ces pa'i bar ro/〉 /'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /chos 〈thabs rig lngas so sor phye ste gsungs pa 〉 rnams rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /'di yi ye shes rdo rje brtag /gzod nas zhi ba gnyis su med/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'khor lo'i rig pas je skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zab dang rgya che'i rang bzhin no/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /gang rnams sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'dzin pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos rnams thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas pa med/ /dbyer med brjod pa dang bral ba/ /sems can dag pa snying rje can/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje nyi mas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di ni bde chen dam pa ste/ /'phel dang 'bri ba yod ma yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam 'phrul ba/ /thams cad rten cing 'byung ba'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bden pa ma yin brdzun min dngos/ /'gro 'di rang bzhin yang dag pa/ /ji ltar chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /mchog tu dga' ba bdag med pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po ral gri'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /—242—

〈shes rab btsun mos bsdus te gsungs pa la zhus pa/〉/de nas rdo rje snying po sogs/ /sngags rnams bzhengs shing phyag 'tshal te/ /dam tshig chen mo rnal 'byor ma/ /gtso mo che la 'di skad zhus/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar las byung ba/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sna tshogs chos kun 'byung ba ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mo ci zhig lags/ /nyon 〈lam mdor bstan ni/〉 cig rdo rje ji bzhin nyon/ /bdag tu lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa bstan/ /stong pa ma yin mi sto nga min/ 〈rgyas bshad dang po snang ba sems ni〉 /thog med bsags pa'i bag chags kyis/ /sna tshogs zhing dang dbang po dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang ro ldan pa/ /dri dang reg bya dang ni lus/ /phyi dang nang du rnam gnas pa/ /thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /'byung ba rnams dang yum med de/ /sems nyid phyi rol snang ba'o/ /kun 〈gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye na〉rdzob tu ni 'jig rten yod/ /dam pa'i don du gzhan dag med 〈kun rdzob/〉 nang 〈don dam 〉gi bde ba rang rig pa/ /gsal ba'i dngos po 'di kho 〈yod/〉na/ ༈srid 〈gsum pa spros bral ni/〉med mya ngan 'das pa med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa 〈don 〉med/ /rgya mtsho lta bu de bzhin nyid/ /sdig dang bsod nams bya las 'das/ /gcig dang du ma'i dngos kyang min/ /thams 〈bzhi pa gol sa bcad pa ni/〉 cad dngos po gcig gyur 〈ni chos nyid 〉pa/ /ye shes gcig nyid rnam par spros/ /sdug bsngal bde ba yul rnam shes/ /kun las 'das pa'i bde chen po/ /bya ba med cing byed po med/ /ma dkrugs rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar 〈bde ba chen po 〉—243—

dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags chen po'i ye shes 'dis/ /chags ldan rnams la byang chub ster/ /'khor 〈don bsdu ni/〉ba sems nyid phyi rol dngos po med/ /sems las g.yin du byang chub yod ma yin/ /srid 〈pa 〉 dang 〈gsar byung te snying po 〉zhi bor bral ba snying 〈bden 〉po med/ /rang sems snying rje'i bdag nyid mgon 〈don dam du 〉'dir yod/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags dang rgyud 'byung ba/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me huX phaṭa swāhā/oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra waṇi nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ na mo bha ga wa te me ru shi kha ra ku ṭa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myaklaX bcwa ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ oṃ āXmi tri ye hūX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ta dhiX lkoX pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā warta ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha wadhe ni/ dhi ri dhi ri budha wadhe ni swāhā/ oṃ nga mo ha swāhā/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re me dha naX de hi de hi rdza hā/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re paṇ+ḍa rā ṇi sbruXswāhā/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hiXswāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba du gi sdi ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ni lwa sba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ dzaX dhi ka ṭha ma ho ha ra sarba dha na sa bh+yo ra sno hūX dzuX huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ aṅga sha aṅga sha hriXhriXhriXhūX huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kṛ ba hiX.a haX a haX aX aX huX huX swāhā/ oṃ mahā ka la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa ma ma kar+yaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ pū/ tre k+ṣaX dzaX hūX ha/di byā ra sno ga ba ri sha na ar pa ka da pa ya sha /sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ya/ khyoXhūX phaṭa/oṃ maX di ri di ri tsaṇ+ḍa huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ gaX ga na pa ti ma ma rat+na sirnyi ga ga ga —244—

ga ga ga ga ga ga na pa taX swāhā/ oṃ ga na baX ho yaX dzaXg na baX hiXyaX dzaX nyi ma'i gdan la yang dag gnas/ /bgrang 'phreng pad+ma dmar po bsnams/ /gos dkar mo yis mgul nas 'byud/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par bya/ /gri gug thod pa lag na thogs/ /phag mo rab khros kha ṭāX bsnams/ /mdzes ma ya ba'i me tog mtshungs/ /dkar mo phyugs bdag zhabs kyis mnan/ /gser mdog mtshan rnams kun rdzogs shing / /bdud 'dul phyag rgyas zil gnon pa/ /go taX byang chub chen por bsgom/ /mgo bregs brtul zhugs chen po'o/ /byang chub mchod rten spyi bor 'dzin/ /klu shing dang ni mchog stsol phyag /dong ka'i me tog ltar mdzes pa/ /sangs rgyas rig mar bcas te brtag /mdog dkar 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lte bar rab bsngags 'khor lo bcas/ /gzhon nu'i tshul can bsgom par bya/ /zla ba ltar dkar mchog spyin dang / /po tis mtshan pa chu skyes bcas/ /bsgoms nas shu dag dang bcas pas/ /skyur po 'thungs pas blo gros ster/ /rin chen bum pa snye mar bcas/ /gang gi lag na nyer gnas pa/ /gser can sgrol ma bsam byas na/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin du 'gyur/ /dpag bsam shing brten yal ga dang / /nor bu'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa ni/ /gser gyi phug na gnas par bsam/ /nyi ma 'char ka gsar ba'i mdog /lcags kyu ut+pal dmar po bsnams/ /sgeg 'chang du mas rnam brgyan pa/ /dbang du byed ma bsam par bya/ /dmar mo phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /lcags kyu ut+pal phyag na bsnams/ /ku ru kul+le bsam par bya/ /rdo rje 'chang ba gdan gnon pa/ /sngo —245—

bsangs yid tsam khro ba ste/ /sgrub pos mdun du bzhug nas ni/ /mtshan brgyad po ni brjod par bya/ /nag po mi sdug rdo rje can/ /brla gnyis bar du mkha' lding ni/ /dug can a dza ga ra 'joms/ /sdigs byed lag na rdo rje bsgom/ /mdog bzang kā ma rde nu'i ba/ /bi tsu ra 'bras snye ma 'dzin/ /bum pa la gnas gnod sbyin mo/ /ma rka ṭa zhes bsam par bya/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od dang mnyam/ /kyo ba ne'u le'i rkyal pa can/ /nor rgyun ma ni rnam bsgoms na/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ khyi gdong rdo rje lha mo bzhi/ /bsgoms nas gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /gzi brjid rta mchog mtshungs par 'gyur/ /yang na nag po dmar dang dkar/ /rdo rje dbyug tho bcas ral gri/ /thod pa zhags pa thal mor bcas/ /mkha' lding rgyal po rnam par spro/ /phyag gnyis dbyug to 'dzin byas nas/ /nor rgyas tshangs par bcas gzir pa/ /bsgoms na dug rnams bskyod pa dang / /sna tshogs las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /mun pa'i sku lus khrag 'dzag zhal/ /ral gri thod bcas sha za ba/ kha ṭāX mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /dug shing la byas mchod par bya/ /dzam bha la ni nor sgrub pa/ /ser po pi dza pu ra 'dzin/ /ne'u le g.yon bsnams bsgoms byas nas/ /chu sbyin dbang po bsgrub par bya/ /rab dmar thod pa'i gdan la gnas/ /cang te thod pa shas gang 'dzin/ /ral pa ldan ma bsgoms byas na/ kha za mo rnams mngag gzhug 'gyur/ /glang po spre'u rgyal byi ba'i gzugs/ /dgra stu la phug phyag na bsnams/ /lcags kyu chang snod bsnams pa yi/ /phyag drug zhabs ni bzhi pa la/ /chung ma g.yog mor bcas bsgoms nas/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mchod par —246—

bya/ /rab dmar mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i rab sbyor ba/ /'di yis bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang / /blo dang dbang du byed pa yin/ /sbru ba hū ca dhi a ta ta ta sdi hu hu ba sdi ha hu dzi hi ga ga /bdag nyid he ru ka'i sbyor bas gnod gnas dbang po dmar po g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/gnod sbyin mo/ la 'jug pa bsams nas/ o dzam bha la dza len+t+ra ye dha na mi de hi ḍā ki ni dzā 'a tshu bha ra swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis chu sbyin na/ khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /tā yig ye shes las skyes kla / /zhal bzhi pa la sha yi mdog /phyag gnyis ut+pal phyag rgya can/ /'phreng ba mda' chen 'khor lo dang / /rgyal mchan gzhu dang bum pa 'dzin/ /lha mo sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung bar 'gyur/ /sngags 'dis bza' bca' ror bcas 'bul/ /na ma sarba ba dha bo dhi sa tā nā/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa na/ he he bha ga ba te mahā sa tā sarba bsnyi a ba lo ki te/ mā bi la sba mā bi las i nga/ bā ling gro hā rī/ ya gro hā pā ya hū ཾ hu hu sarba bi pañca re swāhā/ zla ba nyi ma sman dang dri/ /mar khu sgron ma lngas bcas pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bza' ba dang / /tsa ru de bzhin gtor ma bya/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs kyis bum pa la bzlas te nad pa la bkrus na/nad nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /thig gu la mdud pa byas shing / shing bu la bsngags la a zhes bzlas pas chom po bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /phag mo'i sngags 'bum bzlas te dkyil 'khor rgyu ras byug nga/ byas la/ o ā badz+ra na ra ka hra /spa hu phaṭa/ ces pa zhag bdun gyis rmi lam du zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /sgrol ma nga/mar mo'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas skar ma rgyal la mchod rten dmar po byas —247—

la tshes brgyad la ut+pal gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor byas la/ bum par bcug nas bskul ba dang bcas pa bzlas pas gang dbang du bya ba de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /byis pa'i sngags kyis bzlas pa'i chus 'khrud pa dang / sa dkar la bzlas te ril bu byas pa dang / bsrung skud byas pa de dag ni nad dang gdon las thar pa dang / mtshams med pa byas pa'ang ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ku ru kulbe'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas gtsang po'i chu zangs ma'i snod du blangs te de la gnod spyin mo rin po che dang lcags kyu 'dzin par bsams nas/ oX urdzi ṣa ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swāhā/ oX nga mo he ༷ da yaX warta ni hūX huX phaṭa/ nangs par sum brgya bzlas nas khrus byas na thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lha mo be+e ta li ser mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsams nas/ oX be+e ta lī pu tra sirnyi hūX phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /sarba dza ya/dngul chur bcas pa rna bar bzhag na mtshon gyis chod par mi 'gyur ro/ /rang nyid gdugs dkar mo can du bsgoms nas/ ta du thā/ oX a na le/ a na le/kha sa me/ kha sa me/ be+e ra be+e ra/ so me so me/ sarba bzhi a rnge na a dhi nyi te sarba ta thā ga tā usti ṣa si tā ta pa tre huX phaṭa/ huX ma ma hūX ni snya hā/ zhes bzlas pas/bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje dang gnod mdzes kyi rig sngags grub pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo ba'i rdo rje'am/gnam lcags kyi rdo rje byas la bzlas pas 'bar bar gyur nas sa 'og gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ srad bu la sogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcom nas dpal gyi sgo'am/ bu ga'i sgo rnams su 'jug ste/ stobs can dang gzhan len la —248—

sogs pas mchod par byed do/ /ji ltar sa 'og gi rtog pa las bshad pa de bzhin no/ /dpa' bo gzhin rje gshed po ni/ /nag po dbyug pa zhags pa bsnams/ /ma he la gnas bsgom par bya/ /lko ya mun+ta ka hu bzlas/ /re mig dgu pa khang pa lnga/ khang pa bcu gnyis dag dang bcas/ /hi gyil sogs dag gis bskor/ /'di yis dras shul spyod kun bsgrub/ /yak+ṣi ma med da dza sa do sa /ṇa yo ni rā ya smo ni ra/ /gzhan yang gnod spyin mo la sogs pa sgrub bo/ /o yo yak+ṣi ṇi bī ra dze swāhā/ shang leb la gos 'dzin pa mo bris la skye gnas su gzir bas bzlas na 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs nas kyang ci bgyi byed par 'gyur ro/ /lko bha ga wa te swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs par gzugs brnyan bya'o/ /gnod spyin mo nor can gyi'o/ /na mo be+e shra ma ṇa/ ta ya na ḍa ku be rā ya/dī bya bi mā na tsi ra ta ya/ he ma mā la kuṇ+ḍal/ sha ri ta ya/ yak+ṣa pa/ ban+ta ya t+ta bha ga wān/ ā warnya li sgri mi/ ta bya thā/ o ma ṇi ma ṇi kuṇ+ḍa/ kuṇ+ḍa// ku ku ku ku/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ra pu ra/ ku be ra ku be ra na ḍa ku be rā dī bya ma na kuṇ+ḍa li ku bi ku bi swāhā/ na ḍa mo yi'o/ /o na ḍa bi na ḍi dha ri ṇi swāhā/ na ḍa pho'i 'o/ /yak+ṣa ki li ki lo na mo sa t+ta pa di ti dzha pra ta ta sha kyi paṇ+ḍi da da mi se ma ka mā na pra yasnroṣ+ṭha swāhā/ ki li ki li'i 'o/ /phu ha phu klu mo mtha' yas ma'i 'o/ /o hi dza/gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o/ /na mo bha ga wa te pu lu pa lwa ya/ skra sha tsi/ pa'i bhadha te/ sa mo ka ma na/ pra ya sme skyo/ ta du thā/ hu lu hu lu/ pi shā tsa/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra da ba ra da/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu ṭu tsu ṭu na ma swāhā/ sha za pi lu pa'i 'o/ /na mo bha ga wa te pi shā tsā ya/ a ka ka na pi shā tsa dha ri ma ni swāhā/ sha za nor bu 'dzin pa'i —249—

'o/ /o kriṣ+ṭha pi shā tsa ya sa ra sa ra sarba a the na mo snyu dha ya swāhā/ sha za nag mo'i 'o/ /a lu ke be le ke gro hā baṇ+ḍa bi shā tsi ni swāhā/ e lu ka'i 'o/ /oṃ kha ra mu kha pe shā tsi nī hi hi da da pa ya swāhā/ bong gdong ma'i 'o/ /oṃ ta ti le ta ti li kriṣ+ṭha mu khe mahā pi shā tsi de hi de hi dā swāhā/ dus kyi gdong gi'o/ /tshe ring bcud len ri lu sogs/ /'gro ba pho mo 'gugs pa dang / /lkog gyur shes pa ston la sogs/ /de bzhin gser gyi 'dod pa ster/ de 〈mi g.yo dbugs stung 〉nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa khros pa rdo rje gtum po spros pa ni/ hū ral gri zhags pa bsnams pa'i mchog /skra ser mkhrang la grims pa'i lus/ /ma rungs gtum po cher 'khrugs pa/ /mdog nag mig yon spro ba che/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hū phaṭa/me yis bgegs rnams skrod pa dang / sngags bzlas chu yis srung ba'am/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i 'khor lor bris/ 'di yis bris sku byas nas ni/ khro rgyal rtag tu gtor mas mchod/ yungs dkar chu dang pu ta lis/ /bgegs rnams nyams par byed pa dang / /dpung rnams gnon dang dbye ba dang / /bsad pa la sogs rab bya ste/ /gtum po khros dang gtum po yi/ /dam tshig 'byung ba la sogs par/ /mi g.yo rgyal po nyid kyis gsungs/ /sngon tshe lha mo bde ldan dang / /sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs 'dus pa las/ /bdag dang ming po mi g.yo btsas/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bdud dang lha min gyis nyams byas/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /mig yon mgon gyis lha min dbang / khrag khrig bcu gnyis rab gtubs nas/ /de de'i chung ma kun 'dod byas/ /mi dang dri za mi'am ci/ /gnod sbyin klu rnams srog bcom ste/ /thams cad mi 'khrugs —250—

zhing du 'phangs/ /kun gyi ming yang mi 'khrugs rgyal/ /mi g.yo chags chen gyur pa yis/ /sring mo dag dang ma yang bsten/ /bde ba'i bde ba mchog de yis/ /sangs rgyas mi g.yo mgon por gyur/ /mi g.yos dgra bcom rnams la smras/ /bud med spangs pa'i sdig pa las/ khres rab spangs shing bde spangs pa/ /snying rje shin tu dman par byas/ khres rab snying rje gang spangs pa/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dam chos dang / /dge 'dun yang ni rnam spangs pas/ /dge slong bud med smod byed pa/ /sdom pas dman zhing sdig dang bcas/ /bud med spyor las sdom brtson nyid/ /gas ni tshangs spyod med pa'i phyir/ /mgo bregs sgyu mas 'jig rten bslu/ khyed cag sring mo'i dam tshig gyis/ /de tshe gling bzhi'i dge slong gtso/ / bud med dam tshig bde ba yis/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rnam snang la sogs rab tu grags/ /dus 'dir ming po go ta ste/ /go sma sring mo sgrol ma bdag /bud med brgyad khri'i bde ba yis/ /longs spyod khyim du sa bcu thob/ /de nas zhing du kun 'dar gyis/ /spyod pa yongs su spyod pa na/ /'jig rten kun tu rgyu zhes rtog /dga' mo dang ni dga' stobs ma/ /zas bcas snyoms 'jug bde ba yis/ /dbang bskur rdzogs sangs rgyas pa nyid/ /mi g.yo khros pas bdud bcom nas/ /bdud kyi bu mo rab bkram rnams/ /'dod chen spyad pas rjes su bzung / /drag shul spyod dang 'khrig sbyor las/ /byang chub lam gzhan yod min yang / /blo chen chags bral byams pa la/ /mos phyir rgyal bas sgyu ma mdzad/ /bud med bdag sgrub de yis ni/ /ming po la sogs mnyes par bya/ /mi g.yo rgyal po'i dam tshig gis/ /rnal 'byor pa —251 —

gang sring mo dang / /bu mo ma yang mchod par bya/ /yugs sa mo kun bde ba yis/ /dga' bar byas na mi g.yo mnyes/ /mi gang nga la mchod byed pa/ khro bo re tu ༵ ༵bha ya sha mni/sa/༵ g.yong dun ti /༵ ra'i tu res hā /ba~Xsgo/ /rdo lha rdzogs pa bsrung ba'o/ /oṃ dī ra da/ ba da ni e ka da sti mahā na se la sbo dha ri ka ṭa da ha ṭa ḍa dzhai/༵ ༵ ༵ḍi ༵//sho/༵ sna ༵ di rnyi/ hūṃ ༵ lhi ༵ ༵ ༵ hā ༵ /mā dzī / ༷ rdo lha rdi~X///༵ rnyi lto rdo ༵ sna ༵ dzhai rdo ༵ gi rdo na rnyi snru ka/ dzo ༵ /tsa lu ༵ rdo rdo dhi ༵hā/ /༵ kā rdo kau rnyi ༵ dzhai sgri ༵ ldi ke lgi/ dhi hūṃ dzi ḍi ༵dho bhaṇi sbyi~X ༵༵ bsru dhing 1 ༵ ༵sbyi/ ra/ ༵rak+ta 'a rje dhi shā~X / rno kyā hur kau//rno sngu ༵ tshi ༵ bi re je ༵/ kā ga/sa sgrog spu~X hūṃ ngab ༵ kā za/ ༵/ sna~X dza~X kā ༵ gā ༵ rdi ༵ shā / snro ༵t+ta/ sngi ༵ ༵ ༵ḍi/rdi ༵ // ḍā ༵ dzo/ ma/༵ rdo/ gzhi sbyi ma~X ḍi shā ḍi / rdo / ༵ ba~X/ /bha spyo~X nā rnyi/ ༵ ༵kyi spya~X / //re/dbu shā spra kā/sgrub ༵ dgo rdo par bya/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /sngags kyi grong khyer bdag pos —252—

bskor/ /ljang khus bsrung bar 'gyur ba ste/ /'chi ba bslu byed dkar po'o/ /nad dang brtson las thar pa dang / /tshe dang longs spyod brtson 'grus dang / /dbang phyug dang ni blo gros 'phel/ /tshwa la gi ha dri chu dang / /sa dang tsi tra ka dpa' bo/ /gla rtsi ro tshan ril lu yis/ /dug rnams srung bar byed pa ste/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /paṇ+ḍi ta kar rtsa ba dang / /be'u'i gci bas dug rengs byed/ /rim gsum rtsibs ni bcu drug pa/ /ku ru kulbe'i sngags kyis dgang / kha sbyor gzugs brnyan sbyor ba bya/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis gsang gnas phug /tshwar bcas gcin gyis kha bkang nas/ /rgya shug me la gdung bar bya/ /me tog bsnun dang zas dang spos/ /mig sman sbyor bas dbang du bya/ /sgrol ma dkar mor bsam byas nas/ /mi smra bar ni 'bum bzlas so/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i sbyor las byung / /yid gzhungs ma sogs bzhi dang bcas/ hal ju li dong ra zi ra/ /grog sman ru rta la la phud/ /ra yi 'o ma mar bcas btung / khu dag hal bye'i bzlas zos na/ /'dis ni blo gros 'phel bar 'gyur/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod nas mi 'jigs rgya/ /spyi bor reg pa chom rkun bsrung / /gu gul dwa la'i 'dab ma dang / /ru rta gla rtsi dpa' bo sbyar/ khu dag shing kun sbyar ba las/ /ril bu 'bum bzlas za bar bya/ /dri chu gla bas gnas lngar bsrung / /mdze nad gso bar byed pa'i mchog /me tog lha dha rā dzar bcas/ /sna yis rngubs na rgas pa sel/ /lo gsum bud med sbyor ba yis/ khu ba bkag pas gzhon nur byed/ /rna bar dug dang na le sham/ /lo gcig lon pas 'on pa sel/ /rgya mtsho'i sbu ba rgya mtsho'i 'bras/ /ra gcin sbyar ba mig —253—

nad 'joms/ /oṃ sum bhi ro dha na ye swāhā/ /ka rdzo rus pa bya rog mig /gser gyi phur mas 'bog nad bsrung / /dkyil 'khor lcags kyu ldan par bya/ /mchod na btson las thar bar 'gyur/ /halti gi haX ka sbu ri/ /rtsa sngags— bum par gdags byas la/ /nam gung sbrum ma bkru bar bya/ /nad med bde bas btsa' bar 'gyur/ /bo dhi rtsi 'bras mar dang bsres/ /bzlas nas bud med la byin te/khrus byas mo gsham gzugs 'chang ba'ang / /nges par bu dang bcas par 'gyur/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gdags byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod dang bzlas pa dang / khrus ni nyin re nyin re bya/ /byis pa 'tsho ba'i dam pa yin/ yang gsungs pa/ lte bar hiX brgyad bung ba'i gzugs/ /spro zhing de yis bcud gzhib bya/ /dzaXho huX a baX hi/ ā kar+ṣa ya a du sha dzaX dpral bar thig le byas na ni/ /bud med thams cad dbang du byed/ /yang gsungs pa/ nam 〈bsam gto gyi dkyil 'khor 〉mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus byas par/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /cho ga shes pas der 〈slob dpon gyi〉dbang bskur 〈chung ba 〉sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /skyes pa de bzhin gshegs ye shes/ /bud med rig pa'i lha mor bya/ /bu mo bcu drug lo lon 'byud/ /bde ba bsgom pa slob dpon no/ /gsang 'di su la'ang brjod mi bgyi/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ khren tu rno ba'i hūṃ la ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gi dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'bigs/ /bha ga 'jib bcas tsā ru bza'/ /gsang ba'i dbang de —254—

gnyis pa'o ma /ston pas bu la gtad byas nas/ /snyoms par 'ju ga pas ro mnyam bsgom/ /sa bcu'i bde ba thob pa na/ ṣe)sa rab ye shes zhes brjod rnge do /chags 〈dbang bzhi pa'i mdor bstan tshig drug〉 dang chags bral las 'das pa/ /dbu mar mi dmigs 'od gsal ba/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa mchog tu phra/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes 'gro 'ong med/ /gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs chen po pa/ /bde ba che grub slob dpon te/ /chags ldan g.yo sgyus bud med smod/ /lhung bzed 'gengs byed slob dpon min/ /sa chog slob dpon bya ba dang / /dbang bskur dam tshig sbyin sreg dang / /rab gnas mchod yon cho ga dang / /rdo rje dril bu bgrang 'phreng dang / /dgang blugs de bzhin phyag rgya drug /sku gzugs tshad dang tha ma/'i chog /phyir bzlog bsrung ba bzlas pa dang / /nad dang gdon dang rim 'joms dang / /tshe dang longs spyod rigs 'phel dang / /dbang du byed dang bsad dang skrod/ /dbye dang mnan pa lha khang gi /cho ga 'di rnams slob dpon las/ /de bzhin bcu/da len rig 'dzin dang / /sna tshogs las dang dngos grub dang / /sman gyi sbyor ba rnam mang po/ /rgyud dang rgyud du mngon par brjod/ kha sbyor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /gdan bzhi de bzhin rdo rje gur/ /'byung dang zla gsang thig le dang / /mi g.yo skyon rje gshed dmar po/ /sna tshogs sgrol ma'i rgyud chen dang / /ku ru kul+le ral gcig ma/ /bcu gcig rnal ga 'byar ma yi rgyud/kun gyi sbyor ba rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan/ rnams gang rnams de dag ni/ /sna tshogs rgyud dang rgyud du shes/ /rtsod ldan dus su gang bstan pa/ /de dag thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /'on 〈dbang bzhi pa'i rgyas bshad 'di nas gsungs po'i bar 〉kyang gzhan1 rnams —255 —

——su sbas 〈dbang bzhi pa/〉 pa/ /'dir ni gang dag sngon gsungs pa'i/ /mi shes byis pa rnams la yang / /rtag tu gnas pa'i bde chen po/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes 'gyur ba med/ /rang byung chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /rkyen las byung dang mi rtag phyir/ khres rab ye shes bzhi pa min/ /las dang ye shes phyag rgya ni/ /dam pa'i don du don ma yin/ /don dam brtag pa kun dang bral/ /de phyir smra bar nus ma yin/ /'jig rten 'dod pas rab g.yengs dang / /chags bral rnams kyi dben pa dang / /zhal phyag rnam pa'i yid bde dang / /thig le phra mo'i bde sgrub dang / /lte ba'i re kha bsgom 'bad bcas/ /stong nyid mthong bas rab dga' dang / /rlung rnams thim pa'i sems med bde/ /'gro don byed 'gyur rab dga' dang / /bud med sbyor ba'i reg bde dang / /yid dang gzugs brnyan bde ba ste/ /'di dag skyon dang bcas pa yin/ /rang bzhin bde chen gzhan pa nyid/ /lus dang ngag yid nges dang bcas/ /chags dang chags pa bar ma dang / /chags bral bcas pa'ang yi ger bcas/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog tu dga'/ /bral dga' g.yo bcas mi brtan pa/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rig pa po/ /gsal dang mi gsal brda tsam ste/ /de dag de la snying po med/ /chags pa la ni chags dngos med/ /chags bral la yang chags bral med/ /dbu ma las kyang dbu ma med/ /thams cad rkyen las byung ba tsam/ /dngos dang dngos po kun bral ba/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid dngos/ /'di yi rang bzhin mi 'gyur bde/ /dpe med yi ge med pa dang / ༈g.yo ba med dang 'gyur ba med/ /〈gas stong 〉rang rig bde chen rang bzhin gyis/ /mya ngan 'das pa gcig pu bden/—256—

kun byed redi la byed po med/ /bdag dang sems can srog bcas dang / /gtso bo dbang phyug rdul phran sogs/ /ye shes 'di la rnam par brtags/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /'gog dang lam bden chen po pa/ /dri ma sngon nas zad pa dang / /chos kun gdod nas sangs rgyas pa/ /bden gnyis dbyer med tshul 'di bstan/ /ji ltar me mar khang par bus/ /skar khung lnga las phyir snang ba/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i me mar 'dod/ /dbang shes lnga zhes rnam par sprul/ /me mar lnga zhes yid kyis rtog /'od dang me gzhan yin no zhes/ /yid gzhan blun pos ngar 'dzin byed/ /chu las chu rlabs ji bzhin ltos/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas chos gang gang de/ /sems can 〈bde gshegs snying po yon tan can/〉khams la re rer gnas/ /dbye ba med cing mthong med pa/ /gseྈ khams rdo la gnas pa bzhin/ /lus dang ngag sems 'khrig pa ste/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi mngon gyur pa/ /gzugs brnyan brag cha nam mkha'i dngos/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /nye ba mgrin pa snying pad+ma/ /yang ni mgo bor rab brjod pa/ /sems can srid gsum 'gyung ba dang / /'di nyid du ni thim pa'o/ /dbang bskur ba rdo rje ye shes kyis de skad ces gsungs go 〈'di nas shes rab kyi dum bu/ 〉 de nas rdo rje phag sde dru1 la tre tshegs pa rnams dang / ma mo rnams dang / dbang phyug ma rnams dang /lha dang mi dang klu dang dri za dang gnod spyin dang srin po dang mi'am ci mo la sogs pa'i/ bud med ri rab grangs med pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul snyed rnams the tshom du gyur yid gnyis su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa ri la 'di skad ces gsol to /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dbugs —257—

dbyung ba ni ji ltar bstan/ /dus 'dir nyung du gsung ba ci/ chags chen nges par gsungs pa gang / /rig sngags bzlas pa byed rnams kyis/ /ji ltar lha la bsten par bgyid/ /rlung gi sbyor bas lus dag pa/ /de bzhin dga' ba la sogs ci/ /mchog gyur bud med dam tshig dang / /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /grol ba'i bdag nyid gang yin pa/ /lha lags mgon pos bshad du gsol/ /'di la rig pa'i brtul zhugs ci/ /btsan thabs sbyor ba'ang ji ltar 'gyur/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa dag /mngon par 'grub pa'ang bshad du gsol/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ /'di la dang por rdo rje sems/ /phyi nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid rnams bsdus nas/ /rig ma btsun mo rnam par rol/ /chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams gnas pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam rol ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bskyed/ /bdag nyid bde ba che rang bzhin/ /sems can khams la rjes zhugs pas/ /thams cad bde chen byang chub thob/ /bde bas mngon par zhen rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis stong nyid bstan/ /de des grangs med mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas stong par mngon zhen rnams/ /thams cad dmyal bar lhung gyur pas/ /rgyal ba rtag pa rnam sprul te/ /dbu ma la ni rnam par bzhag /rang dang gzhan don cher bsgrub pas/ /dpag yas mchog tu grol bar byas/ /kun rdzob rjes zhugs ngar 'dzin can/ /rnam rtog du mas rnam dkrugs pa/ /de dag gzhan gyi bsam pa kun/ /rdzogs byed bya —258—

ba mchog la bskul/ /rin chen nyi ma rnam sprul pas/ /de dag bla med byang chub la/ /mchog tu dga' bas gzhol bar 'gyur/ /g.yin las rjes su chags ldan pa/ /de tshe 'dod chags kyis bcings pas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rnam sprul te/ /'dod chags bde ba'i lam gyis ni/ /brjod med 'gro ba mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas bde la chags ldan rnams/ /le los mngon par nyams gyur nas/ /blo ngan 'jig rten rnam par 'khrugs/ /rta mchog rgyal po rab sprul nas/ /sems can brtson 'grus gnas la bzhag /byi bo rkun po dgra la sogs/ /rang rang tshul gyis mngon sprul bas/ /thams cad rdo rje'i gnas la bzhag /rtsod ldan spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ khren tu khro gtum gdug pa can/ /rab khros he ru kar sprul pa/ /drag shul gsod la dgyes pa 'gyur/ /srin po gnod spyin 'byung po gnod/ /ma mo bcom byas rig sngags dang / /rdzas dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor dang / /sman gyis kyang ni thams cad bcom/ /zhe sdang gdug gnon zhi ba'i phyir/ /slar yang bde chen mgon po la/ /ma 'ongs dus na rab 'jug ste/ /dbugs dgrang dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /'dir ni don dam kun rdzob ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa zhes/ /gzhan ni rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /'dir yang don dam rnam pa gnyis/ /bde ba che dang de nyid do/ /kun rdzob gnyis kyang 'jig rten dang / /dkyil 'khor zhes ni re zhig bzhag /tshe thung bsod nams zhan pa dang / /srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang / /'dod la spyod pas g.yengs gyur pa/ /da ltar rgyud rnams nyung ngur gsungs/ /bskal pa grangs med sum cu —259—

gnyis/ /'bad kyang da dung byang chub med/ /bde bas tshe 'dir 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de phyir 'dod chags chen po bstan/ /bde bas bde ba thob 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas bde ba bde chen po/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rgyu sgrub pa/ /ma tshang stong pas mya ngan 'di'i/ /sdig pa med dang dad pa dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang / /ser sna dregs dang nga rgyal med/ /'dis ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga dag byas pa yang / /'di yis sgrub pa por 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /bgegs 'joms bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni/ /dang por 'bum phrag bzlas byas nas/ /mchod rten la sogs byed pa dang / /mchod dang bskor ba la sogs bya/ /yan lag mchog dang dang ldan pa'i/ /bud med yid 'ong yang na gzhan/ /sngags spyod snying rje blo ldan pa/ /snying stobs ldan pa grogs zhes bya/ /bram ze mu stegs nyan thos med/ /dang po'i las can der gnas bya/ /bris sku mchod pa dang bcas shing / /dang por rigs kyi lha nyid bsgom/ /bye ba bye bar bzlas la brtson/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor rnam bsgoms nas/ /bzlas pa 'bum du bya ba yin/ /spyin sreg mchod la mngon par brtson/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa bris nas ni/ /zla ba drug tu mchod par bya/ /sngags pa sngags dang de bzhin grogs/ /phyogs dus rdzas dang brtson 'grus dang / /lha ni bdun par gsungs pa yin/ /dam tshig brtson 'grus bzod pa dang / /dad dang snying rje sngags ma nyams/ /le lo med na myur thob 'gyur/ /lha dang rigs sngags mthu ldan zhing / /sems stobs ldan dang mtshan ma thob/ /'di yis dngos grub bsgrub bya yi/ /gzhan du na ni nyon mongs —260—

'gyur/ /g.yon nas lta bas dgang ba dang / /g.yas kyi dgug pa de bzhin no/ /dpral ba'i lta ba re tsa ka /sna rtser bum pa can yin no/ /lte ba las ni rlung bskyed pa/ /me nyid dang ni rlung nyid dang / /de bzhin chu dang dbang chen te/ /'khor lo sems kyi kun spyod pas/ /steng logs thad ka 'og tu gnas/ /srog nyid dang ni thur sel dang / /gyen rgyu khyab byed me mnyam gnas/ /'khor lo kun tu 'gro spyod pa/ /klu dang rus sbal sogs de bzhin/ /snye ma la sogs rnam par gnas/ /mig dang rna ba dang ni sna/ /lce dang lus la byang chub sems/ /de bzhin sgo ni dgu dang yang / /grong bzhi dang ni sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo ni dam pa gnyis nyid dang / /dman pa'i sgo ni rnam pa gnyis/ /byed pa bcings pas sgo phye zhing / /yur ba las ni chu 'bab ltar/ /de bzhin rlung gi sbyor ba yis/ /lus ni dag par byed pa yin/ /sgrub po'i dbang po gang zhig dge bsnyen nam dge tshul lam dge slong yang rung ste/ shin tu dben nga/'i ri bo'am nags tshal lam/ skyed mos tshal lam khyim du gnas pas/ lang tsho ldan ma gzhon nu ma'am/ dar bab ma blangs te/ gzugs bzang mig mdzes skra bzang ba/ /lam 'dir blo brtan rnyed nas ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba rab tu brtsams/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod ma chags shing / /bde la mngon par rjes chags pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa mthong dga' ba/ /de las sbyor ba'i dngos grub thob/ /lus ni rab tu brtas ldan pa/ /dga' ba'i tshig 'jam rol mo dang / /'khyud dang tsum pa ta nu 'drud/ /ze 'khru 'dab ldan bskul ba yis/ /g.yo dang brtan nyams dga' bar rengs/ /mig zum 'gyur ba bdag —261 —

nyid la/ /las mang 'bras bu bde chung bas/ /cha shas bde ba dga' dang po/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam bltas nas/ /brlan bcas pad+ma rab rgyas par/ /rdo rje rgyas pa rab bcug pas/ /'dar dang 'gyur dang sri ta kyi sgra/ /u yig drod bcas sgra nyams pa/ /bu mos ye shes thob 'gyur te/ /rtsol bral khyab pa'i bde ba ni/ /mchog tu dga' bar yang dag brjod/ /rab bskyod gnyis kyis bskyod pa las/ /du ba'am rgod dam byis pa'i tshul/ /'dod pas mi bzod dran nyams pa/ /bdag gi ye shes bde gsal ba/ /rang bzhin bral 'di lhan skyes dga'/ /nyams pa bral ba'i dga' spangs nas/ /ye shes mchog gis dgag par bya/ /yang na btsan thabs sbyor bas so/ /rdo rje 'khums dang chu skyes zum/ /bde ba rjes dran bral ba'i dga'/ /mchog tu bcings pa rnam pa bdun/ /phrag par rkang pa zung ster dang / /steng dang 'og dang thad ka rgyab/ /shin tu brkyang dang bsnol ba'o/ /rdzas kyis thig le'i rim gror byas/ /skye gnas dam dang tsha ba yis/ /sbyor ba thams cad bya bar bya/ /'di yis ye shes rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhing na gnas pa'i bud med rnams/ /'dod chen sbyor bas mnan bya yis/ /me tog sogs kyis mchod mi dgos/ /spyor ba gang gis rdo rje dang / /pad+ma sad pa de bsten bya/ /chu skyes dbus su sems phyung la/ /de yi ye shes mtshon byas nas/ /me tog bcas pa lidha sa btung / /ra sa ya ṇa'i bde ba'o/ /rab tu dga' sogs gnas byas nas/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'gyur bar ston/ khu ba phyed kyi shes rab ma'i/ /'khor lo 'gro 'ong sad par byed/ /gzugs mdzes ltas dang dga' ba'i sgro/ /dri mnam ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi sna —262—

btung / /reg dang gnyis gnyis sprod pa dang / /rdo rje bslang ba bha ga yis/ /'tshir dang zil pas gsher ba dang / /drod dang g.yo ba rnam shes gsum/ /rab dga' la sogs sar brjod pa/ /phung po rin chen snod du sbas/ /dang po'i las can rnams la ni/ /bud med spangs pas ye shes med/ /dang po tha mar gnyis sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas bde ba rab tu 'grub/ /nus bral slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /pad+ma ra sems ni mngon dbab pas/ /bde gshegs mchod par bya ba nyid/ /gzhan du byung na dngos grub ring / /bud med dag kyang 'dis grol te/ /sor mo shing dang lpags pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor dag gis rtsa sad bya/ /'dod chen bud med rab grol phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rgyas par phye/ /bde ba skyed byed bdun bcu gnyis/ /bud med rnams kyi lhag pa'i rtsa/ /bud med myur du byang chub pa/ /skyes bu de bzhin min pa nyid/ /'du shes gzhan dang ma rdzogs dang / /mi dmigs 'di las lhung med de/ /'dod bcas sad dang rmi lam la/ /'dzag byed de dag nyes dang bcas/ /dus bzhir bzang mo la 'dod spyod/ / dam tshig rnams kyi gtso bo'i gtso/ /zla re'am lo ni re re sa /pad+ma mchod par mi byed na/ /de tshe dam tshig nyams pa yis/ /tsha ba chen por rnam par lhung / /dngos grub 'dod pas bud med kun/ /mchod cing gus pas phyag bya'o/ /dud 'gro mo la'ang gus bya na/ /mi mo ci phyir gus mi byed/ khres rab bud med mi mo'i gzugs/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /lha dang bla ma grogs gyur pa/ /rab tu byams ldan gnyen gshin la/ /mi shes byas pa mi gzo bas/ /skye gnas dman ces rnam smod pa/ /nad dang rims nad tshe thung —263—

dang / /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed pa 'gyur/ /mi shes sngags pa bud med la/ /snun byed dam tshig kun nyams pas/ /skad cig de la mnar med lhung / /sdug pa'i sbun gyi dgrar gyur na/ /sbun zla mchod kyang dgar mi 'gyur/ /bud me da smod la lha mo rnams/ /mi dges de yi mchod mi len/ /bskal ba bye ba grangs med par/ /bzang por spyod pa kho nas kyang / /byang chub rin chen ma thob pa/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis thob par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid bsgom zhing / /phyag rgya'i bde ba rab sgrub pa/ / bud med sbyor las phyag rgya che/ /mngon du mtshon par byed na de/ khrus dang gtsang sgra mi dgos shing / /dka' spyad sdom pa med par yang / /bde ba nyid dang dga' bas 'grub/ /de bas ci ltar 'dod spyod cing / /kun bzang de bzhin thams cad spyod/ /g.yo ba dag kyang ci dgar byed/ /ji lta bus kyang rnam grol 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lugs ma la sogs las/ /rnal 'byor skye bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro/ /g.yo dang smra ba spyod pa kun/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho gar 'gyur/ /mar me legs par blangs nas ni/ /mun pa'i khrod gnas nor bu len/ /sgrib pa'i mun par chos kyi dbyings/ /bud med bde bas 'tshol bar bya/ khren tu nye bar gnas pa rnams/ /de de'i chos la mi gus pa/ /mkhyen nas rgyal bas chags bral bstan/ /dam pa'i don du de nyid min/ yang gsungs pa/ dang por mtshan dus gsangs te spyad/ /gal te der sems mi brtan na/ /bsdus nas tha mal tshul du rol/ /gzhan du smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ sha za bzhin du kun tu —264—

'khyam/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes lnga grub pas/ /'jig rten mngon du yang dag spyad/ /gal te 'phags pa'i sa thob na/ /des ni phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod/ /zhing rnams kun tu rgyu ba'am/ /yang na bas mtha' 'am rang gi khyim/ /sbas pa'i spyod pas grol bar 'gyur/ /yang na tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /bud med bcu gnyis rnam rol pa/ /rgyan dang gdong sogs rnam par brgyan/ khar gyi bud med dbus 'ongs shing / /gcig shos shar du dges rol sogs/ /sna tshogs du mas rnam rol ba/ /skyed mos tshal la sogs par bsgrub/ /glu dang zlos gar kun byas te/ /dbang bskur ba dang las kun bya/ /yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje'i sgo ni dbye ba dang / /de bzhin pad+ma rgyas par dbye/ shing ngam sa yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /bshang ba'i lam du rtse bar bya/ /srog dang de bzhin thur sel ba/ /bkag cing gong bu gcig tu bya/ /dga' bas rol pa la zhugs nas/ /dal bu dal bus rab sbyor te/ /sgo dbye ba dang sor mos gnon/ /bu mos rtsa yi thur ma pyi /sa/ /si ti rnam par 'byed par 'gyur/ /de yi gnas su rlung rgyas te/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo kun sad pa/ /gtum mo 'bar bcas zhu zhing 'dzag /btsan thabs sbyor bas me 'bar ba/ /rwa sa na las rnam par rgyu/ /'dzag pa'ang la la na las te/ khu ba 'dres gyur kun 'dar du/ /bar byed 'khor lo 'khor lo la/ /lan mang bzlog cing yang 'bar gnas/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga 'bigs par byed/ /de las rnam par ltung ba yis/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rab tu 'grub/ /mngon par byang chub rab bshad pa/ /'byung ba'i bde ba lha mor brtag ༈ /gdol ma bram ze'i bu mo dang / /tshong mo glu mkhan mda' —265—

mkhan mo/ /gar mkhan mo sogs rigs can bzung / /yang na lha mo mi'am ci/ /klu mo dri za mo sogs brtag /thig le zhu ba zla ba'i gzugs/ /me tog dang bcas nyi ma gsol/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig rgyur pa/ khu ba khrag dang rlud bcas pa'i/ /tshogs pa 'dir ni rnam par zhig /lus dang sems zhes bya ba 'das/ /kun gzhi rnam par gyur pa nyid/ /'di las longs spyod rdzogs par 'gyur/ /yang na don grub sgyu ma bzhin/ /mā ma ki sogs rab sbyor ba'o/ /sangs rgyas rang nyid gzugs can ni/ /lha mo dang sbyor 'dod chags che/ /'on kyang mos pa tha dad phyir/ /sprul pa mig 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ ༈ /yang gsungs pa/oṃ karti ka sarba mā ra ṇaX maX sa ka rta ya ka rta ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba shā krus rak+ṣaX dh+wa ra ya dh+wa ra ya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba shā trun tri shā la hūX phaṭa/ brtul zhugs so/ /gzugs brnyan yi ge mtshan ma dag /dkyil 'khor gsum du nges byas pa/ /snying ga nas byung snying gar bzhugs/ /mtshone cha phyag rgya phyis bkod nas/ /las dang dngos grub bkas gnang ba/ /bu mo dag la 'byud pa dang / /nu ma mnyed las bde thob pa/ /slob dpon dbang bskur sbyin pa'o/ /zhi ba la sogs pa'i sgrol ma ni dkar ba dang / ser ba dang / dmar ba dang / nag mo'o/ /chu dang dbang chen dang / me dang rlung la gnas pa dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / ma he la bzhon pa'o/ /zhi ba'i lha mo ni mi 'jigs pa dang / ut+pal dkar ngo 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyas pa mo ni mchog sbyin dang bum pa dang / snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang byed ma ni lcags kyu dang zhags pa'o/ /gsod byed ma ni ral gri dang dus kyi zhugs pa'o/ /phyogs kyi lha mo grwa —266—

bzhir 'khod pa ni/ sangs rgyas rin chen chos dang ni/ /rdo rje sgrol ma bsam bya ba/ /dkar dang ser po dmar po dang / /dkar min phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/mchog stsol ba dang ut+pa la/ cang te de bzhin rtse gsum bsnams/ /zhal drug phyag drug tho ba dang / /zhags pa bsnams pa zhabs drug pa/ /tshangs pa 'joms pa gshin rje gshed/ /ral gri thod pas lag brel ba/ /mig yon dbang po dbang ldan gnon/ /dbyug to dang ni pad+ma dang / /'khor lo zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog khro bo'i rgyal po pad mthar byed/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /klu dang gshin rje zhabs kyis mnan/ 'khyil ba rdo rje phur bu ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje tho bar bcas/ /dril bu phur bu bsnams nas ni/ /log 'dren bdud bcas la 'debs brtson/ /dpa' bo 'di gsum sprin gyi mdog /gzhan rnams gang rnams pho nya mo/ /rang rang las dang mtshungs par bya/ /gsang ba thams cad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyis bstod pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang / /rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ /ye shes mtshon cha rnam 'a myong ba/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ /dbang po'i dra ba 'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug /lhan cig skyes pa'i mdzes ma dang gtsugs mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces gsol ba btab par gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi sku la yongs su zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems rnam par dbab pa rdo rje nam mkha'i 267—

khams thams cad yongs su gang bas/ sems can thams cad mchog tu bde ba grub par gyur to/ /rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /hu gi yi ges bdud rnams ga lnga ba/ /oṃ ā ā li kā li ste/ rtsa gnyis zla ba nyi ma dag /de dag me long ye shes te/ /sa bon mtshan mar gyur pa ni/ so sor rtog par ngas bshad do/ /gcig gyur mnyam pa nyid yin te/ /'gro don byed pa bya nan tan/ /gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa chos dbyings so/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor rdo rje gsum/ /rab rdzogs sngags rnams kun gyi lha/ /gsang dang gsang chen shin tu gsang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po dang / /rjes dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang / /stong pa'i ye shes rnam gsum po/ /rgyud kun gyi ni gtso bo'i gtso/ /mi shigs pa dang sngags dang rdzas/ /thig le gsum du ngas bshad do/ /byin gyis rlabs dang yongs brtags dang / /yongs su rdzogs pa rnal 'byor gsum/ /mi gsal ba dang ye shes chung / /ye shes ye shes chen po ste/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /gzugs med tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes bral/ /dbang po yul dang rnam shes med/ /nyon mongs med cing byang chub med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ /'phel pa med cing bri ba med/ /rtag min mi rtag ma yin pa/ /yod dang med dang yod med 'das/ /'di la bdag med gzhan yang med/ /bden min rdzun pa ma yin pa/ /rkyen gyis stong min rang bzhin nyid/ khes rab pha rol phyin par brjod/ /dmigs dang dmigs med las 'das nas/ /bya ba ci dgar spyod byed pa/ /rig sngags grub pa gang yin pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod la gnas/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa —268—

dang / /sgyu mas sgyu ma mchod byed ltar/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa 'di dag gis/ /rmi lam bzhin du sngags spyod pa'o/ /ji ltar me yis bsregs pa ltar/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bud med las/ khres rab pha rol phyin pa bskyed/ /g.yo ba thim dang bde ba dang / /rnam rtog ngo bo nyid kyi gcod/ /de phyir de la de rab bsgrub/ /mtha' med dbus kyang med rig pa/ /don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rtog pas rtog pa rnam spangs te/ /de phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'od gsal mchog tu nyer 'gro ba/ /bde dang sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang / /rnam par mi rtog rnam par sbyangs/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa bcu gnyis/ /pho nya mo sbyor de nyid dang / /rtsa dang khams dang g.yo ba yi/ /'gro 'ong 'gags pa'i ye shes so/ /de nas de la ye shes sku/ /'di la rtsa med khams kyang med/ /rlung gi bgrod pa'ang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang sems kyi rnam 'phrul te/ /de de 'gags las sa bcu gnyis/ /pho nya mo rnams sbyor grub las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis bde ba 'di/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyis zhes brjod/ /las dang po dang rnal 'byor pa dang sgrub pa po/ /grub pa mchog tu grub pa dang ni sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya sngags brjod bdun du gsungs/ /bla ma'i drin gyis skye ba gcig rdzogs mngon gyur pa'o/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /zag med sems 'di de bzhin nyid/ /nam mkha' snod kyis dbye ba ltar/ /gnas skabs bdun du 'jig rten rtog /rdo rje rang bzhin 'gyur med pa/ /gnas skabs theg pa thug med kyis/ /de ni mi 'jigs g.yo ba med/ /nam mkha' lta bu gos pa med/ /ji ltar rab rib can —269—

dag gis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad mthong / /de bzhin 'khor ba rnam par rtog /'khor ba med cing gang zag med/ /de phyir bcos ma kun spangs nas/ /zung 'jug rang bzhin bsgom bya ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung lam la/ /sngags rig rnam rtog ma byed cig /rnal 'byor dbang pos skye bo ni/ /gang la'ang brnyas par mi bya ste/ /nyan thos nang du mi gnas shing / /chags bral lam la blo mi gus/ /bud med rin chen spang mi bya/ /nyan thos spyod pa spangs byas nas/ /'dod chags chen po snying rjer bcas/ /'dul ba'i thabs tshul kun rig pas/ /gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs la gnas pa'o/ /sdom dang sdom min kun las log /bza' dang bza' min mi brtag ste/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang dpyad mi bya/ /rang bzhin de nyid mnyam par shes/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs gzi brjid can/ /mnyam nyid dmigs su med pa la/ /sdig dang bsod nams kun yod min/ /kun kyang byang chub spyod pa can/ /bud med sbyor las sems brtan pa/ /tshangs spyod ma nyams dge slong ste/ /dbang phyug kun gyi bla mar 'gyur/ /rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ /rtog pa phyi ma gsang ba nges par bstan pa ji snyed pa rdzogs te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rtog pa ji snyed pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar lho phyogs ra sgyu shwa ra'i ljongs su sku 'khrungs pa rdo rje theg pa la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun brnya gup+ta la/ rgyud 'di zhib mor nyan cing bsgyur bar sla ba rnams tho re long nge ba bsgyur zhing / dka' gnas rnams —270—

slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po ni rbu ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang / yang slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rna badz+ra'i spyan sngar/ 'grel pa so so dang zhib tu sbyar te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhus dag/ bkra shis//

sgro/na me zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo gu ra be/ rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba sgrolamal phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bla ma la bshud de/ /phyi nas de bzhin lha rnamasala'o/ /gang zhig rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don/ /mdo tsam dam pas bskul phyir bri/ /dus mthar yul gyi mthar skyes shing / /blo dman brtson 'grus zhan mod kyi/ /sngar byas dge ba 'dir sad pas/ /zab mo'i don la dad pa thob/ /slob dpon zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /rgyud kun snang byed rgyud 'di thos/ /rkyen dang rang bzhin rdo rje yi4/ /bla ma ji bzhin bsten pa'i mthus/ /cung zad blo grosamig thob nas/ /don bsdus brtsom la spro ba skyes/ /'di ni sde snod gang du gtogs/ /rgyud 'di'i mtshan ni ci zhig yin/ /su zhig gis ni 'di spyan drangs/ /'di gsum thog mar bshad par bya/ /dngos ni dgos don bsdus don tshig don gsum/ /'dir ni de yi bsdus pa'i don bshad pa/ kho ba'i rgyud kyisadon dngos rgyas par bshad/ /phyi ma'i rgyud kyis the tshom bcad pa go /dang po layang dngos dang rgyud 〈de nas de bzhin 〉gtad pa dngos la le'u dang po sngags bshad cing / /mchog gtsor bsgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis pa dang / /gtso bor lasatsho gis rab 'byams gsum pa'o/ /mdor bstan sgo nas bshad par zhal bzhes dang / 〈de nas dngos grub/〉sngags kyi phan yon sngags kyi byung tshul dang 〈'das

pa'i dus/〉sngags kya dgos pa 'a ni rdig sa ba 〈 da/〉/gañjiXpa phan yo rnam pa gsum du bshad//las kya dngas grub bud mad bad chan 'grub pa 〈mi dang 〉dang //'jig rten pa yi dngos grub che thob pa'o//bzhi pa sku bzhi'i she bye rtsa ri ‘ri rdzod bas spram pa ṭa e rna thu/〈nyo ༷ra/〉lnga pa dkya~Xste dang / rjeX/nga 〈she 〉lasardesdugs gnyas/sa/༷༷ ༷/ sa da la mu gsum da le dang sas/nga pa sngaXsardestan gzhan ge mu ge she cha kyi 'chad/〈mkha' la 'gro/〉/ni gaXrda/ ༷'di te bsdus dmyo lngas//rdze gya sngan she ra 'i dung //rnal she chan she las burashe//dzo su rnal 'byar shan tu cing nge///sna3byar dang pa dang de nasashe//dang pa phur sa gdab pa la//tang 'an gya phur sa dab dang // shesa'adren ga spo ༷sa ma'//dgra la phu/ bus ra 〉 che ༷/ sem〈grog mkhar/rdo/laga'adzo gnad byad she la rtsa ri/ sbrul kau / 'a 'a shesarni/(ye shes/༷/'a mtha' gnyas la rngo ngas gaXbaskye//'u sgor sde gi kyi tsho pa rnaX rjor da pa dung //da ya 'bras bu bshad pa'//dang pa bdu yibs sas ṭa/ra /sbyi la dngas zla ba gshe ga tsho sa rim grol/༷/pa r+sā /༷da bas5gtan lasnashegs 〈༷ 'a 〉sa//she ma rnal ྅byar pa la/gsungs pa dang na ni se gcad 'angs//she 〈dza baX bus su 〉dang gh+ra dang ni zhus da〉na//mas kya ma sdogs rnal ga sto/ra sa ban 〉gsum/'i/phya ma la zhus/dang lan/she/〈de naX rje' rge'u ༷/〉sne she pa 〈don la ye pa na 'dzi so lta〉phu'i/rdedang 'a ga/dag tha〈bajogs 〉 ka'ang/༷༷ gsum//dgas gcad gsum〈pa rlung gas lus na sa rab rtags ka'ang 'phras dang bcas//'bras bu sku gsumarde

ba4/da pa la//〈de la 'di'i sku gsum/〉/nyer len gzhi yi sku gsum dang //〈smos med/〉/skabs don dngos 〈rang byung 〉dang lus dkyil 'khor〈rtsa yi/〉/rjes su rnal 'byoja bsha/da pa la//zhus pa 〈dri ma dang 〉zhus/len gnyis//de la ngo bo 〈ston cig 〉dbye ba dang 〈a spyo bya/〉/sgra 〈rnam shes〉don dang ni rnam pa gsum//〈de phyir 〉shin tu sbyor la'ang zhu 〈spre'u 〉lan gnyis//lan la chags chen lam dgos pa'i//rgyu mtshan/ 〈nyon cig〉'phros dang bcasakhapa dang //shin tu rnal 'byor dngos dang ni//sngon 'gro 〈ha ho 〉dang ni ye shesabashad//sgra don sgo ye shes 〈nas 〉che ba bstan//dngos la gnas dang grogasardedang ni//〈mig bzang /〉/cho ga 〈dang por 〉byed pa'i dbye ba dang //〈masadang /〉yul gyi mtshan nyid bsha/da pa'o//〈zab cing /〉/ye shes la ni dga' bzhi dang 〈de las/〉/snying stobs brgyad dang 〈re bas 〉ye shes lnga//bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi dbye ba'o//〈rdo rje chu skyes/〉lnga pa mthar thug 〈'di'i rdo rje 〉khas skabasaganyis/〈dam tshig〉rnal 'byoja dang po bshad pa la/〈bar do sbyong byed udzi pa nya bskyed dang nam mkha'i//gtso bo bskyed zla ba dang 'khor tshogs spro//rang rang go cha bgod dang o ye shes bsre ye shes/〉/dbang bskur 〈ba dbang bsam dang sems 'dzan pa'o rang lta ra/rnala'abyor bzhi po re re la'ang /ming dngos de la 'di ni ches bya ba ba'i po rnams so//rgyas bshad gnyis gnyis dbye/le'u gsum pa bshad pa la dbang bskur de nas sgrol ma dkyil rdo rje'i 〉dkyil 'bor 'khordo ra sgrub pa dang /〈yang 〉'pho ba spyod 〈gsungs 〉pa dam tshigarde〈de la 'di ni 〉dang //'khru/la 'khore la brten las tshogs dang //〈de las/〉/'khru/la 'khor spangs pa'i las rnams dang //〈gas yang rtsa ba'i/〉dkyil 'khosgyur 274

'phro se dang lha yi 'phro se/ /dbang bskur bzhi pa bshad pa dang /〈'du brdo rjer〉btsan thabs sbyor dang mngon byang bshad/ /〈lha mo'i/〉dkyil 'khor 'phros ni rnam gnyis te/ /sku dang 〈yang gsung 〉gsung gi 〈de nas gsung gi〉dkyil 'khoraro/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don te dngapho/ /gnyis pa phyi ma'i rgyud la ni/ /le'u rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rgyas bshad tshul gyis bzhi pa dang / /don bsdus tshul gyis lnga pa'o/ /dang po la ni dum bu bzhi/ /rgyud kyi snying po mtshan nges pa/ /thabs gtsor gyur pa'i dum bu dang / /shes rab gtso gyur dum bu dang / /dkyil 'khor dang ni cho ga'i 'phrog /dang po sgra ni ji bzhin par/ /'bras bu'i rnam bzhag 'chad pa dang / /ji bzhin min smras legs bsha/da na/ /lam gyi gsang ba ston par byed/ /phyi ma 'a'ang rnam pa gsum/ /dbang dang bskyed rim rdzogs rim mo/ /'di dag phyag 'tshal nyeragacig dang / /spyor ba a ti sha yis bzhed/ /gnyis pa la ni dkyil 'khor dang /rgyud kyi sbyor ba bshad pa gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun rdzob don dam ste/ /dang po thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /thabs la dkyil 'khordo ra phan 〈de la rdzer ni 〉yon dang / /bskyed chog 〈ba mo 〉rnam pa'i khyad par 〈rdo rje zhe sdang 〉dang / /bsnyen pa 〈oṃ dzo la 〉dang ni las kyi sngags/ /〈oṃ a phya ti/〉mchod pa'i bya ba 〈sha r+ṣa 〉rnams kyis ni/ /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bsdus/ /shes rab sku yi dkyila'akhor dang / /〈yang gsung /〉 /phag mo'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor bstan/ /〈yang gsung ba'i phyi ma/〉 /don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ /〈de la 'a ni/〉 /—275—

rigs lnga thabs kyi so sor phye/ /ye shes lnga yi 〈sho lo ka re re 〉mtshan nyid bstan/ khres rab gtso mor bsdus te gsung / /de la zhus pa 〈de nas rdo rje 〉dang ni lan/ /lan la 〈nyon cig 〉bstan bshad bsdus gsum 〈'khor ba〉thod/ /rgyas bshad snang ba sems su bstan 〈thogs med/〉bden pa gnyis/ su bstan pa dang / /〈srid med/〉 /spros bral rang bzhin bshad pa dang 〈dri med/〉/log rtogagol sa gcod pa'o/ /〈thams cad dngos po/〉 /gnyis pa rgyud kyi sbyor ba la/ 〈de na de bzhin/〉 /sna tsho go/sa las rnams rgyas pa yi/ /sna tsho gos nyi shu'i sgrub thabasadang / /〈oṃ ma ṇi/〉 /rmug 'dzin he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ /phyag gyo sgrol mo'i dkyil 'khor dang 〈tī yig〉 /gtor ma'i cho ga 〈sngags 'dis 〉bum chog dang/〈sgrol ma'i/〉 /bgegs dang chom po bsrung ba dang 〈thag ku〉 /phag mo rmi lam/zhal blta 〈phag mo'i 〉dang / /dbang byed sgrol ma 〈sgrol ma 〉byams pa dang/ /〈byams pa'i/〉/ku ru kulbe'i gnod spyin mo 〈ku sa〉 ro langs ma yi chog gnyis/〈lho/〉 gdugs dkar can gyi cho ga dang / 〈rang nyid/〉/ sa 'ogs dros grub sgrub pa lag na dang / /gshi/na rje gshed kyi drag shul sgrub/ /〈dpa' bo/〉 /'byung po rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang / /〈gas yang /〉 mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugasadagung dang / /'jig pa brgyad skyob sngags dang ni/ /〈ma tware/〉 /las tshogs phra mo sna tshogs dang / 〈wor lo/〉 /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 〈namamakha'i 〉du/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga dang / /rdo rje slob dpon las dang ni〈sachog〉 / rgyud chen gzhan la kha 'phang dang 〈kha sbyor 〉bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ni sngags 〈oṃ ma ṇi 〉dang lha'i 〈nyi ma'i/〉/sa bon bstan pa —276—

〈hri〉gsum du dbye//mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugs dbyung la//sgrub thabs〈de nas 〉sngags dang 〈oṃ 〉las tshogs dang //〈tshe yig〉/sngon byung tshul/gyis/dkyil ga bor bstan//〈sngon tshe/〉dam tshig bsha/da 〈bud med 〉de rnam pa lnga/bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad pa la//rgyud gzhan du ni sbas pa dang〈tso yo/〉sdo bo mdo tsam brjod pa dang /〈mi shes/〉/gsum pa bzhi pa'i khyad par dang/〈skyenalas/〉/kun rdzob don dam dbye ba dang 〈las dang /〉bde ba che la zhabrul/ba bkag 〈'jig rten/〉don dam dbyings kyi gol sa bcad 〈lus dang /〉/bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin bshad//〈dngos dang /〉/de nyid dam pa'i bdag tu bstan 〈kun byed/〉/nges don 'gog lam gnyis su dbye//rang bzhin kun gzhir waṃltar 〉bshad pa dang //yon tan dbyer med bstan pa dang 〈rdzogs sangs/〉/lhun grub rdo rje bzhi rnams so//gsum pa shes rab 〈rdo rje 〉dum bu la//zhus pa dang ni zhus lan gnyis//dang po zhu ba po dang ni 〈de nas/〉/zhu ba'i rgyu dang〈ye shesasu gyur 〉zhu ba'i yul/〈bcom ldan/〉/ji ltar zhus 〈lus dang 〉pa'i tshul rnams/so//de la dri ba bcu gcig go〈ji ltar brten zhes sogs/〉/gnyis pa 'an/ labacu gcig ste//rdo rje 'chang dang rigs lnga yi//dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khorerdebarton pa dang 〈spya cig〉/bsdus rgyud gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang〈sna〉/chags chen gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang //bsnyen pa spyi yi dgos pa dang/stu༈bgi sbyor ba'i rnam bzhag dang //dga' bzhi'i lam gyi rab dbye dang/khres rabam yi dam tshig/ dang 〈dus bzhin/〉/dka' ba med pa'i lam bsha/da dang//zig/pa 〈3la pa 〉brtul zhugs spyod tshul dang //btsan thabs sbyor ba'i rab dbye

dang //mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid do//dang po 〈sems can kham sogs 〉gdul bya 〈drug 〉zhing 〈chos 'gyung 〉dang 〈'das pa'i dus sogs 〉dus/dkyila'akhong ra lam dang 〈bdag nyid bde ba che sogs drug 〉 dgos pa 〈bde nas mngon par zhen sogs 〉yis//dbye ba drug po kun la dbye//don bsdus/dbugs/dbyungaganyis su bstan 〈'dir ni/〉/bzhi pa la ni bsnyen pa dang //sgrub pa 〈sbyin thug〉sgrub chen spyod pa'o//dang po gang zag 〈sdig pa 〉sngon 'gro dang 〈bge ltar4/yan lag 〉/grogs dang gnas dang 〈bram ze 〉cho ga dang /〈bris sku/〉/phyi nasabasnyen pa chen po'o/rde〈phyi nas//sgrub r+sā gyi spyod pa 〉khyad par bdun dang sgrub pa po 〈dam tshig〉nyam/sa med bdun ldan 〈dam tshig 〉stobs bzhi tshangs 〈lha/〉/lnga pa rlung sbyor 〈g.yon pas 〉 rlung mtshan nyid 〈ste ba/〉/rlung gi sgo dang dgos pa 〈de bzhi 〉pa'o/〈byed pa'o/〉/drug pa gang zag 〈sgrub pa'i 〉gnas dang yul/〈lang tsho/〉/dga' bzhi skad cig bzhi mtshan nyid//〈lus ni/〉/'a cing / thabs〈mchog tu 〉thun mong min dgos pa//〈ṣ+ka dang 〉so so skye dang 〈chu skyes〉'phags pa yi//ra sa ma ṇi'i bde ba dang 〈rab tu/〉/chal/sa chen pa ba4/da 〈gzugs mdzes 〉de sbas dang 〈phung po/〉/nges 〈dang po 〉bstan dbangabaskur dmigs 〈nus dra'i 〉bsal dang //shes rab mchog/ gi lam bstan 〈bud med dang /〉/theg pa gzhan gyi dogs gcod do//〈'du shes/〉brgyad pa la ni don dngos dang //〈bskal pa/〉/sas kya phyag rgya'i dgos pa bshad 〈rma me/〉/dgupa 〈yang 〉gsang spyod smyon spyod dang //〈ga༈ du 〉kun bzang 〈rdzu 'phrul 〉phyogs las rnam rgyal dang //〈de nas/8〉/tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyod pa'o/

〈yang na/〉 /bcu pa btsan thabs sbyor ba drug 〈rdo rje'i sogs/〉/bcu ge rtsen pa lacho ga dang / /〈mtho par/〉 /yul dang 〈gdol ma 〉 'gro (〈dza〉 bral)tshul 〈thig le 〉'bras bu dang / /〈'di las/〉 /byang chub cho ga gzhan bstan dang 〈yang na/〉 kha spyor yan lag bshad pa'o/ /〈sangs rgyas/〉 /'dir ni dum bu bzhi pa la/ dbang bskur 'phros dang 〈yang gsung pa/〉lha yi 'phros/ /le blu/lnga pa bshad pa la gsol btab 〈de nas 〉dbang bskur 〈dpal rdo rje 〉de nyid ba4/da/ /de la bdud gzhom sbyor ba dang / /〈rab tu/〉 /mngon byang rnam lnga'i dag 'bras dang / /〈oṃ/〉 /lam dang lam gyi 〈dbang po 〉 sa mtshams bsha/da/ /〈mi gsal/〉/lta ba'i don bsdu 〈gzugs med 〉sgrub pa po'i/ /thabs mkhas rje te pa'i khyad par dang 〈dmigs dang /〉 /las rgya'i gsang ba rim 〈ji ltar〉ge nyesakyi/ /gsang ba 〈rtog pas 〉sa lam rnam bzhag dang / /gang 〈chom pas〉zagabadun bshad 〈las dang po 〉rang bzhin bstan/ /〈stong pa ma yin 〉sngags kyi dawatshig spyod pa bshad/ /〈rnal 'byor dbang po/〉 /de ltar le'u kun la yang/ /de ngosadang rang ming brjod pa'o/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me las/ khyud phyi ma'i bsdus don ste gnyis pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di bsdu na/ /rgyud gsum/ du ni rnam bsdus te/ khyu rgyud rang bzhin dang ni rgyu/ /rang bzhin ba/shad pa'i don bcu gcig/ /snang ba sems su bstan pa dang / /chos kun spros pa bral bar bstan/ /zhe lor rdeb rangardebazhin med sgrub cing / /don dam rang bzhin yod par bstan/ /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug dang / /de la sku gsum rdo rje bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor yon to —279—

dbyer med bstan/ /de nyid kun gzhir bshad pa dang / /gnas skabs rigasakyis dbye ba'o/ /de nyid rgyu ru bstan par bya/ /de la rgyu rgyud wo bo dang/ /4shi nyid dbye ba dngos brtags khyad/ /bco lnga rgyu rgyud mngon rtogs so/ /thabs rgyud mngon rtogs dbang dang lam/ /slob dpon slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang/ /bsten tshul bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang / /sa chog sta gon thig tshon las/ /'bri dang rgyan bkram sgrub pa dang / /mchod dang bdag nyid 'jug pa dang / /dkyil zhalora'ajug dang dbang bskur dang / /nyer bsdu rdul tshon bsdu ba ste/ /bo co lnga dbangagi mngon rtogs yin/ /lam la sum cu rtsa drug ste/ /dam tshig bskyed rdzogasaltab dang / /spyod pa lam gyi mngon rtogs yin/ /rab gnas spyin sreg gtoratshadang / /las tshogs rnams ni slob dpon las/ /dam tshig bsrung bya bsgrub bya gnyis/ /sgrub po mtshan nyid gnas dus grogs/ /yo byad sgom pa'i chog ste/ /bdun bdun bsnyen sgrub gnyis la dbye/ /las sbyor sgrub po'i mtshan nyid dang / /rdzas sngags bsam gtan lha bskul ba'i/ khyad par lnga dang ldan parabazhed/ /rdzogs rim la ni rnal 'byor gsum/ /lta ba thun mo pa thun mong min/ /'khrul ba'i gol sa bcad de gsum/ /spyod pa ngo bo nges tshig dus/ /dbye ba chog 'bras bu'o/ /dbye na thun mong brtul zhugs dang / /nye rgyu mngon par byangachub gnyis/ /dang po la ni rnam pa lnga/ /las kyi tshogs la las de ngos grub/ /las la sangs rgyas lha rnams kyi/ /cho ga dang ni las phal ba/ /phyi ma 'thoralol bsten dang / /ma bsten gnyis su mkhas rnams bzhed/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes dang / /'phrin las rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /sku ni gnyis dang gsum dang —280—

bzhi//ye shes rnam pa lnga zhes bstan//'phri/na las nges pa dbugs dbyungadrug/ma nges rnam pa sna tshogs so//de ltar don bsdus bla mo'i gsung//gzhan yang rgyud kyi tshad dang ni//dkyil 'khor dang ni lha'i sgrub thabs//dbang chogadang ni las tshogs dang //bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bsam gtan dang //ṭa sdosagrub cho ga 'bras bu dang //lam gyi che ba bstan pa dang //dngos po'i rangabazhin bshad pa yis//rgyud don thams cad bsdus so zhes//mar me mdzad dpal ye shes gsungs//sgom bya shes bya'i rang bzhin dang //sgom po sgrub po'i rab dbye dang //'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig dang //sgom tshul rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang //rnam pa dkyil snyen ra 'khor lo dang //sgrub bya las dang de ngos grub dang /thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ces//don bsdus bya zhes mkhas pa'i mchog/slob dpon mi yi nyi ma gsung //gzhan rnams gang dag sngar bstan zin//dkyil 'khor sku gsung thugs gsum dang //he ru ka gnyis/dbugasadabyung drug/mi g.yo dbugs dbyung phag mo ste//dngos su bstan pa bcu gnyisaso//mchog sgrub rnams kyi don du gsung //byams pa rta mgrin 'jigs pa brgyad//skyob byed gnyis dang blo 'phel ba'i//sgrol ma dkar mo lha lnga dang //'od zer can dang dka' zlog dang //sum bha lag na rdo rje sogs//lasatshogs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro//dag pa'i slob mas slob dpon la//yangayang gsol ba btab gyur na//nyin bdun bya'am yang na gzhan//dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byin//ji srid dbang bzhi ma rdzogs pas//de srid rgyud rgyal bshad mi bya//phyi nas rnal 'byor la gnas pas//thun re lhun rer yor8

ma dbul//srung phyaXrde ma is bzi ma rdzo dang she//gsol gsum bto stonyan bshad bya//bla gras chung la mad tsam dang //bla ldan rnams la rgyas/paraspyod//rdzo gi sbyor ba la dga' bas//de la gtso bor sgra don dang //be bye yin/rde rgya ri 0ri 0ri ge 7 rdo)rde the / rde lta bu' gang zag la//man ngag shan tu zha 1 ba gri / snar bstan/// rdo//sasaganang bzlas lung sogs//mtha' dag 'a ma pa zhi me spre/ 'i rmogasardepa lko mi sa/sa/slob lton 'a ༷ a ta sha/rang ba med she khosub sa//sa ya nya ma gzha dus kya/༷/gas da she thams cad rgyud du 'dad/khrus wo zha pre ci / zhal snga nas//sems nyad ༵/ stang zung 'jag gsus//de yangashe pa sheX ye/she/phal pa la yo ldeb med kun yang /khyu o tsam par 'jag ga gsung //dā ba nam snang sher ba da//'a she5du zhugs na 'gyu/ra//thabs kya rgyud nal ma kha nar//ḍā ta gup+ta ni lo/salardegasungs//lam 'a 'a su bla ma she//gtan sags kyang she yo yi lasnang //lte rna zhag dam tshi sheX'adad//bla ma' 'anga~X srag na gsung //spyad rdi rdzo rdzugs sa 'ad/sdud pa 'ad nyad shega~Xparashes //'a 'a she bskyed ram she//sa rim rdzo su rim gyi / na//pha nya' lam na shan tu 'dad//rang luX/ rdzags ma ye si ba / zhe//'bras/she bcas ༷ rnal 'byor che//rnal stir la kying rnal stir ba//las rgya dun dum she/ da dang //zab lam nges 'a par bzhed/gi/'bras bu kha bzhi ngas kau ta//sku dngas rdzo / sbru snang gnyas/'i/rang khu tshan phyir / gzhan ba po//ldag cha tha dad ngo ba gag8/snang ba sems kya rgyu mtshan ra//gzhan

snang gdul bya'i sems kyis bsdus/ /rang snang gis bsdus zhing la sogs/ /thams cad ngo bo gcig ye shes/ kha cig gnyis snang yod par 'dod/ /gzhan dag snang bo med par 'dod/ /de na rgyal ba 'khrul bcas 'gyur/ /kun rdzobamisnang ye shes snang / /mthon da shas ldan pas gzhan dag gi /rmi lam bzhin tu kun rdzob ni/ /bdag nyid la ni mi snang yang / /gzhan la 'khrul ba snang ba mkhyen/ /stong nyid bem por smra rnams kyis/ /rgyud 'di zugad par mi nus pa ga /ye shesadam pa'i don can du/ /'jog pa rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gzigs yul dang / /so so skye bo'i blo ngo gnyis/ /mtshungs 'o dod de dgasangs rgyas la/ /shin tu bskur 'debs ma yin nam/ /de phyir chos nyid rangarig pa/ /bde chen rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /rnam dbyer med don nges pa dang / /kun rdzob med dang don dam pa/ /yod cing rig par 'jog pa ni/ khyud rdze'i chos skad rtsa ba yin/ /'khor ba gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ /sbyangs pas dgapar 'gyur gsung ba/ /bden med tsam la dgongs zhe na/ /rgyal ba'i ye shesakyang de ltar/ /sbyangs pas dag par 'gyur ro zhes/ khyed cag lugs la thalamin nam/ /des na rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di/ /rang blo'i lam du mi 'dren cing/ /gzhung gi dngos su ches gsal ba/ /bshad pa de de bskyang bar byos/ /bsdusadon gsal ba'i sgron me las brjod bya don gyi bsdus don ste gsum pa'o/ /gang zhig nges pa'i mtshan ma las/ /rnam par rnyed pa'i spyi btolo gyis/ /rgyud don rgya mtshor zhugs pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi bzod par mdzod/ /slob dpon gnas brten mar me mdzad dpal dang/ /mkhas pa nyi mas rnam phye'i —283—

legs bshad dang / /he ru ka dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung / /ji bzhin rnyed pa zhi ba'i man ngag rnams/ /legs par rdo rje slob dpon zhal snga nag /blo ldan dmapa 'ga' las lan gsum thos/ /rgyud rgyal kun gyi nges gsang mthong ba na/ /don bsdus tshigs bcad mar me lta bu brtsams/ /dge 'di'i blo ldan rnams kyi rgyud kyi don/ /ji bzhin rab rtogs rdo rje theg 'di yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la byangachub mchog gzhol ba/ /rdorje 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'grub gyur cig khres pa 'di ni 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bsdus don ste rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par sbyar ba'o// //—284—

ya shes 'bar ba bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/ na mo gu ra we/ thugs rje chen pos 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gang gis dran pa tsam la'ang dngos grub mchog /stsol mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs pad la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal legs par bca'/ /dang por maṇ+ḍal mchod pa/ dung chos gnyis rnams 'dus byas te/ thun mong spyi'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga bya ste/ yo byad spyi la dmigs nas/ skye( āXka ta kṛ ta hūX huX/ lan bdun/ dung chos la dmigs nas/ skye( āXbadz+re h+phe huX swāhā/ lan gsum/ skye( khyiXswāhā/ kha bkru/ tsho( khaXswāhā/ gdong bkru/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ āXsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX swāhā/ lus thams cad bkru'o/ /oṃ āXhuX/ oṃ sta badz+ra ā sa ni huX/ gdan la reg oṃ dzo pā pa na/ ba na ye huX phaṭa/ sna g.yon nas bus/oṃ ma ṇi dha ri ba dzī ṇi mahā pra ti re hūṃ hūṃ phag phaṭa swā hā ra rak+ṣa sa bi khyuX oṃ āḥbadzo da ke hūṃ ri lan gsums ṇ+ḍal chus byugs/ tshe badz+ra go ma ye swāhā/lan gsum byug tshul bya/ na mo bha ga ba te pukhye ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya a ra ha te sa myaklaX bud+dhā ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ puspro pu 〉 mahā pur+sha su bug bu thi we puṅge paṃ bha we pu phye spo swāhā/ me tog la reg oṃ badz+ra sa tā sa sde nu ta snga ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ maṇ+ḍal —285— —

lag pas mnan/ oṃ badz+ra re khe su re khe huX/ mtha' skor ro/ /ba yi gci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /yang dag byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /srog chags legs par bsal ba bzod pa dang / /bya ba nye bar gnas pa brtson 'grus so/ /sems rtse gcig de'i skad cig bsam gtan no/ /ri mo legs par 'bar ba shes rab nyid/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs par byas na ni/ /pha rol phyin drug de rnams thob par 'gyur/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang / /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las cher lhag cing / /zla ba 'dra ba'i gzi brdzid 'bar/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid/ /oṃ su re khe (〈j-i〉 rtse badz+ra le kha a dhi ti grin ) sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi — ti slarja swāhā/ oṃ waXswāhā/ oṃ tsa stan bi ma le swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa tī no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi sgo me bha ba/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra byu sa spru kasmi su tsa me/ tsit+taX shrī yaXku ru hūX/ha ha ha ha hoX bha ga bā na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badz+re bha ba mahā sa ma ya satwa aX (〈dze+e〉 rtse badz+ra la khe adhi ti zla spyo/) oṃ haX su me ru ma dha ma na maX dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ yaX bi de ha dī pa ya na maX shar lus 'phags po/ raX dzasbu dī pa ya na maX lho dzasbu gling / lāX (〈dze+e〉 a pa ra ) go da nī dī pa ya na maXnub ba glang spyod/ waX ku ru dī ba ya na maX byang sgra mi snyan/ ya u pa di pa ya na maXyā u pa dī pa ya na maX shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ ra u pa di pa ya na maXrā u pa dī pa ya na maX ltor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ la u pa: lā u pa:nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ wa u pa: wā u pa byang du sgra mi snyan dang / sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ yā glang po rin po che na maX rā khyim bdag rin po che na —286—

maX lā rta mchog rin po che na maX wā bud med rin po che na maX yaXral gri rin po che na maX raXnor bu rin po che na maX laX'akhor lo rin po che na maX wāXgater chen rin po che na maX oX aX zla ba/ oṃ a nyi ma / oX oX 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhing dang 'byor pa ma tshang ba med pa kun tu bzang pos byas pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab stims kyi ngo bo nyid na ma rin chen sna tshogs rang bzhin nyid/ /ri rab lcog brgyad nye bar mdzes/ /gling bzhi gling phran ldan pa 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oX badz+ra ā tsar+ya bud+dhā bo dhi sa te khyuX badz+ra kro dha rā dze khyuX badz+ra sa mā dzaX badz+ra ka ma la khyuX ti gro sgri ā sa naX/ dzaXhūX baX hoX oX gu ru badz+ra dha ra hūX/ oX āX.a mo gha sidhi hūṃ/ oX āX.ak+ṣi khyuXhūX/ lkoX āXrat+na sam+bha ba hūX/ oX āX.a mṛ ta bha ba hūX/ oX āXbe+e ro tsa na huX/ oX ā sa ma ya tā ra huX/ oX āXbud+dhā lo tsa na huX/ oX āXmā ma ki hūX/ oX āXbaṇ+ḍa rā huX/ oX āXbadz+ra dha tī shwa ri hūX/ oX āXya mun+ta krita hūX skyoX/ oX āXpra rnyen+ta kri ta huX hūX/ oX āXpad+man+ta kri ta huX huX/ oX ba lha n+ta krita hūX hūX/ oX āX nywa huX khaX hiXskaX saX dzaXhuX baX hoXkhaX raX hūX/ oX badz+ra satwa skyoX/ lkoX āXdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma yang dag pa'i ye shes gsa'/ bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /huX khyod la phyag 'tshal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed la phyag 'tshal khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag ni gus pas khyed la phyag 'tshal gyi/ /bla ma mgon pos bdag la thugs rjes gzung / /byis pa rmongs pa dag gis ni/ /gang yang rang bzhin sdig nga/ dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho nyid/ /sdig pa cung zad gang bsags pa/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar gnas bcas te/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang du yang du —287—

phyag byas nas/ /nongs pa de dag bshags par bgyi/ /byang chub snying poraspomachis kyi bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ / skyob pa'i cho sa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'os sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnams dang / /tshul khrims bzang ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams dang / sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang /spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtshan nyid dang / rang bzhin gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang spyin pa dang sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /'di la bdag gis nyi ma'i snang ba dang / /mun pa ji lta de bzhin nyid du ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi sdug bsngal gzhil ba dang / /bde ba spel ba yang ni dus mnyam gyur/ / mthong thos rjes su dran dang 'ong ba dang / /reg dang gto gyi sbyor ba nyer thob pa/ /rnam pa kun gyi 'gro la phan byed du/ /rtag par phan dang bde ba rnams bgyi'o/ /oX āXdu ta kṛ ta huX/ oX āXhuX/ lan mang du brjod/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal a dhi pa ti badz+ra ā tsar+ya gu ru tsa ra ṇa ya badz+ra put+paX pra nywa smo na maX lan bdun/ oX āX.a mo gha sirnyi huX badz+ra put+paX pra tismo na maX lan gsum/ oX āX.ak+ṣi khyuXhūX badz+ra put+paX pra titsā na maX lan snyag /de bzhi tu rat+na saX bha ba a mṛ ta bha ba/ be+e ro tsa na (〈dzaX〉 rtse nyu 1 / lkoX —288—

āXs ma ya tā ra nyunye/ oX āXbud+dhā )lo tsa na/ mā ma ki /baṇ+ḍa rī: badz+ra dha tī shwa ringuya mun+ta krita: pradz+nyā rnya krita: pa dhan+ta krita: bi gha nan ta krita: rnams la'ang sbyar/ oX āX nywa huX khaX hruXska saX badz+ra puṣ+ṭhaX pra tismo na maX oX āXdzaXhūX baX hoX khaX raX badz+ra pu yiX pra titsā na maX de bzhin du/ badz+ra purmye'i gnas su badz+ra dhu paX dang / badz+ra dī paX dang badz+ra ga rnye dang / badz+ra nai wi te dang / badz+ra ak+ṣa ta/ badz+ra ba sa na rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang bcas te/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi sogs dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ rgyas par na/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i bstod pa logs su yod pa ltar yang bya mod kyi/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro sogs kyi skabs/ de tsam gyis chog go /bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ngam pa stsal tu gsol/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang / / gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa'i/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs/ / oX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /tseX( āXhuX muXgasnro ga smo swa bhā ba naX/ gang zhig kun tu rtog pa bcom pa chos kyi skur brjod dang / /dpe med bde ba'i cha yis mdzes pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /srid na phan pa mdzad phyir sprul pa yi ni sku gang yin/ / bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' des ni khyed la bde legs mdzod/ /de dag ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi maṇ+ḍal te sngon du bya ba'o/ /sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs 'di nges par mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len la ma 'grub kyang mngon —289—

rtogs kyi cho ga'i yan lag chad par mi 'gyur ro/ / de nas sgrub thabs dngos la 'jug ste/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang /sdig sgrib thams cad dag lkoX badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces maṇ+ḍal bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan brtsegs par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa arka bi ma le rdza hā/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ dbus nas brtsams te lha rnams la g.yas skor gyis mchod pa phul bar bsam nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ar+ghaX nas/shabha'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ oX las byung ba'i me tog 'bul bzhin du/ na mo bha ga wa te put+pa ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myaklaX buṅgā ya/ ta bya thā/ oX put+pa pukhye mahā pukhre su pulpe/ put+pa udha be ngu khye (〈rja〉 rgosaX bha we puṣ+ṭha a pa ) ki ra ṇi swāhā/ zhes pa bzla bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes sems bskyed la/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btang pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim/ tshad med bzhi yun ring du bsgom/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/bdag nyid kyang thugs ka'i tāX la thim/ snang ba tsam gyi rnam shes ni/ /sems tsam du ni rnam par brtag /nam mkha' rdo rjer gnas sems 'di/ /chos can —290—
