med cing chos nyid med/ /sa bon de nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/oṃ shu rgya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang sems sgrol ma skyabs sbyin dang ut+pal 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas nam mkhar bzhag la (〈rja〉 chaganas par gyur/) rang sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i yaX raX waX laX suX rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab skad cig gis grub pa ni/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su zla gam gyi rnam pa ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ri bdun dang rol pa'i mtsho bdun dang / rgya mtsho chen po gling bcu gnyis dang bcas pa rnams khor yug gi ri bros yongs su bskor ba/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyis nye bar brten pa'o/ /ri rab kyi rtse mor pad nyi la huX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ byang ser/ nub dmar/ lho sngo/ lte ba ljang khu huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ me ri 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang huX gi 'od kyis bgegs bskrad/ skye( sdo/myu ni sdo/lha huX hūX phaṭa/ glu rna gro hā gro hā huX huX phaṭa/ skye rna grihā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wa na bi du rā dza huX hūX phaṭa/ khro bo —291—

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog nag po nye ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can phur bu dang tho ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bgegs lhag ma rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ rkang mthil gyi bar du phyung ste brlag par byas/ oṃ badz+ra ki li gī la ya sarba bighān ba dha hā phaṭa/ de dag gi rnam par shes pa yi ge a'i rnam pas gnas pa la/ hu zhes lan mang du bzlas pas/ ma dra5sa pa'i sems thams cad dang bral bar byas nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ o ka ka ni ka ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ hro ṭa ni hro ṭa ni/ tru sa ni t+yā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ra pa ra ṇi me swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas de'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing / bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs te/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dngos grub ཿnga ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ shing brgyad dang / phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang / zhing skyong brgyad dang / chu brgyad dang / me brgyad dang / ro dang ro langs dang / sha za dang / srin po dang /dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / sha rus dang / bya dang / gcan zan dang / grub pa pho mo dang / mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang /dngos grub kyi rdzas du mas gang ba'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i yi ge bhu rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin can yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/byang ser/ nub dmar/ lho sngo ba/ de'i nang du las kyi snam bu rim pa lnga ste/ dang —292—

po zhi ba'i las snam dkar po/ de'i phyi rol rgyas pa'i las snam ser po/ de'i phyi ru sna tshogs pa'i las snam phyogs re rer g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ dkar ser ljang dmar sngo ba/ de'i phyi rol du dbang gi las snam dmar po/ de'i phyi ru drag po'i las snam nag po ste/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi gnas gzhan rnams su me tog sna tshogs la mngon par bkram zhing / drag po'i las snam la/ mtsho ni chas gtubs pa'i mi'i yan lag mngon par bkram pa/ dbus sngon po ut+pal dmar po sil mar gtong ba'i gzhi la/ rdo rje'i mu khyud zlum po'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing / ka ba barmyed dang ldan pa/ nang le tshe dgur gyur pa'i dbus dang sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su zla ba/ sgo bzhir nyi ma/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oX dkar po las byung ba'i zla ba nya gang ba la/ a ā i yī u mū/ ṛ phru/ le lī/ e i/ o au/ aX aXrnams kyis mtshan pa'o/ / de'i steng du āXdamar po las byung ba'i nyi ma 'ong 'bar ba la/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaXrnams kyis mtshan pa'o/ /nam mkha'i lha mo zla ba la thim/ zla ba'i dbus su tāX ljang sngon/ de las ut+pal sngon por gyur/ de thams cad las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ tāX la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma rnam 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ sku mdog sngo zhing yid tsam ljang ba/ pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog spyin/ gnyis —293—

pa na gri gug /gsum pa na cang tes bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na ka pā la khrag gis gang ba/ gsum pa na mdung rtse gsum/ bzhi pa na me tog gi gzhu 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du rdo rje kha ṭā ga bsgreng pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs dang / rus pa'i phyag rgyas sku la brgyan cing / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / mgo rlon gyi 'phreng ba dang / ut+pal dmar po'i do shal 'phyang ba/drag mo chen mo/ /spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing / dbu skra nag po phyed bcings shing phyed grol ba/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs shing / phyi rol tu me dpung 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /bshad rgyud las ni zhal lnga pa/ dbu skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhengasapar bshad do/ /rang gi thugs ka nas grwa hā dang / oṃ yig dang / ho yig dang / phaṭa yig dang / tā la/ ta ma/ tā pa/ tā hu/ dza nyu ba ho zhes pa rnams phyir spros te gdan la 'khod pa ni/ le tshe brgyad la/ shar du snyu hā/ las zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo ngang pa la zhon cing chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /byang du oṃ las rgyas pa'i sgrol ma ser mo glang po che la bzhon cing sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ cung zad sha nyams rgyas shing dgyes pa'i nyams can no/ /nub tu ho las dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo rta dmar po la bzhon —294—

pa me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa 'dzin pa chags pa'i nyams can no/ /lhor phaṭa las drag po'i sgrol ma nag mo ma he sngon po la bzhon cing rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa khros pa'i nyams can no/ shar lhor tā la las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ /lho nub tu tā mā las rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ /nub byang du tā pā las chos kyi sgrol ma dmar mo/ /byang shar du tā hū las rdo rje'i sgrol ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas ḍā ma sa g.yon gyi dang pos rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i ut+pal/gnyis pas mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ khyad par gzhan ni gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor dza las lcags kyu sgrol ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor hu las zhags pa sgrol ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor ba las lcags sgrog sgrol ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ho las dril bu sgrol ma ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang khro mo'i nyams can sbom zhing thung ba/ phyag g.yon thugs kar sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa/ stag lpags dang mgo 'phreng dang sprul gyis brgyan cing / me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na mi ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /da ni pho nya mo rnams spro bar bya ste/ las bzhi'i sgrol ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis spros te las kyi snam bu dbus ma'i phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du 'khod pa ni/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re spa ra ṇa hu phaṭa/ lan —295—

brgyad brjod/ ma hā la kha hi dza phaṭa phaṭa/ shar gyi g.yas na rmongs byed ma/ /lug la bzhon cing rtse gsum sbrul/ /g.yon na dug kun gzhil mdzad pa/ /mkha' lding la bzhon bum pa bsnams/ /gnyis car mdog dkar cung zad khro/ /byang gi g.yas na rengs byed ser/ /rus sbal la bzhon lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /g.yon na gnon byed khams ser ni/ /ri rab la bzhon ri rab 'dzin/ /gnyis ka'ang stobs ldan blun po'i gzugs/ /nub kyi g.yas na 'gugs byed ma/ /ha ri ṇa bzhon lcags kyu dang / /zhags pas bsgrub bya 'dren cing rgyug /g.yon na 'debs byed phur bu 'dzin/ /rab g.yo rlung la bzhon pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams/ /lho yi g.yas na skrod byed ma/ /dbyug to 'dzin cing rnga mong bzhon/ /g.yon na 'byed byed gri lcags sgrog /khwa dang lug pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gnyis ka'ang dud kha shin tu khros/ /yang 'byed byed ma srub shing 'dzin pa ma he dang rta la gnas pa bsgom pa'ang yod do/ /de nas phyag brnyan rnams spro ba ni/gtso mo'i thugs ka nas hū zhes spros te/ /nang gi gra bzhir 'khod pa ni/ khar lhor gshin rje gshed po nag /zhal drug phyag drug zhabs kyang drug /g.yas rnams tho ba g.yon zhags pa/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug zhabs kyis mnan/ /lho nub mi g.yo mi g.yo ba/ /nag po ral gri thod pa 'dzin/ /brgya byin dbang ldan zhabs kyis mnan/ /nub byang rta mgrin sku mdog dmar/ /phyag bzhi dbyug to pad+ma dang / /'khor lo dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /dbu yi steng du rta mgo ljang / /klu dang yi dwags rgyal po mnan/ /byang shar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag /phyag bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /dril bu tho ba phur bu 'dzin/ /log 'dren 'dod lha zhabs —296—

kyis mnan/ /thams cad stobs chen pha rol gnon/ /sbom thung spyan gsum stag lpags dkris/ /sbrul gyis brgyan cing skra yang brdzes/ /me dpung 'bar zhing sprul pa dang / /yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oX dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs kar hūX sngon po/gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la mig tu lkoX tā re swāhā dkar po/ rna bar oṃ tu stu re swāhā sngon po/ lce la oX tu swāhā dmar po/ snying gar oX re swāhā sngon po/ spyi bor oX tā re ṇi swāhā ljang khu/ mig tu khriX dkar po sa'i snying po'i ngo bo/ rna bar dzi nag po phyag na rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snar khaX ser po nam mkha'i snying po'i ngo bo/ lcer gaX dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo/ dpral bar skaX ljang gu sgrib pa rnams sel gyi ngo bo/ lte bar saX sngon po kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i dbus su dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje rta'i rgyal po rab tu khros pa sku mdog sngo sangs/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal spyan gsum pa/ steng zhal rta gdong sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan nga'i ral gri dang / g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje/mda' dang / gtun shing 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis thod pa/ gzhu dang / dgra sta bsnams pa/ stag lpags dang / dar dang / nas pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du lha dang lha min thams cad gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i ut+pal/ de'i steng du tāX yig ljang sngon 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od —297—

zer lcags kyu lta bus rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX h+pha/ zhes brjod cing 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ (〈dze+e〉 ye shes pa )rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs par bsam oX badz+ra aX ku sha dzaX oX badz+ra pā sha hūX/ oṃ badz+ra slo ṭa baX/ oX badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoX oX yo ga shudhaXsarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3haX/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun du spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma ki dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams byung ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ laX maX paX taX hūX hūX badz+ra a bhi ṣañca hūX/ zhes chu dbang dang / oṃ bhuX aX dzi khaX hūX hūX rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khri nyu hūX/ zhes cod pan dang / oṃ huX khaX huX/ badz+ra a bhi tañca hūX/ zhes rdo rje dang / oṃ huX hāX huX badz+ra a dhi pa tī stuX a bhi ṣañca hūX/ zhes dril bu dang / oṃ dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra sa tā stuX badz+ra nā ma a bhi khri nyu huX/ zhes ming dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi huX/ zhes brtul zhugs dang / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje semang/ dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /āXsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' —298—

mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /yid kyi las su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi khiñca hūX su ra ta stuX a haX/ zhes de yan chad bum dbang dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma dang dpal don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khar byin par bsam/ oṃ aXhūX zhes brjod pas gsang dbang dang / bdag nyid yab tu gyur pa la dbang gi lha mo de rnams gcig tu 'dus pa dam tshig sgrol mar gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la phyag rgyar gtad/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ zhes shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ dbang dgu yang dag par blang ba'o/ /dbang gi lha rnams rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par gyur te/ lha rnams kyi cod pan du bzhugs pa ni/ gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ 'khor thams cad la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ ar+ghaX nas shas li bar gyis mchod/ mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'am/ mtshan nges par grags pas bstod de/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang / g.yo ba'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs —299—

rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ma/ ye shes dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ (〈ju〉 rdo rje cod pan lnga dang ldan pa/) 'gyung ba rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen po/shin tu phra ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/ sgra sgrog dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ba ma/ rnam par gshegs pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o/ /de skad kyang bka' stsal to/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāX gi mthar/ yi ge bcu pas g.yas skor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing / lkoX tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ tā re tu re tu stu re huX phaṭa/ ces bzla ba ni sku'i bzlas pa'o/ /tseX( tā re swāhā/ zhes pa ni gsung gi bzlas pa'o/ /tseX( āXtāX huX zhes pa ni thugs kyi bzlas pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wā lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ mahā sa tā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ta du thā/ oX tā re tu stu re tu re sarba du ni/ pra —300—

du ni/ ma ma kṛ te/ dzaX bha ya/ staX bha ya/ mo ha yaX/ ban+ta ya/ huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/sarba du niX staX bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes pa ni las kyi sngags so/ /oX tā re tu stu re tu re huX phaṭa/ oX tā re shwarnyi du ru swāhā/ oX tā re punyung ku ru lkoX/ lkoX tā re wa sha ma nā ya hoX.oX tā re ni wa rā ya phaṭa/ lkoX ta thā ga ta tā re laX huX/ lkoX rat+na tā re māX huX/ oX pad+ma tā re pāX hūX/ oX badz+ra tā re hūX hūX/ oX a du sha twa re dzaXskyoX/ oX pa sha tā re huX skyoX/ lkoX shwe kha la tā re baX huX/ oX gaṇ+ḍi tā re hoXhūX/ oṃ mo hā nī tā re maX hūX/ oX pra sha ma ni tā re swāhā hūX/ oX staX bha ni tā re laX huX/ oX nga ni tā re khaX hūX/ lkoX ā kar+ṣa ni tā re hraXhūX/oX gī la ka tā re dzaXhuX/ oX u khya ḍā ka tā re phaṭa huX/ oX dī ṣa ka tā re phaṭa hūX/ lkoX ya mun+ta ka hūX phaṭa/ oX ka ni dhu ni huX phaṭa/ oX ha ya shrī ba hūX phaṭa/ oX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍale hūX phaṭa/ ces pa mtshan sngags kyi 'phreng bar grags pa rnams dang / oX āXkro bye ka ya mun+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūX phaṭa/ lkoX a tsa la kā na tses tses mos mos dra ṭa rus gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūX phaṭa/ oX pad mun+ta tshwa ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya hṝ ba hūX/ hu lu hu lu hūX phaṭa/ na ma sa man+ta budhe spyo na mo mahā badz+re kro dha ya/ mahā raXsgo t+pa ka ṭa bhi ṣa na ghi ra bā ya/ badz+ra san do ha da r+sā ya lkoX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūX phaṭa/ khro bo bzhi'i rtsa sngags su grags pa rnams kyang bzla'o/ /de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dang po rjes su bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma/ mi 'jigs pa spyin pa'i phyag rgya dang ut+pal thogs pa brgyad spros te/ sems can rnams kyi 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug bskyabs par bsams la/ lkoX oX swāhā/ oX tā swāhā/ oX re swāhā/ oX tu ta swāhā/ oX tā swāhā/ oX re swāhā/ oX tu swāhā/ oX re swāhā/ zhes bzlas par bya ste/ 'jigs pa las yongs su skyobs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /gnyis pa tshar bcad pa ni/ hūX ring po lan nyi shu —301—

rtsa lnga brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad thugs rje chen pos bskul te shin tu ches khros shing 'khrugs par bsam/ der pho nya phyag brnyan bcu gnyis po rnams las/ sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo mtha' yas pa spros te/ ma rungs pa gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ na maXsan+ta kā ya lwastsit+ta badz+ra ṇaX/ oṃ ṭak+ki huX dzaXzhes lan gsum brjod pas/ pho nya lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs kyi gtso bo bdud bzhi la sogs pa dang / gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin thams cad bkug /hūX zhes brjod pas 'brub khung gru gsum pa zab cing yangs par gyur/ de'i nang du gnod byed thams cad kyi yan lag zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gis bsdams te/ phaṭa kyi sgras mgon skyabs dang bral bar byas/ na maXs man+ta brnye sbyoX oṃ tā re tu ltu re tu re sarba du giX gī li gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces thugs ka nas phur bu'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ hūX gi sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs la/ na maXs man+ta budhe rtsoX na mo (〈dze+e〉 mahā ) badz+ra kro dha ya/ mahā rda spyo ta ka ṭa (〈lbo〉 rtse bhi ṣa ṇa )bhe ra bā ya/ badz+ra sa sdo ha da nā ya/ oṃ a rmi ta kuṇ+ḍali huX phaṭa/ sarba duXni gī li gī la ya huX phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la bka' bsgos pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa spros/ gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyi dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang / snying ga dang lte ba dang gsang ba dang tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang dbang po lnga la sogs pa rnams su phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs par bsams la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba sdos na phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūX hūṃ huX badz+ra ki la ya/ sa ma ya dha rā udz+nyā pa ya ti/—302—

sarba du/ kā ya wa stsit+ta badz+ra ki la ya hū phaṭa/ ces lan gsum bzlas la/ o tā re tut+ta re tu re badz+ra gī li gī la ya sarba du gi ban+ta hu phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzla/ o za ya la/ zhes 'brub khung gi kha la las byung ba'i ri rab kyis bcad pas/ bskal pa'i bar du gdug pa'i sems can rnams thar pa med par bcings par bsam/de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ ar+gha nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod cing / lha dang lha min cod pan sogs kyis bstod nas/ thams cad rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/badz+ra sa ma ya hū/ zhes brjod/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rang gi lus la thim rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i tā la thim/ de yang cha lnga'i rim pas nā da la bsdus/ de yang stong pa nyid du thim par gyur/ ā zhes brjod cing rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la gnas par gyur/ gzhan yang gzungs kyi sgo ci rigs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de las nges par ldang ba na/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gyur/ zhes lha'i skur bltas te thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug cing / gal te gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ sha khrag myong dang byi kyu la sogs pa'i gtor ma byas la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlung ra las me/ o ā hū las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/ de rnams kyi steng du a las ka pā la'i nang du/ dbus su hū las sha chen dang rkang mar/ shar du oṃ las ba glang gi sha dang dri chen/ byang du hā las glang po che'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu hi las rta'i sha dang khu ba/ lhor a las khyi'i sha dang rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su o yigade'i steng du ā las zla phyed/ hū las rdo rje oṃ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams zhu ste bdud rtsi dkar por gyur/ dri ma thams cad phyir lud ā zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi dmar por gyur/ kha dog dang dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par byas/ hū —303—

zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi kha dog sna tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par spel zhing spros/ o yig zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te bdud rtsi la thim/ zla phyed rdo rje oṃ yig dang bcas pa yang zhu zhing thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ha ho khyo swāhā de nas/ h+pha gyi sgras/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor snyen ra dang bcas pa mdun du badz+ra sa mā dzartsa sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa'am/ sarba sdo lco sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañja ka ma ma shin+ta rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes btanas pas gtso mo dang / na ma sa man+ta bud+dhā bo dhi satwa nā a pra ti ha ta shwa sa nā/ he he bha ga ba te mahā satwa sarba brnya a ba 'e1 ki te mā bi la sba mā bi la sba e da ba ling gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hū hū hu sarba bi sañca re swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la phul la/ dur khrod gnas pa rnams la/ a bhi dha na'am/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las 'byung ba ltar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya'o/ /mchod bstod gsol btab yan lag bdun pa sogs rjes kyi bya ba dang bcas pa rnams bya'o/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ dri mas sems nyid mngon bsgom pas/ /rnam shes ye shes dag mi 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog gi bgrod pa'i gnas/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dngos po bden brdzun rnam dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong / /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ hū zhes bya ba ni ye shes dang ldan pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ phaṭa ces bya ba ni dgas par byed pa'i gzungs yi sgo'o/ /t+yā zhes bya ba ni nyi ma'i 'od —304—

kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /a zhes bya ba ni smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/rde /ha zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i gzungs kyi po pa/ /hru zhes bya ba ni rjes su chags pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /o zhes bya ba ni lus 'jig nga/ra byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ kha zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/rde /a zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /k+ṣa zhes bya ba ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i gzungs kyi pol/ /ā zhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ya zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i rlung ste gzungs kyi sgo gi /ra zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i me ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /wa zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i chu ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sa ste gzungs kyi sgo ro /ta zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sems te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /i zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i dbang po rnams te gzungs kyi snyo /bi zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams su byad pa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o / /ā zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /rnam shes ye shes rnal 'byor te/ /de dag rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor la ni rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /zhes gang gsungs pa de'o/ /des na lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa de yang gzungs kyi sgo la sogs pa sna tshogs pas rnam par dpyad nas/ spros pa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi stong pa nyid la 'jug pa ni lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su bsnan cing bsgom par bya ba yin pas rjes su rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ yang gsungs pa/ spre'u dang glog ltar mi gnas pa/ /rab tu gzung bar dka' ba'i sems/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /gser khams rdo la rnam gnas pa/ /mngon par zhi ba yod ma yin/ /sreg dang dbye ba'i —303—

thabs kyis ni/ /nyi ma bzhin du rnam par gsal/ /lcags bzhin me la rnam bzod na/ /gzhan dag ci phyir mi bzod byed/ /'di yi ye shes rnam shes dag /cha gnyis rnam par rtog mi bya/ /cha gnyis las ni sdig pa 'byung / /sdig pas bsod nams zad par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa zhes brjod de/ /bla med bde ba bsod nams so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam gyur pa/ /bsod nams sdig med rnam par thar/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs te/ /dge dang sdig pa rnam par 'byed/ /bu mo'i longs spyod bde ba yis/ /rnam par mi rteg gnyis med 'grub/ /ri bo nyams ni dga' ba dang / /nags tshal dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan gzung / /dang por 'dus pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje cho gas rab tu bsgrub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /dam tshig chen mor byin gyis rlabs/ khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu brkyang ba dang / khab dang gru mo'i mtshan nyid bya/ /bung ba lta bur i yi sgra/ /nges par blo dang ldan pas bskul/ /sgeg 'chos stabs kyis 'phyud nas ni/ /mgo bo'i skra bzung lkog ma gzir/ /ma mchus sbrang rtsi gzhib par bya/ /zhes sogs nas/ 'dar dang dran pa nyams pa dang / /skra grol gcer bu gsher bas khyab/ /mdog dmar rab tu phra ba'i mig /ye shes lnga yis rnam par sprul/ /bud med shes rab ye shes te/ /de las ye shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes sbyor ldan pa/ /sku yi rdo rje bsnyen par brjod/ /rlung ni mnyam par gyur pa dang / /srid kyi sgra dang skad 'gyur ba/ /gsung ni nye bar bsgrub pa'o/ /bskyod pa las ni rab zhu ba/ /nor bur bcu drug cha babs te/ /yid kyi bde bas gnyis —306—

'gags pa/ /thugs kyi de nyid sgrub par brjod/ /gzhu yi gzugs can rab spyor bas/ /dung dang kun da ltar thig le/ /sdom brtson bde bas gzung bar bya/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes mchog /sgrub pa chen po'i de nyid de/ /rnam shes ye shes dag par byed/ /'di yis rdo rje'i bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes chen por rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor mkhas pas bstod/ /ces pa'i bar du rgya cher gsungs te/ lha sku snang stong zab gsal gnyis su med pa de yang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'char ba zhig nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa ni/ snga ma gnyis kyi steng du bde ba chen po bsnan te rnal 'byor du byed pa'am/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes mchog la shin tu nye ba'i phyir/ shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'i sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor gyur pa ste/ rnal 'byor phyi ma gsum po 'di'i rnam par bzhag pa sogs go don ni/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa la brten te/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sgrub thabs bris pa las/ /bsod nams rgya chen gang thob pa/ /de yis slob dpon mchog dgyes shing / /'gro kun 'jigs las sgrol bar shog /sngon chad kha ba can na 'di med de/ /'phags yul bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa ni/ /bod yul 'gro la chos sbyin dri med de/ /thar pa 'dod rnams rgya cher dga' bar mdzod// // ces sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs ye shes 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ mi phrogs pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag dam pa'i dbang phyug dpal stag lung thang pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi zhal snga nas bka' stsal ba spyi bor nod de/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā —307—
ngag 'don bde bar bcos shing cho ga'i yan lag cung zad kha skong kyang byas pa'o/ / ma ṅga laX/ / bi sta re/ / zhus dag /

ku5rgyag gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar gtor ma gtor snod nang du me tog bdug spos sogs mchod pa btab pa gcig bsham/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ h+pha badz+ra a ra snyi hoX nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi dang 'dra/ /gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod spyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /gang yang sa'i phyogs 'dir gtogs pa'i lha klu gnod spyin la sogs pa sa'i bdag po rnams dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis sa gzhi 'di dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i don du bdag la stsal du gsol/ de las sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med par 'gyur ba lags/ khyed cag skal ba mchog ldan te/ /bsod nams phung po gzi brjid che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po bzod par dka'/ khyod ni bden pa'i rgyu las byung / khyod kyi ngag tshig bden pa yin/ /de phyir rgyu la legs bsams nas/ /bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi bden pa'i tshig gson cig/dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sa gzhi 'di bdag la stsol cig /a pa ra sna naX gats+tsha gasmo zhes gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro/ /de nas —309—

sa lha'i mchod gtor bsham/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i snod bzang po rnams su/ huX las byung ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa bzang zhing rgya che la nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhuX nas/ ni bi rkye'i bar/ oṃ āXrū pa badz+ra hūṃ/ shag/ gan+ta/ ra sa/spar sha /dharma dh+wa tu'i bar ro/ /yang bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āXhuX/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ྅༷༷hūX ha ho hiX g.yas kyi sor mo gsum la gshug /sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūṃ huX huX/ oṃ bri thi bī de bī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung / tshom bu'i steng du 'khod par gyur pa ni/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba/ phyag g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin zhing / g.yas dbang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can mdzes sdug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod yon 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'kho7ra las ni legs grub mdzod/ /oṃ pri thi bī de bi ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog sogs dang / ar+ghaX gyi gnas su/ pur+sha nas/ sha p+ta āXhuX gi bar brjod/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi —310—

stobs/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /lan gsum/ o phri thi bī de bī sa pa ri ba re khyu i da ba li gro hā gro hā/ sarba du ni na sa ma ya mu dra/ pra bha lja ka /ma ma shin+ta rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hu hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyis sa gzhi la 'dug nas/ o hi swāhā/ zhes pa nas bzung / maṇ+ḍal mchod chog sngon du 'gro ba'i/ stu bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes nga/ri bar sgrub thabs nas 'gyung ba ltar dkyil 'khor bsgom/ bzlas pa bya/ de nas mchod pa bshams/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis rlabs/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ bdag nyid dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje'i rta'i rgyal po rab tu khros pa sku mdog sngo sangs/ sngo dkar dmar ljang ba'i zhal spyan gsum pa/ steng zhal rta gdong sngon po'o/ /phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral gri dang / g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje mda' dang gtun shing 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis thod pa gzhu dgra sta bsnams pa/ stag lpags dang dar dang rin po che dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ( 〈dza〉 zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis/ pad+ma dang nyi rma 'i steng du lha dang lha min thams cad gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ) me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rdo rje sgrol mas yang dag par 3khyud pa'i skur gyur/ o badz+ra ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog/—311 —

dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba las yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir/ bdag gis rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po sprul bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha kro dha sgo〉 ā kro dha sgi 〉 skyo/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa/ pad skor dang rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa ma/ hu zhes g.yas skor du bskor nas/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /na ma sa man+ta brnye smyo/ sogs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas/ sa gzhi la yungs kar gtor ro/ /o bhu kha nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o nga ni 'a khru/skṛ spru rgyu hā skyo/ rgyu hā pā ya rgyu hā pā ya hū/ ā na ho bha ga bān bi du rā dza hū phaṭa/ phur bu gcig 'dus byas la/ sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo mtha' yas pa spros te/ zhes pa nas/gdug pa'i sems can rnams thar sa med par bcings par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar —312—

sgrub thabs ltar bya/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gnyis pa zhig spros te/ phur bu srung ba'i don du bzhugs par gyur/ o badz+ra pur+sha ā hū/ sogs nyer spyod lnga phul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phur bu srung ba dang / bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil par gyur pa'i rkang pa hu las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ hu zhes bzla zhing skor ba lan gsum byed/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar bgegs rnams thal bar brlag par byas/ yang hū las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba/ gur bla re/ye shes kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ o badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes srung ba bya'o/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dmigs nas/ 65r+gha la sogs pas mchod/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas te bzhag go /de ltar na zhag dang po sa'i cho ga'o/ /nangs par snga bar bod lugs bzhin du sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gnas yo byin rlabs byas na'ang nyes skyon mi bskyed cing / cho ga mdzes pa'i yan lag tsam du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du skyabs sems dang yig brgya yang ngo / /de rjes spyi 'gro'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga nas brtsams te/ de yang stong pa nyid du thim par gyur/ ā stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byore ma'i skur gyur/ mdun gyi sa gzhir/ lha rnam gyi gnas su tshom bu dang mchod gtor bya/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor yang bshams nas/sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo tshe /zhes pa nas/ lan bdun gyi gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin/des gsungs/ pa/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /sngags kyi cho ga rab tu grub/khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / /mtshungs pa med par 'gro don gyis/ /sa'i —313 —

lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXskyoX/ oX tā re shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ oX āXhuX/ de bzhin du thams cad kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar te/ oṃ tā re tshuspyo ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re ba sha ma na ho/oX tā re ni ba ra ṇa phaṭa/ oX ta thā ga ta tā re yaX skyoX/ oX rat+na tā re maX hūX/ lkoX pad+ma tā re paX skyoX/ lkoX badz+ra tā re huX skyoX/ oX aX ku sha ta re dzaXhūX/ oX pā sha tā re hūX skyoX/ lkoX gri'i la tā re baX skyoX/ oX lha ṇ+ḍa tā re hoXhūX/ oX mo ha ni tā re maX hūX/ oX pra sha ma tā re swāhā hūX/ oṃ staX bha ni tā re la skyoX/ oX dzam bha ni tā re khaX hūX/ oX ā kar+ṣa ni tā re hiXhūX/ lkoX gī la kwa tā re dzaXskyoX/ oṃ u tsas kā tā re phaṭa hūX/ lkoX dī ṣa tā re phaṭa skyoX/oX ya mun+ta ka hūX phaṭa/ oX ka ni dhu ni huX phaṭa/ oX ha ya spyo ba haX hūX phaṭa/ oX a rlu ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūX phaṭa/ ces pa ming sngags su grags pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'bor lo'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i nas/ sgo bzhir nyi ma zhes pa'i bar brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma chen mo dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i sde rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba h+pha/ bdud rtsi yel ba'i sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya/ thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dkyil 'khor du gyur/yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ an+taX pra tī ts+tsha na maX oX tā re tu stu re tu re huX phaṭa/ oX tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūX/ de nas ming sngags sngags re re'i mthar/ oX tiṣ+ṭha sogs sbyar/ oX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le hūX phaṭa/ lkoX tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūX/ so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'bor gyi 'khor lo yang h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis —314—

su med par thim/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /shar du zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo nas/ zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /byang du rgyas pa'i nas/dgyes pa'i nyams can no/ /nub tu dbang gi nas/ chags pa'i nyams can no/ /lhor drag po'i nas/ khros pa'i nyams can no/ /shar lhor de bzhin /lho nub tu rin chen: nub byang du chos: byang shar du las kyi: /thams cad kyang nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor lcags kyu: lho sgor zhags pa: nub sgor lcags sgrog: byang sgor dril bu: thams cad kyang khro mo'i nas/ brkyang pas gnas pa'o/ /shar gyi g.yas las rmongs byed ma/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang dud kha shin tu khros/ shar ltor gshin rje gshed po nag nas/ yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ /lha de thams cad kyi zhes pa nas/ tāX ljang sngon 'od zer 'phro ba'i bar ro/ /'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sogs byas la/ snyan gsan dbab ste/ bdug spos thogs pas/ dam tshig sgrol ma bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang yang bstan la mngon dga' rnams/ /sems can 'di la byin rlabs shing / /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ skabs 'di nyid du nam mkhar 'degs pa yin mod kyang / cung zad spros pa la dga' na bar 'di/ bod rnams la rjes chog tu grags pa ltar/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams pa'am kha gsos/ byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas/ oX bha ga bān ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri ba re/ ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā nas shabha āXhuX —315—

gi bar gyis mchod/ yi ge bcu pa la sogs pa lha so so'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ 'khru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ra pa dang sogs/ gtso bos nus pa sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ oṃ badz+ra be gwa kra ma ho dkyil 'khor gyi lha nam mkhar ba te ga.ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū hū phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis srung ba bya/ de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ skabs 'di nyid du bum pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas pa tsam bum pa'i sta gon yin no/ /slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba ni/ mya ngan 'das pa'i sems bskyed dang / nang dbang dang / gsol btab dang / spro ba bskyed pa dang / sdom pa sbyin par gsol ba dang / sdom pa bsgrags pa rgyas pa dang / bzung ba bsdus pa dang /so shing dang / khyor chu dang / srung skud dang / ku sha sbyin pa dang / srung ba dang / mthong bar 'gyur bar sgrog pa rnams yin te/ dkyil chog tu bshad zin to/ /de dag ni nub gnyis sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /thig tshon byin rlabs kyang spyi dang 'dra mod/ ngag 'don tsam brjod na/ thig tshon bkod/mchog gtor spums/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shar du thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po hū las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo/rang dang 'dra ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor ser po t+yā las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki ser mo rang dang mtshungs pa dang / sogs nub tu: dmar po khyi las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo rang dang sogs/ 316—

byang du: thig skud dang rdul tshon oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ 'khor lo dang / des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ rang dang mtshungs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dbus su ljang khu a las don yod grub pa sogs/ sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum sgrol ma ljang khu sogs/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams thor tshugs dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung / yum rnams zhig phyis ( 〈j-i〉zhal gcig phyag gnyis ) dang / pad+ma'i skyil krung / dpral bar oṃ dkar po nas/ hu sngon po/ mig tu k+ṣi dkar po nas/ kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo'o rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga dang /yum lnga badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rdo rje rol pa mo'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ o badzi bha ba a bhi ṣañca zhes dbang bskur/ nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ pañca ku la dhi pa sa pa ri bā re khyu ar+gha pra titsā sogs nas/ shasta ā hu/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ hu t+yā hi a/ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ yang ar+gha sogs bsdus pas mchod/ mkha' ltar kun tu khyab pa yi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /yon tan 'phrin las mnyam pa nyid/ /bde gshegs yab yum rnams la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'grub shog /rigs lnga yab yum bcu byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas/ thig skud —317—

kha dog lnga rnams dang / rdul tshon kha dog lnga rnams su gyur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra lha ka huX huX/ oṃ āXrat+na dhika truX hūX/ oṃ āX.a ra le ka khyiXhuX/ oṃ āXdzi na dzika oṃ huX/ oṃ āXpradz+nyā dhika ā huX/ zhes mang du bzlas/ snoXljobaXrgyubaX zhes thig skud brkyangs/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra bri ni sarba dharma urlan ta/ a nu pra khru ni sarba dharma huX/ zhes sgril/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ /deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs shig ces/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /hūX oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra su tra sa ma ya/ mā ti kra ma huX/ de nas las thig gdab ste/ gzhan ni spyi dang 'dra/ rta babs sgo tshad gcig tu bya/ /snam bu bzhi par byed na ni/ /snam bu 'og ma ka rgyan mnyam/ /gnyis pa cha chung re res ring / /gsum pa mun pa'i snam bu mnyam/ /bzhi pa de las gcig gis bskum/ /gsum pa'i dbus su myongs thig gi /g.yas g.yon cha chung re re dang / /gnyis pa la ni gsum gsum dang / /dang po la ni gnyis gnyis te/ /yang na glang rgyab mig gsum bya/ /snam bu bcu gcig spyi dang mtshungs/ /de ye nang tshan gsum po yang / /ji ltar 'dod pa sbyar du rung / /ka ba ka rgyan mun pa dag/rtsig pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /rta babs kyi ni g.yas g.yon du/ /mchod rten gnyis ni bya bar 'dod/ /cha chung gnyis ni stegs bu ste/ /de nas gnyis ni dril bu'o/ /bzhi pa bum pa'i gnas su 'dod/ /rtsig pa'i nang gi khyad par ni/ /bzhi pa dang ni gsum pa gnyis/ /phyed gdab nang ma'ang phyed du gdab/ /de dbus re mig dgu pa ste/ /de nas sgo yi rtsa thig phyis/ /rdul tshon blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūX/ zhes mang du bzlas te/ phur khung dgang / 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oX sa ma ya ho ā haX/ zhes dbang ldan nas brtsams te bri bar —318—

bya'o/ /dbus kyi gdung dang ka ba nag/re mig rnams dang gru chad sngo/ /ut+pal dmar po sil mar bkram/ /phyi nas rim bzhin snam bu lnga/ /nag dmar sna tshogs ser dang dkar/ /lha rnams phyogs mdog rtsig pa ni/ /nang nas ljang dmar ser nag dkar/ /dra phyed phyi bstan mu myo pa nag/mchod rten dkar zhing khyam ljang khu/ /ka rgyan glang po seṅge sogs/ /dbus su ut+pal sngon po bri/ /phyogs bzhir pad dkar gser bum dang / /lcags kyu ral gri phyogs mdog bri/ /mtshams bzhir ut+pal sku mdog mtshungs/ /grwa bzhir tho ba ral gri dang / /dbyug pa phur bu rnam par dgod/ /las kyi snam bu dbus ma la/ /lha yi mdog mtshungs gdan du bya/ /phyag mtshan bri na g.yas kyi'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu mdzes par bri/ /bum pa sgrub pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'am/ ma 'byor na bum pa lnga/ stegs bu'i steng du lnga tshoms su bkod/ las bum logs zhig tu bya ste/ bum pa drug go /'dir drug gi dbang du byas nas/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du bhāX las rin po che'i bum pa ser po yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin lpi phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyis dkris pa'o/ /lkoX ta ste ta ste mahā ta ste swāhā/ lha'i chu bo rab tu 'bab par gyur/ oX kalpa bṛ klu ya swāhā/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan par gyur/ dbus kyi bum pa'i gnas su pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ tāX las bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /shar du tāX le las sogs/ lhor tāX maX las sogs/nub tu tāX paX las sogs/ byang du tāX huX las sogs/ gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar du dzaXlas sogs/ lhor hūX las sogs/ nub tu baX las sogs/ byang du hoXlas nas/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su huX re re —319—

yongs su gyur pa las/ shar lhor gshin rje gshed po nag ces pa nas/ yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ /ces pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ shar gyi bum pa'i nang du/ swāhā las zhi ba'i nas/ zhi ba'i nyams can rmongs byed ma dang dug zhi bar byed ma spro ba/ byang gi bum par o las nas/ dgyes pa'i nyams can/rengs byed ma dang gnon par byed ma spro ba'o/ /nub kyi bum par ho las nas/chags pa'i nyams can/ 'gugs par byed ma dang phur bus 'debs par byed ma spro ba'o/ /lho'i bum par phaṭa las nas/ drag po'i sgrol ma/ khros pa'i nyams can/ bskyod byed ma dang / dbye byed ma spro ba'o/ /las bum du hū las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag ces pa nas/ 'dod lha zhabs kyis mnan/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza nas/ gnas kyi dbang bskur spyin par bya/ lko badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣañca skyo/ su ra ta tsū ā ha/ zhes dbang bskur/gtso mo la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa dang / 'khor rnams la gtso mos dbu rgyan/ yi ge bcu pa ci 'grub dang / rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ las bum la dmigs nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyang brgya rtsa sogs bzla'o/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hū/ nyer gcig tsam bzla/ ar+gha nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ o ā tā hū/swahā o ho phaṭa/ ta lwa tā mā tā pā tā hū/ dza / ba ho o ā hū/ zhes nang mchod phul/ a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis rjes chags bya/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/o badz+ra ar+gha pra titsā na ma o ā hu / me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon phul/lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du —320—

'dres par gyur/ las bum gyi chu blangs te bum pa la bskor/ gnas khang la gtor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas/ bar chad srungs shig ces brjod/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris zin pa la/ byur bsal ba dang / bsrung ba byas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing / bum pa lnga po 'jog stabs bde na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su stegs bu'i steng du bzhag las bum dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad dam/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag go /de dag ni nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /nangs par snga bar yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zhes pa nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen go zhes pa nas/ sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ de nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can rdzogs par bkod yod na skad cig gis lha rnams bskyed dgos shing / ras bris la yang de bzhin no/ /sa bon la yi ge nyid dang / thig le las sa bon phyag mtshan gang rung bskyed dgos/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir phyag mtshan 'god pa nyid gtso che bas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal sngon go sdong bu dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /re mig brgyad la/ shar du pad+ma dkar po byang du gser gyi bum pa rab tu gang ba/ nub tu lcags kyu/ lho ru ral gri/ shar lhor ut+pal dkar go lho nub tu ut+pal ser go nub byang du ut+pal dmar go byang du ut+pal nag go shar sgor lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog /byang sgor dril bu/ shar lho'i grwar tho ba/ lho nub kyi grwar ral gri/ nub byang gi grwar dbyug pa dkar po/ byang shar gyi grwar rdo rjes —321 —

mtshan pa'i phur bu/ las kyi snam bu la/ shar du rtse gsum dang / bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ byang du lcags sgrog dang ri rab/ nub tu lcags kyu dang phur bu/ lhor dbyug tho dang ral gri rnams grub par gyur/ oX tā re tu stu re tu re huX phaṭa nas/ oX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūX phaṭa/ kyi bar gong lhag gnas kyi skabs bzhin/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ yi ge brgya pa yang gtso mo la bdun sogs dang / lha gzhan rnams la re re bzla'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga thun mong ba de mi dgos/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i zhes pa nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi skabs snying ga'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad dang / bris pa'i dkyil 'khor yang 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/bdag nyid kyang thugs ka'i tāX la zhes pa nas/ stu tī badz+ra swa bha ba ut+pa ko3haX/zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad cing bsangs gtor bya/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX dpa' bo rdo rje'i brtul zhugs can/ /rdo rje sems dpas byin rlabs de bzhin gshe/gas lnga yis/ /dbu la brgyan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam 'jig rten gsum po skyob mdzad ma/ /phyogs bcu bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus bcom zhing 'joms mdzad rab bzhad bcom ldan 'das mar 'dud/ /ces bstod/oṃ badz+ra a du sha dzaX nas/ gaṇ+ḍi hoX bar 'dir 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i bzlas pa yang ci rigs par bya'o/ /mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX —322—

las byung ba'i mchod pa'i khang pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod sna tshogs pa dag tu/ hūX las skyes pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog /bdug sbos/ mar me/ dri chab/zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra/ dri ro/ reg bya la sogs pa/ phyi nang gsang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mthas klas pa 'khor ba ji srid du 'byung bar gyur/ oX badz+ra añca ma naX snya hā/ pu duX: pro k+ṣa ṇaX/ ar+ghaXngu oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX/ dh+wa pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ nai bi te/ rū pa badz+ra/ shasta/ gan+ta/ rā sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dh+wa hūṃ badz+ra: badz+ra lha ṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta sogs/ khyab rtag bde chen ye shes rol pa las/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje a rgyu'i rgyun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor rab spel bas/ /ye shes lha mo'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga ba tī sa ma ya tā ra yo gi nī maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri bā ra pra ba ra sa t+pa rā theX añca ma ni pra titsā na maX de bzhin du sbyar te/ rkang pa gnyis pa/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri bcil rdo rje'i chu/ /pu byaX/ zhal gyi rnyog sel rdo rje spos kyi chu/ /añca ma nāX/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung mchog /pro k+ṣa ṇaX/ oṃ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog/sa pa ri ba ra badz+ra puspro/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing / /lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni/ /nges par bsregs pa de yi sbos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra ga pe/ yi ge hūX las yang dag byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra ā lo ke /bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar —323—

gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra ga rnye/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /badz+re nai bi te/ chu skyes rdo rje yang dag sbyor/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung / /rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra sha p+ta/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rigs bdag dbyer med pa la 'bul te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /o ā hū/ bar 'dir bod lugs ltar na brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan smos nas kyang 'bul/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar 'bru gsum/dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ra ma'i zhal du o ā hū/ de bzhin du 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ 'bru gsum sbyar bas phul/ bar 'dir chos skyong srung ma dang / 'gro ba drug la spyin pa sogs kyang bod lugs zhig dang bstun pas khyab/ de rjes rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa/ spros pa la mngon par dga' na/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ /zhes sogs sngon byung blo gros gsal ba rnams kyis sbyar ba/ tshig don legs po dag brjod cing / bsdu na sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod pa'o/ /de nas na bza' 'bul te/ bsangs sbyangs/ hu las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi yo byad nam bza'i tshogs dpag tu med par gyur/ dbang po'i gzhu 'dra rta mchog rigs la ste/ /—324—

rtag pa'i rigs la kañca li ka sbyar/ /stag lpags g.yang gzhi la sogs rdo rje'i rigs/ /yid 'ong reg 'jam 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ /rdo rje nyi mar bye ba'i rin thang can/ /dar dkar tshi gu'i na bza' bde chen rigs/ /rdo rje reg bde'i bde ba gos zung rnams/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /badz+ra bsta/ gzhan yang rin chen bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga sogs spyi dang mthun pa'i spros pa sna tshogs kyang bkag pa ma yin no/ /de rjes mtshan nges pa dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa nges par bya la/ bstod pa gzhan gyis kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul te/bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las ya las nas/ lko ha ho hi sta he re bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas/ sta bha ni tā re i da ba li sbro hā skṛgha sarba du ni na sa ma ya mu dra/ pra bhañja ka /mam ma shwarnying rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hu hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun dang / na ma sa man+ta bud+dhā bo dhi sa tā nā/ zhes pa nas/ bi sañca re khyu hā/ zhes pa'i bar du dkyil 'khor pa spyi la 'bul/ dur khrod gnas pa rnams la/ o h+pha sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngo/ ar+gha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ tse( ā skyo/ tse( sgyu 'phrul chen mo dpal ldan ma/ /dbyangs can ma dang dka' bzlog khyod/ /zla ba nyi ma chu lha dang / /gu lang 'phrog byed rnams kyis bshud/ khyod ni srid gsum byed pa mo/ /sems can kun la bde spyin ma/ /bskyed dang 'jig dang bsrung ba mo/ /lha mo sgrol ma 'khor bcas bstod/ /lha'i tshogs rnams zhes pa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub sgo(ga /gi bar bya/ bsdu na nang gtor de tsam gyis chog la/ cung zad spros pa la mos na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin phyi rol gtor ma gtong / mchog tu spros pa la mos na/ snying po mdor bsags sogs las 'byung ba'i phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma byed do/ /de rjes shar sgo nas/—325—

kol+la i ri ri ṭha la sogs pa rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ badz+ra ud ghā ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya huX/ lan bzhis sgo phye/ oṃ rdo rje sems khyod rol zhing rol bar mdzad/ /thams cad mthu yis thams cad stsol bar mdzad/ /ji snyed mchod pa de snyed bdag 'bul na/ /'khor bar gnas pa skad cig gis grol mdzod/ /sa ma ya ho ho ༷༷ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaXhuX baX hoXrab tu grub par mdzod/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ /zhes me tog phul/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya ho/ /zhes dkyil 'khor du 'jug go /bar 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci nus bya/de nas bar 'dir gsang ba'i mchod pa yid kyis 'bul ba yin te/ tshig gis brjod pa ni ma bris so/ /de rjes rang gi snying ga nas 'phags ma sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma zhes pa nas/thar pa med par bcings par gyur/ ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /sogs kyis bstod do/ /smon lam dang / shis brjod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /de nas bdag 'jug ni maṇ+ḍal phul/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su sogs kyis gsol ba btang/ bar 'dir chas 'jug gsum byed kyang / bdag 'jug gi skabs mi dgos/ na maXs man+ta brnye sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring gis mig dar bcings/tso( āXhuX gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum skye ba'i gnas lngar tī yig re res rgyas gdab/ glu( ro ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni/ sarba a the swa dha ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma ki/ ki ri ki ri hūX swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi bi ka ṭa/ ni ka ṭi/ ka ṭaX ka ṭi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dha —326—

tī shwa ri/ sarba du gi ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bi blun sa ya bi dha na sa ya hū phaṭa swāhā/ o badz+ra twa re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ na ma sa man+ta sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bsgrad/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs sngags lan bdun ( 〈j-i〉 rtse brjod de/) gnas bdun du rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bzhag /kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po'o/ /skal bzang des khyod su zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig bdag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying gar snying rje chen po'i ngo bo zla ba'i steng du stong nyid ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /o sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pā da ya mi/ mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta u pa da ya mi a kha bī ra skyo/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal 'e 1 / /hū na ma ste skyo/ na ma mye hū/ na mo na ma hū swāhā/ phyogs re re nas lan gsum gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar dam bzhag lnga'am/ yang na/ rnal 'byol ra ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ / gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyed kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /o badz+ra uta ta ka ṭha ṭha hu/ deng nas brtsams te nga yi bka'/ khyod kyi brnyas par mi bya zhing / /dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste/ dang r+sha—327—

por dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ rang skad cig gis 'od dpag med he ru kar gyur/ rkang 'og tu ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ steng du rkang mthil gyi nang du chug pa'i sna yig ljang khus mtshan pa/ snying gar la las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su nyi ma la hu nag po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par ra las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ dbus su nyi ma la ā dmar po gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ mgo bor ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ dbus su zla ba la ha dkar po sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad/ thugs dang / gsung dang / sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ hū ā hu rnams la thim/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ rnyil bskul/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gang zhing / lus gyen du 'degs bzhin pa la/ yi ge gsum bskul bas de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang mtha' dag gang bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi ba skru'i bu ga nas zhugs te thim/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya/ sa sta bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya/ hu ā hā dzhai zhes ye shes phab/ spogs chog gnyis dang gegs sel bdag 'jug gi skabs su mi dgos/ oṃ teṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ pra ti ( 〈rdza〉 rtse pra ti ) pa ti ta/ hū hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brtan par byas/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kyang lugs 'di la nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba mi mdzad/ bden stobs brjod pa mdzad mod/ bdag 'jug gi —328—

skabs su ma byas kyang chog/oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi rdo me bha ba/ sha shwa twa me bha ba/ hri da ya me/a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sirnyi sme/ pra ru ( 〈rja〉 rgo huX ha ha ha ha hoX) ā khaX bī ra hūX/pra tismo ku su ma añja li/ na tha hoX me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gro hā stuX/ e maX satwa mahā ba la/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson//rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu huX a/ he badz+ra pa shu/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi/ /rdo rje pad+ma mchog rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ oX badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sho3haX/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal dro shi to3haX/ oṃ gu phya maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi khri lto3haX/dngos gzhi las slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas kun dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje rta'i rgyal po/ zhes pa nas/ 'khyud pa'i skur gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i skabs bzhin/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/rang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa zhal du bcug/rjes chags kyi mes thugs kar zhu/ gzhi gnas kyi byang chub sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+ma ra babs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ nas/ kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ /gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/—329—

sangs rgyas thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dza nas/ ho'i bar/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs/ pukhye sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ / 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su bzhu/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam snang gi sgo spyi gtsug nas zhugs/thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bkrus/ dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir spros te/ dbang gi lha tshogs su gyur nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ hu zhes bya bas yum gyi pad+ma'i g.yon gyi mtha' nas phyir spros te/ shar sgo dang nye ba'i lha snam la dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs brjod/ rang gi rigs kyi lhas me tog 'phreng ba spyi bor bcings par gyur/ oṃ prati kṛ hā stu sogs lha thams cad kyi bum chu dung chos su bsdus pa'am/ rig pa'i bum pa logs su bcas yod na des dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye skyo/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba'am/ dar ras kyi cod pan bcings/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+re bha ba a bhi khiñca hu/ snying po yi —330—

ge bcu pa lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud la/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig /de dag ni rig pa brtad pa'i dbang zhes bya ste dbang po dman pa rnams rjes su 'dzin par byed do/ /thod par gnas pa'i bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mā mā ma gī dang / lwa sangs rgyas spyan ma dang / pā gos dkar mo dang / tā dam tshig sgrol ma rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chu nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid mi bskyod nga/ he ru ka mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar skyo/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza o badz+ra a du sha dza nas/ lha rge ho/ o a bhi khri thu stodape ma/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur spyin par bya/ /o la mā pā tā hu badz+ra a bhi 'khri nyu smyo/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye skyo/ de ltar na —331 —

chus dbang bskur bas/ sems rnam par shes pa kun gzhi gnas gyur te/ ji lta ba gzigs pa'i ye shes thugs rdo rje mngon du byas so/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo bhuX yig dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo aX yig dang / 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo dzi yig dang / don yod grub pa'i ngo bo khaX yig dang / mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo huX yig las byung ba'i rin po che'i cod pan de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can sku mdog ser po/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum mā ma gī dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ gtso bo'i) thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX badz+ra a du sha dzaXnas/ lha rnye hoXyi bar bya/ tseX( a bhi khri ྅ sko / maX sarba ta thā ga tā lan gsum/ dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ bhuX aX dzi khaX hūX huX rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khri kwa ni skyoX/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūX/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs la sogs pa 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyi yon tan rnams gnas gyur te 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid yon tan rdo rje mngon du byas so/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX khaX huX rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid 'od dpag med he ru ka —332—

( 〈pho〉 rtse 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can ) sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu: yum gos dkar mo: bcas pa thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par:lha rnye ho'i bar/ gong bzhin la 'don pa spo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni blang bar gyis/ /o hu kha hū/badz+ra a bhi khri kwa ni skyo/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ ngag ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs gnas gyur te/ brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa gsung rdo rje mngon du byas/bsangs sbyangs dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor lo dbang phyug ma dam tshig gi sgrol ma'i ngo bo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid don yod grub pa he ru ka don yod grub pa'i: sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu yum las kyi sgrol ma dang : thams cad don yod grub pa'i rnam par ces 'don pa spo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dril bus dbang bskur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /tse( hū tā hu badz+ra a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi khri po yi spyo/ tsho( sarba nas/ shrī ye hū/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyu/ra/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma ā de —333—

ltar na dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ las dang bya ba thams cad gnas gyur te/lhun grub thogs pa med pa'i 'phrin las rdo rje mngon du byas/ yang rdo rje dang /rdo rje dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i ngo bos dza yig dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma'i ngo bo hu yig dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i ngo bo ba yig dang / rdo rje dril bu ma'i ngo bo ho yig rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje dril bur gyur/ bdag nyid stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka /rnam par snang mdzad kyi: sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma: rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par:dbang gi lha rnams kyis ming gi dbang bskur/ o dza:hū ba ho badz+ra satwa stu a bhi khri tsā skyo/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta ha shrī/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /o sarba ta thā: de ltar na ming gi dbang bskur bas/ ming gi gdags gzhi yul dang dbang po thams cad gnas gyur te/ ji snyed mkhyen cing snang stong gnyis su med cing mi shig pa/ sku rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon du byas so/ /de dag ni slob ma'i dbang dngos gzhi yin la mtha' rten ni/( 〈lbo〉 rtse tshe badz+ra ne tra a wa ha ra pa tra la sdi ) thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /ā chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bzhin/ /'dir ni gsal bdag rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i —334—

rang bzhin gtso/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ / sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/( 〈lbo〉 rgo dril bu blangs la/ a a a/) thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ / nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ / thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya su/ oX shu n+ya ta stong pa'i ngang las swāhā las rang nyid zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyi mthar/ oX tā re tu ltu re tu re shān+ti ku sa ba dzī a bhi khiñca skyoX/ rang nyid rgyus pa'i sgrol ma ser mor gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs/ dha na dza sna ku sa rang nyid dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mor gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs/ sarba sa khyu pa shaX ku sa rang nyid drag po'i las kyi sgrol ma nag mor gyur: sarba du ni na pra snyu tshe na ma raX ku sazhes 'don pa spo/ las bzhi'i rjes gnang ngo / /bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa'i: rdo rje dang dril bu/yum rdo rje snyems mas/ badz+ra lha rnye ho yi bar chu dbang gi skabs ltar ro/ /rdo rje lag tu gtad/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpar gyur/'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje'i sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX/ dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi huX/ lag pa g.yas su hūX las byung ba'i gyi gug /oX karti ka /sarba mā ra ṇaX/ maX sa ka rta ya/—335—

ka rta ya huX phaṭa/ lag pa g.yon du āXlas byung ba'i thod khrag/oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba shā truX ṇaX/ rak+taX dh+wa ra ya dh+wa ra ya hūX phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas su oX las byung ba'i cang tes oX tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ g.yon du ut+pal/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs rtsa sngags so/ /yang g.yon du tāX las byung ba'i mdung rtse gsum pa/ oX ha na ha na mā ra ( 〈j-i〉 rtse ya mā ra ya ) sarba shā krun tri shu la hūX phaṭa/ haX las byung ba'i kha ṭaX ga mchan khung du bkod/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la sbyoXhūX hūX hūX phaṭa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgoms shig/'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin bdegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra a du ri/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra shi rtsi sa ma ya/ bha rgyu ba swa/ gang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /de nas dbang de tsam las mi bskur na/ skabs 'dir dam tshig bshad do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūX/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun sogs/āXsrid pa sogs/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir sogs/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas —336—

pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs par gyur/ tse( tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa dang / lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags rdzogs par brjod/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i lha tshogs rnams phyir spros te/ rang gi snying ga'i gzhal yas khang gi nang / lha'i gdan rnams su 'khorwa da par gyur/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog /rgyas par na zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dza dza / ba ho/ ā las byung ba'i bgrang 'phreng gsung rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ a ā i yī nas/ ha k+ṣa hu phaṭa swāhā/ snying po lan mang du bzlas/ 'phreng ba spyi bor bzhag snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ga nas/ ye shes sems dpa' sngags kyi yig 'khru'i gzugs can badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho hū las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /de snying gar bstad/ snying po'i mthar/ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sogs/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi sngags btags te/ hi hū yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor rnams phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las/ ye shes sems dpa' phyag mtshan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma dza dza : ba ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mtsho ni cha 'khordo ra lo bla na med/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bu khyod long / /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra brta ni a bhi rdzi myu skyo/ de bzhin du/ rdo rje dang / badz+ra/ rin chen dang rat+na/chu skyes dang pad+ma/ ral gri dang kha sga/ zhes pa ni thugs kyi dbang ngo / /o dha ra dha ra bhā ra —337—

ya dh+wa ra ya/ ma rna ma dhe/ badz+ra lcu ka phaṭa/ oX badz+ra dharma sa ma ya swa stuX/ hu lu hu lu/a ro lika phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya/ ta mo bi da ma na swāhā/ a hāX/ rat+na dhika phaṭa/ oX sha shwa to pa ra ma sha shwa to/ e phya hi/ dzi na dzi ka bhuX hūX phaṭa/ oX phu phu phu hi hi hi pra dz+nyā dhika hūX phaṭa/ oX āXhūX haX/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi 'phreng ba rin chen bdag/lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ kha ṭāX ga ni shes rab ste/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin cang te nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ming bos bzung / /sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu bzung la/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub nga/ra gyis/ /'di la slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ las bzhi'i bum pas dbang bskur ro/ /grub pa brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan bstar te/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par bgyi/ /rig ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen por gnas pas/ nu ma la reg cing 'khyud pa na/ dga' ba dang po mi 'gyur zhing brtan par gyur/ oX badz+ra a nu rā ga na āXhūX/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sogs kyi mjug tu/ oX badz+ra ut+ta ka a bhi ski nyu huX/ su ra ta stuX/ ā haX/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang / ye dharma brjod/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /sogs kyis me tog gtor/ rol chen bya/ slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros pas sbun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi —338—

bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ / ( 〈ram̐〉 rtserang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/) /yongs snga ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos la yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /lan gsum/ gsang ba 'di su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ /shin tu rno ba'i shu la ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gi dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'big/oṃ ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūX phaṭa/ ces brjod/ spro na/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin pa/ /sogs dang / mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /zhes pa nas/ khyed rnams brtan par 'gyur gyi bar dbugs dbyung ring mo 'phreng ba nas 'gyung gi bar brjod de bum pa'i dbang ngo / / ( 〈pho〉 de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ 'bor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dag/sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/) /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya yang mdun du bstar/ khyed la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu stsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don gnyer/ /mgon po khyod kyis brtse bas gzung / /byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags thung gis mig dar bcing / mgrin par chos 'byung —339—
