gi dbus su sngags 'phreng g.yon du 'khor bar gyur/ ā li kā li brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ka a bhi khiñca skyoX/ su ra ta stuX a haX/ oṃ laX māX pāX tāX hūX/badz+ra a bhi ṣañca hūX/ oṃ bhuX āX dzi khaX hūX hūX/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khri lca skyoX/ oX hūX khaX huX/badz+ra a bhi khiñca skyoX/ oṃ hūX tāX huX/ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi ṣañca hūX/ āXsrid pa sogs/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /sogs/ oṃ dzaXhuX baX hoX badz+ra satwa stuX/badz+ra nā ma a bhi khri ñca maX/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ thabs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba don yod grub pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ thugs kar gzhi gnas kyi byang chub sems dang ro gcig tu 'dre rnga te/ rtsa a ba dhu ti'i lam nas brgyud/ rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas/ byang chub kyi sems mthe bong dang ming med kyi blangs te lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āXhūX/ 'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ /oṃ āXhūX/ e ma ho bde ba chen po'i rna/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūX ā/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la bltas pas mchog tu dga' ba 'gyur ba med pa brtan par byas/ slar yang bdud rtsi myang / khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang —340—

bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar ba ro/da/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthun par gsungs/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya/ /de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i/ ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i go 'phang thob par gyur/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du ma rdza phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang / /rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ /ye shes mtshon cha rnams 'chang ba/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ /dbang po'i dra ba 'phro zhing 'od zer 'khrug /lhan cig skyes pa'i mdzes ma dang gcugs mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur stso'i// /lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /lha mo 'di ni khyod la shis/ /mtha' yas bde ba spyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya lo/ /gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /bdag nyid rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag don yod grub pa dang / rig ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i skur gyur/ oṃ ā hū/ bdud rtsi myang / oṃ badz+ra uta ta ka nas gzung / dam tshig gsum gyi bar gong gsang dbang gi skabs bzhin/ spyi bor oṃ nas kun tu bzang po'i bar/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs/dang po dga' ba dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ khren tu bde dga' thams cad nges/ /de bde thabs las yang dag rig/shes rab sbyor pas —341—

dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshon par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /ci ste bu khyod 'di spro'am/ /nga las dam tshig len par ni/ /bshang gci rak+ta bza' ba dang / /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/ khyod las dam tshig bza' bar ni/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi mi mo kun gus bya/ /chu skyes rab tu rgyas pa gsal bar byas te/ a re bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bstan byed pa/ /bdag la dngos grub ye stsal mdzad ma/ /dal bu dal bur rab sbyor bas/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /dbus su ze 'brus rnam brgyan pa'i/ /chu skyes 'dab ma gsum par gzigs/ /a ho bde ba can gyi zhing / /sangs rgyas sku mdog dmar pos mdzes/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lor tshol/ /des ni bu khyod 'bras bur bcas/ /hru las pad+ma/ā las ze 'bru/ hu las rdo rje/ oṃ las nor bu/ bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rol zhig rol zhig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ba/ khyod kyis gzhan du mi rtog pa/ /rtogs pas the tshom ma byed cig/ces bskul nas/ rjes chags spel ba dang / kha ga mu kha btsal ba dang / rgyu bsnyen sgrub bzhi las 'bras bu ye shes 'char ba dang / skad cig ma bzhi las mtshan nyid bral ba la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa mngon du gyur pa dang / de las snying stobs brgyad dang / rjes chags kyi sa bcu thob par gyur te/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum 'di dag pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyi rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral mi bya'o/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad —342—

kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la dngos grub mchog med do/ /de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bde stong mkha' mnyam thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ ( 〈rjo〉 rtse kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam spyor ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsole/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ) lhan cig skyes las gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /dpe'i lhan skyes las don gyi ye shes mchon par bya ste/ kun khyab gdung med rgyun mi 'chad/ /rnam rtog thim zhing rang rig pa/ /zab mo gsal ba gnyis su med/ /thig le'i bde ba kha sbyor ba'o/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag/zung 'jug rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ngo bo nyid sku ye shes rdo rje thob par 'gyur/ de nas bod lugs dang mthun par/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsa'/ pa/ /sogs dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag ni gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur/ /deng nas brtsams te sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/tshogs kyi mchod pa ni bdag 'jug gi sngon rol du bya ba yin la/ skabs 'dir byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni spyi'i rigs 'gre ste/ mchod pa gsar du gshom pa'am kha gsos sngon bzhin —343 —

byin gyis brlabs/ ar+gha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ā rū pa badz+ra hū sogs/ o a mṛ ta/ a mṛ te/ swa da na hū/ nang mchod phul/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis/bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ grub pa chen po brgyad dang zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang du bya ba la sogs pa las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrubs pas/ sems can gyi don rgya cher 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang /'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad rtsa ba nas zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum sogs bzla/gtso bo'i nus pa sogs dang / sngags dman pa dang sogs/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ o dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bi shwa ru pa dha ri ru ga tsā swa bhā ba kṛ ta rnye na sarba bud+dhā sgo bi sartsa na/ ma ma kar+ya ku ru swāhā/ smon lam dang / bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod do/ /nyi ma tha ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi dang 'dra ba dang / khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la phreng ba'i lugs bzhin du byed do// //zhes pa sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur gyi rim pa gzhan du bshad zin to/ /dge'o/ / zhus dag / ma dha la/ /—344—

cedro ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa'i yi ge yang dag pa'or /༄༅/ /na ma tu re gu ru tsa ra ṇa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bla ma dang yi dam gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la gus pas dngos kun rab btud nas/ /sgrib gnyis dri ma rab sbyangs phyir/ /dbang bskur cho ga legs bshad bya/ /'bab bsregs rab brten dka' thub kyi ngal zhing / /thor tshug tshangs skud 'chang zhing ral ba bsgrigs/ /oṃ yig glu len las drug gis ngal ba/ /de dag yang dag ma yin rnam par spangs/ /bla med don dam gtor blug nges pa 'dis/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i rang nyams 'pho ba yis/ /gdung sel gang yin bla ma'i man ngag ste/ /'gro la phan pa'i nyer 'tsho mchog tu gyur/ khyud las gsung dang slob dpon ngag /so so'i rang lugs rgya che ba/ /thams cad brjod par mi nus mod/ /bla ma'i zhal lung 'dir zugad bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /slob ma'ang yon tan kun ldan pa/ /de yis de dag cho ga 'di/ /bsdus na don gyi mchog ldan 'gyur/ /ltas brtags slob ma rjes bzung dang / /bsnyen pa bgegs tshogs gzhom pa dang / /gnas dus sa gzhi brtag slang bzung / /sbyang dang srung ba sta gon bzhi/ /thig tshon dkyil 'khor 'bri dang sgrub/ /mchod dang 'jug dang dbang blang ba/ /gshegs gsol bsdu dang spyin sreg ste/ /cho ga nyer bzhi bla ma bzhed/ /slob ma —345—

lan gsum gsol btab na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan byas la/ /sngags 'di nyer gcig bsngags byas te/ /'jig rten dbang la mchod byas nas/ khar ram lho ru mngon phyogs pa'i/ /ma yengs ku sha'i stan la nyal/ /rmi lam mtshan ma legs par brtags/ sngags ni/ skye( mu tsi li swāhā/ tse( mo ha ni swāhā/ o dan+ta li swāhā/ ltas bzang mthong na khas len bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin bsreg gis/ /slob mas sdig pa sbyang ba dang / /sa la sud liṅga bya/ /gnod byed sha za'i gzugs kyi bstim/ /ṭakli'i sngags rgya'i bcug nas kyang / /dza hu ba ho sa bcing bar bsam/ lus nad gtogs pa'ang sha za'i gzugs/ /dgugs gzhugs lan ni gsum gsum bya/ /de la phur bus btab nas kyang / /dong ni gru gsum 'og tu bya/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin bya ba yin/ /gtso mor bskyed la srung ba bya/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags phyin la/ /re zhig 'bum phrag bzlas la gzhug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bsnyen pa dang / /slob ma'i don du lha mnyes pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bsnyen pa'ang 'bad de bya/ /'khor lo bdag mo'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi khrir gsung bzhin/ /mtshan ma rtsub na khro bcu'am/ /phur gdab la sogs bsrung 'khor bya/ /gnas ni ri bo la sogs te/ /dus ni mgo dang nag pa dang / /sa ga smin drug zla ba la/ /tshes kyang gnyis gsum tshes brgyad dang / /bcu bzhi bco lnga la sogs bsngags/ /nyi zla lhag pa phur bu gza'/ /snar ma mgo lag rgyal dang dbo/ /me bzhi lha mtshams snron skrubs/ /gro bzhin chu stod khrum stod do/ /rnam sel shin skrag zug ngu 'bras/ /de sogs skar ma bzhin du sbyor/ /biṣ+ṭi dor ba'i byed pa blang / /gtor ma byin nas sa yang brtags/ /gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin/ /phul nas pus btsugs thal sbyar te/ /tshig 'di lan gsum brjod par bya/ /gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod spyin srin po gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gi bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsole/ /zhes pa'o/ /'a4 'gyur cho ga sa lha las/ /blang —346—

nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhi'i dbus/ /rang 'dug dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom/ /rig ma bzhi yi slob ma bzhis/ /mchod cing stod dbyangs snyan pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /zhes sogs gsang 'dus las gsungs pas/ /lan gsum phyogs bzhir nas gsol gdab/ /'khor los nam mkhar btegs nas ni/ khro bo'i lta bas bkra ba dang / /rkang ba rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /pad skor rdor dril 'dzin pa yis/ /rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /snying mgrin dpral ba spyi bor gtugs/ /oX badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maX/ huX zhes lan gsum bskor ba bya/ /stang stabs bzhi po 'gying zhing bca'/ /dbus nas 'dus pa lan gsum bya/ / lus dang ngag sems zhes sogs brjod/ /yungs dkar gtor bas bgegs bskrad de/ /slar yang mi 'jug mtshams gcod bya/ /lho 'phye brtags na legs 'gyur mod/ /gcig tu dgos pa ma yin pas/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas bskor nas ni/ /bgegs dang ro bsal la sogs bya/ /tseX( bhā khaX/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ /huX laX huX rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ /huX bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ bdag nyid sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas phur bu'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros 'dod rgyal sngags kyis bgegs rnams bskrad/ phur bu bskul ba dang / phur ba'i btab pa'i sngags sgrub thabs nas 'gyung ba bzhin phur bus btab ste/ dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi'i dbus kyi sar phur bu gcig gdab par mdzad de/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis pa zhig spros te phur bu bsrung ba'i don du bzhugs pa la nyer spyod lnga phul/ bgegs bsrung bar gsol ba btab/ bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gyur pa rkang pa huX las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ huX zhes bzla zhing g.yas skor du lan gsum du bskor bas/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar bgegs rnams sbyang bar bsam zhing / huX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur par bsgoms la/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod de/ nam —347—

mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la mchod bstod srung bra bya'o/ /de dag ni sa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang snga bar bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom la/ bzlas pa bya zhing / dkyil 'khor yang bdag nyid la nye bar bsdu'o/ /de nas mdun gyi sa gzhir me tog gi tshom bu dang mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo gsum pa la reg ste/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam ste/ hu hū hu/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī ā kar+ṣa ya dza de yang gser gyi mdog can lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba/ phyag g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin cing / g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ mdzes sdug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ me tog dkar po bto pa'i mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ shwakya sesge'i skyob pa yi/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ni bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btang pas/ gnang ba byin nas thim par bsam/ yang na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar/ sa chog dus su nam mkhar btegs/ 'dir ni phab nas mchod bstod byas la/ sa gzhi la thim par bya/de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i gnas su/ rang sngags kyi me tog gi tshom bu re bkod la/bsangs sbyangs/ gzhan yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ h+pha/ zhes brjod cing so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hū/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyis lha re re'i sngags kyi mthar btags ste gdan la bzhugs par —348—

bsam/ rang gi nam mkhar btegs pa'i lha rnams 'bar ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ yan lag dang skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ bdug spos thogs te/ dam tshig sgrol ma bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang yang bstan la mngon dga' rnams/ /sems can 'di la byin brlabs shing / /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes snyan gsan dbabs par bya'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs/ mchod cing bstod la/ o badz+ra rak+ṣa/ sogs kyis/ bsrung ba'i bskor bar bya'o/ /slob ma sta gon du gnas pa ni/ slob ma rnams myang 'das kyi sems brtan po zhig bskyed du gzhug /slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma gri thod 'dzin pa'i 'phyud par bskyed de/ slob ma rnams yab kyi zhal du zhugs te pad+ma ra phyung ba/ sgrol ma phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur ba bha ga'i mtha' nas spros te/ phyi rol du 'khod pa las/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /bdag gi ston pa dgyes chen khyod/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsole/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyab gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /spa gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po/ /gsang —349—

sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gang gis shākya seṅge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ / mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtog nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod de/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes brjod du gzhug go /de ltar thun mong gi sdom pa can gyis slob dpon gyi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyid/ /ces gsol ba bto/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khes rab dril bu zhes su bshad/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang —3do0—

zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod la log par mi spyad cing / /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor ma kun bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su brkyang / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yong mi spong / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtsho ni cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par mug da/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /ces lan gcig bsgrags/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid —351 —

par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum bzung / gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyi dri'i thig le byas la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ /ba lci'i dkyil 'khor du hūṃ las byung ba'i so shing / oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes 'dor du gzhug /oṃ hi bi shudha dharma sarba pa pa ni : a su sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pā na ya hu/ zhes kha bkrur gzhug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis srung skud sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra za bhan+ta dha ba/ zhes rtsa sngo ljang gi stan sbyin par bya'o/ /slar yang bsangs gtor byas la/ gnas bdun du rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pas bsrung ba bya/ /nangs par gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod/ rin chen lnga'i phye ma'am 'bras sogs kha dog bsgyur ba dang / min na rdo'i phye mas rung / /kun la sha chen khrag chen bsre/ /skye gnas ma nyams bu mo yis/ /thig skud gsar pa legs bkal pa/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur tshad byas la/ /rnam lnga kha dog so sor bya/ /thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po hu las mi bskyod pa/ dkar po oṃ las rnam snang /ser po tru las rin 'byung / dmar po hi las 'od dpag med/ ljang khu ā las don yod grub pa rnams skad cig gis 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed la/ gnas gsum dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur te thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis rlabs la/a kā ros/ phul/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las thig tshon du gyur/ sngon po la/ oṃ ā badz+ra lha ka hu hū/ dkar po la/ oṃ ā dzi na dzi ka oṃ hū/ ser po la/ oṃ ā rat+na dhika drwa hū/ dmar po la/ oṃ ā a ro le ka khyo hu/ ljang khu la/ oṃ ā pra dz+nyā dhika a hu/ /zhes re re mang du bzlas/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje sems dpar mos la skad cig tsam gyis don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ rig ma bcu gnyis lo lon pa sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang bcas te/ thig ni gdab par bya ba nyid/ /rdo rje dang bcas lag gis bzung / /re re bzhin du der gtad la/ /o a rgyo3 n+ya a nu —352—

ga tā sarba dharma pa ra spar a nu pra bi ni sarba dharma a du n+ta a nu pra bi gisarba dharma hū/rig ma'i thig skud sgril bar bya/ /ji skad rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /phyogs ma nor bar thig brgyad gdab/ /lko de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'gro don mdzad du 'di lag pas/ deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs shig ces/ thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ hu/ thig skud nam mkha' gang ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs kun mnyes par bsam/ /rang nub rig ma shar gnas la/ /lho byang thig ni gdab par bya/ /rang lho rig ma byang gnas pas/ /shar nub thig kun sngags 'di dag /tse( sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pu tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hu/de ltar ye shes thig btab nas/ khrag chen chang dang bdud rtsi lngas/ /brlan pa'i rdo rgyus dag gis ni/ /zhu bas thig ni gdab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cha ni bcu drug ste/ /gzhal yas khang pa nyid la'o/ /rta babs sgo tshad gcig tu bya/ /snam bu bcu gcig yang na bzhi/ /rtsig pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /yang na har sgor byas pa yin/ /ka rgyan gyi ni g.yas g.yon du/ /mchod rten gzugs kyis shin tu mdzes/ /bzhi pa phyed gdan nang ma gdab/ /gsum pa'ang de bzhin dbus su ni/ /re mig dgu pa zlum por bskor/ /pad+ma rdo rje me'i phyi rol/ /dur khrod gnas ni ci bder bzhag /de nyid dkyil 'khor mchog tu mdzes/ /rdo rje shugs kyis sogs nas ni/ /bdud rtsir 'khyil bar bsnyems pa yis/ /sgo dbye'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ /hi hi zhes pas rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /dbus kyi phur bu'i khung bur ni/ /nag dmar dkar ser ljang khu steng / /tshon lnga rig mas bris par bya/ /de yis steng du slob dpon gyi/ /dkar dmar ljang khu'i wo gsum bri/ /'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /o sa ma ho.a ha/ de nas ci bder tshon bgye'o/ /'dir tshon gyi rim pa rnams ni/ dbus kyi gdung dang ka ba nag /re mig rnams dang gru chad sngo/ /ut+pal dmar po sil —353 —

mar bcas/ /snam bu lnga rnams rim pa bzhin/ /nag dmar sna tshogs ser dang dkar/ /phyogs mdog dang po mi shes brgyan/ /gzhan rnams me tog phra mo bkram/ /dra phyed phyir bstan mun pa nag /mchod rten dkar zhing khyams ljang khu/ /ka rgyan glang po seṅge dang / /ri dwags la sogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /gzhan dag ji skad bshad bzhin te/ /pa ṭa sprin dang me tog sogs/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i tshon rnams phyir/ /gzugs tshogs ma yis blo gros ni/ /mkhas pa'i rang du spongs shig gsung / /dbus su ut+pal sngon po bri/ /phyogs bzhir pad dkar gser bum dang / / lcags kyu ral gri phyogs mdog bri/ /mtsham bzhir ut+pal sku mdog mtshungs/ /gra bzhir tho ba ral gri dang / /dbyug pa phur bu rnam par dgod/ /las kyi snam bu dbus ma la/ /lha yi mdog mtshungs gdan du byas la/ phyag mtshan bri na g.yas kyi lam/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu thegs pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu mdzes par bri/ /yang na khams dang rtsa shing las/ /legs bcos phyag mtshan 'god pa'o/ /lugs ma'am bris sku sa so gas kyi/ /sku gzugs dgod par byas kyang rung / /yang na sa bon sngags bcas dgod/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /der mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya cher bshams/ bsangs chu sgrub pa la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'am/med na maṇ+ḍal man dzi dang bcas pa'i steng du bum pa lnga tshom du bkod/ las bum log shig tu byas/dbus su mngon rtogs ltar gtso mo lha tshogs gzhan thams cad dang bcas pa bskyed/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i sgrol ma bskyed la/ thams cad kyang dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bsre/ skye( kalpa prak+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes kha rgyan byin gyis rlabs/ lko ta ste ta ste ma ha ta ste swāhā/ dung chos kyis nang du lha'i chu bo gaṅgā bab par bsam/ de nas gzungs thag blang nas gtso mo'i sngags brgya rtsa bzlas la/ las bum gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil ba snga ma'i cho gas bskyed nas/ rang sngags brgya'i bar du bzlas la/ mthar gtsug tor rnam — 354—

rgyal gyi gzungs ci rigs pa bzlas la/ slar yang mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/ mchod yon phul bas zhu bar bsam ste yi ge 'bru gsum brjod/ las bum gyi chu shing gi yal gas blangs/ bum pa'i mtha' skor zhing gnas khang la gtor bsung ba mdzode cig ces bya/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bum pa nyid las bum yin pas/ las bum zur du bca' mi dgos/de nas slob ma rnams la rmi lam gyi ltas dris la/ ngan na sbyin bsregs kyis ni bzlog pa bya/ ltas bzang bar mthong na/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ nang snga bar 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma byin la/ ye shes tshogs bsog mngon rtogs lhar bsgom la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ mngon rtog rdzogs par bskyed la/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyis dbus su 'dug par bsam la/ bzlas pa la thug gi bar mngon rtogs ltar bya ba la/ dbang bskur rgyas btab song ba'i mtshams su/ sta gon gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad la gnyis su med par thim/dkyil 'khor gyis mtha' mchod gtor gyi legs par bskor la/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ nang mchod/ rjes chags kyi mchod pa/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ sogs kyi rgyas par mchod nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma mngon rtogs ltar phul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma 'grub na/ shar du lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ nub tu klu/ lhor phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma'i cho ga ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par 'bul zhing / bsdu na/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul/ khar sgo nas dgyes pa rdo rje nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje glu blangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i sgo phye bas nang du zhugs te/ shar sgo'i thad kyi lha rnams 'dug par mos/ oṃ rdo rje sems khyod rol par mdzod/ /thams cad mthu yis thams cad rtsol bar mdzod/ /ji snyed mchod pa de snyed bdag 'bul na/ /'khor bar gnas pa skad cig gis grol mdzod sa ma ya ho ho lang tsho ya —355—

gnyis lo lon sems brtan ma/ /de ru rjes su chags pas mnyes byas la/ /byang chub sems spro 'od kyi bde gshegs mchod/ khu rdul lce la ba theg byas gtor bar bya/ /de ltar yang 'dus pa las/mig bzang brtan pa'i blo brtan ma/ khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /zhes so/ /bod dag 'dir ni bsam pa kho na yin gyi/ /dngos su na ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra'o/ /bla ma'i zhal nas/ de ltar na ni gsang dbang la yang der 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung zhing sems dge ba la nyes pa med par bshad pa'i don ma go ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gnas pas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir maṇ+ḍal byas la/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wa sra pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hu/ zhes smad g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ha/ zhes stod g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra u 〉 ṣa hu/ zhes gtsug tor bcing / las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi gdong g.yogs bcing / a kha bī ra hu/ zhes me tog gi chun po gtad/gnas gsum du yi ge 'khru gsum bkod la bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le bya/ skye ba'i gnas lngas snya yig re re bsgom la/ yi ge bcu pa'i bsang gtor byas pas sgrol ma rigs lngar gyur/ gtor ma sgron me lnga dang bcas pa slob ma la bskor nas lha mo lnga po rnams kyi sku las 'od zer byung / khams lnga la brtan pa'i nad dang gdon dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad khyi dang spre'u'i tshul gyi phyir byung ste sgron me lnga la thim/ oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba a the spyo dha ne swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ma ma ki ri ki ri hu swāhā/ oṃ ka ḍi bi ka ḍi ka ḍa ka ḍa ka dre swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ bden pa bdar/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas yungs dkar gtor zhing / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas la/ bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam/ /slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gnas bdun du bzung ba bya'o/ /kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni bskal ba —356—

bzang po'o/ /skal bzang des khyod ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig bdag 'tshal lo/ /snying gar zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i/ o sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa dwa ya mi/ zhes rnal 'byor dang bde ba chen po sems bskyed a ti sha'i 'brel ba las ni/ slob ma'i snying gar ā li bcu drug las zla ba na/ o tsit+ta pra ti bi dha ka ro mi/ slar yang zla ba gnyis pa/ o bo dhi tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ zla ba'i steng du/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje gyur pa rdo rje la thim badz+ra ut+pa ko3ha/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag nyid lha'i sku bde ba chen po'o / / /o sarba ya tha sarba ta thā ga tā tha a ha/ zhes brjod du gzhug ste mngon byang lngas sems bskyed par mdzad do/ /de nas/ ā kha bī ra skyo/ de nas nang du bcug la phyogs bzhi nas/o bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pa blor yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hū na ma te hū/ na mā mi hū/ na mo na ma hū swāhā zhes phyogs re re nas phyag gsum gsum bya/ phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar dam bzhag lnga bya/ ye shes dbab pa la rnam pa gsum las/ dang po yang phreng ba'i nge / shes dbab pa bzhin mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis ye shes dbabs pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma sku ji lta bar mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can la/ /lo bcu gnyis mas yang dag par 'byud pa/ de nyid snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyis lus gang / bla ma snying gar thon/ lus bde ba chen pos khyab/ sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur 'dug pas bde ba bskul bar bsam la/ rol mo rje drag je zhan bya/ gsum pa slob ma rnams sgrol ma rigs kyi bu mo bcu gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can bde ba rgyas par mos la/ snying gar don grub yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa la sems 'jog tu bcug cing / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs —357—

par slob dpon gyi mos la/ o ma li mi li hū phaṭa/ zhes drag tu bzla zhing rol mo bya/ rol mo sgra ni lag len bzhin myur dal spel ma bya/ des kyang ma babs na bar chad yin pas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzla zhing / slar yang dbab par bya'o/ /phebs pa ni brtan par bya ste/ glu( tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ pra ti pa ti ta/ hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ni rdo me bha ba:zhes sogs kyis me tog dor/ de nas phyi rol du dri bzang dang rang byung gi rdul gyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi byas la/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog bkod de/ de nas lha so sor mos la/ mdun skyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes pa gnyis spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gtso bo'i snying po mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyi bsrung ba byas la/ dar dmar po dgab bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir rdul tshon la phul bar mos nas/ dngos su me tog gi maṇ+ḍal dor ro/ /rigs kyi lha 'di yin zhes brda' sprad/ de nas gnas gdong dar dkrol ba dang / blta bar bskul ba 'phreng ba bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyi me tog thog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams re re bzhin sgom tshul rgyas par bshad/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sho3ha/ o yo ga ma/khral mahā maṇ+ḍal dri she two3ha/ o gu phya maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣa ka two3ha/ zhes ched du brjod pa bya bar gzhug /de nas slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje: sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ nang dbang yan lag zhi spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rigs kyi lhas me tog gis phreng ba spyi bor bcing par bsam/ glu( pra ti gro hā sta/ i ma satwa ma bā la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag /lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis bsngags pa'i dri'i chu dung chos su blang nas lha thams cad kyi dbang bskur bar bsam la/ ji ltar bltam pa sogs brjod cing dbang bskur/ lha rnams rin po che'i cod pan spyi bor bcing par bsam la/ me tog phreng ba mgo la bcing / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas slob ma'i snying gar 'phos par bsam la/ rus 'phreng mgrin par bzhag la/ bzlas —358—

lung lan gsum dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya/ de phyin chad lha dang bla ma nam du yang spang bar ma byed cig /zhes brjod/ de dag ni rig pa gtad pa'i dbang ngo / /de nas bum chu rnams thod par bsdus la sa bon bzhi las lha mo bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ slob ma skad cig gis mi bskyod pa he ru kar mos/ rang 'dra'i dbu rgyan rang mas su bcas su bsam/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang ye shes pa gzhug /dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ me tog gtor zhing rol mo'i bar du mchod pa bya'o/ /skye( a bhi ti zhwa zhi / maX sarba ta tha ga tā ༷ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug /phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar shis pa brjod/ sangs rgyas —rnams ni: zhes kyis mthar/oṃ māX lwaX pāX tāX huX huX badz+ra a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ zhes dbang skur/ de nas dbu rgyan zhu ba las rdo rjer sgom/ slob ma 'od dpag med du bskyed la/ sa bon lnga las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo bskyed la/ slob ma rin 'byung sgom/ oṃ bhuX aX dzi khaX huX huX rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khri nyu huX/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo la bkon pas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan par bsam/ rdo rje je las don yod grub pa rang snang gi yum can du bskyed la/ oṃ hūX khaX huX/ badz+ra a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje lag tu gtad/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid kyang byin la/ dril bu khyi las gtso mor bskyed de zhu nas/ slob ma don yod grub par bskyed/ oṃ huX tāX hūX badz+ra a dhi pa snya staX/ a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid dang / rig ma yang dag par gtad pas phyag rgyas de nyid kyang sbyin par bya'o/ /dzaXhūX baX hoX las rdo rje dang dril bu sgo ma bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ slob ma rnam snang du bskyed la/ oṃ dzaXhuX baX hoX badz+ra satwa stoX/ a bhi khri ñca :// badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta he shri/ che ge mo rdo rje zhes ming gdags par bya'o/ /bud med la ni mā ma gī sogs yum la yab kyis 'phyud par bskyed pa yin no/ /dbang de dag re re'i mthar chu dbang re bskur zhing / 'di'i mgo mjug tu 'gyung ba'i chu dbang thams cad la rol mo'i sgra mdzad cing / khye'u dang bu mo mchod —359—

rdzas thog pa rnams kyis mchod par bya/ de nas mig thur/ me long / mda' gzhi/ dril bu rnams phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ slob mas las bzhi'i lha mo so sor bskyed la/ dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas ye shes pa re re bzhin du bstim la/ las bzhi'i so so'i bum pa'i dbang bskur/ so so'i bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje brtul zhugs ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par byin la/ hu las 'byung ba'i gri gug dang / a las byung ba'i thod khrag lag pa g.yon du sbyin la/ o karki ka ri/ sarba mā ra ṇa/ mā pa ka rta ya rta ya hu phaṭa/ o badz+ra ka pā la sarba sha tru ṇa/ rak+ta dha ra ya hū phaṭa/ snying po bzlas pa'i cang te'u g.yas dang / rtsa sngags bzlas pas ut+pal g.yon du byin la/mchan khung du kha ṭa ga bkod la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgoms shig bya/ de nas lung bstan dang dbugs dbyung / gzengs bstod dang / dam tshig bstan pa rnams kyang phreng ba las 'byung ba bzhin du bya/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i slob ma thun mong ba rnams re zhig de tsam gyi don yod grub par bya'o/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzung bar mi nus na/ sems bskyed dam bzhag /ye shes 'bar ba rnams dor/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams rdzogs par bya/ nang dbang mi bskur bar rig gtad tsam bya/de la ni sta gon gyi skabs su yang rig lnga'i sdom bzung mi bya'o/ /gal te tshe 'di nyid la mchog don du gnyer ba la ni dbang gong ma bzhi yang sbyin par bya dgos la/ de la dbang stegs pad+ma dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag /gsol btab dang dam tshig gsum spyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ slob ma'i snying gar gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas lha rnams rdzogs par spros de rang rang gi sngags kyis slob ma'i snying ga'i gzhal yas khang du bkod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ de ni sku'i dbang ngo / /gsung rdo rje/ yan lag bskyed pa'i dung chos la tsan na dmar po'i phreng ba lag tu gtad la/ ā li kā li de nyid lnga spel du byas pa lan gsum brjod cing snying po lan brgya'i bzlas lung sbyin no/ /phreng ba spyi —360—

bor bzhag /snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ yi ge'i gzugs kyis ye shes pa bstim/ gsung gi dbang ngo / /rdo rje snying gar bkod la/ snying po'i mthar rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi sngags bcug pas phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khore du gyur/ phyag mtshan gyi ye shes pa stim/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mtsho ni cha 'khordo ra lo bla na med/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bu khyod long / /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ / oX sarba ta tha ga ta tsakra brta na a bhi khiñca skyoX/ de bzhin du badz+ra dang rdo rje sogs 'don pa spos la/rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur te thugs kyi dbang ngo / /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba ltar/rigs lnga'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ phyag rgya lnga slob ma'i lus la bkod la/ spyi bo'i 'kho‘ra lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ kha ṭāX ga ni shes rab ste/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin cang te nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ming pos gzung / /de ni spyod pa'i dbang ngo / /slar yang las bzhi'i bum pa rang sngags kyis dbang bskur/ 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo / /dngos grub brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan byas la lag tu gtad nas/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /dngos grub kyi dbang ngo / /de nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bud med lang tsho ma chas su gzhug pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan la/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis dngos su 'byud du bcug nas/ de'i bde ba ngo sprad la nu ma ru gzhug go /de ni bum pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'am/ bdun po de dag re re'i mthar skye gnas ma nyams pa'i bu mos thogs pa'i bum pa las/ yal 'dab kyi chu blangs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ sogs kyi 'jug tu/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi khiñca hūX/ su ra ta stuX a haX/ de dag gi slob ma la —361 —

mchod bstod rgya chen po byas la/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar gzungs thag rdo rje bzung la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha /sogs dang rten wel snying po lan mang du bzlas shing / me tog tor la rol wo bya/ ro dro spyo sti sogs shis brjod bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang 'di nyid la de nyid la skos su mi byed na/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i sngon/ chu nas ming gis bar du ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyin pa'am/ dngos su bsdus pa sbyin par bya'o/ /dbang gi mthar rtsa ba'i lhung ba la sogs pa dam tshig gi rnam bzhag ci rigs pa bshad/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod du gzhug /gsang ba 'di su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ khren tu rno pa'i shu la ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gis dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'bigs/ /glu( mahā sa ma ya ha na hu phaṭa/ ces rtse gsum snying gar bzhag /de nas rjes kyi bya ba mtha' dag bya'o/ /gal te gsang dbang bskur 'dod na/ /lha ma gshegs par bya ba shes/ /yang na maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /chos 'byung zur drug tshom bu bcas/ /bdag mdun dbyer med rnam par bsgoms/ /mchod gtor dbang 'jug blang bar bya/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor khang pa yis/ / phyi rol yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ /bu mo lo bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar mtshan nyid tshang ba slob dpon la phul te/ khyed la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu rtsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don gnyer/ /mgon po khyod kyi brtse bas zungs/ /byang chub rdo rje: sogs kyis lan gsum gsol btab/ mig dar/ me tog sems bskyed sngar ltar bya/ mgrin par chos 'gyung gi dbus su sngags phreng g.yon du bskor ba la sems gtad/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ rig pa'i dbang lnga slob ma dang phyag rgya gnyis ka la mdor bsdus su bskur la/ phyag rgya rnam rtog dang bcas pa yin na gdong bcing / mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te snyoms par zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems gsang bar lhan —362——

cig skyes pas ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thig le cung zad yum gyi mkhar gyur cing rdo rje la gnas pa byang chub kyi sems slob ma'i khar bab ste/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la/ shes rab ma'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i thig le yang / slob ma'i khar bab la/ 'di ni dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ /bde ba chen po myang bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ /des kyang / e ma bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs sngar bzhin bsal nas/ pad+ma la bltas pa'i dga' ba ngo sprad/ nang mchod byin la/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bsha/da/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya/ /de nas shes rab ye shes dbang gi dbang bskur bar 'dod na/ /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum pad+ma ra bcas/ /g.yin ni ji ltar sngar bshad bzhin/ /snying ga'am lte bar zur drug pa/ /'khyil ba dang bcas bskor bas phebs/ /bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzode/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes dang / dbang po gnyis kyis sbyor ba gang / /rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ /ye shes mtsho ni cha rnams 'chang ba mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ /dbang po'i dra ba 'phro zhing 'od zer 'khrugs/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i mtshan ma dang —363—

gcug mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab par bya/ /gal te gsang dbang gi phyag rgya de nyid slob ma nyid kyi phul ba yin na/'dir slob ma la sbyin du rung ste/ ro mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ /de nyid la yang bya bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gzhan du na slob dpon gyi phyag rgya la bgrod pas ni dmyal ba'i rgyu mi bzad pa yin pa'i phyir gsang dbang yan chad thob pa la ma nyams pa'i bu mo gzhan zhig gi lag pa sbyin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i/ /lha mo 'di ni khyod ma shes/ /mtha' yas bde la spyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun du phyag rgya long / /gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gis dngos grub med/ /de gnyis don 'grub yab yum du bskyed la/ lce la bdud rtsi bzhag cing rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ skye mched lnga dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dga' bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang bde stong sgom tshul zhib tu bshad la/ rab rib ma'am 'thib mo'i mchod pa'am/ dben khang gzhan du slob dpon 'gro bar bya'o/ /de'i shes rab ma gos dang bral ba dri bzang gis bgos pa'i pad+ma mdzub mos gsal bar bstan te/ ci bde bu khyod 'di spro'am/ /nga las dam tshig len par ni/ /bshang gci rak+ta bza' ba dang / /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/ slob mas kyang / khyod las mi gtsang bza' bar ni/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi mi mo kun gus bya/ /yang smras pa/ a re bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /bdag nyid dngos grub rtsol mdzad ma/ /dal bu dal bus rab sbyor bas/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin gyi/ /dbus su ze'u 'brus rnam brgyan pa'i/ /chu skyes 'dab ma gsum par —364—

gzigs/ /a ho bde ba can gyi zhing / /sangs rgyas sku mdog dmar pos mdzes/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo tshul/ /des ni bu khyod 'bras bur bcas/ /de nas sngon slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i cho ga'i rim pas mkha' gsang byin rlabs/ /de kho na nyid kyis nges pa brtan po bskyed la/ rjes su chags pa'i dga' ba cam pa/ra bya ste/ de la tshig gi bskul ba dang / /rjes chag spel ba la rtsa bcal ba dang / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sbyor ba la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes ngos bzung ba dang / dga' bzhi'i dbye ba'i mchog tu nges par bya ba dang / bde ba sa bcu gsum dang sbyar bas so/ /de la dang po ni/ shes rab mas/ rol zhig rol zhig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ma/ khyod kyi gzhan du mi rtogs pas/ /rtogs pas the tshom ma byed cig /ces glu blangs te/ phan tshun rjes su chags pa drag tu bskyed de/ gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma can la sogs pa rig dang rjes su mthun pa'i sbyor thabs so sor bya zhing / shes rab kyis mgul nas dam du 'byud pa'i bcings shing skra nas bzung bas gdong mi g.yo ba legs par blta/ bung ba lta bu i yig gi sgra'i glu dang / brla gnyis kyi bar tu nye bar blta bas mchu yis rtse bar bya/ 'gying bag gi stabs kyi 'khyud nas lkog ma la brten te ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi gzhib/ rtsa bskul bslang ba rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ /nu ma gnyis dang lag sor gyi rtse cho/ rnams dang / /ma mchu dang / 'gram pa dang / rna ba'i rtse mo dang / mig gi mtha' dang / spyi bo dang / gsang ba rnams su tsum pa bya'o/ bar pa rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ rla ba gnyis dang / mchan khung gnyis dang / nam tshong dang bha ga'i 'gram gnyis su sen mos btab/ dka' ba rnams bskul ba'i phyir du nu ma gnyis dang / mchan khung gnyis dang / lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis su mnye zhing / so'i ri mo bya'o/ /pad+ma'i mtha' rnams bskul ba dang / lce gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor bas/rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ na ra na si ka mchog tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam —36nga —

par bltas pas kyang rjes su chags pa bskul nas/ ji skad bshad pa'i rjes kyi dbang mchog la nye bar bgos te/ g.yon phyogs na gnas pa'i rtsa bya gdong gi gzugs can sad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje pad+ma ra reg par bsnyen pa/ rdo rje pad+ma ra zhugs pa nyer bsgrub dang /bskyod pa las shes rab ma 'a 'e shes rnam pa lnga'i rtags mchog gi nye bar brgyan pa na/ shes rab ma rjes su chags pa'i rtags des kyang / rang rgyud kyi bde ba chen po re re nas lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang snying 'dar ba dang dran pa nyams pa ni me long ye shes/ skra grol zhing 'dug tshul zhig pa ni sor rtogs ye shes/ gos 'dor zhing rnam rtog bral ba ni chos dbyings ye shes/ lus rdul gyi khyab pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes/ bzhin dmar po 'gyur ba dang / mig phra pa dang / zim bus blta ba ni bya grub ye shes te/ de dag gi sgrub pa'o/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems nor bur son pa na bde ba yun ring du bsgom zhing / gal te thig le 'dzag pa 'dra na btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas bkag pas/rang dang rig ma gnyis car ba sbu ldang ba dang mchi ma 'byung ba sogs nyid stobs brgyad 'byung ngo / /de dag gi sgrub pa chen po'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thabs shes rjes su chags pas 'khyud dang 'o byed pa dang nu ma mnyed la sogs pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rim pas/ dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'i bar du dga' ba dri bde ba cung tsam bskyed do/ /mtsho skyes kyi 'dab mar chud ba'i rdo rje bskyod pa las nor bu'i rtsa bar byang sems 'ong pa'i bar du mchog dga' ste/ de las lhag pa'i bde ba'o/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su son pa'i nor bu las thig les shes rab ma'i sna rtser spros pa 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas sngon nyams su myong ba 'di lta bu'o zhes nye bar sem/sa pa'i bde ba ni dga' bral te chags bral lo/ /las dang po pas dbang gi skabs su bzung bar ma nus na/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i sprin spros — 366—

par bsam nas/ phaṭa ces brjod cing thig le phyung la pad+ma la gnas pa lces blang par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gzugs mdzes pa mthong ba'i bde ba la sems zin na sa dang po dang / de bzhin du glu dbyangs dang / 'khrig tshig dang / dga' ba'i sgra las byung ba'i bde ba sa gnyis pa dang / dri tshor ba las byung ba'i bde ba sa gsum pa dang / o tha gzhib pa las byung ba'i bde ba sa bzhi pa dang / phyi'i reg bya'i bde bas sa lnga pa dang / mnyam par sbyor ba'i ye shes sa drug pa dang / chu skyes dam zhing dgos pa la sogs pa khams kyi bde ba bdun pa dang / rdo rje nor bu'i zil ba sogs chu khams las thob pa sa brgyad pa dang / bha ga la d+ma'i drod sogs me khams las dgu pa dang / lus 'dar ba dang thig le g.yo ba sogs rlud las thob pa'i bde ba ni bcu pa dang / de dag las skyes pa'i chags pa dang chags bral dang chags pa bar ma'i ye shes re re sa re re ste/ de ltar na lhan skyes ye shes bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa lhag pa'i lha'o/ /de yang bdag dang rig ma lhar gsal ba dang /skra grol ba sdul ba sogs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag /'phyud cing snyoms par 'jug pa kha spyor gyi yan lag /thig le zhu ba bde chen gyis yan lag /de la sems zin pa pas stong bar mthong ba rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag /de ltar na ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje 'jug pa snying rje chen po'i yan lag /sems bde ba dang gsal rig rtag tu gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag go /'bras bu la mi bsdu ba nyid kyi yan lag bdun ldan te/ 'on kyang gnas gsang ba 'ba' zhig dang / 'phral du skye 'gag byed pa/ ngal ba sogs sdug bsngal dang bcas pas don dam pa'i bde ba ma yin/ lam 'di kho na'i ye shes kyi sa bcu gsum myur du thob par 'gyur gyi/thabs gzhan gyi ma yin no/ /yang na dbang 'di tshig gis sbyin par bya'o/ /gsal snang ma thob pa de srid du las kyi phyag rgya las gzhan pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang gi ye shes nyams su myong ba med pa'i phyir/ mchog zab pa ma yin ces gsungs so/ /de nas slob dpon la yon dbul zhing / tshogs —367—

kyi 'khor lo bya'o/ /tsa tu med la dbang mi bskur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo med pa la/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang mi bskur/ /bzhi pa'i don gyi de nyid ni/ /mchog gi slob ma dag la sbyin/ khengs ldan nyan thos gsang mi thub/ /blun po rgyal po rtog ge ba/ /rgan po la sogs dbang bzhi bkal/ /nyi ma gzhan la mchod pa dang / /bcas nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsole / / /zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i phyag rgya gtad de/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos 'dzin du bcug /de nyid dper byas te rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ngo sprad/ kun khyab gdung med rgyun mi chad/ /rnam rtog 'thib cing rang rig pa/ / zab gsal gnyis su med pa ste/ /thig le bde ba kha spyor ba'o/ /dpag bsam gyi shing dang / lha'i sku phyogs bcur bgrod pa dang /mang don legs par rtsa gcod pa sogs man ngag ltar shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon ji ltar mnyes pa de de nyid sgrub pa yin no/ /lhag chad bskang zhing bzod par gsol/ oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bi shwa rū pa dha ri ru ru su bhā ba za na kṛ ta rnye na sarba bzhi shang bi sa rdza ye ta ma ma kar+ya ku ra kyi swāhā/ zhes : sngags kyi rtsa thig gi thad dang / thig chen brgyad kyi thig rnams thog mar dbyi rdul tshon lhag ma rnams bum par blug / klu brgyad cho ga spyi dang mthun pas chu bor spyan drangs/ slar yang bum pa chus bkang ste dkyil 'khor gyi sar gtor de shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /phyag len pa ni/ rjes chog mchod stod kyi rjes su yang shis brjod re mdzad do/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i lngin zhug thams cad dam skabs 'dir nges par sbyin bsregs bya ste/ /de cho ga ni 'o snye las shes par bya'o/ /de yang ma 'grub na gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa nyin so sor nges par bya'o/ /dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun rnam par spel ba 'di/ /gangs can zhing sar kho bos nyer drangs pa/ /skal ldan zhing sa rnams kyi nyer 'tsho ste/ /thub bstan skyed tshal mchog tu rgyas byed yin/ /'di'i dge —368—

bas sems can thams cad myur du rdo rje 'chang chen po gyur cig/ // ces pa sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas 'di nyid kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa de nyid gzhir bzhag cing / phyag len gyis kha skong ji ltar mdzad pa ltar ma 'khrul bar bkod pa ste/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag /bla ma rnam gsum gyi zhal lung te/ rang lo nyer bdun pa la bkod pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba ma dha la/ / bkra shis/ /

myur gter bzhugs/na mo gu ra we/ mchog 'dod rnams la bdud rtsi lta bu'i gtam/ /dpag yas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po'i nyer brtan pa/ /'phags yul grub pa'i thugs bcud 'dir babs kyi/ /blo ldan skal bzang tshogs rnams yi rang byos/ /dri med nam mkha'i lus can 'od 'bar ma/ /gnyen lcug 'khril ldem rdo rje gar gyi ros/ /'pho ba'i gdung sel bde ba rab byin ma/ /sgyu 'phrul bdag mo 'phags ma sgrol mar 'dud/ /ma bcos rig pa gtsor gyur gang / / lhag bsam shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /bla med ye shes 'od stong can/ /sngon med gang de 'di na shar/ /'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bla ma'i zhal snga nas 'byung ba mdo tsam rjod par bya ste/ thog mar sdig sgrib sbyang ba ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba las/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /ye shes me dpung dkar po bsam/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /gnas las me ni 'bar bar sgrub/ /mtshams med lnga dag byed pa yang / /gtsang ma'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa rdo rje'i ye shes 'dis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ rang dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba'am/ tha mal —370—

par gnas kyang rung ste/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su lha mo sgrol ma phyag bzhi ma 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba de'i thugs kar zla ba la ta gyi tha mar sngags kyi bskor ba/ yig 'bru thams cad las me dkar po 'bar ba bsam ste/sngags bzlas pas/ me lce de nyid cher 'bar te ye shes sems dpa'i sku gang /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi po rnams nas rim gyis 'bar bas/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad rnge/ ri dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi sgo dgu nas me lce yongs su 'jug cing / de'i rkyen gyis kyang snying ga'i thig le me dpung dkar po'i ngo bor gyur/ lus thams cad mes gang ste/ de'i 'od kyi sems can de rnams kyis sdig sgrib bsregs par bsam/ mthar me rnams rang gi snying ga'i me la bsdu'o/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ o tā re tu stu re tu re sarba pā pa k+ṣa ya ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas bar chad bzlog par byed nga/ ni/ rgyud las/ sbu las nad rnams spre'u 'am/ khyi dang 'dra bar rab tu dbyung / /nad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig 'dis/ /rdo rje mtshon chas bsnun par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ snying gar ye shes sems dang/'a/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ta yig ljang khur rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i 'od zer rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi nas brgyud de rtsa thams cad rab tu khyab nga/sa/ nad rnams dang / nad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang / gdon dang bar chad thams cad me lce'i gdung bas phyir ded de/ nad rnams spre'u'i rnam pas dang / gdon rnams khyi'i rnam pas ba skru'i bu ga nas phyi rol du phyung ste/ yang sa —371 —

bon gyi 'od zer me lce lta bu dang / rab tu rno ba'i mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/nad gdon de rnams phye mar gtubs shing me lces bsregs pas/ thal bar gyur la/ thal ba'ang rlung gi gtor bar bsam/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re sarba ro ga nā sha ya nā sha ya hūX phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ /byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rgyud las/ zla ba nyi ma'i rlung gi dbus/ /rang sngags sa bon sgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid dmigs gyur na/ /bcu drug pa la de 'grub 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ rang gtso mor bsam pa'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yang gsal btab nas ro ma'i dwangs ma nye ba'i gtum mo dang bcas pa/ chos 'khor gyi lte bar nyi ma dang /rkyang ma'i dwangs ma spyi bo'i haX dang bcas pa snying ga'i dbus su son pa/ zla bar gyur/ de gnyis kyi dbus su mi shigs pa'i rlung taX yig ljang khu/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa la sgrol ma phyag bzhi ma/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la taX ljang khu 'od zer 'phro ba/ rang gi dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX snying ga chos 'khor gyi 'og tu huX rnams bsam la/ oX āXtaX huX ces ma yengs pa'i yid kyi rtag tu bzlas pa bya'o/ /phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa bzlog par 'dod na/ rgyud las/ rang sngags sa bon 'od zer gyi/ /rdo rje gur sogs rtag par bya/ /'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba dang / /lus med rnams kyis kyang mi mthong / /zhes te/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs snga ma bzhin du sgoms la/ sa bon sngags bcas las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir song /ji tsam bsrung ba'i sa phyogs de tsam du ut+pal dmar po'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur de'i phyi rol phyogs kun tu/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba dang —372—

bcas pa/ me'i gseb thams cad khro mo drag gtum 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyis khengs shing / de rnams kyi phyi rol steng gi nam mkha' char sprin glog 'gyu bas khyab pa/ khor yug thams cad de las byung ba'i rdo rje me lce'i ser ba 'bab cing / 'og gi gzhi thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi me lte rab tu 'bar ba can du bsam la/ o tā re tut+ta re tu re sarba du ni pra du ni ma ma kri te dzam bha ya a stum bha ya mo ha ya ban+ta ya hū hu hu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra rak+ṣa tsakra sā dha ya sma dha ya hū phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa bya'o/ /de dag ni bskyed rim rnal 'byor chen po ste sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ spyir rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi rnal 'byor bzhi las/ rnal 'byor dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor bcas yin la/rnal 'byor phyi ma gsum ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin pas 'dir de rnams bshad na/ rjes su rnal 'byor la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi bogs 'don gsum las/dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun gnad du phab nas/ mig sna rtser blta zhing / sems yang der gtad la/ sna nang du 'od dmar ser du ba lta bu yal la la 'dug pa la dmigs/ yang na mig gnyis sna'i rtsa ba la blta zhing / smin mtshams kyi gnas der thig le dkar po 'od 'tsher ba zhig la sems gtad/de rnams mi bde na lag len bzhin smin mtshams nas mtho gang ngam/ khru gang tsam bcal ba'i nam mkha' la che re mig gis blta zhing / rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa cung zad kyang mi byed par rang lugs su bzhag /de gsum la brten nas rtags snang du ma mthong ba dang / nang byang ba dang / thig le brtan pa dang / zhi —373—

gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' dbus med pa skye'o/ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor gyi gzhi zhi gnas de nyid cung zad brtan nas/ kha nang log gi shes pas rang rig de nyid ngo shes kyi tshul du che re bltas pas/ brjod bral gyi ngang nas rig stong ma 'gags pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems rang byung du shes par bya'o/ /rnam par rtog pa dang yul gyi snang ba ci byung yang / skyes tsam nyid nas de nyid kyi ngo bo ngo shes bsten par bya ste/ rnam rtog rang byung du shes par byed pa'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ dngos po bde rdzun rnams dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong / /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ gzungs kyi sgos bogs 'don pa dang / bdud gzhom pas bogs 'don pa'o/ /dang po ni rgyud las rnam grangs mang bar gsungs kyang / man ngag tu rnam pa dgu po 'di dag mdzad de/ dang po ni/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i ngang nas lus kyi snying ga'i gnas su sems gtad la/ a zhes bya ba'i gdangs shig bsam ste/ de'i ngo bo la rnam par dpyad na/ de lta bu'i gdangs de/ dbang po lnga'i yul du mi snang zhing / lus kyi phyi nang gang du yang med pas ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba rnam par yid ngor lam me snang ba ma 'gags pa de nyid la che re bltas shing legs par brtags na/ rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jog /ngag tu a zhes brjod cing / sgra de dang sngar yid yul du bsam pa'i a zhes bya ba'i sgra spyi de la 'brel ba 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de yang yid la dngos po gzhan zhig bsam kyang a zhes ngag tu brjod du rung la/ 374—

a yig gi sgra spyi bsam bzhin du tshig gi brjod pa gzhan yang 'byung bar mthong bas de gnyis 'brel ba med par thag bcad la/ yang yang mnyam par ba theg /de la a ni yi ge thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin cing / de'i sgra don rang bzhin med par shes pas ngag thams cad grag stong du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de tsam gyis kyang thag ma chod na/ ming don gzhan gyi steng du gtan la 'bebs te/ lhas byin zhes pa lta bu/ rang bzhin gyi ming gang yang rung ba thig yid la bsam ste/ tshig spyir snang ba'i rnam rtog de la snang ba ltar don la med pa gong bzhin thag bcad/ de dang ngag tu brjod pa la'ang 'brel ba med par gong bzhin thag bcad/ sgra rtog de gnyis dang rang gi lus sems la 'brel ba ci yang mi snang ste/ gal te de la 'brel ba yod na ming de kho na las don de'i rnam pa 'char dgos pa las/ don de la gzhan mang por ming btags kyang / rnam rtog gis bzhag pa'i tshe de dang de'i rnam pa 'char zhing / rnam rtog gi ma bzhag pa'i tshe/ lhas byin zhes brjod kyang skyes bu lhas byin gyi rnam pa mi 'char ba bzhin/ ming thams cad de dang 'dra bar shes par byas la yang yang mnyam par ba 'ag pas/ sgra thams cad brag cha dang 'dra bar nges par rtog par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni hu gi gzungs te/ sngar gyi zhi lhag de dang 'brel ba'i ngang nas/ rang gi lus kyi khong la sems gtad de/ hu ring po yang yang brjod pa la dmigs skor gcig go /de nas ye shes lnga ldan du sgom ste/ ci yang mi bsam zhing bzo bcos med par 'jog pa ni chos dbyings ye shes so/ /de'i ngang nas sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyis bsgrims nas blta ba ni me long ye shes so/ /lus sems nang —375— ri

dang snang ba gzhan rnams phyi ste/ phyi nang thams cad la dmigs nas che re blta zhing lhod kyi glod pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /de kha'i ngang nas lha sku gsal stong du lam gyi 'char bar byas nas de la ma bcos par 'jog pa ni/ sor rtog ye shes so/ /sems can thams cad la snying rje dung tsam sgom zhing snga ma'i ngang bskyang ba ni bya sgrub ye shes so/ /de ltar lnga po re re la zan khams gcig za ba'i yun tsam re 'jog cing / dmigs pa re re 'pho mtshams su hū ring po re brjod do/ /bar skabs su snga ma lhar lta ba yun ring du bskyang ste/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /'dis ni skad cig re rer dmigs pa sna tshogs la dbang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni phaṭa kyi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang sngar gyi zhi lhag gi ngang nas/ sems gnas pa las rnam rtog gi 'char sgo nam byung ba'i tshe/ phaṭa yig brjod par bya'o snyam nas dran pa yang yang bzhag /rnam rtog nam skyes pa'i tshe phaṭa brjod/ ched kyi 'phro ni mi gcod/ rnam rtog de yal ba'i tshe yang phaṭa yig brjod/ de 'gags nas gzhan zhig shar na phaṭa yig brjod/ gang ltar na'ang sems kyi 'char sgo/ skye 'gag ci byed kyang / spang blang dgag sgrub g.yin ni mi byed la phaṭa yig rtag tu dran cing brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni kha gi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa shugs drag po ci shar yang / dngos po thams cad nam mkhar sgom pa ste/ dper na 'di ni mi yin no snyam pa'i tshe 'a zhes brjod cing mi de nyid nam mkha' dang dbyer med du yal bar bsam la cung zad bzhag /des mtshon pa'i —376—

'di ni 'di'o zhes 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi yul thams cad dang / khyad par bde sdug dga' skyo 'jigs skrag zhum pa yang ngo tsha nga rgyal skye ba sogs mtho dman gyi yul thams cad la mnyam par bsre/ lnga pa ni/ a 'i gzungs te/ gnyis su snang ba thams cad la/ de gnyis ka'i ngo bo la cher gyi bltas pas/ snang ba'i dmigs gtad mnyam du zhig pa la cham me 'jog pa ste/ dper na rang dang dgra gnyis kyi snang ba lam gyi shar ba na/ snang ba gnyis po de'i steng du cher gyis bltas pas/ ngos bzung gi mtshan ma zhig pa'i ngang der cham gyis mnyam par 'jog /rim pa de kho nas/ bzang ngan mtho dman/ che chung legs nyes/ g.yas g.yon/ mtha' dbus/ snyan mi snyan/ bde sdug sogs thams cad la sbyar bas/mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa ni/ ya yig ste/ rlud gi dkyil 'khor gcig bsam la/ ngag tu ya zhes brjod cing / rlung gi dkyil 'khor de/ gnas gang na gnas/ tshad ji tsam/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ji ltar grub/ sems su grub bam phyi rol du grub ces dpyad na/ der snang tsam zhig ma gtogs/ bden dngos su grub rgyu cung zad kyang med pa'i gsal stong la mnyam par bzhag ste/ yig ngor sgom pa ste dmigs pa dang po'o/ /yang rlung gi reg bya la bslab pa ste/ dkar khung la sogs pa nas/ rlud 'jam po dag ldang pa rang gi lus la phog par byas te/ de'i reg bya yang zhing 'jam pa yul yul po de la sems rtse gcig tu bsres te reg bya de 'dra pa la mnyam par ba theg / skabs 'gar rang lus snang ba dang bcas pa/ rlud gi reg bya tsam de la thim par bsam/ de gcig pu ma gtogs g.yin gang yang mi bsam par ci nus mnyam —377—

par bzhag /ngag tu ya zhes rtag tu bzla bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa gnyis pa'o/ /bdun pa ni re yig gi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang dmigs pa dang po'o/ /ra bzla zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni khyad par te/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/me nyid kyi rnam pa la bslab pa ni/ 'grub na 'og tu bud shing / bar du me 'bar ba/ steng nas du ba mthul ba'i thab zhig/ byas la/ de la lta ching / g.yin yid la mi byed par/ de gcig pu la blta zhing / de'i thad du de dang 'dra ba'i me zhig yid la 'char bar byas te/ slar de nyid kyi steng du sngar bzhin cham me mnyam par bzhag /de nas snang ba gzhan shar ba kun kyang me de la bsres pas/thams cad me'i rnam pa 'ba' zhig tu lam lam 'gyur ba la sems gtad do/ /brgyad pa ni/ wa yig gi gzungs kyi sgo la dmigs pa dang po/ /wa bzla zhing chu'i dkyil ge nar sgom pa ni gong ma gnyis dang 'dra/ mdun du chu snod dwangs pa zhig tu chu gtsang 'jug /de la blta zhing / chu de nyid kyi thad du de kho na dang 'dra ba'i chu zhig yid kyis bsam ste/ yang de kha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /rnam rtog gang shar ba'i yul de mdun gyi chu dang bsres te/ gzhan mi bsam par chu 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i tshul gyis sgoms/ dgu pa ni/ la yig gi gzungs ni/dmigs pa dang po/ la bzla zhing sa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa sogs 'dra/ mdun du sa'i rnam pa zlum po'am gru bzhi mtshon sna lnga po gang yang rung ba legs po zhig gis kha bsgyur ba zhig byas la/ de la blta zhing / de'i thad du de dang 'dra ba'i kha dog can sra ba zhig sgom/ gzhan gang yang mi bsam/ de nas gang snang thams cad kha dog can gyi sa'i gzugs brnyan de la thim par sgom/—378—

lhag ma bzhi po de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo bla ma rnams kyi yan lag yin no/ /gnyis pa mi mthun phyogs gsal ba bdud gzhom pa ni/ dang por bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ sngar bzhin zhi lhag gnyis sgoms la/ rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci byung yang / hū zhes brjod cing 'phro bcad/ thun mtshams rnams su/ spyod lam sna tshogs pa dang bsres te/ dper na rjes su rnal 'byor gyi gzhi la gnas bzhin pas/ 'og khang nas khang steng lta bur 'gro ba'am/ snang ba'i sa nas mun par 'jug pa'am/ mun pa'i sa nas snang ba dang bcas pa'i sar 'gro ba dang /nang nas phyi rol du spyod pa la sogs pa yul dus bya ba mi 'dra ba re la/ sems kyi 'gyur ba'i khyad par re yong bas de kun la hu zhes bya bas 'phro bcad cing stong pa nyid dang bsres te/ dmigs skor gcig /yang dga' sdug chags sdang 'jigs pa la sogs par snang ba thams cad la/ de bzhin bsre ste dmigs skor gcig /gnod byed dgra dang gdon yid yul du bsam ste snying rje drag tu bsgoms pas/ hū zhes brjod cing de dang rang sems dbyer med du bsre ste dmigs slor gcig /yang nye du la sogs pa chags yul yid la bsam ste/ hū zhes zhen pa bcad la/ de dang rang sems bsres te bzhag pa dmigs skor gcig /'byung ba dang sems can la brten pa'i yang 'jigs pa thams cad la yang de bzhin du sbyang ba dmigs skor gcig ste lnga'o/ /de ltar rang gi khyim du legs par 'byongs pa na/ mtshan mo dur khrod la sogs par yud re song la sems brtan mi brtan brtag /mi brtan na re zhig rang gi khyim du sgom/ gang gi tshe brtan pa na dur khrod dang / bas mtha' la sogs par/ gnod sbyin dang srin —379

——po 'byung po gnas pa'i sar chos brgyad dang mthun pa'i rnam par nya/ pa hrul gyis bshig nas/ yul dus spyod lam ma nges par rgyus pas/ sems kyi 'gyur ba ci byung ba thams cad hu gis sgras sngar bzhin bsre bar bya'o/ /cho 'phrul lhar snang ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes par bya zhing / gnod byed rnams la snying rje drag tu sgom zhing smon lam btab/ lus dang longs spyod rang phyogs kyi sde dang bcas pa gang la yang zhen pa rdul tsam med par bya zhing / bde sdug bzang ngan gtam snyan mi snyan sogs/ chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa phra mo ci byung ba kun yang dbyings su thim par bya'o/ /mi mthun phyogs bsal ba 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor bogs 'don dang bcas pa la cung zad myong ba thon nas sgom par bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la dngos dang yan lag go /dang po la/ pu ra ka ste dgang pa dang / re tsa ka ste dbyung ba'am/rdul mtha' can dang / bhu myang ga ste/ sa'i yan lag dang / ku spa ka ste bum pa can dang / tru ṭa ka ste gzhil ba'am rengs pa/ dang po pu ra ka la gnyis kyi sgra bcas ni/ lus gnad bcas la/ rlud phyir gsang ba lan 'ga' re bya/ sems sna rtser gtad la/ rlung phyir sangs te bus la/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe dal bus shugs 'phri zhing / sna'i rtsa ba'i bar ka la rlung bdar bas a yig gi sgra dang bcas pa yun ring du drangs shing / de'i tshe shes pa lte bar gtad/ drangs pa rdzogs pa na/ cung zad cig rlung lte bar mnan/ yang btang ste sngar bzhin drangs/ de nyid rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /—380—

————sgra med la slob pa ni/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la/ rlung dal bus sna'i bu ga'i dbus nas drangs pas/ sgra med du 'gyur ro/ /re tsa ka la'ang gnyis kyi sgra bcas ni/ rlung ro lan 'ga' bsal la/ nang du myur bar rngubs/ sna rtse nas sor bzhi tsam gzhal ba'i nam mkha' la sems gtad de/ dal bus rlung phyir btang ste/ sna'i sbubs kyi bar ka la gdar bas/ sgra dang bcas par 'gyur te/rlung phyir 'gro ba rdzogs pa na/ cung zad cig phyir drag tu mnan/ lus dang snang ba thams cad stong sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de nyid yang nas yang du sgom par bya'o/ /sgra med ni/ dal bus rang babs su gtong ba ste/ gzhan ni 'dra'o/ /gsum pa bhu myang ga ni/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yas sna spyi bo dang / mas sna lte bar phyin pa/ spyi bo la zla ba dang / lte bar nyi ma/ khams dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin rtsa mdud bral ma kha mthur bstan sprul nag po lta bu lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar dbu ma la dkris shing / mgrin pa nas mjug ma mdun du 'byogs te lce rtser slem pa zhig sgom/ rlung ro bsal te/ rlung dal bus rngubs pas/ zla ba las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung / dbu ma gang ste/ lte ba na skya chil li li 'dug par bsam/ rngub pa rdzogs pa na/ dal bus phyir btang bas/ lte ba'i nyi ma las rak+ta'i rgyun byung ba dkar po dang 'dres pas/ bdud bral ma mas yar rim gyi khengs/ lce rtse'i bar du thig le dkar dmar gyi khyab par bsam 'di rgyud nas gsal kha mi 'byung bas/ rdzogs rim 'di'i skabs su ma bstan kyang rung bar mngon/ bzhi pa bum pa can la/ dang por rlung ro bsal zhing / rlung dal bus rngubs nas lte bar drag tu mnan/ thur sel rang dgar bzhag /kha —381—

nang nas rlung yang nas yang du mid pas/ rang lus lha sku khang stong du gnas pa de rgya je che je che la 'gro bar bsam ste/ 'di la dmigs skor gcig tu mdzad/yang gzhan 'dra ba la/ rang lus rtsa gsum dang bcas pa gsal 'debs shing /thur sel drag tu 'then nas kha sbyor sgom pa ste/ 'di bum pa can dngos yin no/ /lnga pa tru ṭa ka ni/ rlung ro bsal la mig gnyis dpral ba'i dbyings su drag tu gtad/ rlung nang du sas te/ lte bar steng 'og kha sbyor byas pa/ de nyid g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dbus rnams su gnon 'then drag tu byed cing /sems kyi ci yang mi bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan lus la nye bar mkho ba rnams te/ rgyud las/ ha zhes bya bas mchog tu dga' ba'i tshe bcing bar bya'o/ /yang na hu zhes bya ba snying ga la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /yang na sbru ha zhes bya ba mgrin pa la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /hu dang phaṭa kyi bya ba dang / mda' bo che'i sbyor ba byas la khu ba bcing bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang cha bzhi pa'i phyed kyi mtshams su/ lhan cig skyes pa sgom par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po ha yig gi las ni/ gsang bar ha ser po zhig sgom la/ ngag tu ha zhes dal la ring ba khong shugs che ba brjod pas/ ha yig de nyid gyen du byung / kha nas phyi rol du rgyang gyis thon par bsam/ mthar ha yig drag tu brjod pas/ rlung phyir drag tu bus/yang dal bus rngub pa sngar bzhin bya/ gnyis pa hū 'dren ni/ lte bar hū gcig sgom/ kha btsum zhing sre ba'i sbubs nas hu dal la ring ba sna sgo nas brjod/ hu de lte ba nas dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi gtsug tshang bug tu sleb par bsam zhing /mthar hu thung drag po zhig brjod/ gsum pa sbru 'dren ni lkog mas ol mdud —382—

mnan nas khyi ring po lan mang du ma chad par brjod cing / rlung phyir drag tu btang / mthar rdzogs mtshams su ha zhes shugs phyung la drag tu brjod pas/snying ga nas/ rlung drod kyi rang bzhin kha dog dmar po zhig phyur gyis song la spyi bo nas thon par bsam/ bzhi pa ni rdo rje nor bur hūX yig sngon po 'od 'bar ba mgo bo gyen du bstan pa zhig bsam/ snga ma dang 'dra bar hūṃ ring gis rlung phyir ston pas/ huX yig de nyid dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas/ spyi bo'i steng du thon par bsam/ hūṃ thung gis rngubs te phaṭa ces dran pas/ 'og rlung 'then/ kha sbyor stod du drag tu bsgril bas/ dbu ma mas sna nas yar thung ril li li 'gril te/ spyi bor gong bu gcig tu gyur pa la sems gtad/ lnga pa ni/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i ngang nas/glo bur du bshang sgor drag tu sdigs la/ cung zad cig mnan/yang kha spyor byed pa sogs/ de nyid skyar gyin sgom pa yin no/ /rlung sbyor de rnams kyi phan yon ni/ dgang ba'i spyor bas grang ba dang / /gzhan yang sked pa'i nad sel zhing / /rmu chu la sogs pa sel/ drod skye ba dang / stong nyams shas che bar 'gyur/ dbyung bas ni/ mgo bo'i nad dang / mig nad dang / ro stod 'tshang ba dang / shes pa 'phyo ba la sogs pa sel lo/ /gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing / /lus ldang ba yang bar 'gyur ro/ /bhu myung ga ni/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog cing tshe ring bar byed pa'o/ /bum/ pa can ni/ yon tan de thams cad byed cing / gzhan yang / chur mi bying ba sogs/ 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa rnams rnam par gnon/ t+yā ṭa kas ni/ srog thur gong bu gcig tu byed cing / ma zhu ba la sogs khong pa'i nad thams cad 'joms/ tshiX'adren gyi dga' ba'i ye shes —383—

brtan/ snying rlung dang stod 'tshang la sogs pa sel bar byed/ hū 'dren gyi bgegs kyi bar chad mi 'jug cing / mchog dga'i ye shes brtan par byed/ khyo 'dren gyi gre ba'i nad sel zhing / khyad dga'i ye shes brtan par byed/ hu phaṭa kyi mda' gzhus lhan skyes spyi bor brtan cing / snga ma thams cad kyi bya ba byed/ cha bzhi pa'i mtshams kyi sbyor bas/ kun+da brtan pa dang / srog thur bsre ba yin no/ /de thams cad kyang rlung sems dbu mar 'ching bar byed cing / rtsa mdud 'joms pa dang / snyigs ma'i lus dag pa'i skur yongs su bsgyur ba ste/ dang po lnga ni 'khor lo bzhi la sogs par kun+da brtan par byed pa dang / de nas bzhis kun+da 'dren pa dang / phyi ma ni 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang seng ge rnam rol la sogs pa ni thun mong du snang bas ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/rnal 'byor dang po bskyed rim cung zad brtan cing / rjes su rnal 'byor gyis lta ba la nyams myong cung zad thon nas/ rlung gis rnal 'byor gyis rtsa lam byang ba zhig gis/ dngos gzhi pho nya'i lam la 'jug pa yin te/ rgyud las/ 'di la dgang ba dang / gzhil ba dang / rengs pa dang bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ mi mo rnams kyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ lus 'di nyid kyis dngos grub thob pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bskul byed byed pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang / sngon goms pa'i rlung gi rnal 'byor rnams la brten nas/ dbab pa dang / bzung ba dang / bzlog pa dang / khyab pa dang ye shes su bskyal pa rnams rim can du bsgoms pas/ gtso bor las kyi phyag rgya dang / yan lag tu ye shes kyi phyag rgyas kyang rung ste/ gzhan lus la brten nas bde stong gi ye —384—

shes sgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ rnam pa gsum ste/ lus mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor/ ngag mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor/ sems mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor te gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'ji/ nyid kyi rgyud las/ lte ba'i dbus su re ga bsam/ /a ni mchog tu phra ba ste/ /mi 'gyur nyams dga' bde ba'i gnas/ /mi bshig tshangs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang nyid sgrol mar bsam pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo/ bzhi spyi dang 'dra bar bkod nas/ lte bar yi ge a'i gdangs can gyi/ re kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba zhig bsam la/ sngar bshad pa ltar bum pa can gyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ de las me rab tu 'bar ba dbu ma brgyud nas/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis po khyab pas/ de thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyi bor 'dus/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas lte bar thim/ re zhig me'i gdung ba zhi nas bde bas khyab par bsam de nyid rtag tu sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud las/ rang sngags hūX dang yi ge oX/ /rdo rje āXyig bsam par bya/ /rlung gi de nyid rab grub nas/ /mi 'gro drag po'i ngag tu 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ snga ma ltar gsal ba'i lte bar ut+pal dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ste bar zla ba la/ tāX yig sngon po sna tshogs pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ de'i steng du thig le phra mo āX'i gdangs dang ldan pa/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe tāX de las rlung gi ngo bo 'od dmar po'i gong bu lkoX gyi gdangs dang ldan pa bung ba lta bu'i zir sgra can zhig dbu ma nas brgyud/ spyi bo dang de nas rim pas smin mtshams kyi lam nas song / sna sgo nas thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab/ snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma rnams bdud —385—

rtsi'i rnam par gyur pa/ 'od kyi gong bu de nyid kyis bsdus shing bslangs nas/bung ba lta bu'i tshul gyis snga ma'i lam brgyud hūṃ gi gdangs dang bcas pas nang du byon/ de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste/ tā la thim/ bung ba me tog gi dbus su sgra phra mo 'byin cing 'khor ba ltar/ tā gyi thig le u yi gdangs su gnas par bsam la/ 'di la yang rlud gi sbyor ba ni kum pa ka la nan tan du sbyor ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni rgyud las/ 'od zer sna lnga snying gar gnas/ /pad+mas rdo rje rab dbye ba/ /thig le rdo rjer byed pa ste/ /ye shes khyab 'jug rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la'ang gzhi bca' ba snga ma bzhin/ snying ga chos 'khor gyi nye bar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le rtsa na ka'i tshad tsam 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba rtag tu bsgoms te/ srog thur bsres nas snying gar drangs/ snying gar bum can kha sbyor brtan par byas nas 'di nyid cung zad goms pa na/ shes rab kyi nā ra na si ka zhes bya ba'i rtsa'i/ dang por bde skyong gi 'khor lo dang / de nas sprul pa dang / bde chen gyi 'khor lo rab tu grol nas/ snying ga'i ma rig pa'i sgo nga rnam par 'byed par byed pa yin te/ des 'od gsal mchog la reg par 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis snying ga'i bum pa can cung zad brtan nas/ a pa na bhañja zhes bya ba'i man ngag zhig ston par mdzad mod kyi/ lag len rtsub pa zhig snang bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i rim pa de rnams spyod pa gsum gyi mtshams sbyar nas/ dngos grub dzhai sngu sna dan nags kyi dpa/ ༵/ hūṃ~X ༵rdo gar ro ༵pa rjo rdo~X can /'a//snra —386—

ldan yid kyi gdung sel gang zhig mos dga'i lang tshos mchog tu bskal bzang dga' ma'i yid kyi lcags kyu ste/ /mtha' dag srid gsum rol pa'i chu mtshor rnyog bral zhabs sen zla ris nam yang 'god mkhas rje btsun bla ma de'i/ /gsung gi 'od dkar rnam par spro bas dge legs rab byin ge sar lang tsho bzhad pa'i ku mud rmad byung ba/ /gang 'di blo gros 'dab rgyas zab don gyi/ /sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas thar 'dod mig yangs ma'i/ /mgo dang rna ba'i rgyan du rtag 'god pa/ /yon tan ldan pa'i rang bzhin su yi 'gog /rigs sngags 'chang dbang mi bdag tshul 'dzin pas/ /rnam par bskul phyir sngon med lam gyi srol/ /tā ra nā thas phyogs tsam brjod pa yi/ /dge ba de yang sems can kun la bsngo/ /zhes pa'ang rang lo nyer bdun pa la g.yo ru gong dkar gyi pho brang du sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel// zhus dag/ bkra shis//bdag gis dge ba gang bsags 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde mchog spel ba'i/ /bla na med pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid gyur cig /ces pa'i dge ba bsngo ba 'di ma tis bris// //387—

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mjos 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spe 5shu'i/ra ri1la 'di ni/la5/deb re lnga pa/༄tsho/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/( 23(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang bis bsgrigs/:krung bo'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dang/ra btab/spyi lo2008lo'i zla 4par par sa zhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo2008lo'i zla4par par thengs dang po brtabadapar grangs 0001——150015/)sa978——7—— 80253——0 13——3(2 5———————— ———sdi—————— ———————— — —— ——gsung 'bum cha tshang ( deb 1—45yod 〉 la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khru/gas pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /lkolkopho༈ 4bza1lkosbyo /4 pa1thro//smya4'athru phro byu 4skru mi sgo mi ste rtsa 4 lko 3byu4tsho khu ske 4 ste cha02snro༈smo1sdus7khung1༈’ smo1tshi〉tshi11 tshi༈༈tshi1smo0skya'i smo1501khu smo0khu 1lo'i snga1༈sku khu sha ༷ 7༈༈khri'u0smo'u pa snga’5(smo0smo lnga sku01smo spya stusmo0pakha༈smo0sdu༈0110〉sga/tshi50sdu0rto61po khri’ 01sku8tha khya’ sdu10smos0bya bya’klus spu sku0tshi༈smo’stu10pa༈khri khu00'u tshis0sha sdu'i smo1bya'i smo'i nya smo1tshi51 6khu⑥'i11601smo lnga bya

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar ye ni zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
